# 2021: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 8,350 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2021.sqlite](2021.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `a31266b879d359a6e605567b8511e56ffc8f3440b75cf2adb8daf9cd930e4864`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.0`. Date: 2026-10-21.

Original entries without attached citations: 1. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 1; partial: 0; without a full-event review: 8,349. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2021-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256032349](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20January%201&oldid=1256032349>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-01-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A roadside bomb kills two members of the Egyptian Armed Forces and injures five others near Bir al-Abd in the North Sinai Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/police-egypt-middle-east-islamic-state-group-bombings-94f6eadebb7c9ecd430f652192fd2ca1>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** Six militia members are killed during clashes between the Nduma Defense of Congo-Renovated and Mai-Mai Kabido in Bukumbirwa.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Okapi](<https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/01/03/actualite/securite/nouvel-au-nord-kivu-6-miliciens-morts-dans-des-combats-entre-deux>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** On New Year's Day, Pope Francis livestreams his message from the library of the Apostolic Palace. He states "the Virgin Mary’s motherly care encourages us to use our God-given time for building up the world and peace, not destroying it." In the Catholic Church, January 1 is the Solemnity of Mary, the Holy Mother of God.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-francis-with-marys-help-fill-the-new-year-with-spiritual-growth-50199>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-01-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Tribistovo poisoning.

**Archived source account.** Eight people aged 19 die from carbon monoxide poisoning in a cottage in Tribistovo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, during a New Year's celebration, after carbon monoxide leaks from a generator used to power a heater.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/new-years-eve-holidays-carbon-monoxide-poisoning-poisoning-sarajevo-3456a032b215f414f292edfc1b3eb7eb>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England / COVID-19 pandemic in London.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom Secretary of State for Education Gavin Williamson announces that all primary schools in London will remain closed for at least two weeks at the start of the new term on January 4. It was previously announced that only schools in 23 of the 32 boroughs would be closed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-55511169>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in the Isle of Man, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** The Isle of Man reports two cases of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-isle-of-man-55503507>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** Turkey reports its first 15 cases of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in people who traveled from the United Kingdom and later tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-suspends-entries-from-uk-after-15-cases-of-new-covid-19-variant/news>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** Turkey bans all travelers from the United Kingdom due to the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/turkey-europe-coronavirus-pandemic-united-kingdom-84176d598340dee3ada03748752a6fd3>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France announces it will tighten curfews in 15 departments beginning tomorrow at 6:00 p.m. local time in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20210101-france-tightens-covid-19-curfew-in-worst-affected-areas>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Norway.

**Archived source account.** Norway will lift its ban on flights from the United Kingdom beginning tomorrow at 4:00 p.m. GMT.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/norway-uk-travel-ban-lifted-flights-b1781203.html>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** India approves the emergency use of the vaccine developed by the University of Oxford and AstraZeneca, becoming the third country in the world to do so after the United Kingdom and Argentina.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/1/astrazeneca-vaccine-set-to-become-first-one-approved-in-india>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel, COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** Israel becomes the first country to vaccinate at least 10% of its population against COVID-19, with around 950,000 doses already administered.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/health-science/israel-has-vaccinated-over-10-times-more-of-its-population-than-the-us-653966>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-21"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia extends the recovery phase of the Movement Control Order (MCO) nationwide except for Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, and Sabah as well as other locations under a conditional and enhanced MCO until March 31 due to a substantial increase in the number of new cases.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-extends-recovery-movement-control-order-to-mar-31>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-23"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines includes the United States in its travel ban of countries and territories reported to have new variants of SARS-CoV-2, which comes into effect on January 3. The move comes after the United States reported its first case of a new variant from the United Kingdom on December 30.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-01/01/c_139634794.htm>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-25"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore, 501.V2 Variant.

**Archived source account.** The Singaporean Ministry of Health announces that long-term pass holders and short-term visitors who had travel history to South Africa over the past 14 days will be not allowed to enter Singapore starting January 4, due to reports of a more contagious variant of SARS-CoV-2 circulating in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/travel/singapore-to-block-entry-to-visitors-from-south-africa/story-GPsiXvkf4Cjndw5uA14KcI.html>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-27"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** Bangkok will close all schools, daycare centers for both children and seniors, preschools and tutoring centers from January 4 to 17. Other public facilities will be closed beginning January 2. This comes as the authorities tighten measures to reduce the spread of a new wave of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/bangkok-to-close-schools-for-two-weeks-as-number-of-covid-19-13877296>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-30"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in California.

**Archived source account.** California reports a record 585 new deaths in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [KABC-TV](<https://abc7.com/california-covid-deaths-record-covid19-covid-19/9269869>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-31"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States surpasses 20 million cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-surpasses-20-million-cases-of-coronavirus-on-first-day-of-2021/>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-33"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Chad.

**Archived source account.** Chadian President Idriss Déby signs a decree that imposes a lockdown in the country's capital N'Djamena for the first time since the pandemic began and also declares a dusk-to-dawn curfew due to a rise in the number of cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/healthNews/idUSKBN2961XC?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-3-35"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Uruguay.

**Archived source account.** Uruguay reports a record of 12 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 193.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://www.elpais.com.uy/informacion/salud/coronavirus-record-muertes-casos-activos-tasa-positividad-alta.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-01-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Taiwanese President Tsai Ing-wen says that she is ready to have talks with China and urges the country to have dialogues with Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-01-01/taiwan-president-urges-china-to-pursue-dialog-not-conflict>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action, Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The International Atomic Energy Agency says Iran has notified it of its intention to enrich uranium to 20% purity, in accordance with a law recently passed by the Islamic Consultative Assembly. Iran did not specify when this enrichment would begin. The December 2020 bill, adopted after the assassination of Iranian nuclear scientist Mohsen Fakhrizadeh, instructs the government to increase uranium enrichment if sanctions against Iran are not eased within two months.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20210101-iran-says-it-will-enrich-uranium-up-to-20-percent-un-nuclear-watchdog-says>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-55509048>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The African Continental Free Trade Area, the largest free-trade area since the formation of the World Trade Organization in 1995, commences.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/1/1/after-months-of-covid-delays-african-free-trade-bloc-launches>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-01-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Cannabis in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Initiative 190 comes into effect in Montana, making it the 13th state to legalize recreational cannabis.

Source citations (as archived): [Great Falls Tribune](<https://www.greatfallstribune.com/story/news/2020/12/30/montana-law-take-effect-residents-can-grow-possess-pot/4086023001/>); [KRTV](<https://www.krtv.com/news/montana-and-regional-news/now-legal-in-montana-recreational-use-of-marijuana>).

<a id="event-2021-01-01-5-3"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests in Portland, Oregon, 2020–2021 United States racial unrest.

**Archived source account.** On December 31 and into the early hours of January 1, protesters and police clashed in a New Year's Eve protest which police declared a riot shortly before midnight, alleging the demonstrators' use of violence. Within 30 minutes, police advanced on the demonstration, protesters used fireworks while officers shot pepper balls, rubber bullets, and other "less-lethal munitions". In the wake of the protests, the Portland Police Bureau order all people in the area to leave immediately. Authorities have not stated the number of protesters arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/news/532298-protesters-police-clash-in-portland-during-new-years-eve-riot>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-01-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate votes 81–13 to override President Donald Trump's veto of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021. This is the first successful veto override of the Trump presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/senate-gives-trump-first-veto-override-defense-spending-bill-2021-1>).

### 2021-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1344228137](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20January%202&oldid=1344228137>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-01-02-0-3"></a>

Context: War on terror / Insurgency in the Maghreb / 2021 Tillabéri attacks.

**Archived source account.** At least 79 civilians are killed and 20 others are injured when Islamist militants attack two villages simultaneously in Tillabéri, Niger, near the border with Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-niger-security/at-least-70-killed-in-suspected-militant-attacks-in-niger-security-sources-idUKKBN2970M2?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-01-02-0-4"></a>

Context: War on terror / Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** Two Algerian People's National Army personnel and four militants are killed during a gunfight in Messelmoun, Algeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-01/02/c_139637181.htm>).

<a id="event-2021-01-02-0-7"></a>

Context: War on terror / Mali War / Operation Barkhane.

**Archived source account.** Two French Army personnel are killed when their armoured personnel carrier hit a roadside bomb in Ménaka, Mali. ### 2021-01-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1358339921](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20January%206&oldid=1358339921>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-01-06-0-2"></a>

Context: 2020–21 United States election protests / January 6 United States Capitol attack.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of pro-Trump protesters storm the United States Capitol, causing it to be evacuated. Washington, D.C. mayor Muriel Bowser proclaimed a citywide nighttime curfew. Shots were fired, and at least six people were injured. A woman died from gunshot wounds by Police, according to police. Multiple members of Congress called this an attempted coup d'état. The FBI, police, and National Guard from Maryland, Virginia, and D.C. itself were deployed to stop the riot. Smoke bombs and pepper spray were also used. Multiple suspected pipe bombs were reported, including at the Republican Party headquarters.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/explosive-device-found-rnc-suspicious-211307027.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/dc-md-va/2021/01/06/dc-protests-trump-rally-live-updates/>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/congress-electoral-college-vote-count-2021/h_eed8c8ac9a408646998937a9da353acf>); [WREX-TV](<https://wrex.com/2021/01/06/nbc-person-shot-at-us-capitol-has-died/>).

<a id="event-2021-01-06-0-3"></a>

Context: 2020–21 United States election protests / January 6 United States Capitol attack.

**Archived source account.** U.S President pro tempore Chuck Grassley announces that the United States Senate has entered recess as Senator James Lankford (R-OK) was given out a speech, with an aide informing Lankford that pro-Trump protesters were entering the building. Additionally, the U.S. House enters a recess.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/house-senate-go-into-recess-amid-trump-supporter-protests-2021-1>); [KOCO-TV](<https://www.koco.com/article/we-do-not-encourage-what-happened-today-lankford-delivers-powerful-speech-following-chaos-in-dc/35144032>).

<a id="event-2021-01-06-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parler app is suspended indefinitely from the App Store by Apple Inc. Additionally, Amazon also announces that they will discontinue providing cloud services for Parler due to incitement of violence, which will go into effect on Sunday at 11:59 p.m. Pacific time.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/01/09/tech/parler-suspended-apple-app-store/index.html>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/01/09/amazon-drops-parler-from-its-web-hosting-service.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** At least six park rangers in the Virunga National Park in Rutshuru, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, are killed in an ambush. A Mai-Mai militia is suspected to have committed the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/at-least-six-dr-congo-park-rangers-killed-in-attack-01610288103?tesla=y>).

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** The Ethiopian National Defense Force says that it has killed 15 members of the Tigray People's Liberation Front, including the region's former deputy police commissioner, and captured eight others, including the region's former president Abay Weldu.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict/ethiopian-military-says-it-killed-15-members-of-rebellious-tigray-forces-captured-8-others-idUSKBN29F0JF>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-01-10-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Kazakh legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Legislative elections are held in Kazakhstan. The election is criticized for a lack of opposition to the leading party Nur Otan and is therefore expected to be considered neither free nor fair by international observers.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe](<https://www.rferl.org/a/kazakhstan-parliamentary-elections-2021/31040109.html>).

**Archived source account.** Presidential elections are held in Kyrgyzstan following last year's political unrest and the resignation of President Sooronbay Jeenbekov. Interim Prime Minister Sadyr Japarov is widely expected to win the election. The question of keeping the current parliamentary system or reintroducing a presidential system is also presented to the electorate in the form of a referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kyrgyzstan-election/nationalist-politician-likely-to-win-kyrgyz-presidential-vote-idUSKBN29F01T>); [Radio Free Europe](<https://www.rferl.org/a/japarov-kyrgyzstan-presidential-election-referendum-/31040110.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-politics/north-korea-says-leader-kim-elected-as-general-secretary-of-ruling-party-kcna-idUSKBN29F0OD>).

Context: Syrian civil war / Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War / Syria missile strikes (January 2021).

**Archived source account.** Israel carries out a wave of airstrikes on Syria's eastern Deir ez-Zor Governorate, near its border with Iraq. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports that 57 people have been killed and 28 others injured in at least 18 Israeli airstrikes, saying that several Iranian arms depots were hit. A senior U.S. intelligence official says that the air raids were carried out with "intelligence provided by the U.S."

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/intense-israeli-airstrikes-kill-23-in-eastern-syria>).

<a id="event-2021-01-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Pro-François Bozizé forces attack the Central African Republic capital of Bangui, with fighting reported on multiple fronts, according to Prime Minister Firmin Ngrébada. A Reuters witness reports explosions and helicopters circling over the city. The attack is successfully repelled by the Central African Armed Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-centralafrica-security/rebels-attack-central-african-republics-capital-idUSKBN29I0ZI>).

<a id="event-2021-01-13-0-6"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Rwanda Defence Force peacekeeper is killed in a rebel attack, according to MINUSCA officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhuanet](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-01/14/c_139666640.htm>).

<a id="event-2021-01-13-0-8"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Three Ivorian UN peacekeepers are killed and six others wounded in a jihadist ambush on their vehicle in central Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210114-three-ivorian-un-peacekeepers-killed-in-mali-attack>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-01-13-1-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol.

<a id="event-2021-01-13-1-3"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests in Australia, List of name changes due to the George Floyd protests.

**Archived source account.** Dairy company Saputo announces that Coon cheese, its brand of cheddar cheese in Australia, will be rebranded as "Cheer" cheese, in response to a 20-year campaign by indigenous rights activist Stephen Hagan to remove the usage of the word "Coon", in reference to a racial slur. The new branding will be released in July.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://manilastandard.net/news/world-news/344298/australian-cheese-rebrands-after-20-year-racism-battle.html>).

<a id="event-2021-01-13-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Spanish telecommunications company Telefónica announces that it will sell its cell sites in Europe and Latin America, which are owned by its subsidiary Telxius, to American company American Tower for an estimated €7.7 billion (US$9.4 billion).

Source citations (as archived): [Buenos Aires Times](<https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/economy/telefonica-sells-mobile-phone-masts-in-europe-latin-america-for-77-bn-euros.phtml>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-55674146>).

<a id="event-2021-01-15-6-8"></a>

Context: 2021 Palestinian general election.

**Archived source account.** President Mahmoud Abbas announces that the legislative elections will be held on May 22, while the presidential elections will be held on July 31. These are the first elections in the State of Palestine since 2006.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1793536/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2021-01-15-6-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Lao People's Revolutionary Party elects Prime Minister Thongloun Sisoulith as its new General Secretary, replacing retiring chief Bounnhang Vorachit. Sisoulith was elected for a five-year term as leader of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the top post in the country, and part of the country's Politburo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-laos-politics/laos-communist-party-names-pm-thongloun-as-new-leader-idUSKBN29K0YU>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-01-15-7-1"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on association football, COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

**Archived source account.** FC Barcelona postpones its presidential election originally scheduled for January 24, following an increase in COVID-19 cases in Catalonia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/soccer/barcelona-delays-presidential-elections-because-of-pandemic/2021/01/15/194ba592-5742-11eb-acc5-92d2819a1ccb_story.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-01-16-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of residents flee and government forces withdraw after the town of Marte in Borno State, Nigeria, is captured by Islamic State – West Africa Province militants. The military says it "tactically withdrew" troops, while confirming the town is under insurgent control.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-nigeria-security/residents-flee-islamist-insurgent-attack-on-town-in-northeast-nigeria-idUSKBN29M04T>).

<a id="event-2021-01-16-1-0"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina.

Laschet's election makes him a front-runner to be the party's candidate in the federal election in September.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-01-17-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks; Taliban insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Two judges, both female, are shot dead in an ambush while en-route to their offices at the Supreme Court in Kabul; their driver is wounded. Afghan officials claim the Taliban is responsible, however no one has claimed responsibility for the attack and a spokesman for the Taliban, Zabihullah Mujahid, says that the group was not responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/17/two-afghan-women-judges-shot-dead-in-kabul-ambush>).

Context: War in Darfur / 2021 Darfur clashes.

**Archived source account.** Eighty-three people are killed during clashes between different ethnic groups in El Geneina, West Darfur, Sudan. They started after a row in which a man was stabbed to death.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55695118>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-01-17-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Sulawesi earthquake.

**Archived source account.** More bodies are found under debris in Sulawesi, Indonesia, after a magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck the island two days ago, bringing the death toll to 78.

<a id="event-2021-01-17-1-2"></a>

<a id="event-2021-01-17-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in California.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** Massachusetts reports their first case of a more contagious variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a woman in her 20s from Boston who traveled to the United Kingdom and began experiencing symptoms the day after she returned.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil, COVID-19 vaccine.

<a id="event-2021-01-17-2-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil, COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** Minutes after Anvisa's announcement, a nurse from São Paulo becomes the first person in Brazil to receive a COVID-19 vaccine.

<a id="event-2021-01-17-2-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Austria.

**Archived source account.** Austria extends their nationwide lockdown until February 7 in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19 amid fears about new SARS-CoV-2 variants. People will also be required to wear full protective masks beginning January 25.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/de/%C3%B6sterreich-bis-7-februar-im-corona-lockdown/a-56254093>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-01-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol.

**Archived source account.** Otero County Commissioner Couy Griffin, the founder of "Cowboys for Trump", is arrested for his involvement during the storming of the United States Capitol, in which he allegedly entered restricted area during the riot. He claimed to be planning to drive to Washington, D.C. with a rifle and revolver.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-protests-arrests/new-mexico-official-who-vowed-to-protest-biden-inauguration-arrested-in-washington-idUSKBN29M0RV>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/cowboys-trump-founder-arrested-after-allegedly-leading-capitol-rioters-prayer-n1254559>).

<a id="event-2021-01-17-3-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol.

**Archived source account.** Gracyn Courtright, a West Virginia student who is a senior at the University of Kentucky, is charged for entering the United States Capitol during the riot.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2021/01/17/university-of-kentucky-senior-charged-over-alleged-capitol-riot-role/>); [The Kentucky Kernel](<http://www.kykernel.com/news/i-thought-it-was-cool-uk-student-charged-in-d-c-court-for-participation-in/article_6e26ed92-5922-11eb-8ec8-fbb53195ee20.html>); [Heavy.com](<https://heavy.com/news/gracyn-courtright/>).

<a id="event-2021-01-17-3-4"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the poisoning of Alexei Navalny.

**Archived source account.** Opposition politician and anti-corruption activist Alexei Navalny is arrested upon landing in Moscow, according to a statement from the prison service. The prominent Putin critic was arrested on charges of parole violations and terms of a suspended prison sentence and will be held in custody until a court makes a decision in his case.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2021/01/17/navalny-russia-putin-arrest-459973>).

<a id="event-2021-01-17-3-6"></a>

Context: Central American migrant caravans.

**Archived source account.** A caravan of at least 6,000 Honduran migrants bound for the United States prompts the deployment of Guatemalan police and military troops to the Guatemala–Honduras border, where security forces fire tear gas and assault migrants attempting to cross the border. Health officials report several casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ibtimes.com/guatemala-police-fire-tear-gas-us-bound-migrant-caravan-afp-3124146>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-01-18-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks; Taliban insurgency.

<a id="event-2021-01-18-0-4"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two United Nation peacekeepers, from Gabon and Morocco, are killed in an ambush by anti-balaka insurgents near Bangassou, Central African Republic, according to MINUSCA.

Source citations (as archived): [Relief Web](<https://reliefweb.int/report/central-african-republic/two-un-peacekeepers-killed-ambush-central-african-republic>).

<a id="event-2021-01-18-0-6"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces and pro-government troops clash in the port city of Al Hudaydah, leaving at least 23 people dead. The fighting centered around the government-controlled Ad Durayhimi District in the south of the city. Houthi-run Almasirah network claims "dozens" of government fighters have been killed.

<a id="event-2021-01-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Muhyiddin Yassin announces a new RM15 billion economic assistance package, the Malaysian Economic and Rakyat Protection Assistance Package, which is expected to reduce the impact of COVID-19 on the Malaysian economy.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-01-18-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in China / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong reports 107 new confirmed cases, which is the first time in nearly a month that more than 100 cases are reported and brings the total number of confirmed cases in the city to 9,664. This sudden rise in cases is partially due to an outbreak among ethnic minorities.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://amp.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/health-environment/article/3118122/hong-kong-fourth-wave-mandatory-covid-19-testing>).

<a id="event-2021-01-18-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkey's Information and Communication Technologies Authority bans advertisements on Twitter, Periscope and Pinterest after these companies failed to appoint local representatives under a new social media law.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-twitter/turkey-slaps-ad-ban-on-twitter-under-new-social-media-law-idUSKBN29O0CT>).

<a id="event-2021-01-19-6-3"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Scientists discover that WASP-107b is a super-puff. WASP-107b is an exoplanet the same size as Jupiter but with one tenth the mass, located 212 light years away from Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/astronomers-discover-super-puff-gas-giant-exoplanet-wasp-107b-jupiter/>); [Sci-News](<http://www.sci-news.com/astronomy/super-puff-exoplanet-wasp-107b-09262.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-01-20-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Three Afghan soldiers are killed and four others are wounded in an attack on their vehicle by unidentified gunmen in Herat Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Tolo News](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-169375>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-01-20-1-1"></a>

Context: Events affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Dublin cancels their annual Saint Patrick's Day festival for the second year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The event will instead be held virtually on a special online TV channel.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<https://www.rte.ie/news/2021/0120/1190884-st-patricks-festival/>).

Context: Events affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Cork, Limerick, and Ennis have all cancelled their respective Saint Patrick's Day parades for the second year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<https://www.rte.ie/news/munster/2021/0120/1191023-st-patricks-day-parades/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-01-20-2-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Madrid explosion.

**Archived source account.** An explosion caused by a gas leak at a residence for priests in Madrid, Spain results in four fatalities and injures ten others. It also partially destroys the residence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/BigStory12/idUSKBN29P1SU>).

<a id="event-2021-01-20-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A boat carrying migrants from West Africa capsizes in the Mediterranean Sea off the coast of Libya, resulting in 43 fatalities.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20210120-at-least-43-african-migrants-drown-off-libya-un-agencies-say>).

<a id="event-2021-01-20-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion caused by coal dust and air in a thermal power plant in Angren, Uzbekistan kills three workers and leaves three others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-01/20/c_139684397.htm>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-01-20-4-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese foreign ministry places sanctions on 28 members of the outgoing Trump administration, including former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo, former National Security Advisor John Bolton, and former White House Chief Strategist Steve Bannon. The sanctions are believed to be in response to Pompeo's announcement on Tuesday that the internment of Muslim Uyghurs constitutes genocide.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-pompeo-blinken/china-imposes-sanctions-on-28-trump-era-officials-including-pompeo-idUSKBN29P14K?utm_source=reddit.com>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-01-20-5-2"></a>

Context: Presidency of Joe Biden / Inauguration of Joe Biden.

**Archived source account.** Joe Biden is sworn in as the 46th President of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/world-us-canada-55740014>).

<a id="event-2021-01-20-5-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Joe Biden / Inauguration of Joe Biden.

**Archived source account.** Kamala Harris is sworn in as the 49th Vice President of the United States, making her the first woman, first Indian American in United States history to hold the office.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/kamala-harris-sworn-in/2021/01/20/a184a12e-5aa9-11eb-b8bd-ee36b1cd18bf_story.html>).

<a id="event-2021-01-20-5-4"></a>

Context: Presidency of Joe Biden / Inauguration of Joe Biden.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump becomes the first outgoing president to refuse to attend his successor's inauguration since Andrew Johnson, who did not attend Ulysses S. Grant's inauguration in 1869.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/01/19/us/politics/presidents-who-skipped-inaugurations.html>).

<a id="event-2021-01-20-5-6"></a>

Context: Presidency of Joe Biden / Cabinet of Joe Biden.

**Archived source account.** The Senate votes to confirm Avril Haines, Biden's nominee for United States Director of National Intelligence (DNI), 84-10. Haines is the first Biden appointee to be confirmed by the Senate, and the first woman to serve in the DNI.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/avril-haines-director-national-intelligence-senate-confirms/>).

<a id="event-2021-01-20-5-7"></a>

Context: Presidency of Joe Biden.

**Archived source account.** Biden signs his first executive orders reversing several Trump administration decisions, including rejoining the Paris Agreement and the World Health Organization, repealing 2017 travel bans, ending funding for the United States–Mexico border wall, and revoking the permit for the Keystone XL pipeline.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55738746>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/feature/nbc-out/biden-reverse-transgender-military-ban-imminently-white-house-says-n1254988?fbclid=IwAR2sPvvGIlJDc9JSarjHQ9eFauXDMQzBf95WzR-tjkfSbshEMIhBehZvSfQ>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2021/jan/20/joe-biden-executive-orders-day-one>).

<a id="event-2021-01-20-5-10"></a>

Context: 117th United States Congress / 2020 United States Senate election in Georgia, 2020 United States Senate special election in Georgia.

**Archived source account.** Jon Ossoff and Raphael Warnock of Georgia are officially sworn in as Senators of the United States Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2021/01/20/warnock-ossoff-sworn-in-giving-democrats-majority-senate/4217985001/>).

<a id="event-2021-01-20-5-11"></a>

Context: 117th United States Congress.

**Archived source account.** Alex Padilla of California is officially sworn in as Senator of the United States Senate, as an appointee replacing Kamala Harris.

Source citations (as archived): [LA Times](<https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2021-01-20/alex-padilla-sworn-in-as-californias-first-latino-senator>).

### 2021-01-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284008811](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20January%2021&oldid=1284008811>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-01-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A United States convoy consisting of 40 trucks and armored vehicles enters northeastern Syria from Iraq via the Al Waleed crossing.

Source citations (as archived): [i24 News](<https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/middle-east/1611293792-us-military-convoy-enters-northeast-syria-report>).

<a id="event-2021-01-21-0-5"></a>

Context: ISIL insurgency in Iraq / 2021 Baghdad bombings.

**Archived source account.** A suicide attack at an open market in Baghdad, Iraq, kills at least 32 people and injures 110 others. Attacks have been rare in the country since the 2017 military defeat of ISIL, making this incident one of the deadliest since then.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/BigStory12/idUSKBN29Q0W8>).

<a id="event-2021-01-21-0-7"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Central African Republic government declares a 15-day state of emergency after rebels attempt to surround and blockade the capital Bangui. Pro-François Bozizé loyalists and anti-balaka militias now control around two-thirds of the war torn nation.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/21/c-africa-declares-emergency-as-rebels-try-to-oust-president>).

#### Arts and culture

Context: Events affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England.

**Archived source account.** Organisers announce that the Glastonbury Festival has been cancelled for the second consecutive year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/jan/21/glastonbury-2021-officially-cancelled-due-to-covid-pandemic>).

**Archived source account.** Dubai suspends all entertainment permits issued by the emirate for establishments due to an increase in violations of COVID-19 health protocols.

Source citations (as archived): [Khaleej Times](<https://www.khaleejtimes.com/coronavirus-pandemic/covid-19-rules-dubai-suspends-entertainment-activities>).

<a id="event-2021-01-24-5-5"></a>

Context: Proposed second Scottish independence referendum.

**Archived source account.** Scottish First Minister Nicola Sturgeon says she intends to hold a "legal referendum" on independence since Brexit removed Scotland from the European Union against its will. Another referendum would require the approval of the United Kingdom's government, which Prime Minister Boris Johnson opposes.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/scotlands-leader-vows-push-independence-vote-75456906>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-01-24/sturgeon-seeks-legal-independence-vote-as-party-sets-out-plan>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-01-24-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully launches a record 143 satellites into orbit on a single rocket in its Transporter-1 mission. The payload consisted of 120 CubeSats, 12 microsatellites, 10 Starlink satellites, and 1 transfer stage. It is also the maiden flight of the SHERPA-FX satellite dispenser.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-55775977>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-01-24-7-1"></a>

Context: 2020 NFL season, 2020–21 NFL playoffs, Super Bowl LV.

**Archived source account.** The Tampa Bay Buccaneers beat the Green Bay Packers, 31-26, winning the 2020 NFC Championship and advancing to the Super Bowl. With the Super Bowl being held at the Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, this will be the first time an NFL team will play the championship game on their home field. They will play the Kansas City Chiefs, who beat the Buffalo Bills 38-24 in the 2020 AFC Championship.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/sports/football/nfl/nfl-championship-bucs-packers-bills-kansas-city-recap-nfl-1.5886054>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nfl-sports-tampa-bay-buccaneers-kansas-city-super-bowl-d6f4334e89b9c54f70bf16d0758a6492>).

His current whereabouts are unknown.

Five people are killed in the al-Shabaab attack, including a former military general; ten civilians are wounded. The three other attackers are shot dead during a gun battle with security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55879679>).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/world-news-netherlands-coronavirus-pandemic-dc8e693f15d80c9ab7cf5a1acb58b7ed>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-2-27"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Cyprus, Variant of Concern 202012/01.

**Archived source account.** Northern Cyprus reports its first case of B.1.1.7 variant in 16 samples that contracted SARS-CoV-2 variant first detected in the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/covid-19-variant-found-in-northern-cyprus/2138177>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-2-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission finalizes a deal to secure 300 million additional doses of the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/covid-vaccine-eu-orders-300-million-more-pfizer-shots/a-56502706>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-2-30"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina, Lineage P.1.

**Archived source account.** Argentina reports its first cases of two different Brazilian SARS-CoV-2 variants in two people infected with the P.1 variant and two others infected with the P.2 variant.

Source citations (as archived): [Semana](<https://www.semana.com/coronavirus/articulo/argentina-detecta-una-nueva-variante-del-coronavirus/202101/>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-2-32"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Rwanda.

**Archived source account.** Rwanda eases its lockdown in the capital Kigali and allows businesses to resume operations with up to 30% of essential staff.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/rwanda-eases-covid-19-lockdown-in-capital/2137274#>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-2-33"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of Vietnam reports that it has culled more than 100,000 poultry in 14 provinces so far this year in a bid to contain the spread of highly pathogenic H5N1 and H5N6 bird flu strains.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/vietnam-birdflu/vietnam-culls-100000-poultry-as-bird-flu-outbreaks-spread-idUSL4N2KE1GZ>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-02-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Greece–Israel relations, COVID-19 pandemic in Greece, COVID-19 pandemic in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sign an accord that would allow vaccinated travellers to visit freely between the two countries without any restrictions in order to revive their battered tourism sector.

Source citations (as archived): [Ekathimerini](<https://www.ekathimerini.com/262149/article/ekathimerini/news/greece-israel-sign-agreement-on-tourism-during-pms-visit>).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/02/08/germany-poland-sweden-to-expel-russian-diplomats-in-tit-for-tat-move-a72868>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-02-08-4-1"></a>

Context: Trial of Benjamin Netanyahu, corruption in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pleads not guilty to charges of bribery, breach of trust and fraud at the Jerusalem District Court.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-netanyahu-trial/netanyahu-pleads-not-guilty-to-corruption-as-trial-resumes-idUSKBN2A80JP?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-4-3"></a>

Context: Venezuelan refugee crisis.

**Archived source account.** The government of Colombia announces the legalization of undocumented Venezuelan migrants currently in the country, making them eligible to receive 10-year residency permits.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/access-to-health-care-health-statutes-colombia-venezuela-7767509edf281a6e0b394d4b0b187eca>).

Context: Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election, Trump–Raffensperger phone call.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/02/08/us/politics/trump-georgia-election-investigation.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-02-08-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests, aftermath of the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** A nationwide general strike takes place in Myanmar in response to the military coup with thousands marching in the capital Naypyidaw, where they clashed with riot police. Several injuries have been reported.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-55975746>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-5-2"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests, aftermath of the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** The military junta declares martial law in the country's second largest city Mandalay amid protests against the coup. Public gatherings of more than five people are banned, and a curfew from 8 p.m. until 4 a.m. has been imposed.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/martial-law-parts-myanmar-protests-military-coup-mandalay-14140170>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-5-4"></a>

Context: 2021 Somali presidential election.

**Archived source account.** An alliance of opposition parties ceases recognising Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed as the President of Somalia, and propose the creation of a "national council of lawmakers, opposition leaders and civil society" to govern the country as the President's term expires with no clear plan for succession.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-election/somalias-opposition-cease-recognising-president-as-election-row-escalates-idUSKBN2A80OD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-5-6"></a>

Context: 2018–2021 Haitian protests.

**Archived source account.** Haitian opposition names judge Joseph Mécène Jean-Louis from the Supreme Court the new interim President of Haiti to lead a "transitional government" after arguing that incumbent Jovenel Moïse's term has expired and calling on him to step down. The Organization of American States considers that Moïse's five-year term ends in 2022 as he took office in 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/02/08/americas/haiti-opposition-president-term-protests-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-08-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Palau National Congress passes a joint resolution supporting the decision made by President Surangel Whipps Jr. to leave the Pacific Islands Forum. The National Congress says that the "gentleman's agreement was not honored".

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/435992/palau-congress-backs-withdrawal-from-pacific-forum>).

Context: 2021 Australian Open, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports.

**Archived source account.** The Grand Slam of the Australian Open begins in Melbourne Park, three weeks later than originally scheduled due to the pandemic, with daily attendance capped at 30,000 people per day.

Source citations (as archived): [7 News](<https://7news.com.au/sport/tennis/australian-open-serves-up-quiet-day-one-c-2120076>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-02-09-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada / COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, COVID-19 drug development.

**Archived source account.** The Food and Drug Administration grants emergency use authorization for Eli Lilly and Company's combination antibody therapy bamlanivimab/etesevimab for use in COVID-19 positive adults and children aged 12 and older who are at high risk of severe disease.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-10/lilly-covid-antibody-combo-gets-u-s-emergency-use-authorization>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England.

**Archived source account.** Health Secretary Matt Hancock announces that all British and Irish residents returning from 33 "high-risk" countries will be charged £1,750 to stay in quarantine hotels in England for 10 days and that those who fail to do so or who violate COVID rules face fines of up to £10,000 or up to 10 years in jail.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-55995645>).

<a id="event-2021-02-09-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice/scotland-covid-hotel-quarantine-arrival-b1799754.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-09-2-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Austria.

**Archived source account.** Chancellor Sebastian Kurz announces a statewide isolation order in Tyrol beginning February 12 in order to prevent the spread of the 501.V2 variant. Residents will have to present a negative COVID-19 test result from the last 48 hours in order to leave the state.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/austria-restrict-movement-tyrol-variant-fears-75777121>).

<a id="event-2021-02-09-2-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis announces a near-full lockdown in the Attica region, which includes the capital Athens, from February 11 until February 28. All schools, churches, hair salons, and retail stores, with the exception of supermarkets and pharmacies, are ordered to close; and restaurants are only allowed to offer delivery services.

Source citations (as archived): [Ekathimerini](<https://www.ekathimerini.com/262195/article/ekathimerini/news/attica-to-enter-two-week-hard-lockdown-amid-rise-in-hospitalizations>).

<a id="event-2021-02-09-2-31"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** The government allows more businesses in retail sector and Mosques in most of Malaysia to reopen beginning tomorrow and allows restaurants to resume dine-in service with two people seat on the table despite COVID-19 cases in the country remains high.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-allows-more-businesses-to-reopen-including-dine-ins-at-restaurants>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan approves the emergency use of Russia's Sputnik V vaccine, becoming the third vaccine to be approved in the country after the Sinopharm and Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccines.

<a id="event-2021-02-09-2-35"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Equatorial Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Equatorial Guinea imposes a curfew from 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. local time for the first since the beginning of the pandemic and prohibits many leisure activities. The country also reduces domestic flights to once per day, and international flights to twice per week for domestic airlines and once per week for foreign airlines.

Source citations (as archived): [EWN](<https://ewn.co.za/2021/02/09/equatorial-guinea-imposes-curfew-as-virus-rebounds/amp>).

<a id="event-2021-02-09-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Baden-Württemberg overturns the nighttime curfew imposed since mid-December to stop the spread of COVID-19 following an emergency application. It means that the 8 p.m. to 5 a.m. curfew will be scrapped on February 11.

Klubrádió owner András Arató says that the station will appeal the decision at the Supreme Court.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Red Cross officials report that 80% of Tigray's 6 million people are unreachable. In the regional capital of Mekelle, which is now home to 250,000 displaced people, vaccines have expired and there are no longer any HIV or tuberculosis drugs.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/article/ethiopia-tigray-starvation-bc4b3d569137925c5c34d30ac1683664>); [Europe External Programme with Africa](<https://www.eepa.be/?p=4730>).

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) forces ambush Ethiopian and Eritrean troops in May Keyah, 50–60 kilometers south of Mekelle. Fighting between the TPLF and Ethiopia is also reported in Guya, Kola Tembien.

Context: Sriwijaya Air Flight 182.

<a id="event-2021-02-10-1-3"></a>

Context: Earthquakes in 2021.

A tsunami warning was issued with the Australian Bureau of Meteorology confirming that a tsunami was generated by the earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [The San Francisco Chronicle](<https://www.sfchronicle.com/local/earthquakes/quake-alerts/article/Magnitude-7-5-earthquake-strikes-southeast-of-the-15939087.php>); [Metro](<https://metro.co.uk/2021/02/10/new-zealand-tsunami-warning-after-7-9-earthquake-strikes-nearby-14057100/>); [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/tsunami-confirmed-after-7-7-magnitude-earthquake-in-south-pacific-report-2367789>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-02-10-4-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Pakistan commutes the death sentences of two schizophrenic prisoners after considering that if their illness makes them unable to comprehend the rationale of their crimes, the death sentence will not meet the ends of justice. The ruling is celebrated by human rights groups.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/pakistan-top-court-bars-execution-of-two-mentally-ill-prisoners/a-56520241>).

<a id="event-2021-02-10-4-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Russian protests.

**Archived source account.** A court in Russia orders the arrest of Alexei Navalny's ally Leonid Volkov for "appealing to minors to join illegal protests". Volkov, who lives in the European Union and who will not be extradited, said on Facebook that he will "ignore the charges".

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/russia-orders-arrest-of-top-aide-to-alexei-navalny/a-56522931>).

<a id="event-2021-02-10-4-5"></a>

Context: Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election, Trump–Raffensperger phone call.

**Archived source account.** Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis opens a criminal investigation into former U.S. President Donald Trump for attempting to overturn Joe Biden's victory in Georgia, including conducting a phone call with Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger where he pressured Raffensperger to "find enough votes" for him.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2021/02/10/966332808/georgia-district-attorney-is-investigating-trumps-call-to-overturn-election>).

<a id="event-2021-02-10-4-8"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/10/saudi-activist-loujain-al-hathloul-released-from-prison>).
