**Archived source account.** Mexico receives a shipment of 870,000 doses of the Oxford–AstraZeneca vaccine from India.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/mexico-gets-over-8-lakh-astrazeneca-vaccine-doses-from-india-2370622>).

<a id="event-2021-02-14-1-27"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand reports their first community cases of COVID-19 since January 24. The patients are a family from Auckland.

Source citations (as archived): [Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/world/oceania/new-zealand-reports-three-new-covid-19-local-cases-20210214-p572d3.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-14-1-29"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Rwanda.

**Archived source account.** Rwanda begins a COVID-19 vaccination programme with limited supplies of WHO-approved vaccines acquired through unnamed international partners, making it the first country in East Africa to begin its campaign. Healthcare workers and other high-risk groups will be the first to receive a vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/healthcoronavirus-rwanda/rwanda-says-begins-covid-19-vaccinations-idUSL1N2KK0EO>).

<a id="event-2021-02-14-1-30"></a>

**Archived source account.** Guinea declares a new Ebola epidemic after three people died and four others became ill in the country’s southeast.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/14/guinea-sees-first-ebola-deaths-since-2016>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-02-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Cyprus-Israel relations, COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus, COVID-19 pandemic in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Cypriot President Nicos Anastasiades and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announce an agreement to allow vaccinated travelers to travel between the countries without the need to quarantine in order to restore their countries' tourism industries.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/israel-cyprus-reach-tourism-deal-vaccinated-travelers-75892758>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-02-14-3-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** The leaders of the junta issue warnings to the public against harboring fugitives at the same time that arrest warrants are issued. Among the fugitives is democracy activist Min Ko Naing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/myanmar-coup-junta-fugitive-protesters-overnight-guests-14193522>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-02-14-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Catalan regional election.

**Archived source account.** Catalans head to the polls to elect the new Parliament of Catalonia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/spain-53-catalans-to-vote-in-test-of-separatist-movement/2021/02/14/5183b310-6e9d-11eb-a66e-e27046e9e898_story.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-14-4-2"></a>

Context: 2021 Catalan regional election.

**Archived source account.** Pro-independence parties gain a majority of the votes for the first time, though voter participation was the lowest in history. The anti-independence Socialists' Party of Catalonia, led by former national Health Minister Salvador Illa, wins the most seats for a single party. The far-right Vox places fourth and enters Parliament for the first time, winning 11 seats. Citizens, who placed first in the previous election, falls to seventh and loses 30 seats.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/feb/14/catalonia-regional-election-covid-voting>).

<a id="event-2021-02-14-4-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Peru, impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics.

**Archived source account.** Peru's Foreign Minister Elizabeth Astete resigns amid an uproar over secret vaccination before the country receives one million doses for health workers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/perus-foreign-minister-quits-over-secret-vaccination/2021/02/14/ed38d65a-6f47-11eb-8651-6d3091eac63f_story.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-14-4-6"></a>

Context: 2021 Kosovan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Kosovans head to the polls to elect the new Assembly of Kosovo. The Vetëvendosje party is expected to gain most seats as it shows on exit polling data.

Source citations (as archived): [Voanews](<https://www.voanews.com/europe/kosovo-holds-early-parliamentary-election-120-seat-legislative-body%3Famp&amp;ved=2ahUKEwi8nv-R4-ruAhW5ILcAHSc0CM0QFjAPegQIGRAB&amp;usg=AOvVaw3_YD2CWITHsSrYINhanPCA&amp;ampcf=1>); [DW](<https://amp.dw.com/en/kosovo-left-wing-opposition-set-to-win-election-exit-polls/a-56563753&amp;ved=2ahUKEwi8nv-R4-ruAhW5ILcAHSc0CM0QFjAOegQIGBAB&amp;usg=AOvVaw2aTUCZ07rXXMrhLOPMJzr2&amp;ampcf=1>).

### 2021-02-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1160337636](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20February%2015&oldid=1160337636>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-02-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / Saudi Arabian–Yemeni border conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Houthis say that they have struck Saudi Arabia's Abha International Airport and King Abdulaziz International Airport in Jeddah with drones. A Houthi spokesman said on Twitter that the attacks halted operations in the airports for two hours. The Saudi-led coalition says that it intercepted drones heading towards the kingdom but did not confirm the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-security-yemen/yemens-houthis-say-they-have-struck-saudis-jeddah-abha-airports-with-drones-idUSKBN2AF0X1?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Israeli airstrikes on Iranian weapons and missile depots near Damascus, Syria, kill six foreign nationals, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights. The headquarters of the Syrian Army's 4th Armoured Division is also hit.

Source citations (as archived): [Jewish Press](<https://www.jewishpress.com/news/middle-east/syria/update-israeli-airstrikes-in-syria-kill-6-destroy-iranian-weapons/2021/02/15/>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-0-8"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb / Operation Barkhane.

**Archived source account.** Chadian President Idriss Déby announces that his government will deploy 1,200 troops to the tripoint of the Burkina Faso–Mali and Burkina Faso–Niger borders.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20210215-chad-s-deby-says-deploying-soldiers-to-tackle-jihadists-in-sahel>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-0-10"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests, aftermath of the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's military junta deploys Tatmadaw troops and cuts Internet services in many parts of the country hours after security forces fired live rounds to disperse a demonstration in the northern state of Kachin.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/myanmar-junta-cuts-internet-as-troops-fire-to-break-up-protest>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-0-12"></a>

Context: 2021 Erbil missile attacks.

**Archived source account.** Multiple rockets strike near Erbil International Airport in Kurdistan Region, Iraq, killing a foreign civilian contractor and wounding nine others, including a U.S. service member.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/15/north-iraq-airbase-hosting-us-troops-targeted-by-several-rockets>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-02-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bishop David Zubik of the Pittsburgh Diocese announces that four Catholic elementary schools are merging to form two schools for the school year beginning in fall 2021. The decision comes after more than a year's deliberation and hours of study.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pittsburgh-diocese-announces-mergers-for-four-catholic-schools-38981>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-02-15-2-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 recession / COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark, Economy of Denmark.

**Archived source account.** Denmark's GDP contracts 3.7% in 2020, which is the first annual economic contraction since 2009 due to the impact of the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [DR](<https://www.dr.dk/nyheder/penge/dansk-oekonomi-bloeder-men-saerligt-en-ting-redder-os-paa-maalstregen>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-2-4"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 recession / COVID-19 pandemic in Japan, economy of Japan.

**Archived source account.** Japan's GDP contracts 4.8% in 2020, which is the first annual economic contraction since 2009 due to the impact of the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-56066065>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Trade Organization formally appoints former Finance Minister of Nigeria Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala as its first African and first female Director-General.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-15/wto-formally-appoints-okonjo-iweala-as-its-first-female-leader>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-02-15-3-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Congo River disaster.

**Archived source account.** A passenger barge crashes and capsizes on the Congo River in Mai-Ndombe Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing at least 60 people, while 240 others are reported missing. At least 300 people have been rescued from the river.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-disaster/at-least-60-killed-after-passenger-barge-crashes-on-congo-river-idUSKBN2AF1SD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 37 people are killed by a bus falling off a bridge into a canal in Madhya Pradesh, India.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/16/dozens-dead-after-bus-plunges-into-canal-in-central-india>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico.

**Archived source account.** Mexico begins the second phase of its vaccination programme for people over the age of 60 against COVID-19 in more than 300 municipalities.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/15/mexico-begins-vaccinating-elderly-against-covid-19>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Connecticut, 501.V2 variant.

**Archived source account.** Connecticut reports their first case of the 501.V2 variant in a person from Fairfield County with no known international travel history, which was notified by health officials in New York.

Source citations (as archived): [WVIT-TV](<https://www.nbcconnecticut.com/news/coronavirus/south-african-covid-19-variant-detected-in-connecticut-resident/2423116/>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Mississippi, Lineage B.1.1.7.

**Archived source account.** Mississippi reports their first case of the B.1.1.7 variant first detected in the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Journal](<https://www.djournal.com/news/first-case-of-covid-19-variant-strain-confirmed-in-mississippi/article_84cefcb3-7111-5ab2-a997-bae420a12eb3.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Australia suspends its quarantine-free travel bubble arrangement with New Zealand after the discovery of three new community cases in Auckland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-56063335>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Australia receives 142,000 doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-02-15/pfizer-coronavirus-vaccine-doses-arrive-australia-rollout/13155726>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand receives 60,000 doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff.co.nz](<https://i.stuff.co.nz/national/health/coronavirus/300230422/covid19-first-batch-of-pfizer-coronavirus-vaccine-arrives-in-new-zealand>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Auckland enters level three restrictions for the next three days in response to an ongoing COVID-19 outbreak, closing all non-essential businesses and suspending all in-person education. The rest of the country will enter level 2 restrictions, which will limit public gatherings.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/feb/14/new-zealand-covid-outbreak-race-to-trace-three-local-cases-in-auckland>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern confirms that three members of a family in Auckland who tested positive for COVID-19 are infected with the UK variant and that this is not connected to any managed isolation or quarantine facilities.

Source citations (as archived): [TVNZ](<https://www.tvnz.co.nz/one-news/new-zealand/auckland-family-contracted-covid-19-have-uk-variant-not-connected-miq-ardern>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia, Lineage B.1.1.7.

**Archived source account.** Cambodia reports their first three cases of the B.1.1.7 variant first detected in the United Kingdom in 28-year-old man and a 23-year-old woman from India and a 23-year-old woman who travelled from China.

Source citations (as archived): [Khmer Times](<https://www.khmertimeskh.com/50814311/first-cases-of-new-c-19-variant-found-in-cambodia/>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq, Lineage B.1.1.7.

**Archived source account.** Iraq announces that they will re-impose a partial lockdown from February 18 until March 8 after reporting their first cases of the UK variant of SARS-CoV-2.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1809811/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Japan surpasses 7,000 deaths from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/02/15/21/japans-covid-19-death-count-tops-7000>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency scales back Q1 vaccination targets to 750,000 people due to delayed shipments from COVAX and the decision not to use the AstraZeneca vaccine on people aged 65 or older until more efficacy data becomes available.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-southkorea/s-korea-cuts-q1-covid-19-vaccination-plan-restricts-use-of-astrazeneca-shot-idUSKBN2AF07K?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** Vietnamese authorities order two million people in Hải Dương province to stay at home for 15 days beginning tomorrow due to a growing COVID-19 outbreak in the province. Gatherings with more than two people are banned, and when leaving their homes, residents must stay 2 m from others.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-vietnam-stay-home-orders-hai-duong-hotspot-14202214>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-32"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom begins a mandatory hotel quarantine for all British and Irish citizens and all permanent residents arriving in England from 33 "high risk" countries, requiring them to stay for 10 days at government-designated accommodations.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV](<https://www.itv.com/news/2021-02-15/first-guests-to-check-into-quarantine-hotels-for-10-day-stay>); [The Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/uk/british-and-irish-arriving-in-england-must-now-quarantine-in-hotels-1.4485179>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-34"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland.

**Archived source account.** Scotland begins a mandatory hotel quarantine for all international arrivals, requiring them to self-isolate for 10 days in one of six government-designated hotels.

Source citations (as archived): [STV](<https://news.stv.tv/scotland/hotel-quarantine-begins-for-international-arrivals-to-scotland>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-37"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia.

**Archived source account.** Colombia receives their first shipment of 50,000 doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [MedicalXpress](<https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-02-colombia-shipment-coronavirus-vaccines.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-40"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe.

**Archived source account.** Zimbabwe receives their first shipment of 200,000 doses of the Sinopharm vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://amp.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3121787/chinese-vaccines-reach-zimbabwe-it-receives-its-first>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-42"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization announces the approval of the Oxford–AstraZeneca vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/alisondurkee/2021/02/15/astrazeneca-oxford-covid-19-vaccine-gets-emergency-approval-from-who/?sh=350b511d3953>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-4-43"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Ebola vaccination campaign begins in the city of Butembo, in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Health workers are the first to be vaccinated.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-ebola-congo/ebola-vaccination-campaign-begins-in-democratic-republic-of-congo-idUSKBN2AF16Y>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-02-15-5-1"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations, Operation Claw-Eagle 2.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan accuses the United States of supporting "the PKK terrorists", following the killing of 13 Turkish hostages held captive in Kurdistan Region. Turkey also summons the U.S. ambassador David M. Satterfield in response to the killings.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/war-on-terror/erdogan-slams-us-for-siding-with-pkk-terrorists>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-5-3"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran says that it has informed the International Atomic Energy Agency that it will no longer allow snap inspections of its nuclear facilities as of February 21. The snap inspections were a condition of the 2015 Iranian nuclear deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-usa-iaea/iran-says-it-has-told-iaea-of-plan-to-end-snap-inspections-idUSKBN2AF1K4>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-02-15-6-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol, January 6 commission.

**Archived source account.** House Speaker Nancy Pelosi announces that Congress will establish a 9/11-style commission to investigate the January 6 riot at the United States Capitol.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/donald-trump-capitol-siege-acquittals-impeachments-trump-impeachment-7ebcbaedd6985537dec0c3918cbf06d9>).

<a id="event-2021-02-15-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkish authorities announce the detention of 718 people they accuse of having links to Kurdish militant groups. Among those arrested include pro-Kurdish Peoples' Democratic Party officials. The mass arrests are seen as a direct response to the murder of 13 Turkish hostages in Iraq. The Kurdistan Workers' Party blamed Turkish airstrikes on their bases for the deaths of the hostages.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20210215-turkey-arrests-hundreds-over-alleged-kurdish-militant-links-in-iraq-executions>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-02-15-7-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Peru.

**Archived source account.** President Francisco Sagasti appoints Allan Wagner Tizón as new foreign minister, a day after Elizabeth Astete resigned over secretly receiving a vaccination against COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Andina](<https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-peru-new-foreign-affairs-minister-sworn-in-833806.aspx>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-02-15-8-1"></a>

Context: 2021 NASCAR Cup Series.

**Archived source account.** Michael McDowell wins the 63rd running of the Daytona 500. It is McDowell's first career victory in the Cup Series.

Source citations (as archived): [NASCAR.com](<https://www.nascar.com/news-media/2021/02/15/results-cup-series-2021-daytona-500-race-recap/>).

### 2021-02-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1265401938](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20February%2016&oldid=1265401938>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-02-16-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / Ma'rib Campaign.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces continue to advance on the city of Maʼrib, capturing the village of al-Zor and reaching the Marib Dam. Yemeni government officials say that dozens of people have been killed in the past 24 hours as government forces counter the Houthi offensive. UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator Mark Lowcock condemns the Houthi assault, warning of "unimaginable humanitarian consequences".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/16/un-alarmed-as-battle-for-marib-threatens-millions-of-yemenis>).

<a id="event-2021-02-16-0-4"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** A spokesperson for the rebel group Tigray People's Liberation Front claims that an estimated 100,000 troops (both Tigrayan and Ethiopian) have been killed during the conflict. Three Ethiopian opposition parties previously claimed that an estimated 52,000 civilians have also died.

Source citations (as archived): [Europe External Programme with Africa](<https://www.eepa.be//wp-content/uploads/2020/11/Situation-Report-EEPA-Horn-No.-86-17-February-2021.pdf>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-02/ethiopian-opposition-claims-52-000-dead-in-northern-conflict>).

<a id="event-2021-02-16-0-5"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Rwandan President Paul Kagame says the reported deaths in Tigray were too high to let Ethiopia and the African Union handle the situation alone. He adds that the UN should intervene in the Tigray War, explaining that when a state is not able to stop atrocities on its territory, such as genocide, the UN has a duty to intervene.

Source citations (as archived): [Agence Ecofin](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/gestion-publique/1602-85246-ethiopie-paul-kagame-appelle-a-une-action-directe-du-conseil-de-securite-de-l-onu-pour-resoudre-la-crise-dans-le-tigre>).

<a id="event-2021-02-16-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan, Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand announces that it will withdraw its forces from Afghanistan by May.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/political/436571/new-zealand-troops-to-be-withdrawn-from-afghanistan-by-may>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-02-16-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The White House announces that President Joe Biden will extend the foreclosure ban and mortgage forbearance through the end of June as an effort to address the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/biden-extends-foreclosure-moratorium-mortgage-forbearance-through-june-n1257983>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-02-16-2-1"></a>

### 2021-02-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1281094206](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20February%2018&oldid=1281094206>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-02-18-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / Ma'rib Campaign.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces take control of the Marib Dam, al-Balaq, Dahwan, and Athaf mountains, and the Kholan area, among others, as coalition forces retreat. This is the first time since 2015 that the Houthis control Marib Dam, which gives the Houthis fire control of the southern road to Marib.

Source citations (as archived): [ISWNews](<https://english.iswnews.com/17525/marib-dam-was-liberated-isis-and-al-qaeda-still-could-not-stop-ansarallah/>).

<a id="event-2021-02-18-0-4"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb, Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Jihadist insurgents kill nine people in an ambush in Burkina Faso, while another jihadist attack near Bandiagara, Mopti Region, Mali, kills nine people and leaves others missing, according to local government officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burkina-security/at-least-18-killed-in-attacks-in-burkina-faso-and-mali-idUSKBN2AI2PL?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-02-18-0-6"></a>

Context: ISIL insurgency in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Secretary General of NATO Jens Stoltenberg announces an increase in NATO personnel in Iraq from 500 to around 4,000 amid a surge in ISIL activity in the country. The training mission will also be expanded to more areas beyond Baghdad and include more Iraqi security institutions, according to Stoltenberg.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20210218-nato-to-expand-iraq-mission-to-around-4-000-personnel>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-02-18-1-1"></a>

Context: News Media Bargaining Code.

**Archived source account.** Facebook bans Australian news publishers from posting and Australian users from viewing and sharing news content in a preemptive retaliation move against the Australian Competition &amp; Consumer Commission's (ACCC) proposed News Media Bargaining Code, which would require Facebook to pay to host Australian news content. A number of key government and charity organisations were also blocked for several hours.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2021/feb/18/facebook-blocks-health-departments-charities-and-its-own-pages-in-botched-australia-news-ban>).

<a id="event-2021-02-18-1-2"></a>

Context: News Media Bargaining Code.

**Archived source account.** Alphabet Inc. agrees to begin paying News Corp for news content. News Corp CEO Robert Thomson credits the ACCC's proposed legislation with making the deal possible.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/02/17/technology/facebook-google-australia-news.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-02-18-2-2"></a>

Context: 2020–21 North American winter / February 13–17, 2021 North American winter storm, 2021 Texas power crisis.

**Archived source account.** In Texas, power is restored to millions of homes, but millions of people lack safe drinking water and 325,000 homes and businesses remain without power.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-weather-idINKBN2AI151>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-02-18-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Lockdown restrictions are eased in Victoria as contact tracers are confident that all cases linked to a recent outbreak are self-isolating. People are permitted to leave their homes for non-essential reasons but are required to wear a mask when they are indoors. Private gatherings of up to five people and public gatherings of up to 20 people are once again permitted. Non-essential businesses and on-campus learning have been reopened, and businesses that were working from home can have up to 50% of their employees return to the office.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-02-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Uyghur genocide, Canada–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Canada's House of Commons approves a motion by 266 to zero votes, formally recognizing that China is committing genocide against its Muslim Uyghur minority in Xinjiang. <a id="event-2021-02-22-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Russian protests, 2020–21 NHL season.

**Archived source account.** In ice hockey, New York Rangers winger Artemi Panarin takes a personal leave of absence after the Russian tabloid Komsomolskaya Pravda publishes a story in which former Kontinental Hockey League coach Andrei Nazarov accuses him of sexually assaulting a 18-year old Latvian woman in Riga. The team releases a statement calling the allegations against Panarin a “intimidation tactic” against him after speaking out against “recent political events”, most notably being critical of Russian President Vladimir Putin and expressing his support for Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny, who was detained upon return to Russia from Germany.

<a id="event-2021-02-24-2-31"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in California.

**Archived source account.** California surpasses 50,000 deaths of COVID-19, becoming the first U.S. state to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2021/feb/25/california-coronavirus-death-toll-covid-19-50000>).

<a id="event-2021-02-24-2-33"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Idaho, Lineage B.1.1.7.

**Archived source account.** Idaho reports their first case of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant in a person from Ada County.

Source citations (as archived): [Idaho Press](<https://www.idahopress.com/coronavirus/uk-variant-of-covid-19-confirmed-in-ada-county-woman/article_72bb2990-83c7-519e-8cf1-d008dd0c1274.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-24-2-35"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in North Carolina.

**Archived source account.** North Carolina governor Roy Cooper announces that some stay-at-home and curfew restrictions will be lifted on February 26, such as allowing bars to reopen indoors, increasing the number of people in gatherings, and extending the alcohol sale cutoff to 11:00 p.m.

Source citations (as archived): [The News &amp; Observer](<https://www.newsobserver.com/news/coronavirus/article249467495.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-24-2-37"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** Mayor of Washington D.C. Muriel Bowser's sister, Merica Bowser, dies from COVID-19 as the city surpasses 1,000 total deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2021/02/24/dc-mayor-bowsers-sister-dies-covid-19-city-passes-1-000-deaths/6809594002/>).

<a id="event-2021-02-24-2-39"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** Johnson &amp; Johnson's single-shot COVID-19 vaccine candidate meets the standards for emergency use authorization, according to analysis from a committee within the FDA, though formal authorization will not be determined until February 26. The vaccine is 66% effective in combating the virus and can be stored in normal refrigerators.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/23/health/johnson--johnson-covid-19-vaccine-fda-committee/index.html>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine, 501.V2 variant.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/5942148/moderna-vaccine-covid-19-variant/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-02-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nicolás Maduro's government declares European Union Ambassador to Venezuela Isabel Brilhante Pedrosa a persona non grata and gives her 72 hours to leave the country following new sanctions by the EU against 19 Venezuelan officials.

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/internacional/2021/02/24/60367c18fdddff07178b45d6.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-02-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Assassination of Luca Attanasio.

**Archived source account.** Italian Prime Minister Mario Draghi asks the United Nations and the UN World Food Programme to open an investigation into the attack that killed Italian ambassador Luca Attanasio and two other people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/world-news-italy-luigi-di-maio-rome-united-nations-41596deaa751c68b3a3245e96a91c28d>).

<a id="event-2021-02-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Drug policy of Germany.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Germany and Belgium seize more than 23,000 kg of cocaine, worth billions of dollars, in an international operation that resulted in one arrest. Authorities consider this to be the largest amount of cocaine ever seized in Europe. The containers came on a ship from Paraguay, via Tangier and Rotterdam, the police said.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/02/24/europe/cocaine-bust-grm-intl-scli/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-24-4-5"></a>

Context: Philippine drug war, PNP–PDEA shootout.

**Archived source account.** A mishandled sting operation between the national police and the country's drug enforcement agency in Quezon City results in the deaths of two police officers following a shootout between the two parties.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/02/25/asia/philippines-police-drug-bust-intl-hnk-scli/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-02-24-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists discover Dzharatitanis kingi, a Diplodocus-like dinosaur fossil, in Uzbekistan. It is the first dinosaur of its kind to be discovered in Asia.

Source citations (as archived): [New Scientist](<https://www.newscientist.com/article/2269125-diplodocus-like-fossil-in-uzbekistan-hints-asia-was-a-dinosaur-hub/>).

### 2021-02-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1295800973](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20February%2025&oldid=1295800973>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-02-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / Ma'rib Campaign.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces attack Ma'rib, with ballistic missiles amidst an ongoing offensive to capture the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya English](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/gulf/2021/02/26/Houthis-target-Marib-residential-area-with-ballistic-missile>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-0-4"></a>

Context: 2021 Kaduna and Katsina attacks.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill 36 people, wound several others, and burn down houses when they attack two villages in Kaduna and Katsina States, Nigeria. Several attackers are also killed during an air operation by security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/25/gunmen-kill-36-in-attacks-in-northern-nigeria>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-0-6"></a>

Context: 2021 Armenian coup d'état attempt, 2020−2021 Armenian protests.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan warns of an attempted military coup against him after the army demands that he and his government resign. In response, Pashinyan dismisses the head of the general staff of the armed forces and calls on his supporters to rally in his support.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-politics-pm/armenian-pm-warns-of-coup-attempt-after-army-demands-his-resignation-idUSKBN2AP0WW>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-0-8"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people are killed at a religious site in Bambari, Central African Republic, amid clashes between armed groups and security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/25/at-least-14-killed-at-religious-site-in-car-amnesty>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-0-10"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Nine soldiers are killed and nine others are wounded during a long exchange of fire with armed groups in Bandiagara, Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/26/several-soldiers-killed-in-central-mali-attack>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-0-12"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** Pro-military counter-protesters attack anti-coup protesters during a rally against the military junta in Yangon. Some counter-protesters were armed with knives and clubs, while others used slingshots and threw stones to attack their opponents.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/east-asia-pacific/myanmar-military-junta-supporters-clash-anti-coup-demonstrators>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-0-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** At U.S. President Joe Biden's direction, the U.S. military launches airstrikes against Iranian-backed militia group Kata'ib Hezbollah's structures in Abu Kamal, Syria, killing 17 Popular Mobilization Forces militants. The airstrikes are described as retaliation for a recent rocket strike in Erbil, Iraq, which left two people dead and 13 others wounded, including American military personnel.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/26/us-strikes-iranian-backed-military-infrastructure-in-syria>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-0-15"></a>

Context: Ituri conflict.

**Archived source account.** Seven civilians are killed by CODECO militiamen in Banyari Kilo sector, Djugu Territory, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Okapi](<https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/02/25/actualite/securite/djugu-7-personnes-tuees-par-des-miliciens-de-codeco-banyari-kilo>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-02-25-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Fukushima earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A man in his 50s is confirmed to be the first fatality of the February 13 earthquake that struck near Fukushima, Japan, after his body is found buried in his destroyed home.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2021/02/27bcd1c39fd5-1st-death-confirmed-in-feb-13-northeastern-japan-earthquake.html>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia.

**Archived source account.** The government confirms that bars, cafés, and restaurants can reopen their outdoor terraces on March 1.

<a id="event-2021-02-25-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus.

**Archived source account.** Cyprus announces that it will allow high schools, gyms, and indoor sports facilities such as swimming pools to reopen on March 1 as the number of COVID-19 cases continue to decrease.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210225-more-schools-gyms-to-open-as-cyprus-eases-lockdown>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Finland.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Sanna Marin announces "tier-two" lockdown restrictions for the next three weeks, which includes the closure of bars and restaurants, expanded remote learning, and a ban on gatherings of more than six people beginning March 8 due to the spread of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant.

Source citations (as archived): [Yle](<https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/finland_announces_march_shutdown/11808835>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Ireland reports its first case of the B.1.525 variant first detected in Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent.ie](<https://www.independent.ie/news/first-irish-case-of-b1525-strain-of-covid-19-confirmed-as-r-number-increases-40132928.html>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain.

**Archived source account.** Bahrain becomes the first country to approve the single-dose Johnson &amp; Johnson vaccine for emergency use. It is also the fifth vaccine to be approved in the country.

<a id="event-2021-02-25-2-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka receives 500,000 doses of the Oxford–AstraZeneca vaccine from India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/sri-lanka-receives-500000-doses-of-covid-19-vaccines-from-india/article33933291.ece>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-2-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Syria.

**Archived source account.** Syria's health ministry confirms that the government has received COVID-19 vaccines from an unnamed "friendly country", adding that healthcare workers will be the first to be vaccinated beginning next week.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-health-moscow-coronavirus-pandemic-damascus-361874c0d82e09d92486bd242de4b661>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Algeria, Lineage B.1.1.7.

**Archived source account.** Algeria reports their first two cases of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant in a healthcare worker from Algiers and a person who traveled to France.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://cn.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-algeria/algeria-detects-first-two-cases-of-uk-coronavirus-variant-idUSL1N2KV3HM>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-2-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Argentina receives the first shipment of 904,000 doses of Sinopharm's BBIBP-CorV vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Buenos Aires Times](<https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/amp/argentina/shipment-of-900000-sinopharm-vaccine-doses-arrives-in-argentina.phtml>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-2-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Belize, Lineage B.1.1.7.

**Archived source account.** Belize reports their first case of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant in a member of the British Army Training Support Unit Belize who has been infected with this variant.

Source citations (as archived): [Breaking Belize News](<https://www.breakingbelizenews.com/2021/02/25/first-belize-case-of-uk-variant-of-covid-19-found-in-a-member-of-batsub/>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-2-30"></a>

Context: 2020–21 H5N8 outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Afghanistan reports an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5N8 bird flu on a poultry farm in Herat Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/afghanistan-reports-h5n8-bird-flu-on-farm-oie-101614254187360.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-2-31"></a>

**Archived source account.** Western Cape reports their first case of African Swine Fever at two small farms in Mfuleni, Eerste River in Cape Town, South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [News24](<https://www.news24.com/amp/news24/southafrica/news/ban-on-pig-sales-in-western-cape-as-african-swine-fever-detected-at-two-cape-town-farms-20210225>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-02-25-3-1"></a>

Context: India–Pakistan relations.

**Archived source account.** India and Pakistan issue a joint statement indicating that both sides agree to stop firing at each other at the disputed Line of Control border in Kashmir.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/india-pakistan-agree-to-stop-firing-at-kashmir-border/a-56683894>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-3-3"></a>

Context: Uyghur genocide, China–Netherlands relations.

**Archived source account.** The Dutch House of Representatives votes to recognize the Chinese government's treatment of its Uyghur Muslim minority as genocide, becoming the first European Union country to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-netherlands-china-uighurs/dutch-parliament-chinas-treatment-of-uighurs-is-genocide-idUSKBN2AP2CI>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-3-4"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-02-25-4-1"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in Malaysia, judiciary of Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Court, in a landmark decision, unanimously declares that Selangor's sharia law provision on "unnatural sex" is invalid and unconstitutional, as such offences fall under the jurisdiction of federal law.

Source citations (as archived): [Malay Mail](<https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/02/25/federal-court-unanimously-declares-selangor-shariah-law-criminalising-unnat/1952701>); [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysian-wins-challenge-islamic-law-banning-gay-sex-selangor-14279784>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-4-3"></a>

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. President Donald Trump's tax returns are given to New York County District Attorney Cyrus Vance Jr.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/trumps-tax-returns-manhattan-prosecutors/story?id=76110229>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-4-5"></a>

Context: USA Gymnastics sex abuse scandal.

**Archived source account.** Former USA Gymnastics coach John Geddert dies from suicide by a self-inflicted gunshot wound off Interstate 96 in Michigan, shortly after being charged with human trafficking and sexual assault of a minor.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-56205049>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-4-7"></a>

Context: 2021 Croix-des-Bouquets jailbreak.

**Archived source account.** Notable gang leader Arnel Joseph and other detainees escape from prison in Croix-des-Bouquets, Haiti, during a riot that also resulted in the death of eight people inside the jail, including the prison's director. Casualties are also reported in the city's streets.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/26/several-dead-as-gang-leader-escapes-in-haiti-prison-break>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-5-1"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives votes to pass the Equality Act. The bill will now head to the Senate for a vote.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/feature/nbc-out/house-representatives-passes-sweeping-lgbtq-rights-bill-n1258900>).

<a id="event-2021-02-25-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Facebook bans all accounts related to Myanmar's military, the Tatmadaw, as well as ads from military-controlled companies following the military coup against Aung San Suu Kyi and the military seizure of power on February 1.

### 2021-02-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1160337286](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20February%2026&oldid=1160337286>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-02-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** An explosion hits the Israeli-owned cargo ship MV Helios Ray in the Gulf of Oman. No injuries are reported among the ship's 28 crew members. Israeli media reports, citing unnamed Israeli government officials, that Iran was likely behind the blast.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-26/explosion-strikes-ship-in-gulf-of-oman-crew-safe>).

<a id="event-2021-02-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Zamfara kidnapping.

**Archived source account.** At least 317 girls are kidnapped by armed bandits raiding a secondary school hostel in the Nigerian state of Zamfara.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/26/nigerian-school-students-abducted-in-second-kidnapping-in-a-week>).

<a id="event-2021-02-26-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Security forces open fire against a crowd of demonstrators during anti-government protests in Nasiriyah, Iraq, killing 3 people and wounding 47 others. Two other protestors have also been killed in the past few days.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/26/at-least-three-protesters-killed-in-southern-iraq-rights-monitor>).

<a id="event-2021-02-26-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine reports 10 ceasefire violations in the Luhansk region.

Source citations (as archived): [Unian](<https://www.unian.info/war/donbas-war-update-ukraine-records-10-ceasefire-violations-on-feb-25-11334971.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-26-0-9"></a>

Context: Batwa–Luba clashes.

**Archived source account.** An NGO vice-president met with 70 members of the Twa and Bantu in Nyunzu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to ensure lasting peace in the Nyunzu Territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Okapi](<https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/02/26/actualite/societe/tanganyika-une-ong-invite-les-jeunes-de-nyunzu-sengager-pour-la-paix>).

<a id="event-2021-02-26-0-11"></a>

Context: Ituri conflict.

**Archived source account.** Claude Ibalanky, the coordinator of the National Monitoring Mechanism of the Addis Ababa Agreement (MNS), reveals at a workshop organized by the MNS and MONUSCO in Kinshasa that there are residents taking advantage of the instability in eastern Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Okapi](<https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/02/26/actualite/securite/rdc-la-demobilisation-des-miliciens-de-la-frpi-parmi-les-acquis>).

<a id="event-2021-02-26-0-13"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) kill three civilians in an ambush on the Beni-Kasindi road. Congolese and MONUSCO troops positioned nearby then clashed with the ADF, forcing them to retreat.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Okapi](<https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/02/26/actualite/securite/beni-3-civils-tues-dans-une-embuscade-des-adf-sur-laxe-routier-beni>).

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, American Rescue Plan Act of 2021.

<a id="event-2021-02-26-5-2"></a>

Context: aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol / Criminal charges brought in the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol, Death of Brian Sicknick.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Bureau of Investigation has reportedly identified a suspect in connection to the death of Capitol Police officer Brian Sicknick during the storming of the U.S. Capitol last month.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/26/politics/fbi-identify-suspect-sicknick/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-26-5-4"></a>

Context: Begum v Home Secretary.

**Archived source account.** The UK Supreme Court rules that ISIL supporter Shamima Begum is forbidden from returning to the United Kingdom to appeal the revocation of her citizenship. This overturns the decision by the Court of Appeal, citing four errors in their ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/26/europe/shamima-begum-isis-ruling-uk-gbr-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-02-26-5-6"></a>

Context: 2021 Croix-des-Bouquets jailbreak.

**Archived source account.** Arnel Joseph, a powerful Haitian gang leader, is killed in a gun battle with police in L'Estère a day after escaping from prison during a riot. The death toll from the incident rise to a total of 25 people, including many civilians killed by the inmates after randomly opening fire in the streets. The prison's director, six inmates and police officers are among the dead. Sixty more prisoners who escaped are captured and arrested, while more than 200 others are still on the run.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-56219200>).

Context: Corruption in Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Jakarta Globe](<https://jakartaglobe.id/news/anticorruption-champion-nabbed-by-kpk-when-sleeping>).

<a id="event-2021-02-27-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cuba approves its first animal welfare law after pressure from animal rights movement groups. The decree will regulate scientific experiments on animals, the handling of stray cats and dogs, and veterinarian practices in the country. Some civil society groups say the decree doesn't go far enough, as it doesn't outlaw animal sacrifice or cockfighting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cuba-politics-animalrights/cuba-approves-animal-welfare-law-after-civil-society-pressure-idUSKBN2AR0GM?il=0>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-02-28-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar security forces begin violently dispersing anti-coup protesters and clearing makeshift road blocks, killing a total of 18 protesters in several cities. More than 30 others are wounded by live rounds, and several have been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/28/one-reported-dead-many-hurt-as-myanmar-police-fire-at-protesters>).

<a id="event-2021-02-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Ten civilians are killed, of whom eight have been decapitated and two shot, in two ADF overnight attacks in Boyo and Kainama, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/1/8-villagers-decapitated-by-suspected-adf-rebels-in-dr-congo-army>).

<a id="event-2021-02-28-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chadian security forces raid the home of opposition leader Yaya Dillo Djérou in N'Djamena, killing five of his relatives, including his mother and son. A government statement says the raid was an operation to arrest Dillo. Two other people are also killed and five others are wounded in the ensuing fight.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/28/chad-opposition-candidate-says-security-forces-raided-his-home>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-03-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état, 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** Ousted leader Aung San Suu Kyi appears in court to hear two more charges against her. The charges are a colonial-era penal code prohibiting publication of information that may "cause fear or alarm", and a telecommunications law stipulating licenses for equipment. Meanwhile, police disperse protesters with tear gas and stun grenades.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-politics/myanmar-court-files-more-charges-against-suu-kyi-police-crack-down-on-protests-idUSKCN2AS0P4?il=0>).

Source citations (as archived): [Digi 24](<https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/evenimente/imagini-cu-agresorul-de-la-onesti-a-iesit-la-balcon-fluturand-cutitul-in-timp-ce-negocia-cu-politia-1460767>).

### 2021-03-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1354679959](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20March%203&oldid=1354679959>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-03-03-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-eight protesters are shot dead and 30 more are wounded by the military and police as protests against the February 1 coup continue across the country. A meeting of ASEAN nations called for restraint of the security forces but failed to unanimously call for the release of ousted leader Aung San Suu Kyi.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-56265962>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Vetlanda stabbing attack.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are wounded, three of them critically, after being attacked by a man with an axe in Vetlanda, Sweden. Authorities are treating the incident as a terrorist attack. The perpetrator, a man in his 20s, is shot by police and arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2021/03/03/eight-people-stabbed-in-suspected-terrorist-attack-in-sweden-say-police>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Ten FARC dissidents are killed and three others are wounded when the Colombian Army bombs a base housing them in Calamar, Guaviare.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/3/colombia-military-operation-kills-10-farc-dissidents>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Suspected ADF militants kill eight civilians during a shooting attack at a market in Mambelenga, Democratic Republic of the Congo. ADF attacks have increased, with more than 140 people killed by the group since the beginning of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-security/suspected-islamists-kill-eight-in-attack-on-northeast-congo-village-market-idUSKBN2AV1X9>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-0-9"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The bodies of four Filipinos, an Austrian, and a Czech, all oil workers who were kidnapped and then murdered in Libya in 2015 by Islamic State terrorists, are found at a cemetery.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1818806/world>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-0-11"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Zamfara kidnapping.

**Archived source account.** Three people are shot after armed forces open fire at a reunion of students, kidnapped in Zamfara a week ago, and their parents in Jangebe, Nigeria, while the parents protest the kidnapping.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-56230525>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-0-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten rockets hit the al Asad Airbase hosting US-led coalition forces in Al Anbar Governorate, Iraq. No one is directly killed or wounded by the strikes, but an American civilian contractor dies of a heart attack during the impact.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/56249926>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-0-14"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Following pressure from the international community, Ethiopia releases three reporters working for the BBC, AFP, and Financial Times, alongside two local news reporters and two translators, without charge. No reason was given for their arrest, and it is still unclear if four other journalists have been released.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-56263704>).

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / Economy of Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210303-brazil-ends-new-lost-decade-with-gdp-drop-of-4-1-in-2020>).

Context: 2021 United Kingdom budget.

**Archived source account.** Chancellor of the Exchequer Rishi Sunak delivers the 2021 Spring budget to the House of Commons, announcing the government's tax and spending plans for the year ahead, as well as further COVID-19 support measures, including extending the furlough until the end of September and increasing the minimum wage beginning in April.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-56266773>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-03-03-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Australian Parliament rape scandals.

**Archived source account.** Attorney-General, House Leader, and Industrial Relations Minister Christian Porter comes forward as the minister accused of raping a woman in 1988, who has since committed suicide, in an anonymous letter sent to Prime Minister Scott Morrison last week. Porter denies the allegations and announces that he will be taking a mental health leave.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-03-03/christian-porter-denies-historical-rape-allegation/13206972>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-4-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Toronto van attack.

**Archived source account.** Alek Minassian is found guilty of murdering 10 people, and attempting to kill 16 more, in a vehicle-ramming attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-crime-van-attack-idUSKBN2AV20K>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-4-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol.

**Archived source account.** The United States Capitol Police announces that it has obtained intelligence on a "possible plot" by an identified militia group to breach the United States Capitol building on the following day, March 4, which has recently been the subject of QAnon conspiracy theories. In response to the intelligence, the United States House of Representatives announces that it has ended its work for the week.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/police-uncover-possible-plot-militia-breach-capitol-c470dc642d9b568238f80b5822787159>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A pipe bomb explodes outside a COVID-19 test centre in Bovenkarspel, Netherlands, causing minor damage. No one is wounded in the explosion.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/3/blast-targeting-netherlands-covid-19>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** France bans far-right Identitarian nationalist group Génération Identitaire. Interior Minister Gérald Darmanin says the movement incites "discrimination, hatred and violence".

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210303-france-bans-far-right-anti-migrant-group-generation-identity>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** German intelligence agency Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution formally places far-right oppositional party Alternative for Germany under surveillance, accusing it of aiming to subvert the constitution. It is the first time that a major political party has been placed under surveillance since the end of World War II.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/03/03/world/europe/germany-afd-surveillance-extremism.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-03-03-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Freedom House, in its annual Freedom in the World report, downgrades India from "free" to "partially free". The report cites the rise in mob violence against Muslims, increased government interference in the judiciary, increased intimidation against journalists and activists, and the government's heavy-handed approach to COVID-19 lockdowns that left millions of migrants stranded as the main reasons for the downgrade.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210303-freedom-house-downgrades-india-to-partly-free>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-56249596>).

<a id="event-2021-03-03-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hungary's ruling party Fidesz withdraws from the conservative European Parliament bloc European People's Party (EPP), after the EPP changed its rules to allow it to expel a party's entire delegation. Fidesz's membership had been suspended since 2019 after it accused then-European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker and philanthropist George Soros of conspiring to "flood" Europe with migrants during a national campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/hungarys-orban-pulls-fidesz-from-center-right-eu-alliance/a-56760505>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-03-08-5-1"></a>

Context: Killing of George Floyd.

**Archived source account.** The trial of former Minneapolis Police Department officer Derek Chauvin begins in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Chauvin's trial is the first time that a judge in Minnesota has authorized cameras to show a full criminal trial.

<a id="event-2021-03-08-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian Supreme Federal Court Justice Edson Fachin rules that all convictions of former President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva must be nullified. This ruling restores Lula's political rights and thus clears the way for his presidential candidacy in 2022.

<a id="event-2021-03-08-6-1"></a>

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1196661411](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20March%2010&oldid=1196661411>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-03-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Australian frontier wars.

**Archived source account.** The Victoria State Government announces the establishment of a truth commission into genocidal violence against the state's Indigenous population from the late 18th century to the early 20th century, as part of a process towards developing a treaty.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/mar/09/victoria-launches-truth-commission-into-ongoing-effect-of-violent-colonisation-on-aboriginal-people>).

<a id="event-2021-03-10-0-3"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The armed forces kill twelve people in an operation in the Guaviare Department against a group run by a former FARC leader. Defense Minister Diego Molano Aponte says that there were child soldiers present at the camp but declines to say if they were killed or state their ages.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/03/10/world/americas/colombia-children-military.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-03-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives votes 220–211 to pass the $1.9 trillion American Rescue Plan Act of 2021, which extends weekly jobless benefit payments of $300 until September, sends $1,400 checks to individuals, and funds other coronavirus relief programs for states and businesses. The stimulus bill will be sent to President Joe Biden for his signature.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/house-set-to-approve-covid-19-relief-bill-11615372203>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-56350463>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-ovh-fire/millions-of-websites-offline-after-fire-at-french-cloud-services-firm-idUSKBN2B20NU?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-03-10-4-2"></a>

Context: Libyan Crisis / Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** At an extraordinary session in Sirte, the Libyan parliament votes 121 to 11 to approve a new Government of National Unity led by Prime Minister Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh. The new interim unity government will govern Libya until a general election is held in December.

**Archived source account.** An upper court in Hong Kong denies bail for a second time to 11 of the 47 defendants in the case, citing national security risks. Among those who were again denied bail are prominent activists and politicians such as Leung Kwok-hung, Claudia Mo, Jimmy Sham, Lester Shum, and Fergus Leung. The remaining defendants either withdrew their bail application or remain in custody under other circumstances.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3125152/national-security-law-bail-denied-again-11-47-hong>).

<a id="event-2021-03-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the killing of George Floyd.

**Archived source account.** The family of George Floyd, the man killed while in police custody last May, settles their lawsuit against the city of Minneapolis for $27 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Star Tribune](<https://www.startribune.com/minneapolis-to-pay-record-27-million-to-settle-lawsuit-with-george-floyd-s-family/600033541/>).

<a id="event-2021-03-12-3-5"></a>

Context: Death of Sarah Everard.

**Archived source account.** A Metropolitan Police officer is charged with kidnapping and murder.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-56331948>).

<a id="event-2021-03-12-3-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian political crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Bolivian office of the Prosecutor General issues an arrest order for former interim President Jeanine Áñez, five former members of the national cabinet and the former leadership of the Armed Forces, accusing them of the crimes of sedition and terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/mar/12/bolivia-ex-interim-president-jeanine-anez-arrest-warrant>).

### 2021-03-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1175417197](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20March%2013&oldid=1175417197>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-03-13-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** A car bombing near a police station in Herat Province kills at least eight people and wounds more than 50 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/13/car-bomb-in-afghanistans-herat-province-kills-several>).

<a id="event-2021-03-13-0-4"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are killed after soldiers open fire on protesters in Mandalay, Yangon, and Pyay. A 13-year-old child is among those killed, the youngest victim of the unrest to date.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSKBN2B503Q>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-03-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Avatar retakes its place as the world's highest-grossing film of all time from Avengers: Endgame following a domestic release in China.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/03/13/avatar-once-again-highest-grossing-film-of-all-time-at-the-box-office.html>).

<a id="event-2021-03-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Kazakh Air Force Antonov An-26 crashes in Almaty, killing four crew members on board and wounding two others.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines, Lineage P.1.

<a id="event-2021-03-13-3-21"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Ethiopia.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopia begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19 in order to reduce the number of COVID-19 infections, a week after the country received 2.2 million doses of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine.

<a id="event-2021-03-13-3-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in California.

**Archived source account.** PlainSite public data reveal 450 workers at the Tesla Factory in Fremont have tested positive for COVID-19 since Tesla CEO Elon Musk reopened the building last May.

<a id="event-2021-03-13-3-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Australia reports its first local COVID-19 cases in two weeks, when a doctor in Brisbane tests positive.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/australasia/australia-covid-cases-brisbane-uk-variant-b1816759.html>).

<a id="event-2021-03-13-3-30"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Former President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva receives his first dose of the CoronaVac vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210313-brazil-s-lula-receives-first-dose-of-coronavirus-vaccine>).

<a id="event-2021-03-13-3-31"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Legislative Assembly of Mato Grosso member Silvio Favero, known for introducing a bill against mandatory COVID-19 vaccinations, dies from COVID-19 in Cuiabá, Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [Euro Weekly News](<https://www.euroweeklynews.com/2021/03/15/brazilian-anti-vax-politician-has-died-from-covid-19/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-03-13-4-1"></a>

Context: China–United Kingdom relations, Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom formally declares China to be in breach of the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration, saying that China is now in "a state of ongoing non-compliance" of the treaty. Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab says that the UK will "continue to stand up for the people of Hong Kong".

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/dc2aaf68-b92e-4c48-8823-e7e4648ccb74>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-03-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Death of Sarah Everard.

**Archived source account.** A Metropolitan Police officer is remanded in custody and will appear at the Old Bailey in London on March 16.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-56385657>).

<a id="event-2021-03-13-5-2"></a>

Context: Death of Sarah Everard.

**Archived source account.** At a candlelight vigil in Clapham, mourners defying COVID-19 gathering restrictions clash with police officers attempting to disperse them, resulting in four arrests. The actions of the police draw condemnation from several officials, including London Mayor Sadiq Khan and Home Secretary Priti Patel.

Source citations (as archived): [Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/sarah-everard-vigil-defy-police-ban-clapham-common-b923959.html>).

<a id="event-2021-03-13-5-4"></a>

Context: 2020–21 United States racial unrest, Shooting of Breonna Taylor.

**Archived source account.** People rally in Louisville, Kentucky, on the first anniversary of the death of Breonna Taylor, who was shot by officers who forced entry to her home using a no-knock warrant. Surrounding roads are closed off, but many felt the security measures were excessive.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-56387446>).

<a id="event-2021-03-13-5-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Former interim President Jeanine Áñez is arrested by police and is accused of participating in an alleged coup d'état against ousted President Evo Morales in November 2019. Before being arrested, Áñez denounced the arrest and stated that the "persecution had begun".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-56381697>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-03-13-6-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Western Australian state election.

**Archived source account.** The Labor Party wins the state election in Western Australia, in one of the biggest landslide victories in the country's history.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-03-13/wa-election-winner-called-in-state-election-2021-by-antony-green/13243662>).

### 2021-03-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1059770635](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20March%2014&oldid=1059770635>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-03-14-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** Security forces kill at least 54 anti-coup protesters in several cities, thirty-seven of whom were in Yangon. A policeman is also killed. It is the protests' deadliest day. The civilian Vice President, Mahn Win Khaing Than, says that they will pass legislation to "give people the right to defend themselves against the military" and calls for a "revolution" to overthrow the junta. Meanwhile, a junta spokesman labels the protesters as "criminals" but refuses to elaborate.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-56398001>).

<a id="event-2021-03-14-0-2"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** People armed with axes and crowbars attack and set ablaze ten Chinese factories and a hotel in Yangon, resulting in injuries to several Chinese nationals. Some protesters have accused the Chinese government of supporting the Burmese military.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-56395085>).

**Archived source account.** The 63rd Grammy Awards is held in Los Angeles.

<a id="event-2021-03-15-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The military junta expands the provisions of Myanmar's martial law, which is perceived as an attempt to legitimize their violent pushback against anti-coup protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/aung-san-suu-kyi-myanmar-yangon-asia-pacific-martial-law-0d633653041286307780b7d192280ad7>).
