Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/15/at-least-a-dozen-killed-in-easter-dr-congo-attack>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-03-15-1-1"></a>

Context: Catholic Church and gay marriage.

**Archived source account.** The Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith, the Vatican body responsible for promulgating Catholic doctrine, rules that priests cannot bless same-sex unions or marriages, calling any such blessing "not licit".

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/03/15/world/europe/vatican-same-sex-unions.html>); [Vatican Press Office](<https://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/en/bollettino/pubblico/2021/03/15/210315b.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-03-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** British chocolate maker Thorntons announces it will be permanently closing down all of its stores, with the loss of about 600 jobs, thereby ending its 110-year presence on the high street. The company says it has been massively hit by the pandemic lockdowns and adds that high street conditions are too severe to continue. The company will continue sales online and through supermarkets.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-56407155>).

<a id="event-2021-03-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Killing of Jamal Khashoggi.

**Archived source account.** Agnès Callamard, Special Rapporteur appointed by the United Nations Human Rights Council, reveals that a senior Saudi Arabian official twice threatened to have her "taken care of" if the UN did not obstruct her investigation of the assassination of Jamal Khashoggi. Khashoggi, who had been critical of the al-Saud dynasty, was murdered and dismembered by Saudi agents in the Saudi Arabian consulate in Istanbul in 2018 under what is believed to be the direct orders of Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.

**Archived source account.** During a news conference in Naypyidaw, the Tatmadaw defended the reimposition of the junta and claimed that ousted national leader Aung San Suu Kyi was corrupt, tantamount to graft. No supporting evidence for these allegations was offered outside of the taped testimony of a former colleague of Aung San Suu Kyi, Phyo Min Thein, who has been detained by the military since the coup began.

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1277930280](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20March%2024&oldid=1277930280>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-03-24-0-2"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb / 2021 Niger attacks.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 people are killed during attacks at two villages in the Tillabéri Region, Niger.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/at-least-10-killed-in-southern-niger-attacks-security-source-idUSKBN2BG38J?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-03-24-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / Afghanistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Defense Inspector General releases a report accusing the United States for failing to charge partner nations for the use of American military aircraft. The report also says that the Department of Defense had no way of knowing how many dollars have been lost.

Source citations (as archived): [Air Force Times](<https://www.airforcetimes.com/pentagon/2021/03/24/us-failed-to-collect-reimbursements-from-afghanistan-coalition-partners-for-years-ig-finds/>).

<a id="event-2021-03-24-0-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Mahmoud al-Werfalli, a commander loyal to Khalifa Haftar, is killed alongside his cousin after unknown gunmen open fire on their vehicle in Benghazi.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/24/libyan-commander-wanted-for-war-crimes-by-icc-gunned-down>).

<a id="event-2021-03-24-0-9"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopia's Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed admits for the first time that Eritrean troops entered Ethiopia's Tigray Region and fought the rebel Tigray People's Liberation Front, and that they may have been involved in war crimes. Abiy says that Eritrean forces promised to leave the region as soon as Ethiopia's military was able to "control the border".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/23/ethiopia-pm-abiy-ahmed-says-atrocities-committed-in-tigray>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-03-24-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 recession, COVID-19 pandemic in Vatican City.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis issues a decree that cuts the 10% of the cardinals' and other officials' salaries since the Vatican foresees a financial deficit of 50 million euros this year.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-56515367>).

**Archived source account.** The Suez Canal remains blocked for a second consecutive day after the container ship Ever Given got stuck during a dust storm. The Suez Canal Authority says that tugboats are continuing to try to move the 220,000-ton ship as more than 100 cargo ships wait to pass.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/mar/24/suez-canal-traffic-jam-builds-as-work-to-move-megaship-continues>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-03-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Cabo Delgado / Battle of Palma.

**Archived source account.** In the fourth day of a siege in Palma, Mozambique, several people are killed by ISIL-linked militants. Local civilians are killed in streets and buildings, with reports of beheadings. A South African man and a British citizen are murdered after a hotel and an evacuation convoy are attacked; other foreigners are also suspected to have been killed. At least 21 soldiers are shot dead while responding to the hotel attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times](<https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/islamist-rebels-kill-dozens-in-attack-on-mozambique-gas-project-s3fhl308z>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2021/03/27/least-one-british-expatriate-killed-islamists-storm-mozambique/>).

<a id="event-2021-03-27-0-3"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Michaelia Cash becomes Attorney-General and Industrial Relations Minister, replacing alleged rapist Christian Porter, who is instead made Industry, Science and Technology Minister. Peter Dutton becomes Leader of the House, replacing Porter and Defence Minister, replacing Linda Reynolds, who was criticised for her handling of a rape allegation among her ministerial staff. Reynolds is instead made Government Services Minister.

Former Defence Minister Fernando Azevedo e Silva allegedly resigned over pressure from Bolsonaro to make the Armed Forces publicly support him.

Paulo](<https://politica.estadao.com.br/noticias/geral,bolsonaro-faz-seis-trocas-no-governo-confirma-demissoes-e-leva-nome-do-centrao-para-o-planalto,70003664494>); [O Estado de S. Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/mar/30/png-prime-minister-first-to-be-vaccinated-with-australian-supplied-doses-to-show-its-safe>).

<a id="event-2021-03-30-2-23"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan reports 100 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, the highest recorded in a single day of the year so far, thus bringing the nationwide death toll to 14,434. The number of patients in critical care with COVID-19 also reaches an all-time high of 3,749.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1615587>).

<a id="event-2021-03-30-2-25"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine, Lineage B.1.1.7.

**Archived source account.** Trials for the Novavax COVID-19 vaccine show that it is 90% effective against COVID-19 and the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant of SARS-CoV-2.

Source citations (as archived): [UrduPoint](<https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/novavax-covid-19-vaccine-showing-really-exce-1208641.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-03-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Sex trafficking in the United States.

**Archived source account.** An investigation is opened into U.S. Rep. Matt Gaetz (R–FL) over whether he had a sexual relationship with a 17-year-old girl and violated federal sex trafficking laws by allegedly paying her to travel with him. Gaetz denied the allegations.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/03/30/us/politics/matt-gaetz-sex-trafficking-investigation.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-03-30-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Hong Kong electoral reform.

**Archived source account.** China's National People's Congress Standing Committee members vote in favor of amendments of the Hong Kong Basic Law Annex I and II to overhaul the electoral system. The amendments are widely seen as a move to further reduce the influence of the opposition pro-democracy camp in the wake of the widespread anti-government protests of 2019 and the electoral landslide of the 2019 District Council election.

Source citations (as archived): [Hong Kong Free Press](<https://hongkongfp.com/2021/03/30/breaking-beijing-unanimously-approves-hong-kong-election-overhaul-reducing-democratic-representation/>).

<a id="event-2021-03-30-4-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** In a meeting with recently-appointed Defence Minister Walter Souza Braga Netto in the early hours of the day, the commanders of all three branches of the Brazilian Armed Forces – General Edson Leal Pujol (Army), Admiral Ilques Barbosa Junior (Navy), and Brigadier Antonio Carlos Moretti Bermudez (Air Force) – announce their intention to resign from their posts as soon as new successors are found. The collective resignation announcement comes less than a day after the dismissal of former Defence Minister Fernando Azevedo e Silva and is allegedly a move to signal the Armed Forces' opposition to any military interference in politics.

Source citations (as archived): [O Estado de S. Paulo](<https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2021/03/comandantes-militares-colocam-cargos-a-disposicao-e-descartam-golpismo.shtml>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-03-30-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament.

**Archived source account.** In college basketball, the UCLA Bruins advance to the Final Four as an 11th seed after defeating the Michigan Wolverines, becoming the fifth team to do so after LSU in 1986, George Mason in 2006, VCU in 2011, and Loyola–Chicago in 2018. They will also become the second team to reach the Final Four after starting in the First Four since the 2011 VCU Rams. They will play the Gonzaga Bulldogs, who defeated the USC Trojans.

Source citations (as archived): [Sports Illustrated](<https://www.si.com/college/cal/basketball/elite-eight-michigan-ucla>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-03-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar / Kachin conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Kachin Independence Army says that it attacked a police station in Kyaukgyi village-tract in Shwegu Township, Kachin State, injuring at least one officer. They claim that the police there are involved in killing civilians during the ongoing protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Irrawaddy](<https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/kachin-independence-army-attacks-myanmar-regime-police-station.html>).

<a id="event-2021-03-31-0-4"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** ADF gunmen attack a village in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing at least 23 civilians. Two attackers are shot dead by responding security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/31/suspected-adf-militia-kill-23-in-new-eastern-dr-congo-massacre>).

<a id="event-2021-03-31-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin accuses Ukraine of "provoking armed confrontation" with pro-Russian separatists in the war-torn eastern portion of the country. Putin also said that Ukraine failed to comply with the July 2020 ceasefire of the conflict, which has killed over 14,000 people since it broke out in 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://news.yahoo.com/putin-accuses-ukraine-provoking-clashes-085755024.html>).

<a id="event-2021-03-31-0-8"></a>

Context: 2021 Nigerien coup d'état attempt.

**Archived source account.** Gunfire erupts in the streets of Niamey, Niger, during an attempted coup d'état by soldiers. The coup was foiled and the perpetrators were arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210331-soldiers-arrested-in-niger-after-attempted-coup>).

<a id="event-2021-03-31-0-10"></a>

Context: Indonesian National Police headquarters shooting.

**Archived source account.** A woman opens fire at the Indonesian National Police headquarters in Jakarta before being shot dead by police. A male accomplice flees the scene. No other casualties are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/31/gunfire-heard-at-indonesian-national-police-hq-in-jakarta>).

Chinese diplomats say that the boats were sheltering from rough seas and denies the involvement of militias.

**Archived source account.** At least four people are killed and another injured during a mass shooting at an office building in Orange, California, United States. The attacker is shot and wounded by responding security forces.

The young man, who founded his own neo-Nazi cell at the age of 15, is the third-youngest UK terror convict.

Welfare spending, student allowances, and support for first time home buyers are also increased.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/04/01/pfizer-covid-vaccine-is-91percent-effective-in-updated-data-protective-against-south-african-variant.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-04-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests, Myanmar–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom places sanctions on Burmese conglomerate Myanmar Economic Corporation for funding the junta and for associating with military officials. British Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab also accuses the junta of "sinking to a new low with the wanton killing of innocent people, including children".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-politics-britain/uk-sanctions-myanmar-conglomerate-says-junta-sinking-to-new-lows-with-killings-idUSKBN2BO53U?il=0>).

The visit coincided with the opening of a COVID-19 "travel bubble" between Taiwan and Palau. The highest level visit in 42 years prompted anger from China, who warned the U.S. against "crossing its red line".

Source citations (as archived): [The Diplomat](<https://thediplomat.com/2021/04/us-ambassador-makes-first-visit-to-taiwan-in-more-than-40-years/>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/china/china-taiwan-visit-us-ambassador-b1824196.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-usa-southchinasea/philippines-u-s-to-begin-2-week-joint-military-drill-on-monday-idUSKBN2BY07A>).

<a id="event-2021-04-12-4-3"></a>

Context: War in Donbass, Ukraine–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine triggers Article 15 of the Charter on a Special Partnership, initiating an emergency meeting with NATO to discuss the Russian escalation in Donbass and the build-up of Russian forces on its border. The article was last triggered in 2018 during the Kerch Strait incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukranews](<https://ukranews.com/en/news/768973-ukraine-initiates-april-13-emergency-meeting-of-nato-commission-to-discuss-russia-s-escalation-of>).

<a id="event-2021-04-12-4-5"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan reports the largest incursion into its air defence identification zone to date by People's Liberation Army Air Force warplanes. Twenty-five aircraft entered its airspace, including nuclear-capable H-6K bombers and anti-submarine aircraft. The Chinese fleet flew in an area close to the disputed Pratas Island, according to Taiwan's Defence Ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/taiwan-china-defense/update-1-taiwan-reports-largest-incursion-yet-by-chinese-air-force-idUSL1N2M516J>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-04-12-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020–21 United States racial unrest, Daunte Wright protests.

**Archived source account.** Tensions between protesters and police intensified for the second night after the killing of Daunte Wright, a 20-year-old man who was shot by police at a traffic stop. Minnesota Governor Tim Walz imposes a curfew, and police begin firing gas canisters and flash-bang grenades. Some protesters, wearing gas masks, pick up smoke canisters and throw them back at police. About 40 arrests are made, ranging from curfew violation to rioting.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2021/04/12/daunte-wright-shooting-protests-brooklyn-center-police/7197379002/>).

<a id="event-2021-04-12-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gunman on a motorcycle opens fire in front of a COVID-19 vaccination centre at a hospital in the 16th arrondissement of Paris, France, killing a man and wounding a female security guard before riding away.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-shooting/one-person-shot-dead-in-front-of-paris-hospital-police-source-idUSKBN2BZ1FP>).

<a id="event-2021-04-12-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A serving officer with London's Metropolitan Police is sentenced to over two years in prison for an unprovoked attack on a black member of the public that left his victim with a broken leg, in what the judge described as "a clear case of racial profiling."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/04/13/uk/met-police-officer-jailed-knee-scli-intl-gbr/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-04-12-6-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Peruvian general election.

**Archived source account.** Far-left candidate Pedro Castillo is expected to win the first round of the presidential election. His opponent in the runoff election in June is still to be determined, amidst a political and economic crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-peru-election/peru-presidential-vote-heads-for-run-off-far-left-candidate-leads-idUSKBN2BW27K?il=0>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-04-13-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden says that he plans to withdraw all remaining American troops in Afghanistan by September 11. The United States also reiterates its support for the Afghan government against the Taliban, which declines to comment on the apparent change from the previously-agreed deadline of May 1.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-withdrawal/biden-set-to-withdraw-u-s-troops-from-afghanistan-by-sept-11-idUSKBN2C028S?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom announces that it will withdraw nearly all of its troops from Afghanistan, following the announcement of a U.S. withdrawal. There are around 750 British soldiers still stationed in Afghanistan, mostly in the capital Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-withdrawal-britain/britain-to-withdraw-nearly-all-its-troops-from-afghanistan-the-times-idUSKBN2C02Y1?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** Turkey says that it will host a summit from April 24 to May 4 in an effort to end the war in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/13/turkey-to-host-10-day-afghan-taliban-peace-talks-from-april-24>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / 2021 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** A car bombing in Farah kills three civilians; and 10 security personnel are killed in the country's north.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/car-bomb-kills-afghanistan-10-troops-killed-north-77049191>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-0-8"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** A missile strikes the Israeli-owned cargo ship MV Hyperion Ray off the coast of the United Arab Emirates. There is no immediate claim of responsibility, however Israeli officials suspect Iran of being behind the attack on the vessel.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-owned-ship-said-attacked-off-uae-coast-amid-sky-high-tensions-with-iran/>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-0-10"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Pakistan, Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** An improvised explosive device explodes at a football ground in Hub, Balochistan, Pakistan, injuring twelve people. The attack occurred during a game organised as a commemorative tribute to police officers killed in the line of duty.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/football/top-stories/explosion-rocks-football-ground-during-match-in-pakistan-12-injured/articleshow/82055034.cms>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-0-12"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The New York Times says that a blackout at Iran's underground Natanz nuclear facility was sabotage perpetrated by remotely detonating an improvised explosive device that had previously been smuggled into the site.

Source citations (as archived): [i24news](<https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/middle-east/1618290789-report-explosive-device-smuggled-into-natanz-plant-remotely-detonated>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-0-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** A military court in Burkina Faso indicts (in absentia) ex-President Blaise Compaoré, who is charged with the 1987 murder of his immediate predecessor Thomas Sankara. Compaoré ruled the nation for 27 years following Sankara's assassination before resigning in the face of protests in 2014 and fleeing into exile in Ivory Coast. The court indicts thirteen other Burkinabé ex-officials accused of various crimes including murder.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/13/burkina-faso-ex-president-blaise-compaore-charged-thomas-sankara-murder>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-04-13-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland, Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Talks between rail workers and ScotRail aimed at preventing a strike collapse, as the rail firm cites financial pressures caused by the ongoing pandemic to justify refusing a pay raise and revocation of some day-off entitlements. The Unite union rejects this explanation. The Scottish Government and Transport Scotland are appraised of the situation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Glasgow Times](<https://www.glasgowtimes.co.uk/news/19229399.scotrail-strike-edges-closer-pay-talks-collapse/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-04-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Discharge of radioactive water of the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant.

**Archived source account.** Following a cabinet meeting, the Japanese government says it has decided to release 1.25 million tons of treated radioactive water from the crippled Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant into the Pacific Ocean over the course of 30 years, after concluding there will be no negative impact on human health or the environment. The decision is opposed by Russia, China, Taiwan, South Korea, North Korea and the Philippines, while being supported by the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2021/04/3b41a07d2e30-update1-japan-decides-to-release-water-from-fukushima-nuclear-plant-into-sea.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-56728068>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-disaster-fukushima-water-reaction/countries-react-to-japans-plans-to-release-fukushima-water-into-ocean-idUSKBN2C00WF?il=0>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-2-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Suez Canal obstruction.

**Archived source account.** A court in Ismailia grants the Egyptian Suez Canal Authority's request to seize CS Ever Given pending payment of a compensation claim of over US$900 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-04-13/egypt-seizes-ever-given-pending-900m-compensation>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-2-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress crash.

**Archived source account.** The National Transportation Safety Board concludes that pilot error and inadequate maintenance were behind the crash, which killed seven people, injured six others, and destroyed the historic aircraft.

Source citations (as archived): [The Connecticut Post](<https://www.ctpost.com/news/article/NTSB-Pilot-s-actions-maintenance-issues-16098161.php>).

<a id="event-2021-04-13-2-6"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/14/niger-mourns-death-of-20-children-in-school-blaze>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-04-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States imposes retaliatory measures against Russia in response to the 2020 United States federal government data breach, its interference in the 2020 United States elections, and the occupation of and human rights abuses in Crimea. The U.S. bans trade in bonds newly issued by Russia's Central Bank, National Wealth Fund, and Ministry of Finance, formally names the Russian Foreign Intelligence Service as responsible for the data breach, blacklists 32 Russian entities and individuals, and expels ten Russian diplomats. Russia denies these allegations. The Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs summons the U.S. ambassador to inform him that "a series of retaliatory measures will follow soon". A spokesperson for the ministry also says that a potential summit between both countries' leaders may not take place.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/14/politics/russia-sanctions-expel-officials-hacking-election/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-imposes-wide-array-sanctions-russia-malign-actions-2021-04-15/>).

**Archived source account.** Ukraine protests an alleged announcement by Russia that, beginning next week, it would be closing the Kerch Strait to foreign warships and state ships until October.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax-Ukraine](<https://interfax.com.ua/news/general/737914-amp.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-04-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Killing of Adam Toledo.

**Archived source account.** The Chicago Police Department publicly releases bodycam footage of the shooting of 13-year-old Mexican American boy Adam Toledo. The footage appears to show an unarmed Toledo with both his arms raised in the air before being fatally shot in the chest by an officer. Chicago Mayor Lori Lightfoot says "Simply put, we failed Adam" and calls for calm amidst fears of unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-56768217>).

<a id="event-2021-04-15-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Several protests take place around the city after the video is released, including one that briefly shut down northbound Michigan Avenue and another at Union Park.

Source citations (as archived): [WMAQ-TV](<https://www.nbcchicago.com/news/local/release-of-adam-toledo-shooting-video-sparks-protests-emotional-reactions/2487854/>).

Context: Indianapolis FedEx shooting.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and seven others injured in a mass shooting at a FedEx facility in Indianapolis, Indiana, United States. Police say the gunman took his own life afterwards.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/16/us/indianapolis-shooting-fedex-facility/index.html>); [CNN2](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/16/us/what-we-know-indianapolis-fedex-shooting/index.html>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/shootings-crime-indianapolis-indiana-e92ad3117c56357b3b2c71a2903e68a8>).

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20210415-tunisia-protesters-burn-police-station-after-men-killed-in-car-accident-with-officers/>).

<a id="event-2021-04-15-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The French National Assembly votes unanimously to amend an existing age of consent law in order to officially recognize sex with children under the age of 15 as rape and making it punishable by up to 20 years in prison. Previously, the law allowed an adult to claim the consent of a child in court. The bill also classifies incestuous sex with a minor under the age of 18 as rape.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/france-outlaws-sex-with-minors-2021-04-15/>).

<a id="event-2021-04-15-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The French National Assembly approves a controversial global security law proposal that extends police powers and makes it a crime to help identify on-duty police officers "with the obvious intent of harming". Amnesty International denounces the law's "generalized surveillance practices" and "vague provisions".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/france-passes-controversial-security-bill-to-extend-police-powers>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-04-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Rwandan genocide.

**Archived source account.** The United States deports Beatrice Munyenyezi to Rwanda after she served her jail term for lying on her U.S. citizenship naturalization process. Upon arrival in Rwanda, Munyenyezi was arrested on charges ranging from murder to complicity in rape during the course of the 1994 genocide. She did not comment during her arrest to local press but had previously denied the accusations while in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/rwandan-deported-us-faces-seven-charges-related-genocide-2021-04-17/>).

**Archived source account.** A court in Sicily orders former Italian Interior Minister Matteo Salvini to stand trial accused of dereliction of duty and kidnapping for his role in a standoff with a Spanish-flagged migrant rescue ship operated by Proactiva Open Arms that he refused to allow to dock for nineteen days in 2019. A court order allowed the ship to dock after some migrants jumped overboard.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/17/matteo-salvini-trial-standoff-migrant-rescue-ship>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/17/myanmar-junta-pardons-releases-more-than-23000-prisoners>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/04/19/brian-sicknick-died-of-natural-causes-after-capitol-riot-medical-examiner-rules.html>).

<a id="event-2021-04-19-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian opposition leader and activist Alexei Navalny, who has been on a hunger strike for three weeks, is moved from prison to a hospital, according to the Russian prison service. Meanwhile, European Union foreign ministers hold a meeting to discuss Navalny's health and warn that Russia will be "held responsible" if anything happens to Navalny.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/russian-prison-service-transfers-alexei-navalny-to-hospital/a-57248156>).

<a id="event-2021-04-19-4-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-56802129>).

<a id="event-2021-04-19-5-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/2021/04/19/grand-staircase-tyrannosaur/>).

Manchester United chief executive Ed Woodward announces his resignation.

The IDF says the missile was launched from southern Syria. Residents in both central Israel and the West Bank report loud explosions.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Ambassador to Belarus Julie D. Fisher visits Belarus opposition leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya on the eve of a meeting between Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-04-21/us-ambassador-visits-belarus-opposition-leader-on-eve-of-putin-lukashenko-meeting?context=amp>).

<a id="event-2021-04-21-3-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken says that the Biden administration is working with Congress to provide $300 million in aid to Afghanistan in 2021 amid fears of a collapse of the Afghan government following the withdrawal of US troops in September.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/joewalsh/2021/04/21/us-promises-300-million-boost-in-aid-to-afghanistan-heres-why/>).

<a id="event-2021-04-21-3-5"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations, War in Donbas.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky invites his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin to a face-to-face meeting on the front line in the war-torn Donbas to negotiate an end to the conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraines-zelenskiy-invites-putin-to-meet-on-front-line>).

<a id="event-2021-04-21-3-7"></a>

Context: Czech Republic–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Czech foreign minister Jakub Kulhánek issues Russia with an ultimatum to return all of the Czech diplomats it had expelled from the Czech embassy in Moscow, following a series of reciprocal moves between the two countries since April 17 to expel each other's diplomats after the Czechs discovered Russian intelligence involvement in the 2014 Vrbětice ammunition warehouses explosions. Kulhánek threatens to expel more diplomats from the Russian embassy in Prague if the ultimatum is not met.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/04/21/prague-gives-moscow-ultimatum-to-let-czech-diplomats-return-a73692>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-04-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Estonia–Russia relations, Latvia–Russia relations, Lithuania–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania announce that they will expel several Russian diplomats involved in espionage activities in solidarity with the Czech Republic. The Czech Republic had ordered most Russian diplomatic staff to leave Prague on Thursday and called on its European allies to do the same.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/04/28/nyregion/rudy-giuliani-trump-ukraine-warrant.html>).

<a id="event-2021-04-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States.

**Archived source account.** A gunman kills two of his family members and two responding sheriff's deputies during a 13-hour standoff in Boone, North Carolina. The perpetrator later commits suicide at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/north-carolina-shootings-d74f91e7fcffa316212d9c42e70e19ec>).

<a id="event-2021-04-28-3-5"></a>

Context: LNU Lightning Complex fires.

**Archived source account.** A man from Vallejo, California, is arrested and charged for intentionally setting the Markley Fire, which killed two people and eventually merged with the Hennessey Fire as part of the LNU Lightning Complex, one of the largest wildfires in California's history. Authorities say the suspect set the fire in order to cover up the murder of a woman found near Lake Berryessa, which he had already been arrested and charged for in September 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/california-wildfire-killed-2-was-started-cover-murder-officials-say-n1265805>).

<a id="event-2021-04-28-3-7"></a>

Context: Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot.

**Archived source account.** Federal prosecutors lay out additional charges for three men suspected of plotting to kidnap Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer. The new charges, which include conspiracy to use a weapon of mass destruction, relate to an alleged related plot by the men to detonate explosives at a bridge in order to slow down responding law enforcement.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/28/politics/gretchen-whitmer-kidnap-plot-charges/index.html>); [Detroit Free-Press](<https://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/2021/04/28/whitmer-kidnap-charges-weapons-mass-destruction/4874420001/>).

<a id="event-2021-04-28-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and another is wounded during a mass stabbing at a hospital in Potsdam, Brandenburg, Germany. The perpetrator, identified as a female hospital's employee, is arrested. The victims are all patients.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/four-killed-german-hospital-woman-arrested-media-2021-04-28/>).

<a id="event-2021-04-28-3-9"></a>

<a id="event-2021-04-28-3-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five former members of the Italian far-left group Red Brigades, the co-founder of Lotta Continua, and another far-left militant are arrested in Paris, France.

**Archived source account.** Family and friends of Brazilian Workers' Party activist Rodrigo Pilha, who has been imprisoned for over a month after displaying a banner calling President Jair Bolsonaro "genocidal" over poor management of the COVID-19 pandemic, say that he was beaten and tortured in prison by wardens.

Source citations (as archived): [Forum](<https://revistaforum.com.br/noticias/exclusivo-pilha-foi-espancado-e-torturado-na-prisao/>).

<a id="event-2021-04-30-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United States Federal court upholds a New Jersey Catholic school’s right to fire a teacher under the Ministerial Exception doctrine. The teacher was terminated from Saint Dominic Academy the day after she returned from a leave due to a motor vehicle accident.

Source citations (as archived): [Religion Cause](<https://religionclause.blogspot.com/2021/04/catholic-school-campus-ministers-claims.html>); [Catholic World News](<https://www.catholicculture.org/news/headlines/index.cfm?storyid=50700>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-04-30-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Palestinian legislative election, Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** President Mahmoud Abbas postpones the election scheduled for May 22 until further notice, after the government of Israel allegedly rejected the holding of the election in East Jerusalem. Abbas says that the election cannot be held without the participation of the disputed area.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhuanet](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-04/30/c_139915915.htm>).

<a id="event-2021-04-30-5-3"></a>

Context: Impeachment of Wilson Witzel.

**Archived source account.** In Brazil, Governor of Rio de Janeiro Wilson Witzel is impeached and replaced by Vice Governor Cláudio Castro.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/rio-de-janeiro-governor-impeachment-confirmed-over-alleged-covid-19-related-2021-05-01/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-04-30-6-1"></a>

Context: 2021 NFL Draft, 2021 Green Bay Packers season.

**Archived source account.** Amidst ongoing tensions surrounding the future of Green Bay Packers quarterback Aaron Rodgers, the team trades up to select Clemson wide receiver Amari Rodgers with the 85th pick.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Sports/green-bay-packers-amari-rodgers-nfl-draft-amid/story?id=77435138>); [Packers.com](<https://www.packers.com/news/2021-nfl-draft-packers-select-clemson-wr-amari-rodgers>).

<a id="event-2021-04-30-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Numerous British sports teams, athletes, sports governing bodies, and companies participate in a social media boycott from 3:00 p.m. BST to 11:59 p.m. on May 3 to demand action from social media companies against online abuse.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/04/30/facebook-instagram-twitter-boycotted-by-british-sport-over-abuse-.html>).


## May

### 2021-05-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1345721210](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20May%201&oldid=1345721210>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-01-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The United States formally begins withdrawing its troops from Afghanistan to mark the final phase of the end to its longest war. Additionally, NATO also starts withdrawing their troops.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/joe-biden-kabul-afghanistan-b06334b7f884e5392a92136ee03f610a>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Taliban insurgents overrun an Afghan National Army base in Ghazni Province, capturing dozens of troops and killing a "number of others". Acting Defense Minister General Yasin Zia confirms the fall of the security installation to the Taliban.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/south-central-asia/taliban-overrun-afghan-base-capture-troops-us-nato-forces-exit>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-0-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov signs a decree that declares a two-day nationwide mourning effort for those who have died during border clashes with Tajikistan.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/world/1285731>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-0-6"></a>

Context: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Kyrgyzstan accuses Tajikistan of building up troops and military equipment on the border. The Kyrgyz side also accuses Tajik forces of opening fire on Kyrgyz vehicles in the area. A Tajik spokesman speaking from Dushanbe says the country was sticking to the ceasefire and withdrawal of troops.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kyrgyzstan-accuses-tajikistan-amassing-troops-near-border-2021-05-01/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-0-7"></a>

Context: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan agree to a new ceasefire following border clashes, which includes withdrawing troops from the border. Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov urges both countries to honor the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/1/kyrgyzstan-accuses-tajikistan-of-amassing-troops-near-border>); [Trend News Agency](<https://en.trend.az/casia/kyrgyzstan/3417947.html>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-0-9"></a>

Context: ISIL insurgency in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Seven members of the Kurdistan military force Peshmerga are killed in an ISIL attack in the Kirkuk Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Macau Business](<https://www.macaubusiness.com/7-kurdish-security-members-killed-in-is-attack-in-iraq/>); [Rudaw](<https://www.rudaw.net/english/kurdistan/010520213>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-05-01-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic on cruise ships / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on tourism.

**Archived source account.** Italian cruise line Costa Cruises returns to service for the first time in nearly five months following a ban of cruises by the Italian government due to the pandemic. Several Costa ships had reported cases on board in the previous year.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1426208/costa-cruises-sets-sail-again-after-four-month-covid-19-break>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-05-01-2-1"></a>

Context: Bharuch hospital fire.

**Archived source account.** A hospital fire in Bharuch, Gujarat, India, kills at least 16 COVID-19 patients and two nurses.

Source citations (as archived): [The Scottish Sun](<https://www.thescottishsun.co.uk/news/7046284/india-covid-hospital-fire-latest-disaster/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-05-01-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** India reports a new global record of 401,993 cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby marking the first time a country reported more than 400,000 new cases in a single day. This subsequently brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 19 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Nikkei Asia](<https://asia.nikkei.com/Spotlight/Coronavirus/India-s-daily-COVID-19-cases-reach-record-401-993>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Osaka Prefecture reports a record 1,262 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/osaka-confirms-daily-record-1262-new-coronavirus-cases-saturday-nhk-2021-05-01/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan, Lineage B.1.617.

**Archived source account.** Jordan reports its first three cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant, which originally discovered in India.

Source citations (as archived): [Khaleej Times](<https://www.khaleejtimes.com/coronavirus-pandemic/covid-jordan-detects-three-cases-of-indian-variant>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-3-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** The Singaporean government bans all long-term pass holders and short-term visitors who have been in Bangladesh, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka in the last two weeks from entering or transiting through the country. It also tightens its social distancing rules in an attempt to reduce the spread of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-04-30/singapore-reinstates-some-distancing-measures-tightens-borders>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-3-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Syria.

**Archived source account.** Syria's rebel-held Idlib Governorate begins its COVID-19 vaccination campaign, with a 45-year-old nurse receiving the first dose.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1852196/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-3-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** Thailand reports a record 21 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 224.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2108787/record-21-covid-deaths-1-891-new-cases>).

<a id="event-2021-05-01-3-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Kenyan President Uhuru Kenyatta lifts the lockdown imposed in Nairobi and surrounding counties, allowing bars, restaurants, schools, and religious services to reopen and revising the evening curfew to 10:00 p.m.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-05-01/kenyan-president-lifts-covid-19-lockdown-imposed-last-month>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-05-01-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Salvadoran political crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Legislative Assembly of El Salvador votes to remove several judges from the Supreme Court and remove Attorney General Raúl Melara, both of which had been vocal opponents to the presidency of Nayib Bukele. The event is being referred to as a self-coup by the opposition and by news media outlets.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/constitutional-crisis-el-salvador-bukele-security-plan-200210183636678.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-05-01-5-2"></a>

Context: International Space Station programme / SpaceX Crew-1.

**Archived source account.** The four-astronaut crew of SpaceX's Crew Dragon Resilience successfully splashes down in the Gulf of Mexico off the coast of Panama City, Florida, arriving from a six-month mission aboard the International Space Station.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/spacex-capsule-with-4-astronauts-splashes-down-off-florida-nasa-2426329>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-05-01-6-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Kentucky Derby.

**Archived source account.** The 147th Kentucky Derby is held at Churchill Downs at a 50% capacity, with Medina Spirit winning the race.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/kentucky-derby-2021-winner-medina-spirit/>).

### 2021-05-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1361361977](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20May%202&oldid=1361361977>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-02-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the conflict increases to 46, with hundreds of people injured and more than 100 buildings destroyed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-56963998?piano-modal>).

<a id="event-2021-05-02-0-2"></a>

Context: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Over 30,000 Kyrgyz civilians are evacuated from the Batken Region near the border with Tajikistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Trend News Agency](<https://en.trend.az/casia/kyrgyzstan/3418071.html>).

<a id="event-2021-05-02-0-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Kyrgyzstan Interior Ministry and Tajikistan both report that the situation at the border is stable and calm. Both countries also agree to withdraw troops from the border. However, an unexploded air missile is discovered at a house in Batken, Kyrgyzstan, near the border.

Source citations (as archived): [Rferl.org](<https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-border-truce-holding/31234423.html>); [Prensa Latina](<https://news.prensa-latina.cu/?p=35697/2021/05/02/kyrgyzstan-and-tajikistan-withdraw-troops-from-conflict-zone/>); [Kabar](<http://en.kabar.kg/news/home-of-kyrgyz-villager-in-batken-hit-by-aircraft-missile-fired-by-tajik-side/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-05-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 40-foot (12 m) trawler smuggling migrants capsized in San Diego Bay, Mexico, washed ashore and broke up on rocks. Three people are found to have died, and one person later died in the hospital. Around 25 people are rescued and hospitalized, including 1 in critical condition. The captain was detained.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/05/02/us/san-diego-boat-accident/index.html>).

**Archived source account.** Argentina surpasses three million cases of COVID-19.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-05-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations, Iran–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Iranian state media report a deal to release $7 billion of frozen Iranian funds has been reached between Iran, the United States, and the United Kingdom for the release of prisoners with Western-links, including Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe, in which the British government has agreed to pay a £400 million debt for her release.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/nazanin-zaghari-ratcliffe-uk-to-pay-tehran-163400m-to-free-british-iranian-national-state-tv-reports-12293267>).

<a id="event-2021-05-02-3-2"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations, Iran–United Kingdom relations / Iranian state media report a deal to release $7 billion of frozen Iranian funds has been reached between Iran, the United States, and the United Kingdom for the release of prisoners with Western-links, including Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe, in which the British government has agreed to pay a £400 million debt for her release..

**Archived source account.** The United States denies the claim that it had agreed to exchange either prisoners or money with Iran. The United Kingdom likewise denies that any definitive decision has been made in the case of Zaghari-Ratcliffe's repatriation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/world-news-iran-europe-middle-east-business-af8595806655db90a1204ab88f05273c>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-05-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Kyrgyzstan Interior Ministry launches 11 criminal probe investigations into the events on the border with Tajikistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AKIpress](<https://akipress.com/news:657681:Kyrgyz_Interior_Ministry_launches_11_criminal_probes_into_Kyrgyz-Tajik_border_events/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Jerusalem District Court orders at least six families residing in the Sheikh Jarrah neighborhood in East Jerusalem to vacate their homes, following decades of litigation by Jewish settler organizations claiming they are the rightful owners of the property. Hamas condemns this ruling as "dangerous, racist behavior", threatening retaliation.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/1/what-is-happening-in-occupied-east-jerusalems-sheikh-jarrah>); [Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/several-arab-families-in-sheikh-jarrah-in-jerusalem-face-eviction-666954>).

<a id="event-2021-05-02-4-5"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Canada.

**Archived source account.** The Proud Boys announces that they have dissolved in Canada after being labeled as a terrorist organization by the country earlier this year.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/proud-boys-canada-dissolves-itself-says-it-was-never-a-white-supremacy-group-1.5411112>).

<a id="event-2021-05-02-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Syrian President Bashar al-Assad signs a decree that grants amnesty and reduces sentences for prisoners ahead of an election on May 26.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/syria-amnesty-offered-ahead-presidential-elections>).

<a id="event-2021-05-02-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Istanbul police announce that, on Wednesday, they arrested an Afghan man who served as a close aide to former ISIL leader Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi and who had helped him hide in Syria's Idlib Governorate after the group lost its territory in 2019. The man lived in the Ataşehir district on the Asian side of the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/2/turkish-police-say-top-isil-figure-captured-in-operation>).

**Archived source account.** Inter Milan wins Serie A, the highest tier in the Italian football league system, for the first time since the 2009–10 season, ending Juventus's run of nine consecutive titles.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

The study also supports the existence of seven subspecies of giraffes.

Source citations (as archived): [Sci-News](<http://www.sci-news.com/biology/four-giraffe-species-09632.html>).

### 2021-05-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1161015103](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20May%209&oldid=1161015103>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-09-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks / 2021 Kabul school bombing.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from yesterday's school bombing in Kabul increases to 68 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-school-blast-toll-rises-58-families-bury-victims-2021-05-09/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** With multiple electricity pylons near Kabul being destroyed by bomb blasts, electricity supplier Da Afghanistan Breshna Sherkat (DABS) is reporting a shortage of 530 megawatts of power and announced that it will take 20 days to repair the destroyed pylons. Residents are accusing DABS of discrimination during these outages, as the capital's elite had 24-hour electricity.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLO News](<https://tolonews.com/business-172042>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-0-6"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United States Navy announces that it has seized a shipment of thousands of weapons in a stateless dhow on the Arabian Sea believed to be en-route to Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2021/05/09/us-navy-seizes-weapons-arabian-sea-486127>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-0-8"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Supreme Court agrees to delay its ruling on whether Palestinian residents in East Jerusalem's Sheikh Jarrah neighborhood can be evicted to make way for Jewish settlers to later this month, following a series of violent clashes between Israeli police and Palestinian protesters over this issue.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/may/09/israeli-settlement-ruling-delayed-jerusalem-tensions-palestinians>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-05-09-1-1"></a>

Context: Colonial Pipeline cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden declares a state of emergency following Friday's ransomware cyberattack against Colonial Pipeline, the largest fuel pipeline in the U.S., which transports 2.5 million barrels a day – 45 percent of the U.S. East Coast's supply of diesel, gasoline, and jet fuel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-57050690>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A day after appearing on Saturday Night Live and causing Dogecoin's value to drop by a third by calling the digital currency a "hustle", SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announces that his company will accept the cryptocurrency as payment for a DOGE-1 mission to the Moon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/dogecoin-spotlight-cryptocurrency-backer-musk-makes-snl-appearance-2021-05-07/>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/05/09/spacex-accepts-dogecoin-payment-for-doge-1-mission-to-the-moon.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-05-09-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A landslide at a clandestine gold mine in Siguiri, Guinea, kills at least fifteen miners.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-57046636>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rescue operations are underway in southwest London to help a small whale, believed to be a Minke, stranded in the River Thames, apparently stuck on the Richmond Lock's boat rollers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-57052331>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-05-09-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Germany lifts its curfew and some social restrictions, such as requiring a negative test result to enter certain venues, for those who have been vaccinated or who have recovered from COVID-19. These people are also no longer required to enter quarantine unless they have travelled to a high-risk country.

Source citations (as archived): [MedicalXpress](<https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-05-fully-vaccinated-freedoms-germany.html>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Taoiseach Micheál Martin receives his first dose of the AstraZeneca vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<https://www.irishpost.com/news/taoiseach-micheal-martin-felt-fantastic-after-receiving-first-dose-of-astrazeneca-vaccine-211841>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Spain lifts its state of emergency that had been imposed since October, allowing people to travel freely between regions for the first time in months. The country's curfew is also lifted.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20210509-it-s-like-new-year-s-spain-ends-covid-19-state-of-emergency>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-3-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Laos.

**Archived source account.** Laos reports its first death from COVID-19. The patient is a 53-year-old woman who had been receiving treatment at a designated hospital in Vientiane since April 30.

Source citations (as archived): [Big News Network](<https://www.bignewsnetwork.com/news/269347941/laos-reports-first-covid-19-death>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-3-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia reports a record 26 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 1,683.

Source citations (as archived): [New Straits Times](<https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2021/05/689106/26-covid-19-deaths-highest-daily-figure-pandemic-hit>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-3-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka reports a record 2,672 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the cumulative number of patients to 125,906.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsfirst](<https://www.newsfirst.lk/2021/05/09/sri-lanka-reports-record-2672-covid-infections-in-a-single-day/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-3-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Florida, Variants of SARS-CoV-2.

**Archived source account.** Florida has reported more than 10,000 cases of the Lineage B.1.1.7, Lineage P.1, and Lineage B.1.351 variants since spring break.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Health/florida-reports-10000-covid-19-variant-cases-surge/story?id=77553100>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-3-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia.

**Archived source account.** Tunisia enters a seven-day strict lockdown during the Eid al-Fitr holiday, which includes a curfew from 7:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/9/tunisia-begins-week-of-strict-covid-lockdown>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-05-09-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Colorado Springs shooting.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed by a gunman in a mass shooting during a birthday party at a residence in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The gunman, who committed suicide at the scene, is believed to have been a boyfriend of one of the victims.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-57052452>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-4-3"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Coptic monk Wael Saad Tawadros, better known as Brother Isaiah, is executed over the killing of bishop Anba Epiphanius, the abbot of the Monastery of Saint Macarius the Great in Wadi El Natrun, in 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Macau Business](<https://www.macaubusiness.com/egypt-hangs-coptic-monk-for-killing-of-abbot-family/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-05-09-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Colombian protests.

**Archived source account.** Claudia Blum, the Minister for Foreign Affairs of Colombia, resigns from her post amidst the ongoing anti-government protests that have killed at least 26 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Semana](<https://www.semana.com/nacion/articulo/se-va-del-cargo-la-canciller-claudia-blum/202104/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-05-09-6-1"></a>

Context: Environmental issues in Kyrgyzstan.

**Archived source account.** A court in Kyrgyzstan fines a company owned by Centerra Gold 261.7 billion soms for environmental pollution at the Kumtor Gold Mine.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Recorder](<https://www.brecorder.com/news/40091431/kyrgyz-court-fines-canadian-gold-miner-25bn-euros>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The China Manned Space Engineering Office says that remnants of the Chinese Long March-5B Y2 rocket made an uncontrolled re-entry into Earth's atmosphere into the Indian Ocean, just west of the Maldives.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/05/08/app-international-edition/china-space-debris-long-march-rocket-reentry-scn/index.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/05/08/science/china-rocket-reentry-falling-long-march-5b.html>).

<a id="event-2021-05-09-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea reports that it now holds the world's largest number of standard-essential patents followed by the United States, Finland, and Japan. Standard-essential patents refer to major technologies that are vital in producing standardized products and that must be verified by standards organizations.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20210509001100320?section=news>).

### 2021-05-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1356033081](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20May%2010&oldid=1356033081>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-10-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed and 29 more are injured when a roadside bomb hits a bus in Zabul Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/10/at-least-11-killed-in-afghanistan-bus-bombing>); [TOLO News](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-172073>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Five members of the National Directorate of Security, the head of the economy directorate of the province, and a manager of the Central Bank branch in Logar Province are killed in three separate incidents, all of which involved attacks by unknown gunmen. In a fourth incident in the same province, two civilians are killed and six more are wounded after two mortar shells hit their house on Sunday evening.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLO News](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-172073>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** In the early hours, the Taliban announces a three-day ceasefire to observe the Eid-ul-Fitr holiday. A Taliban spokesman says that it is for the mujahideen to provide a peaceful and secure atmosphere to their compatriots.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-taliban-declares-three-day-ceasefire-eid-celebration-this-week-spokesman-2021-05-09/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-0-7"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian groups in the Gaza Strip including Hamas fire barrages of rockets at Israeli cities and towns near the Gaza border, as well as seven toward Jerusalem, injuring one person. Israel retaliates with airstrikes in Gaza killing 24 people and wounding 103 others. Nine children and a Hamas leader are among the dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/10/palestinians-20-killed-in-fighting-including-9-children>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-0-9"></a>

Context: 2021 Colombian protests.

**Archived source account.** President of Colombia Iván Duque Márquez orders a mass deployment of troops to the city of Cali and its surrounding area after 12 days of protests.

Source citations (as archived): [MercoPress](<https://en.mercopress.com/2021/05/10/duque-militarizes-cali-and-neighbouring-areas-as-situation-worsens-in-colombia>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-0-10"></a>

Context: 2021 Colombian protests.

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch reports on the use of "horizontal high-speed multiple projectile launchers" meant to fire multiples of tear gas or stun grenades simultaneously. The Executive Director of the Americas Division, José Miguel Vivanco, publishes a corroborating video reportedly showing a Venom grenade launcher from Combined Systems being used against protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [MercoPress](<https://en.mercopress.com/2021/05/10/human-rights-watch-warns-colombian-police-uses-high-tech-projectile-launcher-against-demonstrators>); [Twitter](<https://twitter.com/JMVivancoHRW/status/1390396994804502535>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** A US Coast Guard vessel fires roughly 30 warning shots on Monday to drive away Iranian fast-attack boats in an "unsafe" encounter in the Strait of Hormuz.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/a-us-coast-guard-ship-fired-30-warning-shots-from-a-machine-gun-during-an-unsafe-encounter-with-iranian-fast-attack-boats/ar-BB1gzXfu?ocid=uxbndlbing>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-0-13"></a>

Context: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Citizens who evacuated from the Batken Region due to clashes at the Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border return to the area for the first time since the clashes.

Source citations (as archived): [AKIPress](<https://akipress.com/news:657996:Batken_evacuees_return_home/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-05-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Chernobyl disaster.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian scientists report that, for an unknown reason, the levels of nuclear radiation have increased in the remains of the Chernobyl power plant. Most areas of containment have shown decreasing radiation levels, however, in one particular room, radiation counts have doubled over the last four years. These radiation levels are high enough to preclude installing sensors. Additionally, fuel containing materials, which were initially the consistency of lava, are disintegrating into radioactive dust.

Source citations (as archived): [Popular Mechanics](<https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/energy/a36364988/chernobyl-nuclear-reactions/>); [Nature](<https://www.sciencemag.org/news/2021/05/nuclear-reactions-reawaken-chernobyl-reactor>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal.

**Archived source account.** Nepal reports a record 9,127 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 403,794.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines, COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines receives its first shipment of 193,050 doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine distributed through the COVAX initiative.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand, Lineage B.1.617.

**Archived source account.** Thailand reports its first two cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant in a woman and her four-year-old son who traveled from Pakistan and are currently in quarantine.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/indian-virus-variant-found-thai-travelers-pakistan-77600026>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-2-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.

**Archived source account.** Greece reopens primary and junior high schools for in-person classes for the first time in months. The courts also restart many activities.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News and World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/business/articles/2021-05-10/greece-welcomes-young-students-back-to-school-courts-reopen>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-2-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkey surpasses 5 million cases of COVID-19, becoming the fifth country to do so after the United States, India, Brazil, and France.

Source citations (as archived): [Bianet](<https://m.bianet.org/english/health/243817-turkey-s-coronavirus-death-toll-tops-43-thousand-cases-5-million>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-2-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom lowers its COVID-19 Alert level to level 3 as vaccinations and lockdown restrictions ease pressure on the NHS, which means that the transmission of the virus is no longer rising exponentially.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/covid-vaccine-uk-alert-level-b1844864.html>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-2-30"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina, variants of SARS-CoV-2.

**Archived source account.** Argentina reports its first cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant in two people who travelled from Paris, as well as its first case of the Lineage B.1.351 variant in a person who travelled from Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-confirms-first-cases-covid-19-variants-india-south-africa-2021-05-10/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-2-32"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / Variants of SARS-CoV-2.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization classifies the Lineage B.1.617 variant as a "Variant of Concern", becoming the fourth variant to be designated as being of global concern after the B.1.1.7, B.1.351, and P.1 variants.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/coronavirus-strain-found-in-india-is-a-variant-of-concern-who-says-11620662311>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain, COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates, Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-05-10-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Dunedin Countdown stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A man stabs and injures four people in a Countdown supermarket in Dunedin, New Zealand. He is also injured and has been hospitalised.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-05-10/four-people-stabbed-in-new-zealand-countdown-including-staff/100128890>).

<a id="event-2021-05-10-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Paris dismisses the complaint of a French Vietnamese woman against several manufacturers of the Agent Orange chemical used by the United States military during the Vietnam War. The court rules it to be a sovereign case under the jurisdiction of the United States

Source citations (as archived): [VnExpress](<https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/french-court-dismisses-complaint-over-agent-orange-use-in-vietnam-war-4275860.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-05-10-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Federal Parliament of Nepal votes 124–93 in a no confidence vote against Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli over both his handling of the COVID-19 pandemic and his attempts to lead a minority government after his party, the Nepal Communist Party, split into the Communist Party of Nepal–UML and Communist Party of Nepal–Maoist earlier this year. President Bidya Devi Bhandari is expected to name Oli caretaker Prime Minister until the next election.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/10/nepal-pm-loses-confidence-vote-amid-surging-pandemic>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-05-10-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sources in Russia's defense industry report that Russia will be carrying out three tests of the RS-28 Sarmat hypersonic ICBM during the third quarter of 2021 at the Kura Missile Test Range in Kamchatka Krai as part of flight design tests. Two of the tests are expected to test maximum capabilities for the ICBM with a specified range of 18,000 km and speeds of around Mach 20, prior to final deployment with the armed forces in 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/defense/1286447>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-05-10-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italian Football Federation president Gabriele Gravina threatens to expel Juventus from Serie A, the highest tier of the Italian football league system, if the club does not withdraw from the proposed European Super League before the start of the next season.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/57061939>).

### 2021-05-11
