#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-11-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Israel launches another series of strikes in the Gaza Strip, killing eight people and wounding several others, thereby bringing the total death toll from the strikes to 32. The Hanadi Tower is also destroyed during the incident. Hamas responds to the attacks by launching rockets towards Israel, including several towards Tel Aviv, killing three people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinian-rocket-fire-israeli-air-strikes-gaza-2021-05-11/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-11-0-2"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** An Israeli-Arab man is killed and two more are wounded after a Jewish gunman opens fire against a group of protestors in Lod.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://m.jpost.com/breaking-news/25-year-old-man-killed-2-more-injured-in-shooting-incident-in-lod-667815>).

<a id="event-2021-05-11-0-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian actress Maisa Abd Elhadi is injured after being shot by Israel Police in Haifa.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/tv/news/baghdad-central-maisa-abd-elhadi-b1846170.html?amp>).

<a id="event-2021-05-11-0-4"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Protests break out in London, New York City, and other cities across the world expressing solidarity with Palestine. In Manhattan, pro-Palestinian protesters gather at the Israeli consulate on East 42nd Street. #### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-12-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mullah Mannan Niazi, the deputy leader of a splinter group of Taliban led by Mullah Rasul, is wounded and left in a coma after attackers target the area where he lived in Herat Province. Three of Niazi's men are also killed and four others wounded during the clash.

<a id="event-2021-05-12-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks.

**Archived source account.** Afghan officials confirm that Nirkh District, in Maidan Wardak Province, was captured by the Taliban yesterday as the group seized the district building and set it on fire after days of intense siege. Attacks by the group have significantly increased as United States troops have started to withdraw from the country before the final deadline of September 11.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-taliban-captures-strategic-district-close-to-kabul/a-57503194>).

<a id="event-2021-05-12-0-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-seven more Palestinian civilians are killed after further airstrikes are executed by Israel in the Gaza Strip, thereby bringing the death toll to 69. Among the victims are a five-year-old child and their parents, who died when a residential building collapsed, while five more are farmers killed at their farms. The number of children killed rises to seventeen. At least 390 people have also been injured. The main Palestinian headquarters and all of the police stations in Gaza are destroyed by the strikes. Protests also erupt in the West Bank, resulting in the deaths of three protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/12/israeli-bombardment-continues-on-gaza>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-05-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Protests against the 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/kenyan-police-disperse-protesters-demonstrating-against-israeli-attacks-gaza-2021-05-13/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-13-5-3"></a>

Context: Colonial Pipeline cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** The Colonial Pipeline attempts to restart a resource movement after a cyberattack six days ago. The ransomware attackers were reportedly paid $4–5 million in cryptocurrency prior to the restart. Meanwhile, it is revealed that the cyberattack targeted the corporate business computers and that the physical resource supply was turned off in response to the attack. Furthermore, 100 gigabytes of Colonial Pipeline corporate data was stolen prior to the attack. The hacker group, DarkSide, attempts to distance itself from the Colonial Pipeline attack, saying that it provides ransomware as a service, selling licenses to other criminals.

Source citations (as archived): [Tom's Guide](<https://www.tomsguide.com/news/colonial-pipeline-attack-qa>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/drivers-struggle-find-fuel-us-southeast-pipeline-begins-restart-2021-05-13/>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-05-09/colonial-hackers-stole-data-thursday-ahead-of-pipeline-shutdown>); [Politico.eu](<https://www.politico.eu/article/colonial-pipeline-us-cyberattack-europe-energy-infrastructure/>); [Fox Business](<https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/colonial-pipeline-pays-hackers-millions-pipeline-back-online>).

<a id="event-2021-05-13-5-5"></a>

Context: Gun violence in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Nine people are wounded, three of them critically, in a shootout between groups at a residence in Providence, Rhode Island. It is believed to be the largest shooting in Providence's memory.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/rhode-island-providence-shootings-624410b6ff8a8e5fab98245784200aec>).

<a id="event-2021-05-13-5-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol.

**Archived source account.** An active-duty major with the U.S. Marine Corps is arrested and charged for assault and obstruction in relation to the storming of the United States Capitol, thereby making him the first known active-duty service member to be charged in relation to the events of January 6.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2021/05/13/capitol-riot-marine-corps-officer-charged-role-jan-6-attack/5075571001/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-13-5-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** After compromising the Washington, D.C., police department's computers in April, the Babuk group releases thousands of the department's sensitive documents on the dark web. Hundreds of police officer disciplinary files dating back to 2004 are found, as well as intelligence reports that include feeds from other agencies, including the FBI and the Secret Service. The group reportedly asked for $4 million in ransom and were offered $100,000 at which point negotiations stopped.

Source citations (as archived): [WMC-TV](<https://www.wmcactionnews5.com/2021/05/13/dc-police-victim-massive-data-leak-by-ransomware-gang/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/13/dc-police-suffer-massive-info-leak-after-ransomware-attack>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-14-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2021 Afghanistan attacks / 2021 Kabul mosque bombing.

**Archived source account.** Twelve people, including an imam, are killed and 15 others are wounded when a bomb explodes inside a mosque in the Shakardara District on the outskirts of Kabul. The Taliban condemns the attack, for which nobody has so far claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/twelve-killed-explosion-kabul-mosque-during-friday-prayers-2021-05-14/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-14-0-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the Israeli airstrikes in Gaza increases to 137 people with more than 920 others wounded, as shellings and bombardments increase in the districts of Gaza. The Shati refugee camp is hit by bombings, resulting in the death of ten people, including eight children, thereby bringing the number of children killed to 36. The death toll in Israel rises to nine people killed, including a six-year-old boy. The International Criminal Court says that individuals involved in the conflict may be targeted by an investigation into war crimes. Violence also continues in the West Bank, with Israeli settlers attacking Palestinian homes in the city of Hebron, while eleven protestors in the West Bank are shot dead by soldiers, bringing the number of Palestinian protestors killed there to 15. Additionally, two men are killed in Lebanon during protests at the border against Israeli soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/14/israels-bombardment-of-gaza-continues-live>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-16-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Israel continues airstrikes in the Gaza Strip, killing several more people, including 42 in Gaza City, which is the deadliest single attack in the past week. The total death toll there rises to 192 people, including 58 children and 34 women.

<a id="event-2021-05-16-0-2"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hamas fires over 190 rockets at towns and cities in southern Israel, damaging numerous buildings, including a synagogue. Approximately 3,000 rockets have been fired in the past week.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/southern-communities-pounded-by-gaza-rockets-pm-fighting-will-take-more-time/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-16-0-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force destroys the office and home of Yahya Sinwar, the most senior Hamas official in Gaza.

**Archived source account.** After discussions in Qatar and Pakistan, Taliban representatives have reportedly agreed to substantive talks with the Afghan Republic team in Doha, and to attend a summit in Istanbul that they initially refused to attend.

<a id="event-2021-05-17-2-24"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the first global study of its kind, the World Health Organization and the International Labour Organization find that working more than 55 hours a week can lead to higher risks of strokes and ischemic heart disease. The study, which was conducted between 2000 and 2016, also found that people living in the Southeast Asia and Western Pacific regions, as well as men that are at least middle-aged, are particularly susceptible to risks from overworking.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/long-working-hours-are-killer-who-study-shows-2021-05-17/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-17-2-25"></a>

**Archived source account.** Darwin's Arch collapses in the Galapagos Islands.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/galapagos-darwins-arch-collapses/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-05-17-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Morocco–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** More than 5,000 migrants cross the border into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta in an unprecedented influx. The Spanish government in Ceuta says 50 additional Guardia Civil agents and 150 national police officers will be deployed to maintain security in the city. The crossings come amid tensions between Spain and Morocco over Polisario Front leader Brahim Ghali's hospital treatment in Spain for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/may/17/record-1000-migrants-reach-spains-north-african-enclave-ceuta-in-a-day>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-05-17-4-1"></a>

Context: International protests over the 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Protesters gather in Sanaa, Yemen, to protest Israel's attacks on the Gaza Strip. During the protest, demonstrators are seen calling for a boycott of Israeli and American goods, as well as chanting "Death to America" and "Death to Israel".

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Ahram](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/9/411277/World/International/Protesters-in-Yemen-denounce-Israeli-crackdown.aspx>).

<a id="event-2021-05-17-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican President Andrés Manuel López Obrador apologizes for the Torreón massacre that happened during the Mexican Revolution in 1911, in which revolutionaries led by Francisco I. Madero targeted immigrant Asian merchants, among whom 303 Chinese Mexicans and five Japanese Mexicans were slaughtered. This is the first time the Mexican government apologizes for the massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/mexican-president-apologizes-1911-massacre-chinese-77738535>).

<a id="event-2021-05-17-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States approves the release of Saifullah Paracha, a 73-year-old Pakistani man who is currently the oldest prisoner held in the Guantanamo Bay detention camp. He is expected to be formally released in the next few months.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1624317/us-approves-release-of-oldest-guantanamo-prisoner-a-73-year-old-man-from-pakistan>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-05-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Elections in Chile.

**Archived source account.** Independent candidates win the largest number of seats in the election for the Constitutional Convention. The traditional center-right and center-left alliances reach their worst performance in an election since 1990, while the coalition between Broad Front and the Communist Party becomes the second-largest political force.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/chile-ruling-coalition-heading-disappointment-constitutional-delegates-vote-2021-05-17/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/17/chile-ruling-coalition-heading-for-upset-in-constitutional-vote>).

<a id="event-2021-05-17-5-2"></a>

Context: Elections in Chile.

**Archived source account.** In the municipal elections, the center-right Chile Vamos loses some of the largest cities in the country, while Irací Hassler becomes the first Communist mayor of Santiago. In the first election of regional governors, Christian Democrat Claudio Orrego and leftist Karina Oliva move to the second round in the Santiago Metropolitan Region, while the officialist Catalina Parot gets fourth place.

Source citations (as archived): [Mercopress](<https://en.mercopress.com/2021/05/17/communist-candidate-to-become-iraci-hassler-stocks-plummet>).

<a id="event-2021-05-17-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Samoa clears the way for Naomi Mata'afa to form a new government and thereby become the first female Prime Minister of Samoa, ending a political deadlock. This would end a long tenure by current Prime Minister Tuilaepa Aiono Sailele Malielegaoi, who has held power since November 1998.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/samoa-set-appoint-first-female-prime-minister-2021-05-17/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-05-18-5-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Morocco–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** Spain deploys the Army in Ceuta to control the border with Morocco while immigrants continue to arrive in the face of the permissiveness of the Moroccan police. At least one migrant is reported dead while trying to cross the border in Melilla.

Source citations (as archived): [El País in English](<https://english.elpais.com/spanish_news/2021-05-18/more-than-6000-people-swim-to-ceuta-amid-diplomatic-row-between-spain-and-morocco.html>).

<a id="event-2021-05-18-5-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Morocco–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** The mayor-president of Ceuta Juan Jesús Vivas calls the situation an "invasion" and announces the suspension of the vaccination campaign against COVID-19 for Wednesday as the city is experiencing a "state of emergency atmosphere".

Source citations (as archived): [20 minutos](<https://www.20minutos.es/noticia/4699841/0/el-presidente-de-ceuta-dice-que-la-ciudad-vive-un-estado-de-excepcion-por-la-crisis-migratoria-y-suspende-la-vacunacion/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-18-5-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Morocco–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** Spanish Minister of Foreign Affairs Arancha González Laya summons the Moroccan ambassador, who is later recalled to Rabat for consultations. Ambassador Karima Benyaich advises that "there are actions that have consequences, and they have to be assumed", referring to the fact that the Polisario leader is receiving treatment for COVID-19 in Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [Europa Press](<https://www.europapress.es/nacional/noticia-exteriores-convoca-embajadora-marruecos-llegada-masiva-migrantes-ceuta-20210518143036.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-57156320>).

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte issues a gag order that forbids his cabinet from publicly discussing the South China Sea dispute, which comes after some of his secretaries criticized the government of China over the presence of Chinese vessels in the exclusive economic zone of the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/18/philippines-duterte-issues-gag-order-over-south-china-sea>).

<a id="event-2021-05-18-5-7"></a>

Context: Lebanon–Saudi Arabia relations, Lebanon–United Arab Emirates relations.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates both summon their Lebanese ambassadors after Lebanese Foreign Minister Charbel Wehbe accused the Gulf States of playing a role in the rise of ISIL in a heated exchange with a Saudi guest during an interview yesterday. Wehbe has since apologized for his remarks.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/18/saudi-arabia-summons-lebanons-envoy-over-ministers-remarks>).

<a id="event-2021-05-18-5-9"></a>

Context: Libya–Tunisia relations.

**Archived source account.** Tunisia's flag carrier Tunisair announces that it has resumed services to Libya in light of the UN-sponsored peace agreement, becoming the first foreign airline to connect to the country since the outbreak of the Second Libyan Civil War seven years ago. Yesterday, the airline flew its first flights to Benghazi and Tripoli, and it has scheduled five flights to both cities each week.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/18/tunisair-first-foreign-carrier-to-resume-libya-flights>).

These counties join Jefferson and Union counties that have already passed similar measures, while Douglas and Harney counties are voting on similar measure in upcoming elections.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-05-20-5-1"></a>

Context: Colonial Pipeline cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** In the aftermath of the attack, it is revealed at a Senate Armed Services cyber subcommittee hearing that the Department of Homeland Security was not alerted to the ransomware attack and that the Justice Department was not alerted to the ransom type or the amount of money demanded, prompting discussion about the numerous information silos in the government and difficulties of information-sharing between them.

Source citations (as archived): [USNI News](<https://news.usni.org/2021/05/18/lawmakers-grill-pentagon-homeland-security-officials-on-how-to-prevent-another-colonial-pipeline-style-attack>).

<a id="event-2021-05-20-5-2"></a>

Context: Colonial Pipeline cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic publishes a bitcoin wallet report showing that $90 million in bitcoin ransom payments were made to DarkSide or DarkSide affiliates over the last year, originating from 47 distinct wallets. According to a DarkTracer release of 2,226 victim organizations since May 2019, 99 organizations have been infected with the DarkSide malware – suggesting that approximately 47% of victims paid a ransom, and that the average payment was $1.9 million. The DarkSide developer has received bitcoins worth $15.5 million (17%), with the remaining $74.7 million (83%) going to the various affiliates.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Examiner](<https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/colonial-pipeline-hackers-received-$90-million-ransom-victim?fbclid=IwAR2h6ec41MuchXPLefKvz4uL4jMZE8cvwt1TOZCL47LffdWg--Ghp9s6hWo>); [Fox Business](<https://www.foxbusiness.com/money/colonial-pipeline-hacker-darkside-reaped-90m-from-victims>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-05-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A symbolic re-trial for medieval Italian writer Dante Alighieri, who was sentenced to exile in absentia in 1302, is held virtually in Florence.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/florence-hosts-re-trial-of-dante-convicted-and-banished-in-1302/a-57607273>).

<a id="event-2021-05-21-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** New York art collector Stuart Pivar says that he has rediscovered a long-lost Vincent van Gogh masterpiece titled "Auvers, 1890" at an auction. The painting is being sent to the van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam because they have requested to see it and authenticate it. The painting, which is signed on the back as "Vincent" and dated 1890, is a 36" by 36" square panorama of the valley of Auvers-sur-Oise, showing its mosaic of wheat fields bisected by a railway line. The painting also bears the label of art collector Jonas Netter. If authenticated, the work would be van Gogh's largest painting and his only painting in a square format.

Source citations (as archived): [Page Six](<https://pagesix.com/2021/05/20/stuart-pivar-claims-hes-rediscovered-a-long-lost-van-gogh/>).

<a id="event-2021-05-21-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Culture Secretary Oliver Dowden says that the government is considering penalizing the BBC for its 1995 interview with Diana, Princess of Wales, in which an independent inquiry conducted by former Justice of the Supreme Court John Dyson, Lord Dyson found interviewer Martin Bashir to be guilty of deceit and breaching the network's editorial conduct to obtain the interview.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/uk-govt-warns-potential-action-against-bbc-after-1995-diana-interview-cover-up/articleshow/82851140.cms>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-05-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Health Service Executive cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** It is revealed that documents and patient records have already been leaked online from the Irish Health Service Executive ransomware cyberattack. These files were offered by the "ContiLocker Team", believed to be related to be the "Wizard Spider" group from Eastern Europe, as samples to prove that they had confidential information. The 27 files include personal records of 12 individuals, including admissions records and laboratory results. The group claims to have stolen 700GB of unencrypted files from the Irish health service, including patient and employee information, contracts, financial statements and payroll records.

Source citations (as archived): [News Talk](<https://www.newstalk.com/news/hse-cyberattack-hackers-begin-sharing-personal-medical-information-online-1197155>).

<a id="event-2021-05-21-5-2"></a>

Context: Health Service Executive cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** A decryption key for the hospital records has been provided to the Irish Health Service Executive. The government says that it had not paid and would not pay any ransom in exchange for the purported key. The group responsible for the cyberattack continues to threaten to sell patient data.

Source citations (as archived): [US News and World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/technology/articles/2021-05-20/ireland-testing-decryption-key-that-could-ease-impact-of-health-system-cyberattack>).

<a id="event-2021-05-21-5-4"></a>

Context: Animal welfare and rights in Germany.

**Archived source account.** The Bundestag votes to ban the culling of male chicks starting on January 1, 2022. The ban makes Germany the first country to ban male chick culling by law. Agriculture Minister Julia Klöckner, who sponsored the bill, says that she did not consider chick culling "to be ethically acceptable".

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-bans-male-chick-culling-from-2022/a-57603148>).

<a id="event-2021-05-21-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** CNA Financial, the seventh-largest commercial insurer in the United States, reveals that in March 2021, it was the target of a ransomware attack and had paid $40 million to a group named Phoenix two weeks after a trove of company data was stolen, and CNA officials were locked out of their network. The CNA hackers used malware called Phoenix Locker, a variant of ransomware dubbed Hades. Hades was created by a Russian cybercrime syndicate known as Evil Corp., according to cybersecurity experts. In December 2019, the Treasury Department announced sanctions on 17 individuals and six entities linked to Evil Corp. The designation by the Treasury Department made it illegal for a U.S. company to knowingly pay a ransom to Evil Corp.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-05-20/cna-financial-paid-40-million-in-ransom-after-march-cyberattack?sref=KQPtNSUL>); [FOX Business](<https://www.foxbusiness.com/technology/cna-insurance-40-million-ransom-cyberattack>).

<a id="event-2021-05-21-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** One Catholic priest is killed and another kidnapped in an armed attack on the parish in Malunfashi, Sokoto State, in northern Nigeria. Several other people are wounded in the assault.

Source citations (as archived): [Fides](<http://www.fides.org/en/news/70162-AFRICA_NIGERIA_A_priest_killed_and_another_kidnapped_in_northern_Nigeria>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-05-22-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** India releases information on a second, deadlier form of "white fungus" infection that has begun spreading among patients initially placed at risk because of COVID-19. The newly identified white fungus is known as candidiasis. Steroid treatment can cause white fungal infection in COVID patients while unsterile use of oxygen cylinders can also be a cause. White fungus infection is more dangerous because it rapidly affects vital organs and genitals along with the mouth, stomach and skin. The antifungal drugs fluconazole, itraconazole, caspofungin, and micafungin are being prescribed to treat patients.

Source citations (as archived): [New Indian Express](<https://www.newindianexpress.com/galleries/nation/2021/may/22/white-fungus-outbreak-updates-what-we-know-so-far-about-the-infection-deadlier-than-black-fungus-103145--1.html>).

These new restrictions will take effect on May 25.

**Archived source account.** India reports more than 8,800 cases of the deadly "black fungus" in a growing epidemic of the disease. The normally rare infection has a mortality rate of 50% and is believed to occur 12 to 18 days after recovery from COVID-19. Following the increase in the number of cases, India's states and territories are told to declare the disease as an epidemic.

<a id="event-2021-05-23-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A report is published documenting the ways people have been taking advantage of the pandemic to enrich themselves. #### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-05-24-7-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Samoan constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Prime Minister Tuilaepa Aiono Sailele Malielegaoi refuses to concede power to recently elected Prime Minister Naomi Mataʻafa and a disputed government ensues with a FAST spokesman calling Malielegaoi's move as a "coup". New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern calls for upholding of democracy and law but rejects any interventionist role whereas the Federated States of Micronesia is the first country to recognize the legitimacy of Mataʻafa's government. Mataʻafa and FAST MPs remain locked out of parliament on the opening day of the new legislative session.

### 2021-05-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1100900844](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20May%2025&oldid=1100900844>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-05-25-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** One protester is killed and dozens are injured after police attack protesters gathered at Baghdad's Tahrir Square in the evening, where hundreds marched to demand the end of targeted killings of prominent journalists and activists.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2021/05/25/iraq-protests-one-killed-amid-clashes-between-demonstrators-and-security-forces>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-05-25-1-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in India, Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** Tata Steel has said that it will support the families of its workers in India who have died of COVID-19. The firm said that it will pay deceased employees' salaries, housing and medical benefits until what would have been their retirement at the age of 60. The company has also pledged to cover the education costs of the children of deceased front line workers until they graduate. This is the third firm to make such an announcement, after hospitality group Oyo Rooms and glass manufacturer Borosil.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-57236708>).

<a id="event-2021-05-25-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Costa Rica becomes the 38th member of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/costa-rica-becomes-latest-member-of-oecd-01621963213?tesla=y>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-05-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The MV X-Press Pearl, a container ship sailing with a Singaporean flag and carrying cosmetics and chemicals, including 25 tonnes of nitric acid, catches fire off the coast of Sri Lanka after an explosion was detected onboard. Rescuers evacuated all crew from the ship and reported that two people were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/sri-lanka-evacuates-crew-burning-container-ship-2021-05-25/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-05-25-6-1"></a>

Context: 2018–2021 Arab protests.

**Archived source account.** On the third day of economic protests, Omani protestors conduct sit-ins at a bridge in Sohar, and similar protests occur in Rustaq, Nizwa, and Sur.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/25/protest-in-oman-over-poor-economy-jobs-continue-for-third-day>).

<a id="event-2021-05-25-6-3"></a>

Context: Islamophobia in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** An independent report commissioned by the ruling Conservative Party on discrimination within the party details that two-thirds of the 727 discrimination complaints filed against the party from 2015 to 2020 are classified as Islamophobic incidents. Incidents listed include comments made by Prime Minister Boris Johnson about the attire of Muslim women, and comments by London Mayoral candidate Zac Goldsmith about his opponent and current Mayor Sadiq Khan during the 2016 election. It also found "no evidence" that these complaints were treated significantly different from other complaints.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/25/uk-conservative-party-has-ongoing-issue-with-islamophobia-report>).

<a id="event-2021-05-25-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) announces that it will begin making $4 billion of loan forgiveness payments for 13,000 loans that were made by the agency to Black, Hispanic and Indigenous farmers beginning in June. From there, the agency said that it will also distribute loan relief for another 3,000 loans which were made by banks and guaranteed by the USDA. The program has been delayed because of accusations of racism and is currently facing multiple lawsuits.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX Business](<https://www.foxbusiness.com/economy/usda-debt-forgiveness-black-farmers-june>).

**Archived source account.** In a landmark case, The Hague district court orders Royal Dutch Shell to cut its carbon emissions to 45% of its 2019 emission levels. This is the first time that a company has been legally forced to uphold the obligations laid out in the Paris agreement. A spokesperson for Shell states that the company will appeal the decision.

<a id="event-2021-06-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Lebanese liquidity crisis.

<a id="event-2021-06-01-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amazon quietly changes its terms of service to allow customers to file lawsuits after plaintiffs that were barred from filing a class action lawsuit filed 75,000 individual arbitration demands on behalf of Echo users. This resulted in a bill for tens of millions of dollars in filing fees, according to lawyers involved, which would be payable by Amazon under its own policies.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox Business](<https://www.foxbusiness.com/lifestyle/amazon-arbitration-demands-lawsuit>).

<a id="event-2021-06-01-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** American food processing company JBS USA is hit by a massive ransomware attack, temporarily shutting down its operations in the United States, Canada, and Australia. White House spokeswoman Karine Jean-Pierre claims the attack is Russian in origin, and the FBI is currently investigating.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-57318965>).

<a id="event-2021-06-01-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** eBay prohibits sellers from using PayPal, now mandating that all funds will be transferred directly to and from their bank accounts.

Authorities blame IPOB for a recent series of attacks on government buildings in Rivers State.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden signs an executive order banning Americans from investing in nearly a dozen Chinese companies and their subsidiaries, such as China General Nuclear Power Group, either for their ties to the People's Liberation Army or for selling surveillance technology that is used to spy on the country's religious minorities or dissidents. The ban will go into effect on August 2, and current investors have a year to fully divest from these companies.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-06-03-3-1"></a>

Context: George Floyd protests in Minneapolis–Saint Paul, 2020–2021 United States racial unrest.

**Archived source account.** Unannounced and early in the morning, Minneapolis officials had cement barricades and other objects removed from George Floyd Square. Demonstrators gathered to protest the removals and after city crews left, activists quickly restored the barricades and other objects around the intersection. Several activists later spoke at a press conference in opposition to the city's action. Jaylani Hussein, director of the Minnesota Council on American-Islamic Relations, said it was an attempt to "delete history".

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/06/03/us/george-floyd-memorial-minneapolis.html>).

**Archived source account.** The Lahore High Court in Punjab, Pakistan, overturns convictions of illiterate married couple Shafqat Emmanuel and Shagufta Kausar, who were convicted and sentenced to death in 2014 for sending a blasphemous text message to a local imam in 2013. Prosecutors state that they will appeal the verdict.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-57347604>).

<a id="event-2021-06-10-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A report by the International Labour Organization and UNICEF states that approximately 160 million children, over half of them aged between five and 11, are involved in child labour, the highest figures in 20 years. <a id="event-2021-06-11-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Security research firm NordLocker publishes a report on an anonymous trojan virus program that has stolen 1.2 terabytes of login credential information and personally identifiable information from 26 million users between 2018 and 2020. The login credentials were stored in a cloud database and ranged across a large selection of website types from almost a million websites including Amazon, eBay, Facebook, Twitter, Walmart, Apple, Paypal, Gmail, Netflix, and Steam. The malware also targeted stored files in desktops and Downloads folders. Over 6 million files were stolen, with 50% being text files, 1 million images, and 650,000 Word or PDF files. The malware also took screenshots and images of users with their own webcams.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/other/nearly-26m-amazon-facebook-apple-ebay-user-logins-stolen-by-hackers/ar-AAKXasT>); [Fox Business](<https://www.foxbusiness.com/technology/hackers-logins-amazon-facebook-apple-ebay>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** South Korea eases COVID-19-related restrictions at large concerts and sports events, with up to 4,000 people allowed to attend K-pop concerts and other cultural shows, as well as allowing sport stadiums to operate at 30% to 50% capacity depending on the district as the country continues its vaccination campaign.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Boris Johnson announces that the UK's final relaxing of pandemic-related restrictions in England will be delayed by four weeks due to an increase in the number of cases of the Lineage B.1.617 Delta variant. Reopening has been delayed from June 21 to at least July 19.

Fiji has now reported 1,118 cases nationwide.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ International](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/444725/fiji-covid-19-89-new-cases-govt-says-situation-worse-than-australia-nz>).

Additionally, the vaccine candidate was also found to be 86.3% effective against the Lineage B.1.1.7 Alpha variant that originated in the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN International](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/06/14/health/novavax-covid-19-vaccine-us-phase-3-trial-study/index.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/uk-study-finds-vaccines-offer-high-protection-against-hospitalisation-delta-2021-06-14/>).

**Archived source account.** The United States is investigating a leak at the Taishan Power Plant, in Taishan, Guangdong, China, which is partially owned by EDF. The French firm ruled out the possibility of an accident, saying the radiation levels were within the limit.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/06/14/politics/china-nuclear-reactor-leak-us-monitoring/index.html>); [NHK World-Japan](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20210615_05/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin defends himself from accusations of hacking and suppressing dissent, saying that the United States also does the same.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/putin-talks-hacking-navalny-capitol-110004418.html>).

<a id="event-2021-06-14-3-5"></a>

Context: Philippine drug war.

**Archived source account.** Chief Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court Fatou Bensouda states that preliminary evidence collected from 2016 to 2019 shows there is "a reasonable basis to believe that the Crime Against Humanity of murder was committed" by the administration of Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte during their drug war, and that a full investigation on the matter will be sought. Duterte's spokesman Harry Roque attacked the comments as "legally erroneous and politically motivated", and says that the International Criminal Court has no jurisdiction because the Philippines withdrew from the organization in 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/14/icc-prosecutor-seeks-probe-philippines-crackdown-on-drug-crime>).

<a id="event-2021-06-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Trump administration data seizure.

**Archived source account.** John Demers resigns as U.S. Assistant Attorney General for the National Security Division amid an investigation over allegations that the U.S. Department of Justice spied on Congressional Democrats during the Trump presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/top-doj-national-security-official-resigns-amid-fallout-over-seizure-n1270723>).

<a id="event-2021-06-14-4-4"></a>

Context: Post-coup unrest in Egypt (2013–2014).

**Archived source account.** Egypt's highest civilian court upholds the death sentence of 12 members of the Muslim Brotherhood over a 2013 sit-in, which ended with security forces opening fire and killing several hundred pro-Brotherhood protesters. The ruling, which cannot be appealed, leaves the men closer to execution with a pending approval by President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/egypt-upholds-death-sentence-12-senior-muslim-brotherhood-figures-2021-06-14/>).

Additionally, they are also the first suspects facing minor charges to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/06/14/us/politics/capitol-riot-investigation-sentencings.html>).

<a id="event-2021-06-14-4-8"></a>

Context: 2021 Peruvian general election.

**Archived source account.** An investigation is launched into supporters of presidential candidate Keiko Fujimori and the Popular Force party for incidents of harassment of electoral authorities via the Internet.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Latina](<https://www.plenglish.com/index.php?o=rn&amp;id=68407&amp;SEO=fujimoris-followers-are-under-investigation-in-peru>).

<a id="event-2021-06-14-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two American citizens, a U.S. Army Special Forces veteran and his son, plead guilty to helping former chairman of Nissan Carlos Ghosn escape from Japan to Lebanon in December 2019. Although Japan has asked for Ghosn's international capture, Lebanon has so far refused to extradite him.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/american-father-son-admit-tokyo-court-they-helped-carlos-ghosn-flee-japan-2021-06-14/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-14-4-10"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/06/14/reality-winner-who-leaked-russia-intel-to-the-intercept-released-from-prison.html>).

### 2021-06-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1361329007](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20June%2015&oldid=1361329007>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-06-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / June 2021 Mogadishu bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber detonates his explosives at a military camp in Mogadishu where new recruits were queueing outside the camp, killing 15 people and injuring many others. This is the deadliest attack in Mogadishu since December 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/15/somalia>).

<a id="event-2021-06-15-0-4"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** The anti-coup militia group Karenni National Defence Force announces that it has stopped its operations against the Burmese military following pleas by civilians residing in the areas they operate in, which have seen 100,000 civilians displaced. The group says that it will continue its opposition to the military junta through other means. Additionally, deposed leader Aung San Suu Kyi appears in court for the second day, and was reported to be in "better condition".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-militia-group-halts-attacks-troops-after-peace-plea-2021-06-15/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-15-0-6"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** 36 people are injured in a car bomb attack on a U.S. military base in Colombia. The Colombian government suspects possible self-attribution for the attack to the National Liberation Army.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/car-bomb-explosion-colombia-military-base-injures-23-military-sources-2021-06-15/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-06-15-1-1"></a>

Context: Australia–United Kingdom Free Trade Agreement.

**Archived source account.** The British government announces that a free trade agreement has been reached between Australia and the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-57478412>).

<a id="event-2021-06-15-1-3"></a>

Context: Censorship in India, Violence against Muslims in India.

**Archived source account.** The Indian Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology strips Twitter of legal protection from prosecution after the social media site refuses to take down a tweet featuring a video of an elderly Muslim man in Ghaziabad being assaulted by a Hindu mob and being forced to chant "Jai Shri Ram". Uttar Pradesh police, who demanded the removal of the tweet, alleges the video was "misleading".

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/twitter-loses-legal-indemnity-for-not-complying-with-new-it-rules-can-be-charged-for-users-posts-say-government-sources-2464846>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-06-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** The Taiwanese Defense Ministry reports that 28 Chinese air force planes, including four H-6 bombers capable of carrying nuclear weapons, entered Taiwan's air defense identification zone and flew close to the southern tip of the main island and around the Pratas Islands. This is China's largest incursion since Taiwan began monitoring such activities last year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taiwan-reports-largest-incursion-yet-by-chinese-air-force-2021-06-15/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-15-3-3"></a>

Context: Armenia–Turkey relations, Azerbaijan–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan announces that Turkey will open a consulate in Shusha, a Nagorno-Karabakh city captured by Azerbaijan during last year's war, and that he will look to co-produce military drones with Azerbaijan. Both announcements followed his tour of the contested region with Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev the same day. The Armenian Foreign Ministry condemns the visit as a provocation.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Monitor](<https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2021/06/erdogan-aliyev-cement-military-and-business-ties-during-karabakh-victory-lap>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-06-15-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 United States racial unrest, 2021 Uptown Minneapolis unrest, Killing of Deona Knajdek.

**Archived source account.** Heavily-armed police officers in Minneapolis begin clearing an intersection of Lake Street and Hennepin Avenue in Uptown neighborhood which had been the site of protests since June 3, when Winston Boogie Smith was killed by law enforcement. Tensions escalated dramatically since the death of protester Deona Knajdek when she was killed when a speeding car rammed into her car, which she was using to protect protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [WCCO-TV](<https://minnesota.cbslocal.com/2021/06/15/minneapolis-police-work-to-reopen-uptown-street-occupied-by-protesters/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-15-4-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** Seventeen Palestinians are arrested and 33 more are injured after Israeli police fire tear gas and rubber bullets at Palestinians protesting at the Damascus Gate over the procession of a march called Dance of Flags through Jerusalem's Old City.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/15/tensions-high-in-jerusalem-ahead-of-hardline-israeli-march>).

<a id="event-2021-06-15-4-5"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Hungary.

**Archived source account.** The Hungarian National Assembly passes a law banning content depicting or promoting same-sex relationships and gender reassignment to anyone under the age of 18. 157 MPs voted in favor, with all opposition parties except the far-right Jobbik boycotting the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2021/06/15/mps-in-hungary-back-ban-on-sharing-content-with-children-that-promotes-homosexuality>).

<a id="event-2021-06-15-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A French court issues the French subsidiary of the Dutch multinational conglomerate IKEA a €1 million (US$1.2 million) fine for conducting illegal employee monitoring activities on its employees and applicants between 2009 and 2012. Its former chief executive officer is also given a two-year prison sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [RTL Télé Lëtzebuerg](<https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/1738939.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-06-15-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Peruvian general election.

**Archived source account.** Pedro Castillo of the left-wing Free Peru party claims victory in the presidential election, with the final tally putting him 44,058 votes ahead of his rival Keiko Fujimori of the right-wing Popular Force party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/perus-castillo-leads-election-with-501-votes-after-all-ballots-tallied-2021-06-15/>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1351856782](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20June%2018&oldid=1351856782>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-06-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Kidnapping in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** A kidnapped female student is found dead as the Nigerian Army rescues five other students and two teachers who were kidnapped on Thursday from a school in Kebbi State.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/one-kidnapped-student-dead--seven-rescued-in-nigeria-s-kebbi-state--the-army-says/46717364>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Biden administration removes eight Patriot anti-missile batteries from Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Kuwait, and Iraq, removes the THAAD anti-missile defense system from Saudi Arabia, and announces that most jet squadrons and hundreds of American troops will be withdrawn from the region. The changes come in light of both de-escalating tensions with Iran and the administration changing its focus on countering China.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-military-to-withdraw-hundreds-of-troops-aircraft-antimissile-batteries-from-middle-east-11624045575>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-06-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Antwerp building collapse.

**Archived source account.** Five construction workers are killed and nine more injured after a school building site collapse pulling down the scaffolding supporting it, in Antwerp, Belgium.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-57542638>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 17 mine workers are killed and 14 others are injured when the bus carrying them to work falls into a ravine in the Department of Ayacucho, Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/internacional/20210618/7541422/muertos-heridos-accidente-caer-autobus-precipicio-peru-andes.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia reports 12,990 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of new cases since late-January. It brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1.96 million.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesia-reports-12990-new-coronavirus-infections-290-deaths>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel, COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine.

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian Authority cancels a planned vaccine exchange with Israel involving at least one million doses of the Pfizer vaccine, saying the first batch of doses Israel was going to send were near expiration. The swap was previously announced earlier in the day.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/18/palestinians-to-get-1-million-covid-vaccine-doses-in-israel-swap>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Oman.

**Archived source account.** Oman speeds up its COVID-19 vaccination as the number of cases increases in the country, which has seen only a small percentage of the population vaccinated.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/oman-slowest-vaccinator-gulf-pushes-campaign-amid-covid-19-surge-2021-06-18/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin closes the Euro 2020 fan zone due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in the Russian capital.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/moscow-closes-euro-2020-fan-zone-as-covid-cases-surge/a-57950652>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announces that as of June 26, it will no longer be mandatory to wear a face mask outdoors.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20210618/7539733/mascarilla-exteriores-espana-26-junio.html>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez receives his first dose of the COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20210618/7541594/pedro-sanchez-recibe-primera-dosis-vacuna-covid-19-madrid.html>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Boris Johnson expands COVID-19 vaccinations to people aged 18 years and older amidst concerns about the Lineage B.1.617 Delta variant.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/06/18/world/uk-vaccine-eligibility.html>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Restrictions are eased in Melbourne as the number of cases decreases. Melbournians will now be allowed to travel anywhere in the state of Victoria, public gatherings increase to 20 people and masks are no longer required outdoors. Private gatherings of up to two people will be allowed, gyms and indoor entertainment reopen, and workforce capacities increase. These new restrictions bring Melbourne into line with the rest of Victoria.

Source citations (as archived): [9 News](<https://www.9news.com.au/national/victorian-lockdown-restrictions-melbourne-coronavirus-covid19-rules-what-can-i-do/61700b39-6f71-4bd3-85c8-c2fa1f99a520>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand / COVID-19 vaccination in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern receives her first dose of the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff.co.nz](<https://i.stuff.co.nz/national/health/coronavirus/300336289/important-milestone-prime-minister-jacinda-ardern-gets-first-covid19-vaccine>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Papua New Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Papua New Guinea receives 146,000 doses of the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine from New Zealand, facilitated through the COVAX initiative.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/445020/png-receives-146-thousand-vaccine-doses-from-nz>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-2-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Uganda.

**Archived source account.** President Yoweri Museveni announces that the country has imposed new restrictions to combat the spread of COVID-19, including a ban on vehicular movements except for essential workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-imposes-new-anti-coronavirus-measures-stem-raging-pandemic-2021-06-18/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-06-18-3-1"></a>

Context: First Liberian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A federal court in Switzerland sentences Alieu Kosiah of the ULIMO rebel group to 20 years in prison for acts of rape, killings and cannibalism. He had been arrested in Switzerland in 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/swiss-verdict-due-liberia-war-crimes-trial-rape-cannibalism-2021-06-18/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-3-3"></a>

Context: Novara ramming.

**Archived source account.** A driver intentionally rams his truck into a crowd of workers protesting outside a Lidl supermarket in Novara, Piedmont, Italy, killing one of the workers and injuring two others. The suspected attacker is arrested near the scene. The incident came after a series of violent attacks and assaults against workers' protests in Italy in the past few weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [Fanpage](<https://www.fanpage.it/attualita/novara-sindacalista-travolto-e-ucciso-da-un-camion-durante-una-manifestazione-autista-fugge/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-3-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least 17 Palestinians are injured and 10 arrested after the IDF stormed Al-Aqsa Mosque to break up a rally held in response to videos of far-right marchers insulting the Islamic prophet Muhammad during the Dance of Flags on Tuesday. A further 47 are injured when the IDF fired tear gas and rubber bullets at demonstrators near Beita in the occupied West Bank protesting the recent establishment of a military outpost near the town.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/18/israeli-forces-storm-rally-in-support-of-prophet-at-al-aqsa>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-06-18-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Iranian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Iranian voters head to the polls to elect a successor to current President Hassan Rouhani. Hardline Chief Justice Ebrahim Raisi is projected to be the winner. Reformists and dissidents are calling for a boycott after most of their candidates were initially rejected by the Guardian Council and one other, former Vice President Mohsen Mehralizadeh, dropped out, saying that there is no serious competition against the hardliners.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-57510763>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-4-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Peruvian general election.

**Archived source account.** Interim President Francisco Sagasti condemns a letter signed by retired military officers that urges the Peruvian Armed Forces not to recognize Pedro Castillo as President. Sagasti also announces that an investigation is launched into the retired officers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-ex-military-stir-election-tensions-with-appeal-armed-forces-remedy-poll-2021-06-18/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations General Assembly reelects current Secretary-General of the United Nations António Guterres for a second term beginning in January.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/un-chief-guterres-appointed-second-term-2021-06-18/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-18-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Montenegrin Parliament votes 43–27 to dismiss Justice Minister Vladimir Leposavić for disputing the death toll of the Srebrenica massacre in March. Legislators then voted 55–19 to pass a resolution condemning the Bosnian genocide, banning Bosnian genocide denial, and establishing a commemorative holiday honoring the victims of the Srebrenica massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/18/montenegro-minister-sacked-over-srebrenica-genocide-denial>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-06-18-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 NBA playoffs.

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the Los Angeles Clippers advance to their first NBA Conference Finals after a 131–119 victory against the Utah Jazz in game 6. They will play the Phoenix Suns. During the game, Terance Mann scores a career-high 39 points.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/los-angeles-clippers-utah-jazz-nba-sports-25e260c944fe362d60838345903965c2>).

### 2021-06-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1061050804](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20June%2019&oldid=1061050804>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-06-19-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** President Ashraf Ghani names Bismillah Khan Mohammadi as his new defense minister and Abdul Sattar Mirzakwal as the new interior minister, replacing their respective predecessors amid a deteriorating security situation, with foreign forces withdrawing from the country and the Taliban gaining territory, capturing six more districts.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-president-ashraf-ghani-sacks-ministers-amid-deteriorating-security/a-57965826>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-0-3"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Saudi air defenses destroy six armed drones late in the evening, bringing the total of armed drones destroyed during the day to 17. A Houthi spokesman says that one drone was launched at Khamis Mushait while the Saudi air defenses say that two other drones toward Khamis Mushait were intercepted and that eight other drones were also launched toward the south of the kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/saudi-air-defences-intercept-houthi-armed-drone-says-state-tv-2021-06-19/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-06-19-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia.

**Archived source account.** Cambodia reports a record 20 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 414.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2135003/cambodia-reports-record-20-covid-deaths>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-1-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Laos.

**Archived source account.** Laos extends its lockdown measures for another 15 days until July 4 as the number of community transmission cases of COVID-19 continue to increase.

Source citations (as archived): [The Laotian Times](<https://laotiantimes.com/2021/06/19/laos-extends-lockdown-measures-for-further-15-days/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-1-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia.

**Archived source account.** Mongolia reports a record 14 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 439.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhuanet](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2021-06/19/c_1310016828.htm>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-1-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Indiana.

**Archived source account.** Indiana reports its first case of the Delta variant of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [WTHR-TV](<https://www.wthr.com/article/news/health/coronavirus/delta-variant-of-covid-19-detected-in-indiana/531-3c32d62a-5969-48cd-a168-d8abc8be32fd>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-1-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil surpasses 500,000 deaths from COVID-19, becoming the second country to do so after the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://amp.dw.com/en/brazil-exceeds-500000-covid-19-deaths/a-57956562>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-1-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji.

**Archived source account.** Fiji reports a record 150 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the national toll to 1,798. The Ministry of Health reports that most cases are from known clusters while others are under investigation. Also, Australia and New Zealand announce that they will deploy doctors to Fiji to help deal with the increase in the number of COVID-19 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/445099/fiji-covid-19-150-cases-as-nz-and-australia-medics-prepare-for-deployment>); [FBC News](<https://www.fbcnews.com.fj/news/covid-19/150-new-covid-19-infections-new-cluster-identified/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-06-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Australia–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Australia begins lodging a formal complaint against China with the World Trade Organization over anti-dumping duties on imported Australian wine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/jun/19/australia-takes-china-to-wto-over-its-trade-sanctions-on-australian-wines>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-06-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are critically wounded as a man intentionally drove his pickup truck into a group of cyclists taking part in a charity bike ride in Show Low, Arizona. The driver is shot and arrested. The motive behind the attack is unknown so far.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-57542454>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-06-19-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Brazilian protests.

**Archived source account.** As Brazil reaches 500,000 deaths due to COVID-19, demonstrations are held in hundreds of Brazilian cities and by Brazilians abroad. Protestors are critical of President Jair Bolsonaro's handling of the pandemic and demand his impeachment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/jun/19/fresh-protests-in-brazil-against-bolsonaros-handling-of-covid-pandemic>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-4-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Iranian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Rival candidates concede victory to hardline Chief Justice Ebrahim Raisi, who was widely predicted to be the next president. An official from the Interior Ministry claims that Raisi won 17.8 million votes out of the 28 million votes cast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/irans-sole-moderate-presidential-candidate-congratulates-raisi-his-victory-state-2021-06-19/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-4-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** Protesters against the military junta carry out a national day of "flower protest" to celebrate the 76th birthday of deposed leader Aung San Suu Kyi and condemn her arrest. The flower symbol was allegedly chosen because Suu Kyi is often seen with a flower on her head. Protests supporting the military junta led by Min Aung Hlaing also occur across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-flower-protests-mark-aung-san-suu-kyis-76th-birthday/a-57962893>).

<a id="event-2021-06-19-4-7"></a>

Context: 2021 Peruvian general election.

**Archived source account.** Supporters of Pedro Castillo and Keiko Fujimori gather following the election. Castillo supporters call for his win to be upheld, while Fujimori supporters call for the results to be overturned.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/20/rival-protests-in-peru-as-tensions-rise-over-presidential-vote>).

### 2021-06-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1100904985](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20June%2020&oldid=1100904985>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-06-20-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people are killed in Alabama, United States, during the Tropical Storm Claudette. Ten of the victims, nine of whom were children, die in a fiery 17-vehicle crash.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2021/06/20/tropical-storm-claudette-strengthen-least-12-dead-alabama/7762373002/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A tornado strikes Naperville, Illinois, U.S., destroying twelve homes and injuring six people.

Source citations (as archived): [WBBM-TV](<https://chicago.cbslocal.com/2021/06/21/naperville-tornadic-storm-damage/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-06-20-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

**Archived source account.** The number of COVID-19 vaccine doses administered in China surpasses one billion.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/06/20/asia/china-one-billion-doses-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-1-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia reports 13,737 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of cases since January 30.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-indonesia/indonesia-reports-13737-daily-coronavirus-infections-371-deaths-idUSL3N2O204Q>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-1-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines, COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The government signs an agreement to purchase 40 million doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine. It is the largest COVID-19 vaccine deal in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/philippines-40-million-pfizer-biontech-covid-19-vaccine-15053700>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-1-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan / COVID-19 vaccination in Taiwan, Taiwan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States sends 2.5 million doses of Moderna's vaccine to Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/6074433/us-taiwan-covid-19/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-1-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji.

**Archived source account.** Fiji reports a record for the second consecutive day of 166 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,964. The Ministry of Health also reports the death of a 77-year-old man from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/445165/166-more-fiji-covid-19-cases-continue-to-escalate>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-1-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France lifts its nighttime curfew due to an improvement in the COVID-19 situation in the country. The country previously dropped its outdoor mask requirement on June 17.

Source citations (as archived): [SortiraParis](<https://www.sortiraparis.com/news/in-paris/articles/238738-curfew-lifted-from-this-sunday-june-20-jean-castex-announced/lang/en>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-06-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations, Hong Kong–Taiwan relations.

**Archived source account.** The Taiwanese Mainland Affairs Council says that it will "adjust" the operations of its Hong Kong offices beginning tomorrow, stating that since July 2018, the Hong Kong government has been hindering the offices' operations by pressuring the Taiwanese staff to sign a letter affirming China's claim to Taiwan under the One-China policy in order to receive their work visas.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/20/taiwan-to-adjust-hong-kong-office-operations-in-one-china-row>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Diplomats meet in Vienna to negotiate and restore the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action, an agreement signed in 2015. Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett warns against rejoining the deal and calls for allies to "wake up" to the threat of Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-06-20/diplomats-to-meet-in-vienna-for-more-iran-nuclear-talks?context=amp>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-57546290>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-06-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Manhunt for Jürgen Conings.

**Archived source account.** Belgian officials report that Jürgen Conings, a 46-year-old soldier and far-right sympathizer who made threats against various politicians and virologists, was found dead in the Hoge Kempen National Park near the Dutch border.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-57542496>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Germany bans the flag of Hamas after it was used during protests over the 2021 Israel–Palestine crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Hamodia](<https://hamodia.com/2021/06/20/germany-bans-hamas-flag-display-pro-palestinian-protests/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-06-20-4-1"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of the provisional Libyan government Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh announces the reopening of a major coastal road connecting the western city of Misrata and the eastern city of Sirte, declaring it a major step in restoring stability in the country. However, a media unit connected to the Libyan National Army disputes this, saying that the road remains closed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/20/libya-pm-says-key-coastal-road-reopened-ahead-of-peace-talks>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-4-2"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The Libyan Presidential Council bans all unauthorized military movement in the country, after forces loyal to Libyan National Army leader Khalifa Haftar announce that they have seized control of the southern border with Algeria earlier in the day. The seizure was the first major military operation of its type since the ceasefire was signed last October.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/20/libya-haftars-lna-says-it-seized-control-of-border-with-algeria>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/libyas-haftar-closes-border-with-algeria-2021-06-20/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-4-4"></a>

Context: 2021 Armenian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** In a parliamentary snap election, former and acting Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan's Civil Contract wins the majority of seats of the National Assembly, but 16 fewer than it did in 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/armenia-votes-neck-and-neck-parliamentary-election-2021-06-20/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-20-4-6"></a>

Context: 2021 French regional elections.

**Archived source account.** In a series of elections seen as a major bellwether for next year's presidential election, exit polls show left-wing parties and the right-wing Republicans as the main winners, obtaining 34% and 29% of the total votes respectively. The far-right National Rally and the ruling centrist La République En Marche\! receive disappointing results, with the former receiving 19% of the total votes, and the latter receiving only 10.9% and not even qualifying for the second round in some regions.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico.eu](<https://www.politico.eu/article/emmanuel-macron-crushing-defeat-france-local-elections-exit-poll/>).

<a id="event-2021-06-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalan independence leaders.

**Archived source account.** Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announces that the nine Catalan separatist leaders involved in the unsuccessful 2017 independence bid will be pardoned tomorrow, saying that this is needed to ease tensions with Catalonia. President of the Catalan Government Pere Aragonès welcomes the pardons but says that they will pursue more concessions, such as a new authorized independence referendum. The Spanish oppositional parties subsequently announce that they will try to reverse the pardons.

Pérez says that he will appeal the judge's ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/peru-fujimori-avoids-return-to-pre-trial-detention/a-57987223>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-06-21-3-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Swedish government crisis.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Stefan Löfven's government collapses after a vote of no-confidence is adopted by the Riksdag. Löfven has one week to either resign or call a snap election.
