#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France begins to require people who want to enter shopping centres, cafés, restaurants, or travel by long-distance bus, train, and airplane, to show a health pass generated by a QR code, which contains either proof of full vaccination, a negative test result from the previous 72 hours, or that the person has recovered from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210809-france-to-implement-coronavirus-health-pass-despite-protests>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland, COVID-19 vaccination in Switzerland.

**Archived source account.** Swissmedic approves the Moderna COVID-19 vaccine for children between the ages of 12 and 17.

Source citations (as archived): [Swissinfo](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/second-anti-covid-vaccine-for-swiss-teenagers-approved/46853984>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland.

**Archived source account.** Scotland moves to level zero and removes most of the remaining COVID-19-related restrictions, allowing all hospitality venues, including nightclubs, to reopen at full capacity and to remove most legal social distancing requirements. However, face masks remains mandatory in indoor public settings and on public transport, and must be worn by pupils and teachers at school for the first six weeks of the semester.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-58136277>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Brunei.

**Archived source account.** Brunei reports a record 42 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours after reporting their first local infections in 15 months, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 406.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/brunei-sees-record-covid-19-cases-after-first-local-infections-15-months-2021-08-09/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran reports a record for the second consecutive day of 40,808 new cases and 588 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 4.199 million and the nationwide death toll to 94,603.

Source citations (as archived): [Asharq Al-Aswat](<https://english.aawsat.com/home/article/3123026/iran-says-one-person-dying-covid-19-every-two-minutes>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal, COVID-19 vaccination in Nepal.

**Archived source account.** Nepal begins administering second doses of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine dose for nearly 1.4 million elderly people following a months-long delay due to India suspending exports of vaccines due to a substantial increase in the number of cases there. The vaccines were donated by Japan and Bhutan.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio France Internationale](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/nepal-s-elderly-get-second-covid-19-vaccine-shots-after-months-long-wait>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 vaccination in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Therapeutic Goods Administration grants provisional approval for the Moderna COVID-19 vaccine, becoming the fourth vaccine to be approved for use in Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/moderna-vaccine-gets-provisional-approval-in-australia-20210809-p58h9p.html>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-21"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Palau.

**Archived source account.** Palau reaches herd immunity as 80% of its 12-and-over population are vaccinated against COVID-19. Plans to vaccinate teenagers are underway as tourism reopens in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/448816/palau-settles-into-new-normal-after-it-claims-herd-immunity>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

<a id="event-2021-08-09-2-25"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. CDC announces that 60% of Americans have received their first dose of the COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/nearly-60-americans-least-partially-vaccinated-against-covid-19-cdc-2021-08-09/>).

**Archived source account.** Arkansas reports 103 hospitalizations from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record.

Source citations (as archived): [Egypt Independent](<https://www.egyptindependent.com/egypt-receives-261600-doses-of-johnson-johnson-vaccine/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-08-09-3-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Canada, Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic, Canada–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Canada reopens their border to Americans and permanent residents who are fully vaccinated against COVID-19 for non-essential travel. All travellers must present a negative COVID-19 test result from the previous 72 hours in order to enter the country.

Source citations (as archived): [MarketWatch](<https://www.marketwatch.com/story/canada-reopens-its-border-for-fully-vaccinated-u-s-visitors-01628544473>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Nicaragua.

**Archived source account.** Nicaragua recalls its ambassadors to Argentina, Mexico, Costa Rica and Colombia for "consultations" after those countries recalled their ambassadors to Nicaragua over a crackdown on the opposition in Nicaragua.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/nicaragua-recalls-mexico-argentina-colombia-costa-rica-ambassadors-2021-08-09/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-3-5"></a>

Context: Egypt–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Direct commercial flights between Russia and Egypt resume for the first time since the Metrojet Flight 9268 bombing in 2015, which killed 224 people, most of whom were Russian tourists. A Rossiya Airlines passenger plane landed in Sharm El Sheikh carrying 518 passengers, and was welcomed with a water cannon salute, roses and flags.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/russian-flights-return-egypts-resorts-six-years-after-crash-2021-08-09/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-08-09-4-1"></a>

Context: Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot.

**Archived source account.** Federal prosecutors say that five men who were accused of plotting to kidnap Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer also discussed Ohio Governor Mike DeWine as a potential target.

Source citations (as archived): [Detroit News](<https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/local/michigan/2021/08/09/accused-whitmer-plotters-mulled-attacking-ohio-gov-dewine-feds-say/5544873001/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A priest is murdered at a church in Saint-Laurent-sur-Sèvre, France, by the same person who committed the arson at the Nantes Cathedral in July 2020. He is arrested after confessing to the killing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58145468>).

<a id="event-2021-08-09-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A barely legible letter to Pope Francis regarding the Vatican's financial scandals, which contained three bullets and is believed to have originated from France, is intercepted by postal workers in Peschiera Borromeo, near Milan. The letter is being treated by authorities as a possible death threat against Francis.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/envelope-containing-three-bullets-sent-to-pope-francis/ar-AAN6oGB?ocid=BingNewsSearch>); [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2021/08/09/letter-sent-to-pope-containing-bullets-intercepted-by-postal-workers>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-08-09-5-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian government announces that President Jair Bolsonaro will attend a military parade featuring tanks and armored vehicles in Brasília tomorrow, as a preparation for military exercises. The parade is expected to pass near the National Congress building as a controversial bill reinstating paper ballots and ending electronic voting, which is supported by the government, is set to be voted. As the bill is widely expected not to pass, critics argue that Bolsonaro is using the parade as a show of force and intimidation against the Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [Correio Braziliense](<https://www.correiobraziliense.com.br/politica/2021/08/amp/4942554-em-demonstracao-de-forca-bolsonaro-recebera-desfile-de-tanques-na-esplanada.html>); [UOL](<https://noticias.uol.com.br/colunas/thais-oyama/2021/08/09/bolsonaro-dara-demonstracao-de-forca-com-desfile-de-tanques-de-guerra.htm>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-08-09-6-1"></a>

Context: Climate change in the Arctic; 2021 Russian wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Smoke from wildfires in Siberia is detected in the Geographic North Pole for the first time in recorded history, according to NASA. The space agency says that as of August 6 "most of Russia" is covered in smoke, while Russia's weather monitoring institute Rosgidromet says that the situation "continues to deteriorate" in the far-eastern Sakha region with around 3.4 million hectares (8.4 million acres) of land currently on fire.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/aug/09/smoke-siberia-wildfires-reaches-north-pole-historic-first>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-08-10-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban tightens its grip in many districts and cities in northern Afghanistan as Afghan President Ashraf Ghani calls on local militias to fight the armed group. Pentagon spokesman John Kirby says that the United States is willing to continue their airstrike campaign against the Taliban but warned that "it is up to the Afghan government to defend themselves" and also added that "it is their struggle".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-tighten-control-afghan-north-residents-weigh-options-2021-08-10/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-10-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

**Archived source account.** Afghan President Ashraf Ghani says he views peace talks with the Taliban as concluded and unsuccessful, and anticipates a civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [Stars and Stripes](<https://www.stripes.com/theaters/middle_east/2021-08-10/afghanistan-taliban-peace-talks-dead-ashraf-ghani-2513250.html?fbclid=IwAR1hzZ1zs4YNJjzOseS2W2N1G5lYjGS-B_H8Hlz2jZWZLEe1zdDx2aU3Zek>).

<a id="event-2021-08-10-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban captures the city of Farah, the capital of the southwestern Farah Province, as well as the city of Puli Khumri, the capital of the northern Baghlan Province. These are the seventh and eighth provincial capitals to fall under Taliban control in the past five days.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/10/taliban-seizes-farah-seventh-provincial-afghan-capital-in-five-days>).

<a id="event-2021-08-10-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2007 Bagram Airfield bombing.

**Archived source account.** A report published from the Afghanistan Papers by The Washington Post journalist Craig Whitlock accuses former U.S. President George W. Bush and his administration of lying about the Taliban attempting to kill former U.S. Vice President Dick Cheney during a 2007 attack on the Bagram Airfield base.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Beast](<https://www.thedailybeast.com/bush-administration-lied-about-taliban-nearly-killing-cheney-in-2007-suicide-attack-says-report>).

<a id="event-2021-08-10-0-9"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed calls on "all eligible citizens" to join the armed forces to "stop the Tigray forces once and for all" and for all Ethiopians to "show patriotism" in this moment. Abiy had promised a swift victory when the war broke out in late 2020, but this changed in June when Tigrayan forces recaptured the region and advanced further into other regions.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/10/ethiopia-calls-on-civilians-to-join-army-to-fight-tigray-rebels>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban captures its ninth provincial capital in six days, seizing Fayzabad, the capital of Badakhshan Province, amid a rapid advance in northern Afghanistan. The capture comes as President Ashraf Ghani appeals to local warlords to confront and fight the Taliban. The jihadist group also takes control of Kunduz Airport, after hundreds of Afghan National Security Forces personnel in the area surrender with all of their military equipment.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-08-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Andrew Cuomo sexual harassment allegations.

**Archived source account.** The New York State Assembly says that they will suspend impeachment investigations of outgoing governor Andrew Cuomo once he resigns on August 24.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/article/andrew-cuomo-new-york-impeachments-f3ab4342f645cc604f7d6e20c28b796b>).

<a id="event-2021-08-13-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Samsung chairman Lee Jae-yong is released from prison in South Korea after his parole was announced on Monday. Lee served seven months out of a 30 month imprisonment sentence that had been imposed on him for financial corruption. Lee addressed journalists, saying that he will do "his best" from now on and apologizing for his crime.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20210813-jailed-leader-of-s-korea-s-samsung-walks-free-in-latest-early-release-for-business-elite>).

<a id="event-2021-08-13-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nicaraguan police raid the offices of national newspaper La Prensa after the government announces an investigation into allegations of customs fraud and money laundering by its directors. La Prensa had published several critical stories against current president Daniel Ortega, whom they have called a "dictator" numerous times.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/nicaraguan-police-raid-la-prensa-newspaper-charge-directors-with-fraud-2021-08-13/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-08-14-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban captures the eastern Logar Province and seizes seven more provincial capitals, Gardez, Sharana, Asadabad, Maymana, Mihtarlam, Nili and Mazar-i-Sharif, as heavy fighting is reported amid a rapid advance of the group towards the capital Kabul. Mazar-i-Sharif had been visited on Wednesday by President Ashraf Ghani.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-taliban-attack-mazar-e-sharif-live-updates/a-58863457>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/14/major-northern-afghan-city-mazar-i-sharif-falls-to-the-taliban>).

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

**Archived source account.** President Ghani addresses the nation and says that he is in "urgent talks" with local leaders and international partners as the Taliban advances closer to Kabul. Ghani did not comment on the Taliban's demand that he resign in order to restore talks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/us-troops-arrive-afghan-capital-assist-evacuations-2021-08-14/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-14-0-5"></a>

<a id="event-2021-08-14-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

<a id="event-2021-08-14-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

Source citations (as archived): [The Nation](<https://nation.lk/online/rampant-taliban-ransack-the-palatial-home-of-top-afghan-warlord-and-us-ally-general-dostum-110887.html>).

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

**Archived source account.** For the first time since the offensive began, the Taliban commandeers Mi-17 helicopters captured from the Afghan Air Force. The militants were filmed flying the aircraft over the city of Kandahar. The jihadist group has also seized several UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/taliban-seize-control-of-afghan-government-s-mi-17-helicopters/vi-AANk0aR>).

<a id="event-2021-08-14-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A major 7.2 magnitude earthquake strikes Petit Trou de Nippes, Haiti, killing at least 304 people and wounding more than 1,800 others. Haiti is still recovering from a major earthquake that impacted the country in 2010.

Among the people in the negotiation team is the first president of Afghanistan after the 2001 U.S. invasion, Hamid Karzai.

<a id="event-2021-08-15-0-6"></a>

<a id="event-2021-08-15-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive / Fall of Kabul.

<a id="event-2021-08-15-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive / Fall of Kabul.

**Archived source account.** In his first public comments since going into exile, ousted president Ashraf Ghani concedes that the Taliban has "won the war" in Afghanistan, saying that "they are now facing a new historical test. Either they will preserve the name and honour of Afghanistan or they will give priority to other places and networks".

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/afghanistan-president-ashraf-ghani-leaves-country-say-officials/article35927207.ece>).

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

The jihadist group faced no resistance as the Afghan military and provincial governor surrendered. Taliban forces also enter the Char Asiab District of the Kabul Province, advancing within 11 km of Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/us-troops-arrive-afghan-capital-assist-evacuations-2021-08-14/>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/afghanistan-taliban-seize-jalalabad-without-a-fight-kabul-is-now-the-only-big-city-that-it-does-not-control-12382021>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/south-asia/afghanistan-taliban-kabul-ashraf-ghani-b1902651.html>).

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico Europe](<https://www.politico.eu/article/israel-diplomat-poland-anti-semitic-unethical-restitution-law/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-08-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Hong Kong national security law.

**Archived source account.** The Civil Human Rights Front in Hong Kong disbands. The pro-democracy group had been under pressure from the government for allegedly being internationally funded. The group's leader Figo Chan and prominent member Jimmy Sham are both in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/hong-kongs-pro-democracy-protest-group-chrf-disbands/a-58869104>).

<a id="event-2021-08-15-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Konstantin Pavlov, the pro-Russian mayor of Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, is found dead at his home with a gunshot wound. The National Police of Ukraine say that they are currently establishing the circumstances of the mayor's death and have also opened a criminal case.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/opposition-mayor-ukrainian-city-found-dead-2021-08-15/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-08-15-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Canadian federal election.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Justin Trudeau obtains the dissolution of the House of Commons for an election scheduled on September 20.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/federal-election-call-1.6141189>).

<a id="event-2021-08-15-5-3"></a>

Context: 2020–21 Malaysian political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Reports emerge of the imminent resignation of Prime Minister of Malaysia Muhyiddin Yassin on August 16.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysia-pm-muhyiddin-resign-monday-report-2021-08-15/>).

#### Science and technology

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive / Fall of Kabul.

**Archived source account.** Russia accuses President Ashraf Ghani of fleeing the country with "four cars and a helicopter full of cash" and that he also left money behind that could not be transported with him. Ghani's whereabouts are still unknown although multiple sources say that he is currently in Tajikistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/russia-says-afghan-president-fled-with-cars-helicopter-full-cash-ria-2021-08-16/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive / Fall of Kabul.

**Archived source account.** The first Afghan President after the 2001 United States invasion, Hamid Karzai, announces that he and his daughters will remain in Kabul as he appeals to the Taliban to respect his life and the lives of civilians in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Indiatimes](<https://www.indiatimes.com/news/world/former-afghanistan-president-hamid-karzai-with-daughters-appeals-to-taliban-to-protect-people-547334.html>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive / Fall of Kabul.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia calls on the Taliban and "all Afghan parties" to "preserve lives and property" and also states that "Saudi Arabia stands with the decision of the Afghan people without interference".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/saudi-arabia-calls-taliban-preserve-lives-property-2021-08-16/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive / Fall of Kabul.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban sets up a cordon and blocks access to Kabul's Hamid Karzai International Airport and also fires warning shots as civilians attempt to leave the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/16/taliban-says-afghanistan-war-over-as-president-diplomats-flee>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-8"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive / Fall of Kabul.

**Archived source account.** Kyrgyzstan says 500 visas will be issued to students from Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AKIpress News Agency](<https://akipress.com/news:661509:Kyrgyzstan_to_issue_500_student_visas_as_humanitarian_assistance_for_Afghanistan_-_national_security_chief/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-10"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** U.S. troops shoot dead two "armed men" at Kabul's Hamid Karzai International Airport as evacuations of Western diplomats and allied Afghans continue.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/three-killed-in-kabul-airport-as-afghans-scramble-to-escape-taliban-11629096273>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-11"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Two people are recorded falling to their deaths from a U.S. Air Force C-17 Globemaster III flying over the airport. Local reports say that the stowaways landed on nearby rooftops. In a separate incident, three civilians are run over and killed while clinging to a U.S. jet on the runway.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/3-fall-off-plane-some-huddled-on-aircraft-wing-in-kabul-mayhem-2511643>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-12"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden addresses the nation following his decision to withdraw from Afghanistan. In the address, Biden said that he "stands squarely behind" the decision to withdraw from the country and admits that the government's collapse was "quicker than anticipated".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/biden-address-afghanistan-trump-taliban-b1903620.html>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2021/08/16/biden-speak-taliban-control-afghanistan/8148263002/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-14"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Operation Pitting.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom deploys an additional 200 troops to Kabul to help airlift UK nationals and Afghans who worked with British forces during the war.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-58235707>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-15"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Uzbekistan shoots down an Afghan Air Force jet that crossed into its airspace. The pilot ejected and survived, according to a statement from the Ministry of Defense.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-military-jet-was-shot-down-by-uzbek-air-defences-ria-2021-08-16/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-18"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb / 2021 Niger attacks.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen on motorbikes storm the village of Darey-Daye, Niger, openinf fire against civilians while they were tending their fields, killing 37 people, including fourteen children.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/18/niger-declares-national-mourning-after-37-killed>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-0-20"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Four Palestinians are killed and another is seriously injured after an undercover branch of the Israel Border Police raided a refugee camp in Jenin in the occupied West Bank. The raid, which was organized to arrest a suspected Hamas member, resulted in the highest death toll in the area in months.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-58228621>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-08-16-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Haiti earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the earthquake that struck Haiti two days ago increases to 1,297 people. More than 5,700 others are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-58222888>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-1-2"></a>

Context: 2021 Haiti earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Tropical Storm Grace threatens earthquake-hit Haiti as it approaches the island of Hispaniola with sustained winds of 35 mph (56 km/h), and even stronger gusts.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN International](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/08/16/americas/haiti-earthquake-news-monday-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-1-4"></a>

Context: Wildfires in 2021.

**Archived source account.** Around one thousand people are evacuated in Castile and León, Spain, as a wildfire spreads across the region.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/spain-evacuates-nearly-1000-people-path-wildfire-2021-08-16/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-1-6"></a>

Context: 2020–22 North American drought.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Bureau of Reclamation issues an official water shortage declaration at the Lake Mead reservoir for the first time. The shortage will mean reduced water apportionments to Arizona, Nevada and Mexico beginning in October.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-declares-first-ever-shortage-western-reservoir-triggering-water-cuts-2021-08-16/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** Bangladesh reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Lambda variant in the sample of a 49-year-old woman in Dhaka.

Source citations (as archived): [Dhaka Tribune](<https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2021/08/16/covid-19-lambda-variant-found-in-bangladesh>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong / Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong reclassifies 15 countries and territories, including the U.S., France, Malaysia, and Thailand, to the "high-risk" category, which means that beginning on August 20, there will be mandatory 21-day quarantines and tougher boarding requirements for travellers arriving from those countries due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases caused by the Delta variant.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/hong-kong-reclassifies-15-countries-high-risk-covid-19-2021-08-16/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran reports a record 655 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 98,483.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-iran-int-idUSKBN2FH1BT>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel, COVID-19 vaccination in Israel.

**Archived source account.** The number of people over the age of 50 who have received a booster COVID-19 vaccine dose in Israel reaches one million.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/over-1-million-israelis-have-now-received-covid-booster-shot/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia / Malaysian movement control order.

**Archived source account.** The Government of Malaysia begins to allow 11 more economic sectors in states under Phase 1 of the national recovery plan to reopen. Operators of businesses in these sectors must ensure that their customers show a digital COVID-19 vaccination certificate before entering the business.

Source citations (as archived): [Free Malaysia Today](<https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/nation/2021/08/15/barber-shops-markets-among-11-activities-allowed-from-tomorrow/?__cf_chl_jschl_tk__=pmd_dfc832dd62f76acc01c08ad50893fe9e9e6cd4fe-1629111241-0-gqNtZGzNAnijcnBszQi6>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France requires shoppers to show their "health pass" in order to enter 126 shopping centres that have a size of more than 20000 m2 in Paris and 12 departments that reached a threshold of 200 COVID-19 cases per 100,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio France Internationale](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20210816-contraversial-health-pass-now-mandatory-in-shopping-malls-in-parts-of-france>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Germany, COVID-19 vaccination in Germany.

**Archived source account.** The German Standing Committee on Vaccination recommends that all children between the ages of 12 and 17 receive a COVID-19 vaccine due to increased risks posed by the highly transmissible SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant.

Source citations (as archived): [The Tribune](<https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/world/germany-approves-vaccinations-for-over-12s-298052>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in North Macedonia.

**Archived source account.** North Macedonia restricts the access of cafés, restaurants and public events to only those who have been vaccinated with at least one dose or who have recovered from COVID-19 within the past 45 days and also limits the capacity of restaurants to 30 people with only outdoor parts of restaurants to be open in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-08-16/north-macedonia-reimposes-restrictions-as-covid-19-resurges>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-23"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England, COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Ireland.

**Archived source account.** A requirement for fully vaccinated people and people under the age of 18 to self-isolate is removed in England and Northern Ireland if they come into contact with someone who has tested positive for the virus. These people are now advised to take a PCR test despite such tests being voluntary and also wear a face covering while in enclosed spaces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-58226678.amp>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Northern Territory, COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** Greater Darwin and Katherine enter a three-day lockdown after new community transmissions of COVID-19 were reported. Meanwhile, lockdown restrictions in Melbourne are extended and tightened for an additional two weeks, with a controversial nighttime curfew reinstated.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<https://www.theaustralian.com.au/breaking-news/darwin-and-katherin-plunged-into-lockdown-after-positive-covid19-case/news-story/67520b024685a139c4dd19522e3e0670>); [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-08-16/victoria-new-local-covid-cases-melbourne-lockdown/100379330>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-29"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state).

**Archived source account.** Outgoing New York Governor Andrew Cuomo announces that healthcare workers in the state will be required to be vaccinated by September 27.

Source citations (as archived): [WIVB-TV](<https://www.wivb.com/health/coronavirus/new-york-state-mandating-covid-19-vaccinations-for-healthcare-workers/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-31"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** Washington, D.C. announces that they will require healthcare workers and other health-related professionals to be vaccinated with at least a first dose of the Pfizer–BioNTech or Moderna vaccine or a single-dose Janssen vaccine by September 30.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/568036-dc-requires-health-care-workers-to-get-vaccine-by-sept-30>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-2-32"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ivory Coast begins to vaccinate "healthcare workers, close relatives and contacts of the victim" against Ebola using 5,000 doses of Ebola vaccines donated by Guinea after the first case of the virus since 1994 was reported over the weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/16/ivory-coast-rolls-out-ebola-jabs-after-first-case-in-decades>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-08-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Speaker of the Tongan Parliament, Lord Fakafanua, introduces the Illicit Drugs Control (Amendment) Bill 2021 for debate in the legislative assembly. The Speaker wants a mandatory death sentence for serious drug offenses. Tonga has a moratorium on the death penalty and has not used it in more than four decades.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ International](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/449246/tongan-talk-of-the-death-penalty-for-worst-drug-offenders>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The last living Khmer Rouge leader, Khieu Samphan, appears before a court in Phnom Penh in order to appeal his conviction and attempt to overturn it. The 90-year-old's hearing is expected to last for only a few days as analysts say that it is very unlikely that he will succeed in his appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/cambodia-khmer-rouge-official-appeals-genocide-conviction/a-58874415>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a unanimous decision, the Supreme Court of Uganda strikes down a 2014 law outlawing the distribution of pornography and wearing of "indecent" clothes as unconstitutional. Women's rights groups in the country campaigned against the law since its inception, saying it unfairly singled out women for discrimination.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58235637>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-08-16-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020–21 Malaysian political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Muhyiddin Yassin resigns from office, as a result of the ruling Perikatan Nasional coalition government's collapse. Yassin will remain as caretaker prime minister until a new government is formed.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-prime-minister-resign-muhyiddin-yassin-king-2115091>).

<a id="event-2021-08-16-4-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka, Political impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** President Gotabaya Rajapaksa replaces his health minister Pavithra Wanniarachchi with Keheliya Rambukwella, who was previously the media minister and government spokesman, with Wanniarachchi becoming the transport minister, amid public criticism over her understating of COVID-19 infections and her endorsement of sorcery and magic potions to combat the virus.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/16/sri-lanka-health-minister-covid-cases>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-08-16-5-2"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports / 2020 Summer Paralympics.

**Archived source account.** The Tokyo Organising Committee of the Olympic and Paralympic Games, the International Paralympic Committee, the Tokyo Metropolitan Government, and the Japanese government issue a joint statement indicating that spectators will be banned at Paralympic venues in Tokyo and other prefectures that are currently under a state of emergency due to the spread of COVID-19.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-08-17-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / Taliban insurgency / 2021 Taliban offensive / Operation Allies Refuge.

**Archived source account.** Pentagon spokesperson John Kirby says that evacuations have resumed at Kabul's Hamid Karzai International Airport.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-08-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The European Union says that there will be "no recognition, no political talks" with the Taliban. #### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-08-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 Kabul airport attack.

More than 150 others are wounded. ISIL-KP, who have threatened the airport in recent days, have claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/afghanistan-kabul-airport-explosion-11629976397>).

<a id="event-2021-08-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 evacuation from Afghanistan / Operation Pitting.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Boris Johnson says that the United Kingdom will continue evacuations despite the terrorist attacks that occurred at Hamid Karzai International Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/afghanistan-boris-johnson-says-uks-evacuation-operation-will-continue-despite-barbaric-kabul-attack-12391442>).

<a id="event-2021-08-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 evacuation from Afghanistan / Operation Allies Refuge.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden, in an address to the nation, says that the evacuation of American citizens will continue despite the terrorist attacks. He also vows that the U.S. will avenge the deaths of the 13 service members killed in the attacks by "hunting down" those responsible and "making them pay".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/europe-evacuations-kabul-f9321f143fd8749c1cc8c460b647fdd5>).

<a id="event-2021-08-26-0-8"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 evacuation from Afghanistan / Operation Allies Refuge.

**Archived source account.** The United States says that it is taking steps to boost humanitarian aid into Afghanistan despite the Taliban being blacklisted by the treasury. The United States also says that it is working with local partners to facilitate humanitarian aid to reach the Afghan population.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us-taking-steps-allow-humanitarian-aid-afghanistan-continue-2021-08-26/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-26-0-9"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 evacuation from Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Canada, Belgium, Denmark, Russia and the Netherlands end their evacuation flights from Hamid Karzai International Airport ahead of a Taliban ultimatum to leave by August 31. Several shots are fired in the direction of an Italian military plane as it was departing the airport, although the airplane was not the intended target and no casualties or damage have been reported.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-58279900>).

<a id="event-2021-08-26-0-11"></a>

Context: Oromo conflict, Tigray War, War crimes in the Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** The Ethiopian Human Rights Commission accuses the Oromo Liberation Army of killing 150 civilians during the past week. The group denies the report. The report says that gunmen targeted people of Amharan ethnicity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ethiopia-rights-commission-says-150-killed-attack-oromiya-2021-08-26/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-08-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Political repression in the Soviet Union.

**Archived source account.** A mass grave containing between 5,000 and 8,000 skeletons is discovered in Odesa, Ukraine, during exploration works for a planned expansion of Odesa International Airport. The graves are believed to date back to the late 1930s during a major purge.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-58340805>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-08-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Pacific Islands Forum.

**Archived source account.** Kiribati confirms its decision to withdraw along with four other countries, the Federated States of Micronesia, the Marshall Islands, Palau and Nauru. Despite efforts by multiple countries to have the countries remain in the forum, Kiribati says that there is "no value" in staying if the agreement is not honored in regards to disagreements over the designation of Henry Puna as Secretary-General of the forum.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/450088/kiribati-restates-decision-to-leave-pacific-forum>).

<a id="event-2021-08-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Argentina, Foreign relations of Iran.

**Archived source account.** Argentina condemns "energetically" the designation of Mohsen Rezai in a ministerial rank in the government of Ebrahim Raisi in Iran. Yesterday, Argentina had renewed its condemnation of the designation of Ahmad Vahidi as minister of the interior. Both men are wanted by Argentina and Interpol over alleged connections with the 1994 AMIA bombing. The Foreign Ministry condemns Iran for its "affront to Argentine justice".

Source citations (as archived): [Notimérica](<https://www.notimerica.com/politica/noticia-argentina-iran-argentina-condena-designacion-dos-ministros-iran-reclamados-participacion-atentado-20210826123507.html>).

He is the first person to be sentenced in the conspiracy, which includes thirteen other accused plotters who are currently awaiting trial.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-08-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Response to the 2021 Kabul airport attack, Drone strikes in the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The United States launches an airstrike in Nangarhar, killing two Islamic State members and wounding a third. It is reported that one of those killed was planning more attacks in Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/08/28/politics/isis-k-drone-strike-us-afghanistan/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-08-27-0-4"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Aftermath of 2021 Taliban offensive and Fall of Kabul.

**Archived source account.** Afghan political leader and activist Fatima Gailani, who helped draft a new constitution for Afghanistan and also took part in peace talks with the Taliban, blames exiled former Afghan president Ashraf Ghani for the current "chaotic" situation in the country, and says that U.S. president Joe Biden also contributed by withdrawing troops without a "political settlement" in place.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/afghan-activist-says-ashraf-ghani-and-joe-biden-caused-misery-and-chaos/a-58998732>).

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Aftermath of 2021 Taliban offensive and Fall of Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/27/exclusive-taliban-plans-inclusive-caretaker-govt-in-afghanistan>).

<a id="event-2021-08-27-0-7"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 evacuation from Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Australia, New Zealand, Norway and Spain end their evacuation flights from Hamid Karzai International Airport in Kabul.

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 evacuation from Afghanistan.

<a id="event-2021-08-27-0-14"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Uganda arrest an Islamist belonging to the ADF for planning a suicide bombing attack in the country. Police are also investigating if the murders of 21 civilians in the cities of Lwengo and Masaka since late July were carried out by ADF terrorists. The victims were killed by knifemen during raids in the night. Thirty-eight suspected have been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [All Africa](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202108280022.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-08-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Zambia.

**Archived source account.** The newly appointed Minister of Finance ​of Zambia Situmbeko Musokotwane says that he has begun to negotiate with the International Monetary Fund on a $12 billion external debt. Musokotwane says that he is also working with other private funds to which Zambia owes payments. Musokotwane anticipates that Zambia "will not be able to immediately cancel all debts".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/zambian-president-hichilema-appoints-new-finance-minister-2021-08-27/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-29-0-6"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Drone strikes in the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. airstrike targets a vehicle driven by an aid worker for U.S. based Nutrition and Education International, who was bringing home water for his family. At least 10 people are killed during the strike, including seven children. Some of those killed had previously worked for international organisations and held visas allowing them entry to the United States. There are reports of other civilians being killed too. The majority of the casualties were residents of the area.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-58380791>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/09/10/world/asia/us-air-strike-drone-kabul-afghanistan-isis.html>).

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two Pakistani soldiers are shot dead by unknown gunmen at the border with Afghanistan. Two or three of the attackers are killed after a gunfight.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/29/pakistani-soldiers-killed-in-cross-border-fire-from-afghanistan>).

<a id="event-2021-08-29-0-8"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

<a id="event-2021-08-29-0-9"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Atta Muhammad Nur and Abdul Rashid Dostum say that they are forming a group to negotiate with the Taliban and also say that surrender is "out of the question". They both said that they plan to meet Taliban representatives for a new government. Both men fled to Uzbekistan when Mazar-i-Sharif fell but have since returned to Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/veteran-afghan-strongmen-form-new-front-negotiating-with-taliban-2021-08-29/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-29-0-10"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Taliban spokesman Suhail Shaheen blames former president Ashraf Ghani for the "chaos" in Kabul. Shaheen says that Ghani must return the money that he allegedly stole and says that it was not necessary for Ghani to leave the country as the Taliban "just wanted a peaceful transfer of power".

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ashraf-ghani-made-a-mistake-taliban-say-former-president-must-return-afghanistan-s-money-101630232430501.html>).

Context: Syrian civil war / 2021 Daraa clashes.

**Archived source account.** The army bombards the last rebel enclave in the southern city of Daraa, killing six people. The army declined to comment but released a statement saying that it was losing patience with what it called "armed groups and terrorists". The site of the bombing is the birthplace of the 2011 uprising against President Bashar al-Assad which marked the start of the war.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-army-bombards-rebels-birthplace-uprising-residents-2021-08-29/>).

<a id="event-2021-08-29-0-15"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces attack the Al Anad Air Base in Lahij Governorate, Yemen, with drones and ballistic missiles, killing 43 soldiers and wounding 56 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/29/several-killed-in-houthi-attack-on-yemens-largest-base>).

<a id="event-2021-08-29-0-16"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gunman kills a civilian before stealing her car in Garland, Texas. He then drove with the vehicle and opened fire outside a police station, before being shot dead by police. Authorities are investigating a possible terrorist background as the perpetrator left a note in which he expressed the motive behind his act.

Source citations (as archived): [The Dallas Morning News](<https://www.dallasnews.com/news/crime/2021/08/30/authorities-identify-lyft-driver-killed-in-garland-before-gunman-shot-at-plano-police-headquarters/>).
