Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/lifestyle-canada-health-ontario-coronavirus-pandemic-25f590df3bb6ba612988d50d7da668d8>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-09-01-4-1"></a>

Context: China–Holy See relations.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis defends the dialogue with China via the appointment of new Catholic bishops. Francis says that uneasy dialogue is better than no dialogue at all and compared the talks with China to those with Eastern European countries during the Cold War. The Vatican and China have had strained relations since the communist party took power in 1949.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/pope-defends-deal-with-china-says-dialogue-necessary-2021-09-01/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-01-5-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack / Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Justice secures its 50th guilty plea in its criminal investigation of the January 6 riot at the United States Capitol.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/01/politics/capitol-riot-50-guilty-pleas-600-arrests/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-01-5-5"></a>

Context: Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.

**Archived source account.** Protests occur in front of hospitals across Greece to oppose compulsory vaccination for healthcare workers which takes effect today and could result in the dismissal of up to 10,000 unvaccinated workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/protests-in-greece-as-unvaccinated-health-workers-face-suspension>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-09-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Romanian Prime Minister Florin Cîțu dismisses justice minister Stelian Ion, stating that he would "not accept ministers in the Romanian government who oppose the modernisation of Romania." The removal creates a political crisis within the coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/romanian-pm-sacks-justice-minister-over-reform-response-2021-09-01/>).

### 2021-09-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359356441](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20September%202&oldid=1359356441>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 evacuation from Afghanistan / Operation Pitting.

**Archived source account.** Former Royal Military Police soldier Ben Slater is briefly arrested for questioning by the Taliban while trying to evacuate 400 Afghans and 50 staff members.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/south-asia/british-soldier-mission-taliban-arrest-b1913200.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-0-5"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Aftermath of the Fall of Kabul, Capital punishment in Afghanistan, LGBT rights in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Afghan LGBT rights activist Nemat Sadat and an unnamed gay man in Kabul both report that the Taliban beheaded the man's boyfriend on the same day that they entered the city. Sadat said that while women are only executed if they commit adultery, homosexuals face an "automatic death sentence based on their mere existence".

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-09-02/afghans-lgbt-community-face-stoning-under-taliban-law/100412330>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Panjshir conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban enters the Panjshir Valley and clashes with National Resistance Front of Afghanistan forces led by Ahmad Massoud. The Taliban reports gaining some territory as both sides also claim heavy casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-afghan-rebels-claim-heavy-casualties-fighting-over-valley-2021-09-02/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli soldiers open fire on Palestinians protesting against Israel's 14-year blockade of the Gaza Strip, killing one person and injuring 15 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/2/israeli-troops-shoot-dead-palestinian-during-gaza-demonstrations>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-0-11"></a>

Context: Kashmir conflict.

**Archived source account.** Indian authorities deploy security forces in the Kashmir Valley in order to restrict public movement and impose a near-total internet blackout following the death of senior separatist leader Syed Ali Shah Geelani.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210901-security-clampdown-in-indian-kashmir-after-death-of-separatist-icon-geelani>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-09-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Ida.

**Archived source account.** At least 41 people are killed by flash flooding and tornados in New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, and New Jersey as the remnants of Ida pass over the Northeastern United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-us-canada-58420997>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are dead and 4,500 are sick in the Democratic Republic of the Congo following a toxic leak from a massive diamond mine in Angola.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58432578>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A plane crashes into a building killing all 4 onboard and injured two on the ground in Farmington, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CT](<https://www.nbcconnecticut.com/news/local/plane-crashes-into-building-in-farmington-police/2574190/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A minibus overturned and plunged off a road into a valley in Kurdish province, Iran killing 16 and injuring 12.

Source citations (as archived): [THE TIMES OF INDIA](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/mini-bus-plunges-off-road-into-a-valley-in-iran-killing-16/articleshow/85864273.cms>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-09-02-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia.

**Archived source account.** Mongolia reports a record 3,805 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 221,351.

Source citations (as archived): [AKI Press](<https://m.akipress.com/news:662085:Mongolia_reported_a_record_of_3,805_new_COVID-19_cases/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore reports 191 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, including 187 locally transmitted cases. It is the highest number of locally-transmitted cases since August 7, 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/covid-19-new-cases-sep-2-local-unlinked-bus-interchange-clusters-2151011>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan, COVID-19 vaccination in Taiwan.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan receives its first shipment of 932,000 doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Asahi Shimbun](<https://www.asahi.com/sp/ajw/articles/14431805>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-2-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates, Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Abu Dhabi will lift its quarantine requirements for all vaccinated foreign travellers on September 5 as long as they show a negative PCR test result as the UAE reported no COVID-19 deaths in the past 24 hours for the first time since November 14, 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/abu-dhabi-eases-tourist-quarantines-as-uae-hits-zero-deaths-01630593307>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-2-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium.

**Archived source account.** King Philippe and Queen Mathilde cancel or reschedule their attendance at all public events and engagements, in addition to placing all members of the Royal Family into quarantine, after a Royal Family member tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/article-member-of-belgian-royal-family-tests-positive-for-covid-19/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria.

**Archived source account.** The Bulgarian government announces nationwide restrictions that would require restaurants, bars, and casinos to close at 10 p.m., restrict the capacity of gyms, theatres, and cinemas to between 30% to 50%, and ban all mass gatherings from September 7 until October 30 amid the spread of COVID-19 and the low percentage of vaccinated people.

Source citations (as archived): [See News](<https://seenews.com/news/bulgaria-to-tighten-covid-19-restrictions-as-of-sept-7-752815>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-2-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Norway, COVID-19 vaccination in Norway.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Erna Solberg announces that children aged 12 to 15 years old in Norway will be offered the single-dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. However, only the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine that is currently recommended for this age group.

Source citations (as archived): [Norwegian Institute of Public Health](<https://www.fhi.no/en/news/2021/12-15-year-olds-will-be-offered-coronavirus-vaccination/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-2-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Kenya receives a shipment of 358,200 doses of the Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine donated by Canada as part of the COVAX initiative.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/kenya-receives-nearly-360-000-doses-of-coronavirus-vaccine-from-canada/2353611>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-09-02-3-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Belarus–European Union border crisis.

**Archived source account.** Poland declares a state of emergency on its border with Belarus amid an increase in illegal migration. The Polish Border Guard says that there were around 3,500 attempts to illegally cross the border in August, 2,500 of which were not successful.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-president-imposes-state-emergency-belarus-border-2021-09-02/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** British Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab announces that there is no "foreseeable recognition" of the Taliban government in Afghanistan although he asserts that the United Kingdom will nevertheless directly engage the group in necessary talks.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/2/taliban-shows-us-plunder-as-kabul-flight-resumes-after-withdrawal>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Dar es Salaam shooting.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Tanzania have confirmed that the gunman who killed three policemen and a security guard in Dar es Salaam on August 25, was motivated by Islamic extremism.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tanzania-says-gunman-who-killed-four-people-last-month-was-terrorist-2021-09-02/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-02-4-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** President Jair Bolsonaro signs a law allowing vaccine and medication patents to be broken in situations of public health emergency in Brazil, such as the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazils-bolsonaro-signs-law-that-could-break-covid-19-vaccine-patents-2021-09-02/>).

### 2021-09-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1115446101](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20September%203&oldid=1115446101>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Panjshir conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban says that it now controls the Panjshir Valley, and thus all of Afghanistan. Resistance leader Amrullah Saleh denies leaving the country and says that the resistance, also led by Ahmad Massoud, continues.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-co-founder-baradar-lead-new-afghanistan-govt-sources-2021-09-03/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-0-4"></a>

Context: 2021 Auckland Countdown stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Six people are injured, three critically, in a mass stabbing at a supermarket in LynnMall, Auckland, New Zealand. The attacker, a man who had been under surveillance since 2016 for following ISIL online, is shot dead by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-58405213>); [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/national/450699/man-shot-dead-at-countdown-supermarket-in-auckland>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-0-6"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Rival armed groups clash in Tripoli, in what is described as the worst confrontation since the ceasefire reached in 2020 between the Government of National Accord and the Libyan National Army forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/worst-tripoli-fighting-year-shows-limits-libya-peace-push-2021-09-03/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines, COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Food and Drug Administration approves the emergency use of the Moderna COVID-19 vaccine for children between the ages of 12 and 17 years old.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/philippines-allows-emergency-use-moderna-covid-19-vaccines-12-17-year-olds>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore, COVID-19 vaccination in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** The Singaporean health ministry will administer booster doses of the COVID-19 vaccine for people over the age of 60, people who are immunocompromised and residents of nursing home facilities beginning later this month.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/09/03/singapore-to-roll-out-covid-boosters-to-seniors-immunocompromised.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in North Korea.

**Archived source account.** North Korean leader Kim Jong-un demands that officials wage a tougher epidemic prevention campaign in “our style” after he rejects a donation of three million doses of the COVID-19 vaccine from the U.N. COVAX initiative.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna1278445>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** Vietnam surpasses 500,000 cases of COVID-19 after reporting a record 14,922 new cases in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2021/09/03/vietnam-reports-record-high-number-of-covid-19-cases-as-virus-total-goes-above-500000>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales.

**Archived source account.** New South Wales reports a record 1,431 new cases and 12 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/record-1431-new-cases-12-deaths-in-nsw-as-premier-anticipates-a-peak-in-cases-20210903-p58ohg.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in French Polynesia.

**Archived source account.** French Polynesia extends their COVID-19 lockdown to September 20 following the deaths of more than 200 people over the past two weeks. The lockdown extension will apply to the Society Islands and the Tuamotus archipelago as the number of cases increase in those regions.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/450675/tahiti-lockdown-extended-to-september-20>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Cuba.

**Archived source account.** Cuba begins a nationwide COVID-19 vaccination campaign for children aged two to 18 years old as a condition to reopen schools for in-person learning using Abdala and Soberana vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210903-cuba-starts-vaccinating-children-in-order-to-re-open-schools-amid-covid-surge>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom, COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Joint Committee on Vaccination and Immunisation recommends that healthy children between the ages of 12 and 15 should not be given a COVID-19 vaccine due to children being at low risk for COVID-19 and the vaccine only offering a marginal benefit.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-58438669>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-1-20"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bangladesh has reported a total of 10,981 dengue fever cases and 48 related deaths since the beginning of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/3/dengue-covid-bangladeshs-deaths-health-pandemic>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-09-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Union says that it will not currently recognize a Taliban government in Afghanistan and that the government will be "subjected to conditions". However, the EU also states that it will still engage the group in diplomatic talks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/eu-will-engage-with-taliban-subject-conditions-foreign-policy-chief-2021-09-03/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-2-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Chile.

**Archived source account.** China and Chile jointly announce the opening of a Sinovac COVID-19 vaccine production plant in the Santiago Metropolitan Area. Health minister Enrique Paris says that "it is a happy day for Chile and Latin American countries" because Chile would now be able to export vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/9/3/chinese-investment-in-chile-sparks-opportunities-concerns>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-03-3-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack / Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack.

**Archived source account.** Jake Angeli, also known as Jacob Chansley and "the QAnon shaman", pleads guilty to obstruction of the electoral college vote count during the January 6 riot at the United States Capitol. His sentencing is scheduled for November 17.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/qanon-shaman-jacob-chansley-january-6-capitol-riot-guilty-plea/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-3-4"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases.

**Archived source account.** Defrocked Catholic Cardinal Theodore McCarrick pleads not guilty to three counts of indecent assault and battery on a 16-year-old boy at a wedding reception in Massachusetts in 1974. The statute of limitations paused when he left the state shortly after the alleged incident. McCarrick is the first American cardinal to be charged with a sex crime.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/us-ex-cardinal-mccarrick-pleads-not-guilty-to-sexual-assault/a-59078937>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-3-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in New Caledonia.

**Archived source account.** The Congress of New Caledonia votes to make vaccination against COVID-19 mandatory for all adults, including anyone visiting New Caledonia, and set December 31 as a deadline to vaccinate them.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio France Internationale](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20210903-covid-vaccines-to-be-mandatory-in-new-caledonia-by-end-of-year-pacific-delta>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-3-8"></a>

Context: European Commission–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine dispute.

**Archived source account.** The European Union and AstraZeneca reach a settlement to end a legal battle over slow delivery of the Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, with an agreement that requires AstraZeneca to deliver the remaining 200 million doses of its vaccine to the EU countries at the end of March 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2021/09/03/eu-reaches-vaccine-delivery-deal-with-astrazeneca-ending-legal-battle-over-supply-delays>).

<a id="event-2021-09-03-3-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** The president of Vanuatu, Obed Moses Tallis, pardons former prime ministers Charlot Salwai, Joe Natuman and Serge Vohor, all of whom were convicted of political and financial crimes, including bribery and corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/450671/vanuatu-president-pardons-three-former-pms>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-09-03-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Liberal Democratic Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Yoshihide Suga, the Prime Minister of Japan, announces that he will not seek re-election after one year in office. Suga had replaced former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe who resigned for health reasons in September 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/02/asia/yoshihide-suga-intl-hnk/index.html>).

### 2021-09-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1060935183](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20September%204&oldid=1060935183>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Panjshir conflict.

**Archived source account.** The leader of the National Resistance Front of Afghanistan Ahmad Massoud announces that resistance against the Taliban will continue despite reports indicating that the Panjshir Valley fell to Taliban control yesterday. Yesterday, Massoud's ally Amrullah Saleh denied leaving the country and also vowed to continue to resist the Taliban.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/afghan-resistance-group-vows-to-keep-fighting-taliban/a-59084522>).

<a id="event-2021-09-04-0-4"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / LGBT rights in Afghanistan; Violence against LGBT people.

**Archived source account.** Afghan LGBT rights activist Hamid Zaher reports that a young Afghan man seeking support on social media to leave the country was tricked by Taliban members who raped and beat him. Zaher says that this violence was already common under the governments of Hamid Karzai and Ashraf Ghani and that the Taliban will use the same tactics to persecute homosexuals. Zaher also expressed concern that many other gay men in the country could be similarly deceived by the Taliban.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/gay-man-raped-and-beaten-by-taliban-tricked-into-meeting-2021-9>).

<a id="event-2021-09-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** ADF militants, armed with knives and guns, storm a village in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing 30 civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/6/at-least-30-killed-in-northeast-dr-congo-by-suspected-adf-rebels>).

<a id="event-2021-09-04-0-8"></a>

Context: Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two ballistic missiles that targeted the cities of Najran and Jizan are intercepted by Saudi Arabia. A third missile is intercepted over the city of Dammam, with shrapnel from the third missile injuring two children and damaging 14 homes.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/5/saudi-forces-intercept-three-ballistic-missiles-blame-houthis>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-09-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Syria welcomes Lebanon's request to import energy through Syrian territory. The energy would be generated in Jordan using Egyptian gas before being transmitted to Lebanon through Syria's power grid. Lebanon has been dealing with shortages of energy due to its ongoing economic crisis. However, the deal is complicated by sanctions against Syrian officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syria-says-it-welcomes-lebanons-request-import-energy-2021-09-04/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-04-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hamid Karzai International Airport in Kabul reopens to domestic flights and aid after it was closed due to NATO evacuations from the country.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/kabul-airport-reopens-aid-domestic-services-n1278515>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-09-04-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India / COVID-19 pandemic in Maharashtra.

**Archived source account.** Maharashtra reports a single-day record of 1,191,921 vaccines administered. State officials also announce that 80% of adults in Mumbai have received at least one dose of the COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/mumbai-news/maharashtra-vaccinates-record-1-191-million-beneficiaries-in-a-day-health-dept-101630774145742.html>); [CNN-News18](<https://www.news18.com/news/india/maharashtra-vaccine-milestone-80-of-adults-in-mumbai-have-received-at-least-one-jab-4166099.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-58453778>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/heavy-gunfire-heard-guinea-capital-conakry-reuters-witness-2021-09-05/>); [Europa Press](<https://www.europapress.es/internacional/noticia-militares-golpistas-detienen-presidente-guinea-ordenan-disolver-instituciones-20210905155127.html>); [The Economist](<https://www.economist.com/middle-east-and-africa/2021/09/05/alpha-conde-the-president-of-guinea-is-apparently-ousted-in-a-coup>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-06-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Panjshir conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban repeats its claim of having captured all of Panjshir Province, releasing footage of Taliban militants in front of the gubernatorial palace in Bazarak, the capital of the province. The National Resistance Front of Afghanistan continues to deny the Taliban's claims.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india/taliban-claim-control-panjshir-evacuation-flights-await-clearance-2021-09-06/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-06-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Panjshir conflict.

**Archived source account.** Anti-Taliban forces in Panjshir claim to have been bombed by Pakistan Air Force drones, accusing Pakistan of directly supporting the Taliban offensive.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/videos/world-news/panjshir-pakistan-air-force-dropped-bombs-via-drones-to-help-taliban-say-reports-afghanistan-101630909614845.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-06-0-6"></a>

Context: Tigray War / War crimes in the Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** In a single day, 11 more dead bodies of Tigrayans wash up along the Setit River, most likely coming from Humera. According to refugees from Humera, Amhara militants have rounded up thousands of Tigrayans and forced them into makeshift mass detention camps while those of other ethnicities were safe, particularly those of the Amhara ethnicity. Inside these detention camps, people were crammed together on the floor without rooms or partitions to create privacy. These people were also not given food and sometimes did not even have access to a toilet.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/05/africa/ethiopia-tigray-humera-sudan-bodies-cmd-intl/index.html?utm_medium=social&amp;utm_content=2021-09-06T18%3A15%3A06&amp;utm_source=twCNNi&amp;utm_term=link>).

<a id="event-2021-09-06-0-8"></a>

Context: 2021 Guinean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** The military junta led by Colonel Mamady Doumbouya announces an indefinite nightly curfew in the country, and says that Guinea's governors will be replaced by regional commanders of the military. The junta also refuses to issue a timeline for the release of deposed President Alpha Condé, saying that the former leader still has "access to medical care and his doctors".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/africa-guinea-d0426ca0b6fb0e40b3671a941e6d387e>).

<a id="event-2021-09-06-0-9"></a>

Context: 2021 Guinean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Doumbouya announces the formation of a new government soon and says that there will be no "witch-hunting" of ministers or former ministers of the Condé government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58461436>).

<a id="event-2021-09-06-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Algeria arrest 27 members of the separatist group MAK, which has been blamed for two recent attacks in northern towns. The group is known for seeking independence for the Berber-speaking region of Kabylie. Algeria cited Morocco's support for the group as a reason for suspending diplomatic relations last week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/algeria-arrests-members-mak-separatist-group-after-attacks-2021-09-06/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-09-06-5-1"></a>

Context: Germany–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** The German government calls on Russia to cease its cyber-attack operations, alleging phishing attacks against members of the Bundestag. Those accused are believed to be "cyber-actors of the Russian state" and specifically from the GRU.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/germany-russia-cyber-attack/2021/09/06/7b9ca734-0f28-11ec-baca-86b144fc8a2d_story.html?utm_source=rss&amp;utm_medium=referral&amp;utm_campaign=wp_homepage>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-06-6-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 Belarusian protests.

**Archived source account.** A court in Minsk, Belarus, finds opposition activist Maria Kalesnikava guilty of "trying to seize power and extremism" and sentences her to 11 years in prison. Kalesnikava had destroyed her passport to avoid being expelled from the country. Opposition leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya promises to release Kalesnikava "much earlier than these 11 years" and condemns the verdict.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belarus-protest-leader-kolesnikova-sentenced-11-years-jail-2021-09-06/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Duwa Lashi La, leader of the anti-junta National Unity Government, calls for a national revolt and uprising against the military government led by Min Aung Hlaing and for a "defensive war" in "every corner of the country; every village, town and city".

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-resistance-group-calls-for-revolt-against-military/a-59106630>).

<a id="event-2021-09-07-0-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 Guinean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** As the military consolidates power in the country, Colonel Mamady Doumbouya vows to free all "political prisoners" without mentioning any specific people or referring to deposed president Alpha Condé. Condé opposition groups welcome the news but say that no prisoners have been released.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/guinea-coup-leaders-promise-to-free-political-prisoners/a-59112681>).

<a id="event-2021-09-07-0-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Afghan protests.

**Archived source account.** Around 300 to 500 protesters, including women, took to the streets of Kabul. The Taliban used gunfire, detentions and beatings to disperse the crowds.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/09/07/asia/afghanistan-tuesday-kabul-protests-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-07-0-7"></a>

Context: Kidnapping in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kidnap 18 villagers in Kaduna State, Nigeria, including seven children, according to a community leader.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-kidnap-18-villagers-latest-attack-northern-nigeria-2021-09-07/>).

#### Businesses and economy

<a id="event-2021-09-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** El Salvador becomes the first country in the world to adopt the cryptocurrency Bitcoin as legal tender as well as the national currency as the Bitcoin Law comes into effect. However, a small but growing number of people opposed to the new law protested against it in the capital, San Salvador.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/9/7/glitches-protests-as-bitcoin-becomes-legal-tender-in-el-salvador>); [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/bitcoin-comes-to-el-salvador-first-country-to-adopt-crypto-as-national-currency-11631005200>).

Context: 2021 Guerrero earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A 7.0 magnitude earthquake struck just outside the tourist city of Acapulco, Guerrero, Mexico, killing at least one person and leaving more than 1.6 million without electricity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/magnitude-74-quake-strikes-mexico-usgs-2021-09-08/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/sep/08/mexico-earthquake-tsunami-warning-acapulco>).

<a id="event-2021-09-10-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Footage released by The New York Times shows that a U.S. drone strike conducted on August 29 targeted an aid worker named Zemari Ahmadi instead of ISIS-K militants. The report also confirms that 10 Afghans were killed in the drone strike, including seven children.

<a id="event-2021-09-10-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights says that the Taliban response to the peaceful marches has been increasingly violent, with authorities using live ammunition, batons and whips, which has resulted in the deaths of four civilians. A spokesperson for the rights office says that the response from the Taliban has been "unfortunately severe".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/taliban-response-afghan-protests-increasingly-violent-un-says-2021-09-10/>).

The forum also documented and urged the governments of Tanzania, Uganda, Burundi and Kenya to decriminalize homosexuality and protect the minority.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand, Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/17/nz-australia-travel-bubble-suspension-stays-amid-delta-outbreaks>).

<a id="event-2021-09-17-1-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia.

**Archived source account.** The Slovenian government announces that all public sector employees, with the exception of employees working in the education sector, will have to show a proof of vaccination or recovery from COVID-19 beginning on October 1 or they risk losing their jobs.

<a id="event-2021-09-17-1-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/09/17/fda-panel-begins-voting-on-pfizers-covid-booster-doses-rejecting-shots-for-general-public.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-17-1-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** A five-month survey finds that the Moderna COVID-19 vaccine is the most effective vaccine against hospitalization due to COVID-19. The study found that Moderna’s vaccine candidate had a 93% effectiveness in reducing hospitalizations, compared to 88% for Pfizer’s, and 71% for Johnson &amp; Johnson’s.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/covid-vaccine-efficacy-study-pfizer-moderna-johnson-and-johnson/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-09-17-2-1"></a>

Context: AUKUS.

**Archived source account.** The Australian Defence Minister announces that the new strategic partnership will also include increased numbers of U.S. bombers and airplanes being based out of Australia. In addition, the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace notes that the deal has revealed a loophole in nuclear policy that does not bar states without nuclear weapons from obtaining nuclear technology for submarines and that this falls outside of IAEA inspections.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-09-17/us-raises-concerns-about-china-economic-coercion-of-australia/100469360>); [Foreign Policy](<https://foreignpolicy.com/2021/09/16/u-s-seeking-basing-in-australia-after-submarine-deal/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-17-2-2"></a>

Context: AUKUS.

**Archived source account.** France recalls its ambassadors from the United States and Australia in protest of the security pact, which also includes the United Kingdom. The French Foreign Ministry says that the "exceptional decision" was justified by the seriousness of the pact, which has replaced its own security agreement with Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-58604677>).

<a id="event-2021-09-17-2-4"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The Shanghai Cooperation Organization grants membership status to Iran.

<a id="event-2021-09-17-2-6"></a>

Context: Libya–Tunisia relations, Libya–Tunisia border, Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Libya and Tunisia reopen their borders with stringent health protocol requiring travellers to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19 and PCR tested negative, two months after the closure on July 8 due to an explosion of COVID-19 cases in the latter country.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210917-libya-tunisia-border-reopens-after-covid-closure>).

<a id="event-2021-09-17-2-8"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** In escalating tensions over the past week, North Korea accuses the United States of double standards when it comes to condemning missile tests, saying that the U.S. only condemned North Korea the same day that South Korea also tested missiles. North Korean state media cited its chief as saying that the American response was a "vivid revelation of the American-style double-dealing attitude" and also says that unless "the U.S. drops its hostile policies towards North Korea, denuclearization can never be put on the table" of negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nkorea-accuses-us-double-standards-missiles-hampering-talks-2021-09-17/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-17-2-10"></a>

Context: Djibouti–Somalia relations.

**Archived source account.** Somali president Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed condemns Djibouti for detaining and forbidding a Somali security advisor from leaving the country. The president accused Djibouti of "destabilizing" relations amid a political feud between the Somali president and prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/somalias-president-berates-djibouti-detaining-his-security-adviser-2021-09-17/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-17-2-12"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine and the United States announce that they will begin joint military exercises involving 15 other countries in western Ukraine next week.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/ukraine-us-to-hold-joint-military-drills-/6232331.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two bombings in Jalalabad and two more in Kabul kill seven people and injure 30 others: one of the attacks targeted a vehicle carrying Taliban members.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/18/afghanistan-several-reported-dead-jalalabad-blasts>).

<a id="event-2021-09-18-0-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 Guinea coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** A Guinea junta spokesman for leader Mamady Doumbouya says that Doumbouya shrugged off threats of economic sanctions by ECOWAS when confronted with them, saying that "as soldiers, their work is in Guinea and there is nothing to freeze in their accounts." Talks are also ongoing to allow ousted president Alpha Condé to leave Guinea, a petition to which the junta has refused permission.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/guinea-junta-brushes-off-impact-ecowas-sanctions-2021-09-18/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-18-0-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/19/indonesia-police-kill-is-linked-leader-in-sulawesi-shootout>).

<a id="event-2021-09-18-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and seven more injured during a grenade attack at a volleyball match in Datu Piang, Maguindanao, Philippines.

<a id="event-2021-09-18-0-7"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-18-3-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 United States Capitol attack / Justice for J6 rally.

**Archived source account.** A rally is held near the United States Capitol to express solidarity with the people arrested for their roles in the January 6 riot. A fence is erected outside the building amid fears of violence, with four participants being arrested for various felonies.

Source citations (as archived): [WRC-TV](<https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/local/justice-for-j6-dc-rally-protest-uscp-arrest/2806087/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-18-3-4"></a>

Context: Illegal immigration to the United States.

**Archived source account.** Over the last 48 hours, Del Rio, Texas, sees an increase in border crossings with approximately 10,000 migrants, primarily from Haiti who traveled through Central and South America. The migrants are currently being kept in a camp underneath an overpass bridge and provided emergency supplies before being sent to either a Border Patrol station or Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Migrants are reportedly using instructions circulated on WhatsApp to evade border security based on interviews conducted at the camp.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/whatsapp-instructions-mexican-struggles-how-haitians-ended-up-texas-camp-2021-09-17/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-18-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Houthis in Yemen execute nine men by firing squad over their connection with the death of Saleh Ali al-Sammad, who was killed in a Saudi airstrike on Yemen's west coast in April 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/yemens-houthis-execute-nine-men-involvement-samad-death-2021-09-18/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-18-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Taliban replaces the Ministry of Women's Affairs with a new ministry named the Ministry for Preaching and Guidance and the Propagation of Virtue and the Prevention of Vice, in what analysts say is a setback for women's rights in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/18/taliban-replace-ministry-for-women-with-guidance-ministry>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-19-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Kabul Airlift.

**Archived source account.** A Qatar Airways charter flight carrying 200 passengers, including Afghans and Americans, departs from Kabul International Airport to Qatar.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/qatar-flight-with-afghans-americans-europeans-leaves-kabul-official-says-2021-09-19/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-19-0-4"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / ISIL–Taliban conflict.

**Archived source account.** Three Taliban members and two civilians are killed when a bomb, planted by ISIL–K, explodes near a Taliban vehicle in Jalalabad, Nangarhar.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/sep/18/three-killed-in-explosions-in-jalalabad-eastern-afghanistan>).

<a id="event-2021-09-19-0-6"></a>

Context: Papua conflict, Australia–Indonesia relations.

**Archived source account.** A recently declassified Australian intelligence report from 1998 reveals that the government was fully aware that the Indonesian military had massacred peaceful protesters from the Free Papua Movement, which was not publicly acknowledged or condemned by Australia at the time. Guardian Australia speculates that supporting photographic evidence may have been destroyed by Australian authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/sep/19/killed-like-animals-documents-reveal-how-australia-turned-a-blind-eye-to-a-west-papuan-massacre>).

**Archived source account.** Police officers have discovered the remains of three children and one adult inside a residential property in Killamarsh, near Sheffield, England, after being called out to reports of a disturbance. A 31-year-old man has been arrested and a murder inquiry has been launched.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-derbyshire-58622164>).

**Archived source account.** Laotian capital Vientiane enters in a strict lockdown for two weeks as the city reported a record number of COVID-19 cases. Travel between the hard-hit provinces is also banned and anyone wishing to enter the city must be quarantined for 14 days.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2184815/laos-locks-down-capital-as-covid-cases-hit-record-high>).

<a id="event-2021-09-19-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia, COVID-19 vaccination in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** The Malaysian government approves a plan to administer a COVID-19 vaccine booster dose for high-risk groups once the nationwide vaccination rate surpasses 80% of the adult population.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2021/09/19/pm-frontliners-elderly-to-get-booster-shots-once-80-of-adults-vaccinated>).

<a id="event-2021-09-19-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore reports 1,012 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of new cases since April 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/health/1012-new-covid-19-cases-in-spore-second-day-in-a-row-new-infections-cross-1000-mark>).

<a id="event-2021-09-19-3-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sixty-three African penguins are dead after being stung by a swarm of bees in Simon's Town, South Africa. The African penguin is an endangered species.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58622482>).

Context: Mexico–United States border crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United States closes the Mexico–US border near the Texas city of Del Rio after thousands of Haitian migrants arrived at the International Bridge near the city. The U.S. will also begin flying the migrants back to Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/immigration-border-haiti-mexico-texas-09d7de5bc57e1dbd92d40751c0d91f69>).

<a id="event-2021-09-19-5-1"></a>

Context: Gilboa Prison break.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces announces that all six Palestinian fugitives have been recaptured, after the last two, who are part of the Islamic Jihad Movement, were arrested in the Palestinian city of Jenin through a joint operation with the Yamam.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/last-two-prison-break-fugitives-recaptured-israeli-army/articleshow/86334721.cms>).

<a id="event-2021-09-19-5-3"></a>

Context: Women's rights in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The new Taliban mayor of Kabul, Hamdullah Nomani, asks women to stay at home in case their job can be filled by a man. Nomani also added that the Taliban "finds it necessary to stop women from working for a while" and instead urged them to work in places where men cannot go due to gender segregation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-58614113>).

<a id="event-2021-09-19-6-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Philippine presidential election, 2021 PDP–Laban dispute.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of protesters call to "kick out" prime minister Prayuth Chan-ocha on the 15th anniversary of the 2006 Thai coup d'état, which ousted former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/19/protesters-call-to-kick-out-thai-pm-on-coup-anniversary>).

### 2021-09-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1101118745](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20September%2020&oldid=1101118745>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Rwandan genocide.

**Archived source account.** A court in Rwanda finds Paul Rusesabagina, a former hotel manager portrayed as a hero in the Hollywood film about the genocide, guilty of terrorism-related charges. Rusesabagina, who remained handcuffed in court, denounced president Paul Kagame and said that he was abducted from exile in Dubai in order to stand trial in Rwanda.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/rwandan-court-finds-hotel-rwanda-film-hero-rusesabagina-guilty-terror-related-2021-09-20/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Cabo Delgado.

**Archived source account.** ISIL-linked militants raid a village of Kagera, Tanzania, after crossing the border from Mozambique, killing four people. Three of the victims were beheaded. Between 18 and 33 people have been kidnapped.

Source citations (as archived): [Cabo Ligado](<https://www.caboligado.com/reports/cabo-ligado-weekly-20-26-september-2021>).

<a id="event-2021-09-20-0-5"></a>

Context: Anglophone Crisis.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen soldiers and civilians are killed during two bombing and shooting attacks in the Northwest Region, Cameroon. The attacks had been carried out several days ago but were not reported until today.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/20/rebel-attacks-kill-15-soldiers-in-troubled-cameroon>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-09-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Volkswagen submits an offer of €2.5 billion for French car rental firm Europcar. The deal, which would give Volkswagen 66% of Europcar's shares, has been accepted by the board but still needs to be accepted by regulators in France. Volkswagen previously owned Europcar and sold it to French investment firm Eurazeo for €3.3 billion in 2006.

Source citations (as archived): [RTE](<https://www.rte.ie/news/business/2021/0920/1247953-volkswagen-europcar-offer/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-20-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twitter agrees to pay $809.5 million to settle a shareholder class action lawsuit that accused the social media company of painting an overly rosy picture of its future.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-09-20/twitter-in-810-million-settlement-of-shareholder-suit-on-growth?srnd=premium>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-09-20-2-1"></a>

Context: 2021 La Palma eruption.

**Archived source account.** More than 100 homes on the island of La Palma in the Spanish Canary Islands are destroyed by lava flows, and 5,000 people are evacuated. Several schools on the island suspend classes.

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/ciencia/2021/09/20/61480a3dfc6c83bd7d8b4639.html>); [Europa Press](<https://www.europapress.es/islas-canarias/noticia-suspenden-clases-paso-llanos-aridane-tazacorte-20210919200914.html>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England, COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland, COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** England and Scotland begin the rollout of COVID-19 vaccines for children between the ages of 12 and 15 as part of an expansion of their vaccination programme in order to protect more people from COVID-19 during the winter.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-58623058>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/religion/vatican-city-enforces-mandates-for-vaccines-covid-19-test/2021/09/20/ec3aa2b4-1a38-11ec-bea8-308ea134594f_story.html>); [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/249038/vatican-requires-vaccine-pass-for-visitors-employees>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** Washington D.C. Mayor Muriel Bowser announces that COVID-19 vaccines will be required for all teachers and students in the district by November 1.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Biden administration announces that travel restrictions will be lifted for international travellers who are fully vaccinated and show a negative COVID-19 test. These rules will be in effect beginning in November.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

<a id="event-2021-09-20-6-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 protests in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Members of Melbourne's far-right violate lockdown laws and riot at the office of the Construction, Forestry, Maritime, Mining and Energy Union, damaging windows and assaulting state secretary John Setka before being dispersed by police. The rioters were dressed in the high-visibility clothing associated with the construction industry and presented themselves as Union rank-and-file protesting a bureaucracy which they claimed was working to impose mandatory COVID-19 vaccinations. Setka said that the Union opposes mandatory vaccinations and blamed the riots on "outside extremists", stating that only a minority of those in attendance were Union members.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/sep/20/construction-union-blames-extremists-as-melbourne-protest-against-vaccine-mandate-turns-violent>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

<a id="event-2021-09-21-0-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

Context: Australia–European Union relations, Australia–France relations.

Context: Foreign relations of Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Argentine President Alberto Fernández asks Iran to "cooperate with the Argentine justice" regarding an investigation into the 1994 AMIA bombing in Buenos Aires and demands that countries where wanted Iranian officials are residing should comply with its Interpol red notices.

Source citations (as archived): [Infobae](<https://www.infobae.com/politica/2021/09/21/ante-la-onu-alberto-fernandez-critico-al-fmi-y-dijo-que-argentina-fue-sometida-a-un-deudicidio/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-21-3-5"></a>

Context: Recognition of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, Foreign relations of Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** In a letter to the United Nations Secretary-General, the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs requests representation at the seventy-sixth session of the United Nations General Assembly. The Emirate's Foreign Minister Ameer Khan Muttaqi also requests that Permanent Representative of Afghanistan to the United Nations Ghulam Isaczai be replaced by Mohammad Suhail Shasheen. The Taliban also note that former President Ashraf Ghani had been "ousted and \[countries across the world\] no longer recognize him as president."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/21/world/taliban-unga-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-21-3-7"></a>

Context: Russia–United\_Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** British police announce a third Russian had been charged in absentia with the 2018 Novichok murder attempt on former double agent Sergei Skripal, saying they could also now confirm the three suspects were military intelligence operatives.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/the-third-man-uk-charges-another-russian-for-nerve-attack-on-double-agent>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Death of Gabby Petito.

**Archived source account.** A coroner in Teton County, Wyoming, confirms that the remains found on September 19 were that of Petito, who disappeared from Grand Teton National Park on August 27, and rules her death a homicide.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.todayonline.com/world/missing-us-woman-gabby-petito-confirmed-dead-homicide-fbi>).

<a id="event-2021-09-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Human Rights rules that agents acting on behalf of the Russian government were responsible for the fatal poisoning of Alexander Litvinenko in 2006.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-58637572>).

<a id="event-2021-09-21-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Court of Justice of the European Union imposes a daily fine of €500,000 (2.31M zł) on Poland for its refusal to close the Turów Coal Mine, which was declared illegal by a temporary injunction from the court in May.

Source citations (as archived): [WIAT-TV](<https://www.cbs42.com/news/international/eu-court-fines-poland-500000-euros-daily-until-mine-closes/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-09-21-5-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 protests in Australia, COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** Victorian Premier Daniel Andrews announces a two-week suspension of construction work in the state after yesterday's riot at the Construction, Forestry, Maritime, Mining and Energy Union (CFMEU) office. Rioters claimed that they were construction workers, although CFMEU officials and others claim that there were few construction workers present.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-09-21/victoria-construction-industry-shutdown-melbourne-protest-police/100478450>).

<a id="event-2021-09-21-5-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 protests in Australia, COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** Protesters return to the Melbourne CBD for the second consecutive day, assaulting journalists and blocking the West Gate Freeway. Riot police responded with rubber bullet rounds.

Source citations (as archived): [New Zealand Herald](<https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/covid-19-coronavirus-australia-melbourne-erupts-in-violent-anti-lockdown-protests-for-second-day/6IW53HVDEJIVHK5LBYX3VMYUSE/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-21-5-4"></a>

Context: Women's rights in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Taliban spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid says that girls will return to school soon, adding that "We are finalizing things... it will happen as soon as possible". The announcement came as the Taliban banned girls from grades 6 to 12 from attending school, to which Mujahid said that this was only "temporary" and that new announcements would be made soon.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-girls-could-return-to-school-soon-says-taliban/a-59248723>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-09-21-6-1"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup qualification, Racism in association football.

**Archived source account.** FIFA sanctions the Hungarian Football Federation with a US$216,000 fine and orders the Hungarian national team to play their next two World Cup qualification home matches behind closed doors, following incidents of racist behavior among their fans during a match against England on September 2.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/09/21/football/hungary-stadium-ban-fine-england-racist-spt-intl/index.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** ISIL-K militants open fire against a Taliban vehicle at a gas station in Jalalabad, killing two Taliban members, a gas station attendant, and a child. Two bombs also explode nearby to two more Taliban vehicles, killing another child and injuring three more Taliban members.

Source citations (as archived): [First Post](<https://www.firstpost.com/world/two-taliban-fighters-among-five-killed-in-fresh-attacks-in-jalalabad-9987431.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-22-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** ISIS-K militants kill four Christian Afghan men after stopping their vehicle and then shooting the victims.

Source citations (as archived): [Mission Network News](<https://www.mnnonline.org/news/isis-kills-four-afghan-christians/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-22-0-4"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces capture the Bayhan District in Yemen's Shabwah Governorate where oil fields are located and continue their advance into neighboring Usaylan District.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://www.msn.com/en-ph/news/national/rebels-seize-yemen-oil-fields/ar-AAOI7P5?ocid=BingNewsSearch>).

<a id="event-2021-09-22-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Germany link a belief in COVID-19 conspiracy theories and far-right extremism as motives behind the killing of a cashier in Idar-Oberstein, Rhineland-Palatinate, four days ago. The 20-year-old student employee was murdered at the shop where he worked by a man who refused to wear a mask. Far-right extremists praise the killing and make denigratory comments about the victim.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58635103>).

<a id="event-2021-09-22-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire against a vehicle carrying Serhiy Shefir, an official close to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, near the village of Lisnyky, outside of Kyiv, wounding the driver of the car. The attack is deemed an assassination attempt against Shefir.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/22/shots-fired-at-car-carrying-ukrainian-presidents-aide>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-09-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Mansfield earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 5.8 earthquake strikes the Alpine National Park in Victoria, Australia, with tremors felt throughout the state and in parts of New South Wales, the Australian Capital Territory, South Australia and Tasmania. Some buildings in Melbourne are damaged but no casualties are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-parliament-passes-law-oligarchs-final-reading-2021-09-23/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-09-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Commission announces plans to require the USB-C connection to become the standard port for wired charging of all smartphones, tablets, cameras, headphones, portable speakers and handheld video game consoles.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/technology/573569-eu-proposes-requirement-for-standard-charging-port-across-devices>).

### 2021-09-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1060942470](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20September%2024&oldid=1060942470>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban-appointed defense minister of Afghanistan Mohammad Yaqoob orders a crackdown on those members of the Taliban who commit abuses following reports by Kabul residents who complained about abusive treatment by certain Taliban members. Yaqoob says that "We direct you to keep them out of your ranks, otherwise strict action will be taken against you," and added that the Taliban does not "want such people in our ranks."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-taliban-defence-minister-orders-crackdown-abuses-2021-09-24/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli soldiers open fire using rubber bullets against Palestinians allegedly throwing rocks towards soldiers during a protest against Israeli settlements in the West Bank, killing one person and injuring eight others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/24/israeli-troops-kill-palestinian-man-in-west-bank-ministry>); [Ynet News](<https://www.ynetnews.com/article/ryeqcoixk>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Cabo Delgado.

**Archived source account.** Rwandan president Paul Kagame announces during a press conference in Pemba, Mozambique, that Rwandan troops will continue to be stationed in Mozambique for the reconstruction of areas affected by the extremist insurgency. Mozambican president Filipe Nyusi thanks Kagame for the country's commitment to fight terrorism in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/24/in-mozambique-kagame-says-rwandan-troops-presence-to-continue>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-0-7"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** A French serviceman, Maxime Blasco, is killed in a shootout with jihadists in a forest near Mali's border with Burkina Faso. The gunman who shot Blasco was also killed during the clash, according to the Ministry of Armed Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210924-french-soldier-killed-in-mali-in-clash-with-armed-terrorist-group>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-09-24-1-1"></a>

Context: Legality of bitcoin by country or territory.

**Archived source account.** The People's Bank of China rules that all financial transactions and activities involving cryptocurrency are illegal in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/business/china-cryptocurrency-ban-news-chinas-central-bank-rules-all-crypto-transactions-are-illegal-2552286>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-09-24-2-1"></a>

Context: 2021 La Palma eruption.

**Archived source account.** The Cumbre Vieja volcano enters a more explosive and extreme phase, forcing the evacuation of three more neighborhoods. Currently, 390 buildings and 14 km of roads have been destroyed by lava flows.

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/ciencia/2021/09/24/614d0cd0e4d4d866658b45a1.html>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore reports a record 1,650 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 84,510.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina, COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Argentina and Brazil jointly announce that they will be producing COVID-19 vaccines after being selected by the Pan American Health Organization. Two manufacturing plants will be built, one in each country, to produce both Moderna and Pfizer vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [Voz de América](<https://www.vozdeamerica.com/a/argentina-brasil-produciran-vacunas-contra-covid-19/6243832.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-3-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America / COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian Congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, son of President Jair Bolsonaro, tests positive for COVID-19. Agricultural Minister Tereza Cristina and Solicitor General Bruno Bianco also test positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-agriculture-minister-tests-positive-covid-19-2021-09-24/>); [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/international/573816-bolsonaros-son-tests-positive-for-covid-19>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-3-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy, COVID-19 vaccination in Italy.

**Archived source account.** The Italian National Institute of Health recommends that pregnant women should receive a COVID-19 vaccines after the first three months of their pregnancy due to growing evidence on the safety of vaccines during pregnancies for both the fetus and mother.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economic Times](<https://health.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry/italy-backs-covid-19-shots-for-pregnant-women-from-second-trimester/86482861>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-3-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record 828 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 202,273.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2021/09/24/russia-record-as-daily-deaths-from-covid-19-hit-new-high>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-3-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia, COVID-19 vaccination in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The number of Australians who are fully vaccinated against COVID-19 surpasses 50% after a record 347,796 doses of the COVID-19 vaccine were administered in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [7 News](<https://7news.com.au/lifestyle/health-wellbeing/australia-reaches-critical-50-per-cent-vaccination-milestone-as-morrison-government-pushes-for-restrictions-to-ease-c-4052703>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-09-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Algeria–Morocco relations.

**Archived source account.** In escalating tensions, Algerian foreign ministry official Amar Belani says that Algeria "may escalate its dispute" with Morocco, adding that the "adoption of additional measures cannot be ruled out". Both countries suspended diplomatic relations in August 2020 and have had strained relations due to Algeria's support for the Polisario Front in Western Sahara and alleged Moroccan support for the MAK, a Berber separatist group in Algeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/algerian-official-warns-further-measures-against-morocco-2021-09-24/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Mexico–United States border crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of Homeland Security Alejandro Mayorkas says that the Haitian migrants have been cleared from the International Bridge in Del Rio, Texas. Around 2,000 of the migrants were deported to Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/migrants-have-been-cleared-under-del-rio-bridge-mayorkas-says-n1280055>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-24-5-1"></a>

Context: Arrest of Meng Wanzhou, Detention of Michael Spavor and Michael Kovrig, Canada–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Huawei executive Meng Wanzhou reaches a deferred prosecution agreement, pleading not guilty to multiple fraud charges. Meng's extradition case was subsequently dropped and she was released after spending nearly three years under house arrest in Vancouver, Canada, reportedly travelling to Shenzhen, China.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/meng-wanzhou-us-court-1.6188093>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-5-2"></a>

Context: Arrest of Meng Wanzhou, Detention of Michael Spavor and Michael Kovrig, Canada–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Several hours after Meng Wanzhou was released, Canadians Michael Spavor and Michael Kovrig are also released after spending more than 1,000 days in detention in China and will return to Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/spavor-kovrig-return-1.6189516>).

<a id="event-2021-09-24-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jitender Mann Gogi, a major Indian gangster, is shot dead inside a courtroom in Rohini, Delhi, where a case was being heard against him. The two attackers, who both posed as lawyers, are killed by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-58674452>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-09-24-6-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Northern Chad.

**Archived source account.** Military junta leader and de facto president Mahamat Déby appoints 93 new members to the junta, which serves as Chad's interim parliament ahead of a proposed election. Déby says that the new parliament comprises parties previously represented in the dissolved parliament, as well as members of the armed forces.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.trtworld.com/africa/chad-junta-leader-names-new-interim-parliament-50233>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-09-24-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In an article for Science, a team of researchers based at Bournemouth University conclude that a series of human footprints preserved at White Sands National Park in the U.S. state of New Mexico date back between 21,000 and 23,000 years ago during the Last Glacial Maximum, suggesting that humans lived in the Americas 5,000 years earlier than previously thought. The team also determined that most of the footprints came from children and teenagers.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2021/09/24/1040381802/ancient-footprints-new-mexico-white-sands-humans>).

<a id="event-2021-09-25-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** The Netherlands begins to require a COVID-19 pass for people over the age of 13 years old as a precondition to enter hospitality venues and arts and cultural events. The COVID-19 pass replaces most social distancing and mask requirements.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Norway.

**Archived source account.** Norway lifts its social distancing rules and capacity limits on business, sport, and cultural venues, and other COVID-19-related restrictions, and also allows the reopening of nightclubs, as 67% of people have been fully vaccinated.

<a id="event-2021-09-25-3-11"></a>

<a id="event-2021-09-25-3-13"></a>

Context: Climate change.

**Archived source account.** Vanuatu launches a global campaign to seek an advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice (ICJ). Vanuatu bases its decision on being incapable with its own decisions to address rising sea levels and other challenges linked to climate change and wants the ICJ to establish responsibilities for climate change under international law.
