### 2021-09-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1193276035](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20September%2026&oldid=1193276035>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / War in Afghanistan / 2021 Kabul Airlift.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban calls for international commercial flights at the Kabul International Airport to resume after the airport was closed for evacuations.

Source citations (as archived): [UrduPoint](<https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/kabul-airport-ready-to-open-for-international-1360360.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Five Palestinians are killed in Biddu, Jerusalem, and two more are killed in Burqin during overnight military raids by Israeli soldiers. Two soldiers are also injured during one of the raids. According to Israeli officials, the Palestinians were members of a Hamas cell who were planning large-scale kidnappings and murders across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/26/two-palestinians-killed-by-israeli-forces-in-occupied-west-bank>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/hamas-cell-hit-in-west-bank-raids-planned-massive-jerusalem-terror-attack-tv/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Communal conflicts in Nigeria, Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen raid the village of Madamai in Kaduna State, killing 34 people and wounding seven more. Two suspects are arrested. In Sokoto State, 22 security personnel are killed by ISWAP terrorists during an attack on a remote army base. Other gunmen in Kaduna then also attacked a church, resulting in the death of a person and the wounding of others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/27/gunmen-kill-34-people-in-northwest-nigeria>).

<a id="event-2021-09-26-0-9"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and six more are injured during a mass shooting at a public venue in Tumaco, Colombia. A military commander has blamed the attack on FARC dissidents.

<a id="event-2021-09-26-0-11"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 Ethiopian–Sudanese clashes.

**Archived source account.** Sudan claims that it has repelled an advance by Ethiopian troops into Umm Barakit District, al-Fashaga. However, Ethiopia denies any movement of its forces on the Ethiopia–Sudan border.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58698010>).

News](<https://news.yahoo.com/kidnapping-assassination-and-a-london-shoot-out-inside-the-ci-as-secret-war-plans-against-wiki-leaks-090057786.html>); [Rolling Stone](<https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-news/cia-julian-assange-kidnap-assasinate-1232546/>).

Context: Kosovo–Serbia relations / 2021 North Kosovo protests.

**Archived source account.** The Serbian government accuses Kosovo of "provocations" after it mobilized its special police units to the border, and places the Serbian Army on a heightened state of alert. The police units were mobilized after hundreds of Kosovo Serbs staged daily protests and blockaded roads connected to the two border crossings between the two countries after the Kosovar government passed a law requiring that Serbia-registered vehicles wear temporary license plates when entering the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/26/serbian-troops-on-heightened-alert-at-kosovo-border>).

<a id="event-2021-09-28-5-3"></a>

Context: September 2021 Guayaquil prison riot.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-four people are killed and 42 others are wounded during a battle between rival gangs at a prison in Guayaquil, Ecuador. Some of the inmates were armed with guns and grenades.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/29/at-least-24-killed-in-ecuador-prison-gang-clash-police>).

<a id="event-2021-09-28-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twenty-five people are injured, four critically, during an explosion at a block of flats in Gothenburg, Sweden. An accident has been ruled out, with authorities suspecting a criminal background.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/sep/28/explosion-at-block-of-flats-in-gothenburg-sweden>).

<a id="event-2021-09-28-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a 35-page report, a commission appointed by the World Health Organization (WHO) to investigate sex abuses during the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo finds that there were "clear structural failures" and "individual negligence" for the sex abuse and rape of women and girls between 2018 and 2020 by WHO staff. WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom apologizes for the abuses.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20210928-negligence-by-who-staff-to-blame-for-sexual-abuse-in-drc-independent-commission-says>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-09-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA announces the scheduled launch of Lucy, a twelve-year space probe on the Jupiter trojan asteroids, the first mission to do so. It will launch from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida on October 16.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/united-states/nasas-lucy-mission-to-probe-jupiters-mysterious-trojan-asteroids>).

### 2021-09-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1238498873](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20September%2029&oldid=1238498873>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Five Malian gendarmes are killed and four others are wounded in an ambush on a convoy escorting mining equipment to the Australian-owned Morila Gold Mine in Sikasso Region. Jihadist group Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/five-gendarmes-killed-attack-mining-convoy-mali-army-2021-09-29/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mohibullah, a prominent Rohingya Muslim leader and high-profile advocate for the Rohingya, is killed by a gunman in a refugee camp in southern Bangladesh.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/29/top-rohingya-leader-in-bangladesh-shot-dead>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-09-29-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China.

**Archived source account.** Three pet cats who previously tested positive for COVID-19 are euthanized in the Chinese city of Harbin amid fears that pets could spread the virus to humans.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/china-kills-3-pet-cats-which-contracted-covid-amid-fears-they-would-spread-virus-humans-1633899>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-1-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore reports a record 2,268 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 94,043.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/singapore-covid-19-sep-29-8-more-deaths-2268-new-cases-2209956>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-1-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record 857 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 206,388.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/09/29/russia-reports-record-virus-deaths-for-second-day-a75166>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-1-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia.

**Archived source account.** Slovenia suspends the use of the Janssen COVID-19 vaccine following the death of a 20-year-old woman who had received the vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2021/09/29/slovenia-temporarily-suspends-use-of-johnson-johnson-covid-19-vaccine>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-1-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Algeria.

**Archived source account.** Algeria begins producing the CoronaVac COVID-19 vaccine developed by Sinovac, with expected production of eight million doses per month.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210929-algeria-begins-sinovac-covid-19-vaccine-production>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-1-14"></a>

Context: Holocene extinction.

**Archived source account.** Eleven species of birds, two fish, one bat, eight mussels and one plant are declared extinct by the United States Fish and Wildlife Service. The ivory-billed woodpecker, the Guam flying fox and the Bachman's warbler are among those declared extinct.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-58740362>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-09-29-2-1"></a>

Context: France–United Kingdom relations, 2021 Jersey dispute.

**Archived source account.** Jersey rejects 75 French fishing applications, once again raising tensions over disputed fishing rights off Jersey. France condemns the move as French fishermen threaten to impose either a "blockade" of ports, or of lorries travelling to the United Kingdom via the Channel tunnel, as retaliation.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/fishing-wars-flare-in-channel-as-jersey-rejects-french-applications/a-59356353>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Unexplained wealth of the Marcos family.

**Archived source account.** The Sandiganbayan, the Philippines' anti-graft court, orders Royal Traders Holding Co. Inc., a bank formerly controlled by the late dictator Ferdinand Marcos, to pay the Philippine government an estimated PHP1 billion ($32.446 million) in bank certificates that were confiscated by the United States Customs Service after Marcos was deposed in 1986.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/sandiganbayan-decision-royal-traders-holding-marcos-ill-gotten-bank-asset>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-3-3"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Nepal.

**Archived source account.** The Central Bureau of Statistics adds an option for a third gender to its census forms for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/29/nepal-introduces-third-gender-category-in-latest-census>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-3-5"></a>

Context: Britney Spears conservatorship dispute.

**Archived source account.** The Los Angeles County Superior Court suspends James Parnell Spears from the conservatorship of his daughter, American singer Britney Spears, which was implemented in 2008.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.philstar.com/entertainment/2021/09/30/2130788/britney-spears-father-removed-her-guardian>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-3-7"></a>

Context: September 2021 Guayaquil prison riot.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from yesterday's riot between rival gangs at a prison in Guayaquil, Ecuador, increases to 116, making the incident the deadliest prison riot in the country's history.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-58733202>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Treasury Department, in coordination with Qatar, imposes sanctions on United Arab Emirates real estate company Aldar Properties and seven residents of Bahrain, Qatar and Saudi Arabia for allegedly financing Hezbollah.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/9/29/us-issues-hezbollah-related-sanctions-in-coordination-with-qatar>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-09-29-4-2"></a>

Context: Politics of Japan / 2021 Liberal Democratic Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** The Liberal Democratic Party elects former foreign minister Fumio Kishida as its new leader. Kishida is expected to become prime minister within days, succeeding Yoshihide Suga.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/japans-ruling-party-votes-new-leader-who-will-almost-certainly-be-next-pm-2021-09-28/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-4-4"></a>

Context: Indigenous land rights in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Queensland state government grants land rights over parts of the UNESCO-listed Wet Tropics, including the Daintree National Park, to the Kuku Yalanji people. The Kuku Yalanji will initially co-administer the land with the Queensland government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/sep/29/indigenous-traditional-owners-win-back-daintree-rainforest-in-historic-deal>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-4-6"></a>

Context: Politics of Tunisia.

**Archived source account.** Tunisian President Kais Saied appoints Najla Bouden Romdhane as the first female prime minister in Tunisia and the Arab world.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/29/africa/tunisia-prime-minister-najla-bouden-romdhane-intl/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-09-29-5-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 misinformation.

**Archived source account.** YouTube says that it will ban misinformation related to all vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2021/09/29/youtube-will-now-ban-content-with-vaccine-misinformation/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-29-5-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 misinformation.

**Archived source account.** Russia threatens to ban YouTube if it does not reinstate two German-language channels backed by the Russian state that were deleted for violating COVID-19 misinformation guidelines.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-58737433>).

### 2021-09-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1238893898](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20September%2030&oldid=1238893898>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-09-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Three Palestinians are killed, two are injured and two more are arrested by Israeli soldiers during armed confrontations in the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/30/israeli-forces-kill-two-palestinians-burqin-jerusalem>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-0-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Afghanistan protests, Treatment of women by the Taliban.

**Archived source account.** Taliban forces use gunfire to disperse a group of six women who protested in front of their high school in Kabul against the Taliban regime forbidding them to return to study. Security forces also pushed the women and threatened arrests. A guard said that they dispersed the protest because the six women "did not coordinate with security forces regarding their protest".

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/afghanistan-taliban-takeover-taliban-fire-shots-to-disperse-woman-protesters-in-kabul-2558728>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban orders all members belonging to the group's defense, interior and intelligence agencies who are living in private homes to "report back to military bases" across the country and stop occupying private homes they had taken over.

Source citations (as archived): [Military.com](<https://www.military.com/daily-news/2021/09/30/taliban-order-fighters-out-of-afghan-homes-they-took-over.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-09-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Expo 2020.

**Archived source account.** Dubai holds an opening ceremony to kick off the Expo 2020 event after it was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Around 192 countries will be participating in the event. This will be the first world's fair to be held in the Middle East.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/gulf/2021/09/30/UAE-officially-launches-Expo-2020-Dubai-the-world-s-biggest-cultural-gathering>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-09-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The government's furlough scheme ends in the United Kingdom after 18 months. Almost a million people are reported to still be on furlough from their employer.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-58735299>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Egypt receives their first shipment of 1.6 million doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine donated by the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Arabiya English](<https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/10/01/Egypt-receives-first-1-6-mln-doses-of-Pfizer-COVID-19-vaccine-from-US>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Africa / COVID-19 pandemic in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** Somalia opens its first public oxygen plant in Mogadishu to treat patients infected with COVID-19. The new plant was purchased from Turkey by a local foundation for $240,700.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/the-great-reboot/somalia-opens-first-public-oxygen-plant-help-treat-covid-19-amid-severe-shortage-2021-09-30/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia, COVID-19 vaccination in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** The Malaysian Public Service Department mandates that all federal government employees will need to be vaccinated against COVID-19, with exceptions only to be allowed on health grounds, in order to increase the country's vaccination rate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/seasia/2021/09/30/malaysia-makes-covid-19-jabs-compulsory-for-government-workers.html>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore reports a record for the third consecutive day of 2,428 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 96,521.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/singapore-new-covid19-cases-record-sep-30-2-deaths-dormitory-clusters-2212476>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France begins to implement a mandatory health pass for children aged 12 to 17 to enter most activities in their daily lives.

Source citations (as archived): [(Radio France Internationale](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20210930-health-pass-becomes-mandatory-for-french-teens-from-30-september>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Romania.

**Archived source account.** Romania reports a record 12,032 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,233,668.

Source citations (as archived): [Romania Insider](<https://www.romania-insider.com/covid-cases-ro-sept-30-2021>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the third consecutive day of 867 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 207,255.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/09/30/russia-reports-record-virus-deaths-for-third-day-a75178>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in Queensland.

**Archived source account.** Restrictions are increased in Queensland after an increase in locally-acquired COVID-19 cases, resulting in 25% of ticket-holders for the NRL Grand Final in Brisbane receiving cancellations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/sep/30/queensland-covid-update-nrl-grand-final-capacity-cut-as-six-new-cases-recorded>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-3-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** Victoria reports a record 1,438 new COVID-19 infections in the past 24 hours, surpassing New South Wales as the epicentre of the pandemic in Australia. Victorian Premier Daniel Andrews blames the increase on illegal parties held to celebrate the AFL Grand Final and also announces that the time between doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine will be reduced to three weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Age](<https://www.theage.com.au/national/victoria/state-records-surge-of-1438-new-covid-19-cases-five-deaths-as-double-dosed-victorians-allowed-to-return-home-20210930-p58vxq.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-09-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** European Union diplomat Josep Borrell says that nuclear talks will resume "soon" at an acceptable time period.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-nuclear-talks-resume-acceptable-period-time-eu-2021-09-30/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-4-2"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken warns that Iran is running out of time to return to the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action signed in 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg.com](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-09-30/blinken-says-there-s-limited-runway-for-iran-nuclear-talks>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-4-4"></a>

Context: Abraham Accords.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Foreign Minister Yair Lapid travels to Bahrain for the first official visit by an Israeli cabinet member to the Gulf kingdom since the countries established diplomatic ties last year.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-58745885>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-4-6"></a>

Context: 2021 North Kosovo protests.

**Archived source account.** Serbia and Kosovo agree to defuse their previously high tensions. Kosovo will withdraw its police units from protest sites on the Serbian border and the two countries will also end their bans on the other country's license plates.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kosovo-serbia-agree-deal-end-border-tensions-2021-09-30/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-4-8"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** The Ethiopian foreign ministry announces that it will expel seven senior United Nations humanitarian officials working in Ethiopia and declare them as persona non grata for "meddling" in the country's internal affairs.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/ethiopia-to-expel-seven-senior-un-staff-for-meddling-ministry-01633011608?refsec=afp-news>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-09-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 96-year-old German woman accused of collaborating with the SS in the deaths of thousands of people at the Stutthof concentration camp, where she was employed as a typist, is arrested by German police shortly after a court ordered her arrest for evading the beginning of her trial. The court now orders the woman to be examined to determine whether she is fit to be jailed or to attend the court proceedings in person.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/30/former-nazi-camp-secretary-96-caught-hours-after-fleeing-trial>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-09-30-6-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Ethiopian general election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Ethiopia's Somali Region go to the polls as part of the larger general election originally scheduled to be held on June 21. Three opposition parties withdrew from the election, leaving President Abiy Ahmed's Prosperity Party as the sole party to participate.

Source citations (as archived): [Addis Standard](<https://addisstandard.com/news-voters-in-somali-state-cast-ballots-for-incumbent-candidates-after-withdrawal-of-three-opposition-parties/>).

<a id="event-2021-09-30-6-3"></a>

Context: 2021 South West Region referendum.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples' Region zones of Keffa, Sheka, Bench Sheko, Dawro, West Omo, and Konta vote 98.07% in favor of separating from the Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples' Region becoming the South West Ethiopia Peoples' Region.

Source citations (as archived): [Addis Standard](<https://addisstandard.com/news-alert-ethiopia-gets-eleventh-state-with-more-than-96-approval-for-south-west-referendum/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-09-30-7-1"></a>

Context: 2021 in sumo.

**Archived source account.** Hakuhō, the 69th yokozuna and widely considered to be one of the greatest professional sumo wrestlers of all time, officially retires from competition after a 20-year career, 14 of them at the sport's highest rank.

Source citations (as archived): [The Mainichi](<https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20210930/p2g/00m/0sp/057000c>).


## October

### 2021-10-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1187314143](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%201&oldid=1187314143>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen Allied Democratic Forces terrorists are arrested in Rwanda after planning multiple bombing attacks in Kigali. The planned attacks came as Rwanda is helping Mozambique fighting ISIL-linked groups in the Insurgency in Cabo Delgado.

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<https://www.africanews.com/2021/10/01/rwanda-arrests-13-suspected-of-plotting-terrorist-attacks/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamic State–Taliban conflict.

**Archived source account.** A bomb targets a Taliban security forces vehicle, injuring five people. Soldiers raided an ISIL-K hideout after the attack, killing several terrorists and arresting a few more.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLO News](<https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-174877>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-10-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Fall of Kabul.

**Archived source account.** It is announced that the Afghanistan pavilion at Expo 2020 in Dubai will remain closed to visitors due to the Taliban takeover of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/afghan-pavilion-dubai-world-fair-stays-shut-after-taliban-takeover-2021-10-01/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-01-2-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela launches its second monetary overhaul in the past three years by cutting six zeros from its currency in order to simplify accounting. This move was in response to hyperinflation, which reached an annual record of 1,743%, amid a serious ongoing economic crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [MercoPress](<https://en.mercopress.com/2021/10/01/fear-reigns-among-venezuelans-as-six-more-zeros-are-to-be-removed-from-local-currency>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian gas supplies via the Yamal–Europe pipeline fall almost 77% in a single day, raising European gas prices to an all-time high. European Parliament lawmakers request investigations of market manipulation, although Gazprom's exports outside the former Soviet Union rose 15.3% year on year in the first nine months of 2021 and German utility Uniper confirms that Russia was fulfilling its contractual obligations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/european-gas-prices-hit-all-time-highs-russian-flows-slump-2021-10-01/>); [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/natural-gas-prices-record-highs/31488196.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia, COVID-19 vaccination in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia grants the conditional approval of the Sinovac Coronavac vaccine for children aged above 12.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2021/10/01/covid-19-sinovac-vaccine-approved-for-those-aged-12-and-above>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines, COVID-19 pandemic in Bermuda, Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines adds the British territory of Bermuda to its red list due to COVID-19. Bermuda became the first British territory to be added to the Asian country's red list.

Source citations (as archived): [PLS](<https://philippineslifestyle.com/bermuda-ph-red-list-october-15/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 2,909 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 99,430.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/8-seniors-die-of-covid-19-bringing-death-toll-to-103-in-spore-2909-new-cases>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka lifts a nearly six-week lockdown to contain the spread of COVID-19 but continues to maintain a night curfew and a ban on public gatherings and parties as the number of cases declines.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/sri-lanka-lifts-lockdown-retains-curfew-at-night/article36783784.ece>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.

**Archived source account.** Greece imposes a curfew and bans music at bars, cafés and restaurants in Thessaloniki, Larissa, Chalkidiki and Kilkis due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [Ekathimerini](<https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1168893/covid-curfew-for-thessaloniki/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 887 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 208,142.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/10/01/russia-breaks-covid-deaths-record-for-fourth-day-straight-a75188>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state) / COVID-19 pandemic in New York City.

**Archived source account.** Associate Justice Sonia Sotomayor rejects an order to block the vaccine mandate for New York City schoolteachers and employees.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/supreme-court/sotomayor-declines-block-vaccine-mandate-new-york-city-public-school-n1280610>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-21"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in California.

**Archived source account.** California Governor Gavin Newsom announces that California will become the first U.S. state to mandate COVID-19 vaccines for all students in schools.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/covid-vaccine-mandate-california-students/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States surpasses 700,000 deaths from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-covid-19-death-toll-hits-700000-2021-10-01/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina, COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Argentina authorizes the approval of the Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine for children between the ages of 3 and 11 years. Health minister Carla Vizzotti announces that Argentina will end the year with all of its population over the age of 3 years vaccinated against COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [El Universo](<https://www.eluniverso.com/noticias/internacional/vacuna-sinopharm-es-aprobada-en-argentina-para-infantes-de-3-a-11-anos-nota/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Australia expands eligibility for the Pfizer–BioNTech and Moderna COVID-19 vaccines to include seniors over the age of 60 who had previously only been eligible for the Oxford–AstraZeneca vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/sep/30/pfizer-and-moderna-covid-vaccines-now-available-to-all-australians-over-60>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-3-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / Deployment of COVID-19 vaccines.

**Archived source account.** It is announced that more than 50 countries have missed the World Health Organization's (WHO) target for 10% of their populations to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19 by the end of September. Most of these countries are in Africa, where the WHO's overall figure for fully vaccinated populations is currently 4.4%.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/56100076>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Post-Brexit United Kingdom relations with the European Union.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Boris Johnson says that the contentious arrangements regarding the Northern Irish Protocol could work in principle if they were "fixed" but warns the European Union that they could be "ditched" if they do not work. Johnson adds that this is a problem that "the United Kingdom did not want".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/fix-it-or-ditch-it-uks-johnson-warns-eu-nireland-deal-2021-10-01/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Murder of Cécile Bloch.

**Archived source account.** The suicide note left by François Vérove, a 59-year-old French former military police officer who committed suicide two days ago in Le Grau-du-Roi, Occitanie, reveals that he murdered four people, including 11-year-old Cécile Bloch. The serial killer, nicknamed Le Grêlé, was also involved in a series of rapes.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/1/french-ex-policeman-leaves-serial-killer-suicide-confession-note>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-5-3"></a>

Context: September 2021 Guayaquil prison riot.

**Archived source account.** Ecuador says it will pardon more than 2,000 inmates after 118 inmates were killed during a riot at a prison in Guayaquil on 28 September. A government official said that some prisoners will be prioritized and that the main goal is to address prison overcrowding.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/death-toll-ecuadors-worst-ever-prison-riot-rises-118-2021-10-01/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-01-6-1"></a>

Context: Second Berejiklian ministry.

**Archived source account.** New South Wales Premier Gladys Berejiklian announces her resignation after the Independent Commission Against Corruption revealed that they are investigating her over a series of suspicious historical community grants.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-10-01/icac-investigating-gladys-berejiklian-daryl-maguire/100506956>).

<a id="event-2021-10-01-6-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Georgian local elections.

**Archived source account.** Exiled Georgian politician Mikheil Saakashvili announces that he is back in Georgia despite threats by prime minister Irakli Garibashvili, who said that Saakashvili would be "immediately arrested and brought to prison" if he returned. Saakashvili, in his support for the United National Movement, concluded by saying that "I risked my life and freedom to be back". Saakashvili is arrested later in the day.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/georgias-exiled-ex-president-saakashvili-says-he-is-back-in-country-ahead-of-elections/a-59373706>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/georgian-ex-leader-says-he-is-back-home-despite-jail-threat-authorities-deny-2021-10-01/>).

### 2021-10-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1102097739](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%202&oldid=1102097739>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-10-02-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sister Pietra Luana (Etra) Modica, a Scalabrinian Catholic nun, is the new Secretary General of the Pontifical Urbaniana University. The appointment was signed by Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, Prefect of the Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples and university Grand Chancellor. It is the first time since its founding in 1627 that this position has been assigned to a woman.

Source citations (as archived): [Fides](<http://www.fides.org/en/news/70894-VATICAN_Urbaniana_University_for_the_first_time_the_new_General_Secretary_is_a_nun_a_Scalabrinian_missionary>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Journalist Sayed Maroof Sadat, two Taliban soldiers and a civilian are killed by suspected ISIS-K gunmen in Jalalabad after opening fire against a vehicle.

Source citations (as archived): [La Repubblica](<https://www.repubblica.it/esteri/2021/10/02/news/afghanistan_giornalista_ucciso_da_uomini_armati_a_jalalabad-320448540/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-02-1-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Five Pakistani soldiers are killed by gunmen at the border with Afghanistan.

<a id="event-2021-10-02-1-4"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Cabo Delgado.

**Archived source account.** Rajab Awadhi Ndanjili, one of the leaders of the ISIL-linked groups, has been killed by Mozambique security forces in Cabo Delgado during an operation a week ago. Seventeen other terrorists were also killed.

Source citations (as archived): [All Africa](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202110030029.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-02-1-6"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Clashes between government forces and the separatist Southern Transitional Council (STC) in Aden kill at least four people. The government has been battling the separatists of the STC and the Houthis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/fighting-between-yemeni-separatist-forces-kills-four-aden-say-sources-2021-10-02/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-02-1-8"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** A United Nations peacekeeper is killed and three others are seriously injured when an IED detonates near where they were patrolling in the volatile north of the country, near the border with Algeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Dhaka Tribune](<https://www.dhakatribune.com/world/africa/2021/10/02/un-peacekeeper-killed-in-blast-in-mali-s-troubled-north>).

<a id="event-2021-10-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are dead and two others are injured in Cosenza, Calabria, Italy, after accidentally falling into a vat of grape must.

Source citations (as archived): [Gazzetta del Sud](<https://cosenza.gazzettadelsud.it/articoli/cronaca/2021/10/02/tragedia-a-paola-quattro-morti-in-seguito-ad-un-incidente-durante-la-vendemmia-a8cadab7-84e1-42b4-b7aa-a168b85833b8/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-02-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire breaks out on Rome's Ponte dell'Industria, or Industry Bridge, due to an electrical fire near gas pipelines and causes portions of the structure of the bridge to collapse.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2021/10/03/Italy-fire-causes-partial-collapse-Rome-Iron-Bridge/7491633273481/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-02-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore surpasses 100,000 cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/singapore-tops-100000-covid-19-cases-reports-4-more-deaths-2217041>).

<a id="event-2021-10-02-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam.

<a id="event-2021-10-02-3-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** Victoria reports a record 1,488 new cases and two deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. The Victoria lockdown is also extended to Greater Shepparton after an increase in new COVID-19 cases in the regional community.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-10-02/victoria-new-covid-cases-melbourne-lockdown/100509348>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina.

Health minister Carla Vizzotti also announces that the country will receive a shipment of 7.2 million doses of the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine to be used for teenagers.

Source citations (as archived): [DBSAS](<https://diputadosbsas.com.ar/nota/22994/llegan_mas_de_160_mil_vacunas_astrazeneca_y_argentina_supera_las_70_millones_de_dosis/>).
