#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 North Kosovo protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests in North Kosovo end with the protesters removing barricades and vehicles used to block the border crossings, according to an agreement reached in Brussels two days ago, which will end the ban on Serbian license plates on October 4.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbs-unblock-roads-kosovo-nato-moves-end-car-plate-row-2021-10-02/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-02-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Georgian local elections.

**Archived source account.** Georgians head to the polls to elect the bodies of local government in the country. The election is being closely watched in the aftermath of yesterday's arrest of Mikheil Saakashvili, who returned from exile in order to support his party. The pro-Western former leader had a ruling in his favor when Interpol turned down a request for his arrest.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/2/polls-open-in-georgia-after-former-president-saakashvilis-arrest>).

<a id="event-2021-10-02-5-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Qatari general election.

**Archived source account.** Qataris head to the polls to elect 30 members of the Consultative Assembly in the country's first legislative elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/qatar-holds-first-legislative-elections-2021-10-02/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-02-5-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Madagascar food crisis.

**Archived source account.** President of Madagascar Andry Rajoelina visits the famine-hit southern region of the country and promises the prompt inauguration of a water pipeline from the Efaho River to the Ambovombe districts after the allocation of 322 million euros of a loan requested from the International Monetary Fund. Rajoelina also promises more food aid to those affected by the disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [Madagascar Tribune](<https://www.madagascar-tribune.com/Andry-Rajoelina-en-periple-dans-le-Sud.html>).

### 2021-10-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1344020040](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%203&oldid=1344020040>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and four others are injured when a bomb explodes at the entrance to Id Gah Mosque in Kabul, during the funeral of Taliban spokesman Zabiullah Mujahid's mother. Three suspects are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/3/several-killed-in-blast-outside-kabul-mosque>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-0-3"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 Indian farmers' protest.

**Archived source account.** Four farmers are rammed and killed in Uttar Pradesh by a convoy of the Bharatiya Janata Party. Other farmers then attacked the convoy, killing three members of the party and the driver of the vehicle.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/3/eight-including-four-farmers-killed-in-uttar-pradesh>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two children are killed when a Houthi missile hits their home in the city of Marib. Many others are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/three-civilians-killed-missile-strikes-yemens-marib-sources-2021-10-03/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Libyan peace process.

**Archived source account.** Libyan foreign minister Najla Mangoush announces a "very modest start" to the withdrawal of foreign troops from the country following a permanent ceasefire of the Second Libyan Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/north-africa/2021/10/03/-Very-modest-start-to-pullout-of-foreign-fighters-Libya-FM>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-03-1-1"></a>

Context: North Sea Link.

**Archived source account.** The world's longest under-sea electricity cable interconnector begins transferring power between Kvilldal, Norway, and Blyth, Northumberland, United Kingdom. At its full 1,400 megawatt capacity, the interconnector is expected to supply at least 1.4 million homes with electricity.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-tyne-58772572>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-10-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2021 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed in Chabahar, Iran, and three more are killed in Muscat, Oman, as Cyclone Shaheen impacts the two countries. Shaheen is expected to make further landfalls in other parts of Oman later today.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/3/cyclone-shaheen-approaches-oman-flights-delayed>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-2-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Milan airplane crash.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed when their Pilatus PC-12 plane crashes into an empty building in San Donato Milanese, Lombardy, Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [i](<https://inews.co.uk/news/plane-crashes-building-italy-killing-eight-1229964>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-2-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Orange County oil spill.

**Archived source account.** An oil spill occurs off Orange County, California, U.S., amounting to 126,000 gallons (573,000 liters) of oil, which could affect popular Southern California locations such as Huntington Beach.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/oil-spill-hits-california-beaches-after-pipeline-breach/a-59392322>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-03-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel, COVID-19 vaccination in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israel introduces a new rule that requires booster dose of the COVID-19 vaccine to be considered fully vaccinated for everyone aged 12 and older in "Green Pass", becoming the first country to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/10/03/world/israel-covid-booster.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand moves Hamilton, Raglan, and other Waikato towns to alert level 3 after the discovery of two Delta variant cases and the spread of the virus beyond Auckland.

Source citations (as archived): [New Zealand Herald](<https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/covid-19-delta-outbreak-hamilton-raglan-move-to-alert-level-3-after-new-cases-in-waikato-prime-minister-jacinda-ardern-announces-33-new-cases-in-total-15-unlinked/GY2UQQQVAB75Z777CBLO4ZK5YI/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-3-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 890 deaths from COVID-19, bringing the nationwide death toll to 209,918.

Source citations (as archived): [Azeri Press Agency](<https://apa.az/en/xeber/cis-countries-news/russia-documents-890-coronavirus-deaths-in-24-hours-sets-new-record-359114>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Algeria–France relations.

**Archived source account.** Algeria bans French military planes from using its airspace, and recalls its ambassador to France for consultations after accusing French President Emmanuel Macron of an "inadmissible interference" in its internal affairs.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico Europe](<https://www.politico.eu/article/algeria-bans-french-military-planes-from-airspace/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-4-3"></a>

Context: North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** North Korea warns the United Nations Security Council against criticizing the country's renewed missile launches. The Council had convened an emergency meeting two days ago to discuss concerns over North Korea resuming missile testing. North Korea further threatens the Council with unspecified "consequences" should they "encroach upon the sovereignty" of the country in the future.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/north-korea-threatens-top-un-body-after-emergency-meeting/ar-AAP5sh8?ocid=uxbndlbing>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-03-5-1"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases.

**Archived source account.** A commission to investigate sexual abuse by clergy in France reveals that since the 1950s, there have been about 3,000 pedophiles who have committed sex crimes.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211003-some-3-000-paedophiles-in-french-catholic-church-since-1950-probe>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-5-3"></a>

Context: Pandora Papers.

**Archived source account.** 11.9 million leaked documents are published by the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists, which expose hidden wealth, tax evasion and money laundering among 330 politicians, including 35 national leaders, and numerous celebrities worldwide, including 130 billionaires, totaling 29,000 beneficiaries among 27,000 companies. This is the largest offshore data leak in history, surpassing the Panama Papers by nearly half a million documents.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-58780561>); [International Consortium of Investigative Journalists](<https://www.icij.org/investigations/pandora-papers/about-pandora-papers-leak-dataset/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates changes the death toll of those who died while working at the Expo 2020 to six. However, the actual death toll is suspected to be higher.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/dubai-expo-revises-worker-fatalities-six-after-including-covid-related-deaths-2021-10-03/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Tunisia arrest a lawmaker and a TV presenter for calling president Kais Saied a traitor over his seizure of power in July. The arrests were ordered by the military judiciary for "conspiring against state security and insulting the army".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisia-arrests-lawmaker-tv-presenter-who-called-president-traitor-2021-10-03/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-03-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chairman of Mitsubishi Electric resigns after the company published a report about long-term test data falsification, organized coverup of the falsification, and extended use of unapproved materials. An investigative committee at Mitsubishi Electric is currently examining 2,300 reports of issues with its manufacturing plants.

Source citations (as archived): [The Asahi Shimbun](<https://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/14452676>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-03-6-1"></a>

Context: Native title in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Queensland Police Service refuses a request from the Adani Group to remove a group of Wangan and Yagalingu protesters occupying the Carmichael coal mine, saying that this would be a human rights violation. The Wangan and Yagalingu peoples previously held native title to the land before the Queensland Government extinguished it in 2019 in preparation for the contract with Adani.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/oct/03/queensland-police-refuse-to-remove-traditional-owners-occupying-adanis-coalmine-site>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-10-03-7-1"></a>

Context: 2021 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** In American football, Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Tom Brady returns to Foxborough, Massachusetts for the first time since departing the New England Patriots in March of last year. Tom Brady also becomes the fourth quarterback to defeat all 32 National Football League teams following the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 19-17 victory against his former team. He also surpasses Drew Brees as the NFL's all-time leading passer.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/32334871/tom-brady-overtakes-drew-brees-claim-nfl-career-passing-yards-record>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nfl-sports-tampa-bay-buccaneers-new-england-patriots-nick-folk-6d060206412a135a8d6d181dc1b9425f>).

### 2021-10-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1198285809](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%204&oldid=1198285809>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-04-0-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 Indian farmers' protest.

**Archived source account.** Farmers vow to intensify their protest against laws aimed at liberalising agriculture, after four farmers were rammed and killed yesterday in Uttar Pradesh by a vehicle owned by Minister of State for Home Affairs Ajay Kumar Mishra. Three members of the party and the driver of the vehicle were then killed by protesters. A journalist was also found dead today near the scene of the violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/4/india-lakhimpur-kheri-town-deaths-farmers-protest>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamic State–Taliban conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban says it has "destroyed an IS–K cell" in Kabul following yesterday's bombing at a mosque during the memorial for the mother of Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid. Mujahid says that a special Taliban unit carried out the operation and that the base was destroyed and everyone inside was killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/taliban-destroy-is-k-cell-after-kabul-mosque-bombing/a-59396833>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** Twelve Burkinabé troops are killed and five others are wounded in an attack in the northern Sanmatenga Province. No group has claimed responsibility for the ambush assault.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/militants-kill-eight-soldiers-injure-five-burkina-faso-attack-2021-10-04/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-0-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A United Nations report blames all warring sides in Libya of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity, particularly against detainees, migrants and prominent women.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/4/libyas-warring-sides-may-be-guilty-of-war-crimes-un-probe>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Cyprus arrest a man suspected of "planning attacks against Israeli people". Israel has accused Iran of orchestrating the plot, although Iran has denied the allegations. Other reports suggest that the target of the plot was businessman Teddy Sagi and could be linked to business disputes involving Sagi.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-58714131>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four ISIL terrorists and one security forces member are killed during clashes in southern Khartoum, Sudan. Four other suspected militants are arrested during the raid, while three more soldiers are wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sudanese-security-forces-clash-with-terrorist-cell-khartoum-state-tv-2021-10-04/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Evergrande liquidity crisis.

**Archived source account.** Chinese state-run tabloid Global Times reports that Chinese property developer Evergrande Group will sell 51% of its property service arm to rival company Hopson Development for US$5 billion. The report comes as both Hopson and Evergrande suspended trading in their shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in the morning, pending an announcement about a "major transaction".

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/10/04/evergrande-set-to-sell-part-of-stake-in-property-services-unit.html>); [AFP](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2021/10/04/property-giant-china-evergrande-suspends-hong-kong-market-trading.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-10-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2021 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the floods in Muscat, Oman, caused by Cyclone Shaheen, increases to 12 as nine more people are found dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/4/uae-saudi-arabia-brace-for-cyclone-shaheen-after-oman-landfall>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-2-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Cumbre Vieja volcanic eruption.

**Archived source account.** The main cone of the Cumbre Vieja volcano on the island of La Palma collapses, increasing the lava flow into the Atlantic Ocean. The main lava flow is now 1.2 km across at its widest point.

Source citations (as archived): [El Pais](<https://english.elpais.com/society/2021-10-04/volcanic-eruption-in-la-palma-part-of-cone-collapses-increasing-lava-flow.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-2-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Orange County oil spill.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Orange County, California, United States, blame a 41-year-old oil pipeline for yesterday's spill, so far releasing 3,000 barrels of oil into the Pacific Ocean and severely damaging the coast of Southern California.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/investigators-probing-cause-major-california-offshore-oil-spill-2021-10-04/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-04-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia, COVID-19 drug development.

**Archived source account.** The Australian government signs an agreement with Merck Sharp &amp; Dohme to buy 300,000 courses of the antiviral drug molnupiravir, pending regulator clearance, which would be the first pill to treat COVID-19 patients.

Source citations (as archived): [9 News](<https://www.9news.com.au/national/coronavirus-australia-treatment-covid-pill-molnupiravir-may-be-ready-for-use-in-australia-by-2020-after-deal-made-with-merck-sharp--dohme/0f04b8fb-2d9d-443d-beb9-ce2a1a48abd3>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji.

**Archived source account.** Fiji reopens businesses, places of worship and educational institutions at 70% capacity to those who have been fully vaccinated amid a decrease in the number of new cases and an increase in the vaccination rate.

Source citations (as archived): [Matangi Tonga](<https://matangitonga.to/2021/10/04/fiji-businesses-re-open-after-months-lockdown>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand drops the elimination strategy to combat COVID-19 in favour of a new model that contains vaccination rates amid the continued outbreak of the SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/04/new-zealand-covid-strategy-in-transition-ardern-says-as-auckland-awaits-lockdown-decision>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-3-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Isle of Man.

**Archived source account.** The Isle of Man begins administering booster shots of the COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-isle-of-man-58768063>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-3-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden, COVID-19 vaccination in Sweden.

**Archived source account.** The Public Health Agency of Sweden recommends that children between the ages of 12 and 15 be vaccinated against COVID-19 using the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/sweden-recommends-pfizer-covid-19-vaccine-for-children-aged-12-to-15-rejects-moderna>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-3-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / European Union response to the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** The European Medicines Agency approves a third dose of the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine for people aged over 18-years-old. However, it was up to member states to decide whether to use them.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/covid-eu-regulator-backs-biontech-pfizer-vaccine-booster-for-18-and-over/a-59404536>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-3-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand, COVID-19 vaccination in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** Thailand begins a vaccination programme for children between the ages of 12 and 17 years old using the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine as the government plans to resume face-to-face learning.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK World-Japan](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20211004_24/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-3-18"></a>

Context: Insulate Britain protests.

**Archived source account.** Insulate Britain holds a sit-in protest in three major routes into London, including the Blackwall Tunnel. The group have stated that they will continue protesting until the government has concrete plans to retrofit around 29 million buildings which the group claims have insufficient insulation.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV News](<https://www.itv.com/news/2021-10-04/insulate-britain-block-major-london-routes-including-blackwall-tunnel>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-04-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 North Kosovo protests.

**Archived source account.** Kosovo and Serbia begin implementing stickers to cover national symbols and country abbreviations on their respective vehicle license plates when they are in the other country, with normal traffic on the border fully resuming.

Source citations (as archived): [Exit News](<https://exit.al/en/2021/10/04/kosovo-implements-brussels-agreement-with-serbia-over-license-plates/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-4-3"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The North and South Korean governments reinstate the Seoul–Pyongyang hotline after North Korea suspended the connection in early August, in protest against South Korea's military exercises with the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211004-north-and-south-korea-restore-cross-border-hotline>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-4-5"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** A total of 52 People's Liberation Army Air Force aircraft fly into Taiwan's southwestern air defense identification zone, the Ministry of National Defense says on Twitter. This amounts to 145 Chinese aircraft which have flown into Taiwan's air defense area this month

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/think/opinion/chinese-warplanes-fly-toward-taiwan-alarm-u-s-display-only-ncna1280856>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-04-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Deposed leader Aung San Suu Kyi asks to reduce her time in court appearances, stating that her health has deteriorated. The judge will make a decision on the request next week. Suu Kyi currently faces multiple charges ranging from corruption to money laundering.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/04/aung-san-suu-kyi-asks-to-reduce-court-time-due-to-strained-health>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) special agent is killed and another is critically wounded, and a Tucson Police Department officer is wounded at a shooting involving two suspects, one of whom was a gunman who is believed to have killed himself, at the Tucson, Arizona Amtrak train station; the officers had boarded the just-disembarked Sunset Limited to do a drug check.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN/AP](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/dea-agent-killed-in-arizona-amtrak-shooting-was-noted-leader/ar-AAPaMFz?ocid=msedgdhp&amp;pc=W000>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-04-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The parliament of Singapore passes a law aimed to outlaw foreign interference in domestic affairs. Opponents of the measure have expressed concerns regarding the broadness of certain provisions that may potentially hinder some civil liberties.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/05/singapore-passes-foreign-interference-law-allowing-authorities-to-block-internet-content>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-10-04-7-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Facebook outage.

**Archived source account.** Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Oculus experience an extended global outage that began at 15:39 UTC. Some experts believe that the outage was caused by a BGP update from Facebook.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/10/04/tech/facebook-instagram-whatsapp-outage/index.html>); [Cloudflare](<https://cfl.re/3l7WBQs>).

<a id="event-2021-10-04-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists David Julius and Ardem Patapoutian are awarded the 2021 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine "for their discoveries of receptors for temperature and touch".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/julius-patapoutian-win-2021-nobel-prize-medicine-2021-10-04/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-10-04-8-1"></a>

Context: 2021 NASCAR Cup Series.

**Archived source account.** Darrell "Bubba" Wallace Jr. wins the rain-shortened YellaWood 500 at Talladega Superspeedway, becoming the first African-American to win a NASCAR Cup race since 1963.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/10/04/sports/autoracing/nascar-bubba-wallace-talladega.html>).

### 2021-10-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1259819297](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%205&oldid=1259819297>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Three civilians are killed by suspected Islamist terrorists at three different locations in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, in a spike of killings targeting civilians in the area. The victims were a Hindu chemist, an Indian street food vendor from Bihar, and a Muslim taxi driver. Two other civilians were killed in Srinagar four days ago by a Lashkar-e-Taiba-linked group.

Source citations (as archived): [The Indian Express](<https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/srinagar/prominent-kashmiri-pandit-businessman-shot-dead-in-srinagar-7554192/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** A report by Amnesty International says that the Taliban has executed 13 Hazaras, including eleven former members of the government, shortly after the fall of Kabul. The Taliban denies that they were behind the killings.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/5/taliban-killed-13-members-of-hazara-ethnic-group-report>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-10-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian actress Yulia Peresild and film director Klim Shipenko launch into space onboard Soyuz MS-19 from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in southern Kazakhstan. They intend to film scenes for The Challenge, which will be the first feature-length movie filmed in outer space, on the International Space Station over one week before returning to Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/10/05/russian-crew-blast-off-to-film-first-movie-in-space-a75211>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-05-2-1"></a>

Context: Evergrande liquidity crisis.

**Archived source account.** Two further Chinese real-estate developers, Fantasia Holdings and Sinic Holdings, with liabilities of $12.8 billion and $14.2 billion respectively, both fail to make bond payments amid tightening resource availability after Evergrande raised investor concerns, and were both downgraded to "CCC" or "substantial credit risk".

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/10/05/china-property-default-risk-for-fantasia-sinic-amid-evergrande-crisis.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-05-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Romania.

**Archived source account.** Romania reports a record 15,037 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,289,156.

Source citations (as archived): [Romania Insider](<https://www.romania-insider.com/index.php/ro-covid-cases-oct-5-2021>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record 895 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 211,696.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax](<https://interfax.com/newsroom/top-stories/72811/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, COVID-19 vaccination in Spain.

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Health announces that the National Public Health Commission will offer booster doses of the COVID-19 vaccine beginning in late October to elderly people who received their second vaccine dose at least six months ago.

Source citations (as archived): [MedicalXpress](<https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-10-spain-over-70s-dose-covid-vaccine.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-3-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** Victoria reports a record 1,763 new cases and four deaths in the past 24 hours, which is the highest daily total reported by any Australian state since the start of the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-10-05/victoria-records-new-covid-cases-vaccine-progress/100513784>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-3-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand, COVID-19 vaccination in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern announces the details of the COVID-19 vaccine certificates, which show full vaccination status, in order to make large-scale events safer. The vaccine certificate is expected to come into use in November.

Source citations (as archived): [TVNZ](<https://www.tvnz.co.nz/one-news/new-zealand/vaccine-certificates-in-use-summer-ardern>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-3-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore reports a record 3,486 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 109,084.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/community/nine-people-aged-between-64-and-90-die-of-complications-linked-to-covid-19-in>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-3-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Zambia.

**Archived source account.** Zambia lowers its vaccination target from 70% to 30% in December as the country will relaunch the nationwide vaccination program on Thursday.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/zambia-lowers-covid-19-vaccination-target/2382699>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** UK special envoy Simon Gass meets with Taliban Deputy Prime Ministers Abdul Ghani Baradar and Abdul Salam Hanafi in Kabul for the first time since the takeover of the country to discuss Afghanistan's growing humanitarian crisis and terrorism, and to guarantee safe passage to those wishing to emigrate. Taliban Foreign Ministry spokesman Abdul Qahar Balkhi also said they discussed the possibility of restoring diplomatic relations, with Gass saying the foreign ministry wishes to "begin a new chapter of constructive relations".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/5/british-pms-envoy-holds-talks-with-taliban-in-afghanistan>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-05-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two prison guards are taken hostage at a prison in Condé-sur-Sarthe, Normandy, France. One of the hostages is injured. The hostage-taker later surrenders.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-guards-taken-hostage-french-jail-bfmtv-2021-10-05/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in the Holy See agrees to return to the investigative phase of an ongoing trial against Cardinal Giovanni Angelo Becciu for alleged embezzlement, abuse of power and fraud, and other charges. Becciu was fired from his position in the Vatican City by Pope Francis in 2020 for alleged nepotism, which Becciu also denies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/prosecution-vatican-trial-acknowledges-defects-willing-investigate-more-2021-10-05/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine barracks at the former Auschwitz concentration camp, now the Auschwitz-Birkenau State Museum, are vandalized with Holocaust denial graffiti.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/anti-semitic-graffiti-discovered-at-auschwitz/ar-AAPayoF?ocid=uxbndlbing>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prosecutor General of Moldova Alexandru Stoianoglo is suspended from his positions by President Maia Sandu, and is detained by security forces following allegations of corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldovas-top-prosecutor-suspended-detained-corruption-case-2021-10-05/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-05-6-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Romanian political crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Romanian government is dissolved following a no confidence vote against the centrist government of Prime Minister Florin Cîțu.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/romanias-parliament-topples-pm-citus-centrist-government-2021-10-05/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-6-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Libyan general election.

**Archived source account.** The Libyan House of Representatives votes to postpone the parliamentary elections initially scheduled for December 24, alongside the presidential election, until January 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/5/libya-legislative-elections-delayed-until-january-parliament>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-10-05-7-1"></a>

Context: Microsoft Windows version history.

**Archived source account.** Microsoft launches Windows 11, its latest version of the Microsoft Windows operating system. The upgrade to Windows 11 will be free for Windows 10 users.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-58795119>).

<a id="event-2021-10-05-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Climatologists Syukuro Manabe and Klaus Hasselmann and theoretical physicist Giorgio Parisi are awarded the 2021 Nobel Prize in Physics for their work towards the understanding of physical systems through climate models.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/nobel-physics-2021-syukuro-manabe-klaus-hasselmann-giorgio-parisi-winners-2564735>).

### 2021-10-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1128582063](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%206&oldid=1128582063>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-06-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Islamic State–Taliban conflict.

**Archived source account.** Taliban soldiers raid an IS–K hideout in Kabul, arresting four militants. Meanwhile, ISIL claims responsibility for the beheading of a Taliban soldier in Jalalabad.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-say-four-islamic-state-members-captured-near-kabul-2021-10-06/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Nigerian bandit conflict.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of armed bandits on motorbikes storm a village in Zamfara, killing 18 civilians, burning shops and cars, and forcing many residents to flee.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/armed-bandits-kill-18-nigerias-zamfara-state-2021-10-06/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-06-0-6"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** A battle between jihadists and Malian forces in the central Mopti Region leaves at least nine soldiers and 15 insurgents dead. The mayor of the nearby town of Bankass says that up to 16 soldiers were killed in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/islamist-militant-attack-kills-least-five-mali-soldiers-toll-could-rise-2021-10-06/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-10-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Afghanistan pavilion opens at the Expo 2020 after being closed during the first week of the event following the Taliban takeover in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Khaleej Times](<https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/expo-2020-dubai/expo-2020-dubai-afghanistan-pavilion-opens-to-visitors-rare-artefacts-on-display>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-06-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark, COVID-19 vaccination in Denmark.

**Archived source account.** Denmark suspends the use of the Moderna COVID-19 vaccine for people under the age of 18 after reports of myocarditis and meningitis, which are rare side effects of the vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local Denmark](<https://www.thelocal.dk/20211006/denmark-stops-offering-moderna-covid-19-vaccine-to-under-18s/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-06-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Romania.

### 2021-10-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256033175](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%207&oldid=1256033175>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Two teachers are killed by suspected Islamist terrorists inside a school in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. The victims, who were members of the Hindu and Sikh minorities, are the 24th and 25th civilian victims killed by suspected terrorist groups in Kashmir this year.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/7/two-kashmir-schoolteachers-shot-dead-civilian-killings-spike>).

<a id="event-2021-10-07-0-3"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** ISAWP militants kills 87 Boko Haram fighters after raiding their camp in Borno State, Nigeria. The attack is said to be a reprisal over the killing of 24 ISWAP fighters, five days ago, by Boko Haram.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Post](<https://dailypost.ng/2021/10/07/boko-haram-87-iswap-fighters-killed-in-borno/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-07-0-5"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes at a religious school in Khost, killing one student and injuring 17 other people.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2021-10/07/c_1310230311.htm>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2021-10-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tanzanian novelist Abdulrazak Gurnah wins the 2021 Nobel Prize in Literature, "for his uncompromising and compassionate penetration of the effects of colonialism and the fate of the refugee". Gurnah's most renowned novel is Paradise, set in colonial East Africa during World War I.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economist](<https://www.economist.com/books-and-arts/2021/10/07/abdulrazak-gurnah-wins-the-nobel-prize-in-literature-for-2021>).

<a id="event-2021-10-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department confirms accusations made yesterday by Venezuelan vice president Delcy Rodríguez, who blamed an alleged U.S. veto for not allowing Venezuela to receive IMF COVID-19 relief funds. The State Department says that only recognized governments can access these funds.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-says-imf-has-not-delivered-covid-19-funds-amid-dispute-2021-10-06/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/earthquake-61-jolts-tokyo-preliminary-magnitude-estimated-61-nhk-2021-10-07/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Taiwan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Wall Street Journal reports a contingent of U.S. special forces soldiers have been deployed in Taiwan to train Taiwanese forces amid tensions with China. The military trainers were first deployed under the Trump administration.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/07/taiwan-us-military-trainers-china>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-07-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The trial against a 100-year-old former SS concentration camp guard begins in Germany. The man is accused of collaborating in the murders of 3,518 people at the Sachsenhausen concentration camp between 1942 and 1945, when he was employed as a standing guard in the watchtower.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/07/trial-begins-of-100-year-old-former-nazi-concentration-camp-guard>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-07-7-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Ukraine, 9th Ukrainian Verkhovna Rada.

**Archived source account.** Dmytro Razumkov, the speaker of the Verkhovna Rada, the Ukrainian parliament, is dismissed following his disagreements with President Volodymyr Zelensky and his ruling Servant of the People party's stances on legislation which aimed to reduce the influence of Ukrainian oligarchs.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/speaker-razumkov-dismissed-after-disputes-with-zelensky.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-07-7-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Norfolk Island.

**Archived source account.** A political party named the Norfolk Island Party is formed to advocate for the islanders' self-determination from Australia. The party's goal is to achieve sovereignty for Norfolk Island.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/453103/sense-of-turmoil-prompts-birth-of-norfolk-island-party>).

<a id="event-2021-10-07-7-5"></a>

Context: Poland and the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The Polish Constitutional Tribunal rules that the Constitution of Poland takes precedence over EU laws, directly challenging the primacy of European Union law principle, escalating tensions around the Polish rule-of-law crisis and in particular around the country's controversial judicial reforms.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/10/07/world/europe/poland-eu-law-constitution.html>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/poland-european-union-constitution-justice-treaties/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-07-7-7"></a>

Context: 2022 Philippine presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Opposition leader and Vice President Leni Robredo joins the race to replace President Rodrigo Duterte.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-10-07/philippine-opposition-leader-robredo-to-seek-presidency-in-2022>).

**Archived source account.** A Saudi-backed consortium, funded through its sovereign wealth fund Public Investment Fund, officially purchases Newcastle United F.C. for £300 million. An agreement on its purchase was finalized upon last April, but impasses on the issue of ownership among the specific entities in the consortium prevented the deal from moving forward until recently.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/soccer/newcastle-united-engnewcastle/story/4492706/saudi-arabian-takeover-of-newcastle-nears-completion-sources>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-08-1-1"></a>

Context: Public sector undertakings in India.

**Archived source account.** Tata Sons is announced as the winning bidder for Air India, ending years of attempts by the government to privatise the loss-making airline. Tata Sons was the initial owner of the airline before it was nationalised.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/business/tata-wins-control-of-air-india-once-again-with-rs-18-000-crore-bid-2568657>); [Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/return-of-the-prodigal-son-air-india-back-in-founder-tata-fold-after-68-years/articleshow/86865871.cms>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/travel/article/ita-airline-explainer/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-08-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The severity of the energy crisis in Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Guangdong provinces of China is reported as worsening, with power outages occurring every week and "notices... telling us which days the following week that they will cut the power". Some factories report receiving power for only two or three days per week and are operating primarily on generators. China has also placed large bids for coal that are causing supply issues in locations as far away as Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Nikkei Asia](<https://asia.nikkei.com/Business/China-tech/China-power-outages-spur-new-wave-of-supply-chain-shifts>); [Interfax](<https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/economic/772520.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-09-3-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department confirms that the first face-to-face meetings with high representatives of the Taliban since the departure of U.S. troops from Afghanistan, will begin today in Doha, Qatar. A spokesperson for the State Department says that the U.S. will pressure the Taliban to "respect the rights of all Afghans, including women and girls" and form an inclusive government. The spokesperson also clarifies that this is not a recognition of the Taliban government by the U.S., saying that the Taliban will have to earn recognition by its actions.

The memorandum aimed to make Iran cooperate in the investigation at the time that Argentina issued red notices against Iranian officials through Interpol. Relations between Argentina and Iran have been strained, with a recent condemnation by Argentina of the new cabinet of Ebrahim Raisi.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-14-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chinese Catholic Bishop Stephen Yang Xiangtai, the retired leader of the Handan diocese, died at the age of 99 after a long illness. Bishop Yang was arrested in 1954 and again in 1966, and served more than a decade in labor camps before being released in 1980. He became Bishop of Handan in 1999.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic World News](<https://www.catholicculture.org/news/headlines/index.cfm?storyid=52565>); [Asia News](<http://www.asianews.it/news-en/Handan&#x27;s-Bishop-Emeritus-Yang-Xiangtai-has-died-54278.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-14-5-1"></a>

Context: Armenia–Azerbaijan relations.

**Archived source account.** Armenia expands its case before the International Court of Justice against Azerbaijan, accusing Azerbaijan of violating the International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination, to which both states are signatories, for allegedly promoting ethnic hatred against Armenians. Azerbaijan denies the accusation and accuses Armenia of violating the treaty.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/armenia-tells-world-court-azerbaijan-promotes-ethnic-hatred-2021-10-14/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-14-5-3"></a>

Context: Murder of Giulio Regeni, Egypt–Italy relations.

**Archived source account.** An Italian court in Rome drops charges against four Egyptian police officers for the 2016 murder of Italian PhD student Giulio Regeni in Cairo, citing its inability for the four officers to be tried in absentia since their prosecutors failed to inform them of their charges.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211014-italian-court-stops-trial-against-egyptians-over-student-s-murder>).

<a id="event-2021-10-14-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka drops charges against Admiral Wasantha Karannagoda, who was accused of being part of a group of 14 navy personnel who kidnapped 11 children and murdered them after attempting to extort money from their families. The actual number of children murdered by the group is suspected to be at least three times higher. The crimes were carried out in 2008 and 2009, amid the chaos of the Sri Lankan Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/14/sri-lanka-charges-former-navy-chief-11-killings-civil-war-tamils>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-14-6-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Japanese general election.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Fumio Kishida dissolves the lower house of the Japanese Parliament ahead of the election on October 31.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2021/10/14/japan-fumio-kishida-dissolves-parliament-elections/6881634216659/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-14-6-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Norwegian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Jonas Gahr Støre takes office as Prime Minister of Norway.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/article/business-denmark-europe-norway-9370dce582ddc667935c0c7208c5e31d>).

<a id="event-2021-10-14-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistan International Airlines suspends flights to the Afghan capital Kabul, citing "heavy-handed" interference from the Taliban. It was the only foreign carrier operating regular flights out of Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-58913855>).

### 2021-10-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1101118153](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%2015&oldid=1101118153>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 Kandahar bombing.

**Archived source account.** Three suicide bombers attack a Shiite mosque in Kandahar, Afghanistan, killing 47 people and injuring 70 others. The explosions occur at the main door and inside the mosque. Taliban authorities later arrived and secured the mosque. Taliban interior ministry spokesman Qari Saeed Khosti says that authorities are currently collecting evidence in order to determine responsibility for the bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/15/explosion-hits-shia-mosque-in-afghanistans-kandahar>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 Kandahar bombing.

**Archived source account.** ISIL-K claims responsibility for the attack, reporting that two attackers shot and killed security guards outside the mosque before blowing themselves up inside, where people were worshipping.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/islamic-state-claims-responsibility-mosque-attack-afghan-city-kandahar-statement-2021-10-15/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** United States Marine Corps lieutenant colonel Stuart Scheller is reprimanded by a military judge following his criticism of the U.S. military’s handling of the withdrawal from Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/marine-officer-receives-reprimand-afghanistan-criticism-80608893>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-0-7"></a>

Context: Murder of David Amess.

**Archived source account.** David Amess, United Kingdom MP for Southend West, is stabbed to death in Leigh-on-Sea, Essex, while meeting constituents at Belfairs Methodist Church. The suspect was arrested at the scene, and police are not looking for anyone else in connection with the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-58930593>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-58935372>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-0-9"></a>

Context: Anglophone Crisis.

**Archived source account.** A Cameroonian policeman is lynched by a mob after he killed a five-year-old girl at a checkpoint in Buea Southwest Region. Protests involving hundreds of people occurred after the killing of the child.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/14/cameroon-urges-calm-after-policeman-kills-schoolgirl-in-anglophone-region>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-0-11"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** President Faustin-Archange Touadéra declares a unilateral ceasefire with the Coalition of Patriots for Change and the anti-balaka militia groups.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/c-africa-president-decrees-unilateral-conflict-ceasefire-01634320207?tesla=y>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-10-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four migrants are found dead by the Spanish Maritime Safety and Rescue Society in the Mediterranean Sea off the coast of Cape Trafalgar in the Province of Cádiz after their boat sank. The coast guard reports that 21 others from the boat are missing.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/1634301321-four-migrants-dead-21-missing-off-coast-of-spain>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Brunei.

**Archived source account.** Brunei surpasses 10,000 cases of COVID-19 after reporting a record 423 new cases in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [The Scoop](<https://thescoop.co/2021/10/15/brunei-passes-10000-covid-cases-milestone-after-breaking-daily-record/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

**Archived source account.** India is expected to reopen its borders to overseas travellers as it relaxes COVID-19-related restrictions amid a decrease in the number of new cases.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-58880429>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines, COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases announces that the National Capital Region will be downgraded to Alert Level 3 beginning on October 16, which will allow cinemas and theme parks to reopen for the first time since March 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/metro-manila-alert-level-3-october-16-31-2021>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea, COVID-19 vaccination in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** President Moon Jae-in and first lady Kim Jung-sook receive booster doses of the COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News Agency](<https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20211015002751315>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium.

**Archived source account.** The Brussels-Capital Region expands the use of the COVID Safe Ticket to the hospitality industry, sports centres, and indoor events with more than 50 people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Brussels Times](<https://www.brusselstimes.com/brussels/189262/covid-safe-ticket-mandatory-in-brussels-from-tomorrow-but-no-fines-yet/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italy's Green Pass becomes mandatory for all workplaces, but there are fears of disruption among transport workers and at ports where COVID-19 vaccination rates are relatively low.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58913865>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 999 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 221,313. The country also reports a record for the second consecutive day of 32,196 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 7.92 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax](<https://interfax.com/newsroom/top-stories/72904/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** A COVID-19 vaccination mandate comes into effect in Victoria, with all essential workers required to have at least one dose of a World Health Organization-approved vaccine to continue working.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian Australia](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/oct/15/victoria-covid-update-vaccine-mandate-takes-effect-as-state-records-2170-cases>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Papua New Guinea.

**Archived source account.** The COVID-19 crisis worsens in Papua New Guinea, as the government seeks international help in order to combat the increase in new cases and deaths. The government has admitted to a slow response to the crisis and also blames vaccine hesitancy as part of the problem. The World Health Organization has agreed to help the country.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/453627/png-desparately-needs-overseas-help-to-fight-covid-19>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-2-25"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada / COVID-19 pandemic in Yukon.

**Archived source account.** Yukon imposes a COVID-19 vaccine mandate for sports facilities, restaurants and other non-essential services. The mandate will take effect on November 30.

Source citations (as archived): [Yukon News](<https://www.yukon-news.com/news/yukon-government-announces-mandatory-vaccination-rules/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-15-3-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** During an online emergency meeting, the foreign ministers of the ASEAN agree to exclude Myanmar's military junta chief Min Aung Hlaing from the upcoming ASEAN Summit to be held later this month. The country will instead be represented by non-political representative at the summit.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2021/10/16/Myanmar-junta-chief-excluded-from-summit-ASEAN>).

<a id="event-2021-10-15-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Paramount leader Xi Jinping of the People's Republic of China will not attend in person the Cop26 climate change conference in Glasgow, as it's told to UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson. The announcement comes amid international pessimism that, now compounded by the absence of China, a global leader in pollution and greenhouse gas emissions, the event would not result in any substantiative change.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/chinas-xi-snub-cop26-uk-pm-johnson-told-times-2021-10-15/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Masten Wanjala, the Kenyan suspected serial killer of 14 boys, who escaped from prison two days ago, is murdered by lynching by a mob of villagers in Bungoma. Wanjala was hiding at his parents' home when he was identified by neighbours.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-58923592>).

### 2021-10-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1219269066](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%2016&oldid=1219269066>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-16-0-2"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / 2021 Kandahar bombing, 2021 Kunduz mosque bombing.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban says that they will step up security at Shi'ite mosques after ISIS–K bombed mosques in Kunduz and Kandahar this month, killing over 120 people in total.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-pledge-step-up-security-shiite-mosques-after-fridays-attack-2021-10-16/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-0-4"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Two workers are killed by gunmen in Srinagar and Pulwama, Jammu and Kashmir, in a spike of civilians being killed by rebels in the area.

Source citations (as archived): [Greater Kashmir](<https://www.greaterkashmir.com/todays-paper/front-page/non-locals-again-targetted-2-shot-dead-in-srinagar-pulwama>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** A Lashkar-e-Taiba commander and another militant are killed during a gunfight with security forces in Pulwama. The killed commander, who was involved in the murder of two policemen, was among the top 10 targets of Jammu and Kashmir police. It is also announced that two more rebels, involved in the recent killings of civilians, were killed yesterday during a gunfight in Srinagar.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/amp/india/story/j-k-encounter-security-forces-terrorists-pulwama-let-commander-trapped-1865357-2021-10-16>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-0-7"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Twenty Boko Haram militants and three Nigerian Army soldiers are killed during a gunfight as the military has tried to recapture the Nigerian town of Maiduguri.

Source citations (as archived): [Sahara Reporters](<http://saharareporters.com/2021/10/17/scores-boko-haram-terrorists-killed-military-insurgents-clash-maiduguri>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-0-9"></a>

Context: Murder of David Amess.

**Archived source account.** Yesterday's killing of MP Sir David Amess, who was stabbed to death in a Methodist church in Leigh-on-Sea, Essex, is declared as a terrorist incident by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-58935372>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-10-16-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Bali earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and seven are injured as a 4.8 earthquake hits Bali, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/16/moderate-earthquake-rocks-bali-killing-at-least-3>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people drown during a school outing for a river clean-up in West Java, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/16/11-students-drown-during-river-clean-up-in-west-java>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-16-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in Tasmania.

**Archived source account.** Southern Tasmania, including the state capital of Hobart, enters a lockdown after an increase in locally transmitted COVID-19 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/oct/15/hobart-and-southern-tasmania-enter-snap-three-day-covid-lockdown>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 1,002 deaths from COVID-19, which is the first time that the country has reported more than 1,000 COVID-related deaths in a single day since the pandemic began. Only 32% of the population has been fully vaccinated, amid wide distrust in vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211016-russia-tops-1-000-daily-virus-deaths-for-first-time>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Hong Kong national security law.

**Archived source account.** Seven activists are sentenced to prison terms ranging from six to twelve months' imprisonment for protesting against the national security law in July 2020. Among those sentenced are Leung Kwok-hung and Figo Chan. Leung is currently serving two sentences of 18 months' imprisonment for other charges and Chan is currently serving a sentence of 18 months' imprisonment for unauthorized assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/16/seven-hong-kong-activists-jailed-over-unauthorised-protest-in-2020>); [RTHK](<https://gbcode.rthk.hk/TuniS/news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1615491-20211016.htm?spTabChangeable=0>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentine federal judge María Romilda Servini indicts post Franco-era Spanish minister Rodolfo Martín Villa on four counts of homicide. Villa, who resides in Spain, says that he will appeal the decision of the Argentine judge.

Source citations (as archived): [SwissInfo](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/judge-indicts-franco-era-spanish-minister-for-four-charges-of-homicide/47033840>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An unidentified armed gang kidnaps 15 American missionaries and their families in Port-au-Prince, Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/15-us-missionaries-and-family-kidnapped-in-haiti-local-security-source-01634440807?refsec=afp-news>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombian businessman Alex Saab is extradited to the United States from Cape Verde ahead of an initial court appearance in Florida on October 18 over his alleged money laundering for the Venezuelan government.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.deccanherald.com/international/world-news-politics/colombian-businessman-alex-saab-extradited-to-us-justice-department-1041362.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French president Emmanuel Macron condemns the Paris massacre of 1961 on the eve of its 60th anniversary, but does not issue a formal apology. Macron is the first French president to attend a memorial ceremony for the victims.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.wionews.com/world/macron-condemns-inexcusable-crackdown-on-1961-paris-protest-of-algerians-421375>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-10-16-5-1"></a>

Context: Chinese space program.

**Archived source account.** Shenzhou 13 launches on a Long March 2F rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center in the Gobi Desert, Inner Mongolia, for the Tianhe core module of the Tiangong space station, where the crew will stay for six months. It will be China's longest crewed mission to date.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/china-rocket-blasts-off-for-longest-crewed-mission-to-space-station-2576900>).

<a id="event-2021-10-16-5-3"></a>

Context: Discovery Program.

**Archived source account.** Lucy, a NASA spacecraft that will visit Jupiter's trojan asteroids in twelve years, launches at 05:34 EDT from Cape Canaveral, Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/10/16/world/lucy-mission-launch-nasa-scn/index.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

<a id="event-2021-10-17-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Brunei.

**Archived source account.** Brunei reports a record 504 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 10,860.

<a id="event-2021-10-17-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia eases its COVID-19-related restrictions, lifting mandatory social distancing requirements as well as a requirement to wear face masks outdoors.

Source citations (as archived): [Arabian Business](<https://www.arabianbusiness.com/industries-culture-society/469804-saudi-arabia-eases-coronavirus-restrictions>).

<a id="event-2021-10-17-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida says that the mass release of wastewater at the Fukushima nuclear plant cannot be delayed. The water, which has been inside the plant since the 2011 meltdown, is planned to be dumped into the Pacific Ocean over several decades despite strong opposition from local fishermen and the governments of China and South Korea.

<a id="event-2021-10-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Belarus.

**Archived source account.** The French ambassador to Belarus departs following a directive issued by the Belarusian government, which did not cite a rationale. The ambassador had not presented his credentials to President Alexander Lukashenko.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/10/17/french-envoy-leaves-belarus-at-minsks-demand-embassy-a75320>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-17-4-1"></a>

Context: Honour killing in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** A man is wanted in Pakistan after killing his two daughters and four grandchildren after setting their house ablaze, as one of the daughters married against his wishes. Her husband also died in the fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/father-suspected-killing-daughters-grandchildren-pakistan-marriage-feud-police-2021-10-17/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-17-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Haiti says that members of the "400 Mawozo" gang are behind the kidnapping of 16 American citizens and one Canadian citizen yesterday near Port-au-Prince. Those kidnapped include seven women, five men and five children.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-17-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Cape Verdean presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Cape Verdeans head to the polls to elect their new president to replace outgoing term-limited president Jorge Carlos Fonseca. The candidates of Fonseca's right-wing MpD and the leftist PAICV are the main contenders. The election is seen as important to reopen the important tourism industry which was hard-hit by the COVID-19 pandemic in the country.
