Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Moscow mayor Sergei Sobyanin announces a non-working week from October 28 until November 7 in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. Only firms that serve essential goods and the city infrastructure would be allowed to operate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/10/21/moscow-goes-on-partial-lockdown-starting-oct-28-a75363>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record 36,339 new cases and 1,030 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 8.13 million and the nationwide death toll to 227,389.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/russia-hits-new-record-daily-covid-cases-deaths-amid-upward-trend/2398795>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Latvia.

**Archived source account.** Latvia enters a month-long lockdown until November 15 that closes non-essential shops, cinemas and hairdressers, as well as implements a curfew from 8 p.m. to 5 a.m., due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Medical Xpress](<https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-10-latvia-lockdown-covid-spikes.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine reports a record 22,415 new cases and 546 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.7 million and the nationwide death toll to 62,389.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-health-ukraine-europe-coronavirus-vaccine-5ad7fb543096e0c2278976007ce12860>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India, COVID-19 vaccination in India.

**Archived source account.** India reports that it has administered more than one billion COVID-19 vaccinations since it started its vaccination drive in January.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-56345591>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia, COVID-19 vaccination in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia begins the rollout of booster doses of the COVID-19 vaccines for people aged above 18 and have received their second dose at least six months ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/amp/world/gulf/saudi/saudi-arabia-allows-covid-19-vaccine-booster-shots-1.83105328>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand reports a record 102 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the first the time that the country has reported more than 100 cases since the beginning of the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/21/new-zealand-covid-daily-cases-pass-100-for-first-time-since-pandemic-began>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Biden administration announces that the United States has donated 200 million COVID-19 vaccines to countries around the world, fulfilling a pledge from president Joe Biden that the U.S. would be the "world's arsenal" in vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/577680-white-house-us-has-donated-200-million-covid-19-vaccines-around-the>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention endorses booster shots of the Moderna and Johnson &amp; Johnson vaccines.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/10/21/health/covid-vaccine-boosters-cdc.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 misinformation / COVID-19 misinformation by China.

**Archived source account.** The University of Oxford links the Chinese government to a disinformation campaign promoting the unfounded claim that COVID-19 could have been imported to China from the United States through Maine lobsters shipped to a seafood market in Wuhan in November 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/china-linked-disinformation-campaign-blames-covid-maine-lobsters-rcna3236>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-1-24"></a>

Context: Climate change.

**Archived source account.** Greenpeace partially leaks a draft report from the International Panel on Climate Change, revealing that a number of large oil, coal, beef and animal feed-producing countries including Australia, Saudi Arabia, Brazil and Argentina are lobbying the IPCC for looser restrictions on global heating.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/climate-environment-and-nature-environment-united-nations-greenpeace-308a04052994ecf028ca08c323e10958>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-21-2-1"></a>

Context: 2021 North Kosovo crisis.

**Archived source account.** A working group to find a more permanent solution to the license plate issue, consisting of negotiators from the governments of Kosovo and Serbia, meet for the first time in Brussels. If negotiations are successful, the group will announce their proposals in 6 months.

Source citations (as archived): [Gazeta Tema](<https://www.gazetatema.net/en/delegations-from-kosovo-and-serbia-meet-to-discuss-a-permanent-solution-to-the-issue-of-license-plates/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives votes 229–202 to hold former White House Chief Strategist Steve Bannon in criminal contempt for refusing to comply with a subpoena issued by the January 6 select committee investigating the attack on the U.S. Capitol. The contempt is referred to the U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia and United States Attorney General Merrick Garland to decide whether to prosecute Bannon.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/steve-bannon-donald-trump-subpoenas-merrick-garland-house-elections-ea316d27da03c1c2ac467e34fefaf1da>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in France, Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The French National Assembly votes 135 to 125 to approve the extension of the COVID-19 Health Pass until at least July 31, 2022. The bill will be debated at the French Senate on October 28 in preparation for adopting the bill on November 15.

Source citations (as archived): [The Connexion](<https://www.connexionfrance.com/French-news/French-MPs-back-law-to-keep-possible-use-of-health-pass-until-July-31>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-3-5"></a>

Context: Killing of Justine Damond.

**Archived source account.** Former Minneapolis Police Department officer Mohamed Noor is resentenced to four years and nine months in prison for the manslaughter of unarmed 9-1-1 caller Justine Damond. Noor had originally been sentenced to 12.5 years for murder in 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/10/21/us/mohamed-noor-resentencing/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twenty-four people have been executed in Syria for deliberately starting wildfires in late 2020 that killed three people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-58997475>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The leader of the Haitian gang who kidnapped 17 United States and Canadian missionaries has threatened to kill the hostages if the gang does not receive the $17 million ransom for their release.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/10/21/americas/haiti-missionaries-intl-latam/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Benin National Assembly votes to legalize abortion within the first three months of pregnancy if it is likely to "aggravate or cause material, educational, professional or moral distress" or is "incompatible with the woman or the unborn child's interest", becoming one of the few countries in Africa to authorize abortions.

Source citations (as archived): [Africanews](<https://www.africanews.com/2021/10/21/west-africa-s-benin-votes-to-legalise-abortion/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ratu Wiliame Katonivere becomes the president-elect of Fiji. He will replace incumbent president Jioji Konrote when he is confirmed by parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/453970/ratu-wiliame-katonivere-set-to-be-fiji-s-next-president>).

<a id="event-2021-10-21-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cindy Kiro is sworn in as the 22nd Governor-General of New Zealand.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/national/453964/dame-cindy-kiro-sworn-in-as-governor-general>).

### 2021-10-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104442898](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%2022&oldid=1104442898>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-22-0-1"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Defense reports that forces have killed a senior al-Qaeda leader in Syria through an MQ-9 drone strike.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1953406/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Assailants armed with guns and knives attack an Islamic seminary at Balukhali refugee camp for Rohingya refugees near the Bangladesh–Myanmar border, killing seven people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/22/bangladesh-rohingya-refugee-camps-seven-killed-police>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Evergrande liquidity crisis.

**Archived source account.** Chinese property developer Evergrande Group reports that it transferred US$83.5 million to pay off interests on its dollar bonds, allowing it to avert short-term default a day before its deadline.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/evergrande-repays-84-million-worth-of-interest-in-dollar-bonds-2021-10?amp>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-10-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed during an explosion and fire at an illegal oil refinery in Rivers State, Nigeria. Children are among the victims.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-25-including-minors-died-illegal-refinery-blast-nigeria-2021-10-24/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed and another is injured by an explosion at a chemical plant in Ryazan Oblast, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/up-5-feared-dead-after-fire-russian-gunpowder-plant-reports-2021-10-22/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Iran, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on religion.

**Archived source account.** Mass Friday prayers resume in the capital Tehran after a 20-month suspension due to the pandemic. Worshippers must adhere to social distancing measures and use face masks during the gatherings, with most worshippers using their own prayer rugs and clay tablets.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Arabiya English](<https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/10/22/Friday-prayers-resume-in-Tehran-after-nearly-two-year-hiatus-due-to-COVID-19>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China, COVID-19 vaccination in mainland China.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese capital Beijing begins administering booster doses of the COVID-19 vaccines to "at-risk" individuals over the age of 18, which includes those participating, organizing, or working in the 2022 Winter Olympics as well as people working in education, manufacturing, retail, and public facilities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/international/asia-pacific/577969-beijing-offering-booster-shots-ahead-of-winter-olympics>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka, COVID-19 vaccination in Sri Lanka.

**Archived source account.** President Gotabaya Rajapaksa orders security personnel and health care and tourism industry workers in Sri Lanka to receive a booster dose of the COVID-19 vaccine beginning on November 1 in order to revive the economy and specifically the tourism industry due to the effects of the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/sri-lanka-orders-covid-19-booster-shots-frontline-workers-tourism-industry-2021-10-22/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus.

**Archived source account.** Belarus ends its short-lived mask mandate that was introduced on October 9 despite a record number of COVID-19 cases as President Alexander Lukashenko dismissed the measures as "unnecessary".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-europe-health-pandemics-belarus-23001be567f93f12980c60bedd81a77c>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 1,064 deaths from COVID-19, bringing the nationwide death toll to 228,453. The country also reports a record for the second consecutive day of 37,141 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 8,168,305.

Source citations (as archived): [Saudi Press Agency](<https://www.spa.gov.sa/viewfullstory.php?lang=en&amp;newsid=2297583>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine closes schools and public venues in Kyiv and will only permit the schools to reopen if teachers are vaccinated in other "red zone" areas after the country reported a record for the second consecutive day of 29,785 new cases and 614 deaths from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/articles/ukraine-posts-record-covid-deaths-cases-for-second-day-01634890807>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** Melbourne lifts its world-record lockdown restrictions as over 70% of the Victorian population are now fully vaccinated against COVID-19. Private and public gatherings are now allowed with limitations and schools and businesses will reopen with density caps. The controversial night-time curfew is also lifted.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-10-21/victoria-melbourne-covid-lockdown-curfew-ends/100549690>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-20"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji, COVID-19 vaccination in Fiji.

**Archived source account.** After vaccinating most of its adult population, Fiji announces that it has already vaccinated 28,965 children between the ages of 15 and 17 with at least one dose of the COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/454061/fiji-vaccination-of-teens-going-strong>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** The New Zealand Government sets a target of 90% of the population fully vaccinated, which is very high by international standards, in order to end lockdown measures and shift to a new traffic light system giving vaccinated Kiwis more freedoms. (1 News)\]

Source citations (as archived): [Source](<https://www.1news.co.nz/2021/10/21/ardern-sets-covid-19-target-of-90-fully-vaccinated-to-ease-restrictions/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Peru.

**Archived source account.** Peru surpasses 200,000 deaths from COVID-19, which is the second Latin American country to do so after Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/peru-surpasses-200-000-coronavirus-deaths/2400487>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-3-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** Pfizer says that its vaccine is 90% effective in children between the ages of 5 and 11.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pfizer-covid-vaccine-kids-effective-trials/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Eswatini protests.

**Archived source account.** Police and the army open fire on a group of health workers protesting outside a hospital in Eswatini, injuring 30 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-59011033>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-4-3"></a>

Context: Murder of David Amess.

**Archived source account.** After appearing at Westminster Magistrates' Court and the Old Bailey, Ali Harbi Ali is charged with the murder of David Amess and remanded to Belmarsh prison. He is due to be tried on March 7, 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-59010500>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-4-5"></a>

Context: Cannabis in Luxembourg.

**Archived source account.** Luxembourg legalizes cannabis, becoming the first country in Europe to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [TheStreet](<https://www.thestreet.com/investing/luxembourg-first-eu-country-legalize-cannabis>).

<a id="event-2021-10-22-4-7"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Defense Ministry designates six Palestinian groups, including human rights organization Al-Haq and non-profit organization Union of Agricultural Work Committees, as "terrorist organisations" for their alleged connections to the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine. The Palestinian National Authority, the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights, and several human rights groups harshly criticize the designations.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/22/israel-palestinian-human-rights-groups-terrorism>).

### 2021-10-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1133112886](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%2023&oldid=1133112886>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-23-0-1"></a>

Context: October 2021 Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan protests.

**Archived source account.** Clashes continue for the second day in Lahore, Pakistan, as the banned far-right Islamic extremist political party Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan is demonstrating to pressure the government to release its leader Saad Hussain Rizvi, who was arrested last year. Three protesters and two policemen were killed yesterday during the clashes and two protesters are killed today.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/23/deadly-clashes-as-banned-pakistan-party-continues-protest>).

<a id="event-2021-10-23-0-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks.

**Archived source account.** IS claims responsibility for the killing of 16 civilians during an assault at a village in Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo, three days ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/islamic-state-claims-responsibility-attack-congo-2021-10-23/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-23-0-5"></a>

Context: 2021 Uganda bombings.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and three others injured when a bomb explodes in a bar in Kampala, Uganda. Three suspected terrorists are behind the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-59028210>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-10-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** A tropical storm intensifies into Hurricane Rick off Mexico's southern Pacific coast, and is expected to make landfall in the states of Michoacán and Colima.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://federalnewsnetwork.com/world-news/2021/10/rick-becomes-hurricane-off-mexicos-pacific-coast/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-23-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Namibia.

**Archived source account.** Namibia suspends the usage of the Russian made Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine amid reports from South Africa that the vaccine increases risk of men contracting HIV.

Source citations (as archived): [WION](<https://www.wionews.com/world/namibia-suspends-use-of-russias-sputnik-v-vaccine-due-to-concerns-of-hiv-infection-423364>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/namibia-suspends-use-russian-covid-vaccine-after-safrica-flags-hiv-concerns-2021-10-23/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-23-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** The South Island reports its first community case of COVID-19 since November 2020 in a man who travelled from Rotorua to Blenheim on October 21.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff](<https://i.stuff.co.nz/national/health/coronavirus/126726176/the-wakeup-call-the-south-island-needed-covid19-in-blenheim-is-souths-first-community-case-since-2020>).

<a id="event-2021-10-23-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 1,075 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 229,528. The country also reports a record for the third consecutive day of 37,678 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 8.2 million.

Source citations (as archived): [ANI News](<https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/russia-confirms-new-single-day-record-of-37678-covid-19-cases20211023143459>).

<a id="event-2021-10-23-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea, COVID-19 vaccination in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The percentage of the population that is fully vaccinated in South Korea surpasses 70%, allowing the government to ease their COVID-19-related restrictions in November.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-korea-says-over-70-of-its-population-is-fully-vaccinated>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Turkey.

**Archived source account.** President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan orders the ambassadors of ten Western nations to be expelled from the country after their embassies called for the release of political prisoner Osman Kavala.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-erdogan-orders-10-ambassadors-declared-persona-non-grata-2021-10-23/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Hungary, 2022 Hungarian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** At a rally in central Budapest, prime minister Viktor Orbán accuses the United States, the European Union, and philanthropist George Soros of trying to meddle in the upcoming parliamentary elections. The accusations come as opinion polls show Orbán's alliance Fidesz–KDNP and the rival United Opposition polling neck-and-neck.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/23/hungarys-orban-accuses-eu-us-of-meddling-in-2022-election>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-23-4-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The trial of Matteo Salvini opens in Palermo, Italy. Salvini is accused of kidnapping and abuse of office when he ordered the detaining of 147 migrants at sea in August 2019, when he was serving as minister of the interior. Salvini said that the decision was agreed upon with the government, including then-prime minister Giuseppe Conte.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20211023-italy-s-former-interior-minister-salvini-stands-trial-on-migrant-kidnapping-charges>).

<a id="event-2021-10-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Illegal drug trade in Colombia.

**Archived source account.** Colombian police arrest Dario Antonio Úsuga (alias "Otoniel"), a leader of the Clan del Golfo drug cartel, in the town of Necoclí. Úsuga has been listed by authorities as one of the country's most-wanted drug traffickers.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/colombia-most-wanted-drug-lord-otoniel-captured-gulf-clan-2264631>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-10-23-5-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Scientists at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa announce the discovery of 2M0437b, one of the youngest exoplanets ever found at a distant star. The exoplanet was discovered using the Subaru Telescope at the observatory on Mauna Kea.

Source citations (as archived): [SciTech](<https://scitechdaily.com/astronomers-discover-infant-planet-one-of-the-youngest-exoplanets-ever-observed/>).

### 2021-10-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1060918545](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%2024&oldid=1060918545>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Clashes between the Somali National Army and Sufi paramilitary group Ahlu Sunna Waljama'a in Galmudug kill at least 30 people and injure more than 100 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dozens-killed-fighting-between-somalia-army-former-allied-group-2021-10-24/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-24-0-3"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency / 2021 Uganda bombings.

**Archived source account.** It is revealed that yesterday's explosion on a bus in Mpigi District was carried out by an ADF suicide bomber. The attacker was killed, and three other people were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211026-uganda-bus-blast-a-suicide-bomb-attack-police>); [Daily Monitor](<https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/dead-passenger-in-mpigi-bus-explosion-was-terrorist-says-museveni-3596510?view=htmlamp>).

Context: Islamic State insurgency in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Islamic State militants attack a village in Diyala Governorate, Iraq, killing 11 people and injuring several others.

<a id="event-2021-10-26-0-6"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2016 Berlin truck attack.

**Archived source account.** A man who was critically injured in the truck attack in Berlin, Germany, in 2016, dies from complications related to his injuries this month, becoming the thirteenth fatality of the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59048891>).

<a id="event-2021-10-26-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Military leader Abdel Fattah al-Burhan says that he and his forces seized power in an attempt to avoid a civil war in Sudan, saying that "the dangers we witnessed last week could have led the country into civil war". Meanwhile, anti-coup protests occur across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/telecommunications-interrupted-sudan-after-coup-2021-10-26/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-26-0-9"></a>

Context: War in Donbas.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine confirms it has carried out its first drone strikes using the Turkish-made Bayraktar TB2, destroying a pro-Russian separatist D-30 howitzer. A Ukrainian soldier is killed and another wounded by rebel artillery near Hranitne in Donetsk Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/10/27/ukraine-destroys-pro-russian-artillery-in-its-first-use-of-turkish-drones-a75420>).

Context: War in Donbas, Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov warns that the delivery and Ukraine's first operational deployment of the Turkish Bayraktar TB2 in Donbas may "destabilize the situation" in the region. Ukraine carried out its first strikes against separatist forces using the Bayraktar drone yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/kremlin-says-turkish-drones-risk-destabilising-situation-east-ukraine-2021-10-27/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Donbas, Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian troops regain control of the village of Staromaryivka in the so-called "grey zone" between Ukraine and the Donetsk People's Republic (DPR), according to DPR Foreign Minister Natalya Nikonorova.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/world/1354741>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamic State insurgency in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed and 26 more injured as angry villagers attack residents of Nahr Al-Imam in retaliation for yesterday's Islamic State attack in the nearby village of Al-Rashad, Diyala Governorate, which killed 15 people. The victims were not however connected to the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Arab](<https://english.alaraby.co.uk/news/iraqis-kill-11-blaming-neighbouring-village-attack>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-0-6"></a>

Context: October 2021 Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan protests.

**Archived source account.** Four policemen are killed and 263 more are injured during clashes with supporters of the banned far-right Islamic extremist Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan party in Lahore, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/27/pakistani-police-killed-at-tlp-protest>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-0-8"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** A report by the United Nations and the government of Papua New Guinea finds that thousands of Papuans from Indonesia have crossed into the remote border areas of western Papua New Guinea. In one of the areas, the sole police commander, Terry Dap, has asked the central government in Port Moresby to help reduce the influx of asylum seekers into Papua New Guinea.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/454356/west-papuans-flee-from-conflict-into-remote-png-area>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-0-10"></a>

Context: October 2021 Sudanese coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** The African Union suspends Sudan in response to Monday's military coup.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/african-union-suspends-sudan-after-military-coup/a-59638408>).

They each weigh more than 2,000 pounds, are nearly four feet in diameter, and were cast by the Felczyński bell foundry in Przemyśl, Poland.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/249411/pope-francis-blesses-pro-life-bells-going-to-ukraine-and-ecuador>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Labour Party leader Keir Starmer tests positive for COVID-19.

<a id="event-2021-10-27-3-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia, COVID-19 vaccination in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Therapeutic Goods Administration approves the usage of the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine as a booster dose for people over the age of 18 years old, which can be administered at least six months after the second dose.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-10-27/tga-approves-covid-vaccine-booster-shots-for-over-18-year-olds/100571442>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 drug development.

**Archived source account.** Merck &amp; Co. signs a licensing agreement with the UN-backed Medicines Patent Pool that will allow more companies to manufacture generic versions of its experimental oral antiviral COVID-19 treatment molnupiravir with a royalty-free license that will apply to 105 low- and middle-income countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-merck-co/merck-signs-pact-to-broaden-generic-manufacturing-of-covid-19-pill-idUSKBN2HH179>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Lebanon–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia summons the Lebanese ambassador over "offensive" remarks about the war in Yemen made by Lebanese information minister George Kurdahi.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1956511/saudi-arabia>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-4-3"></a>

Context: China–Tajikistan relations.

**Archived source account.** Tajikistan approves the construction of a new US$10 million Chinese military base near its border with Afghanistan, and in a separate statement offers to hand over a pre-existing base to China and waive future rent payments on the base in exchange for military aid. The approval comes as the Tajik government expressed concerns about the worsening security situation along the border after the Taliban took over Afghanistan a few months prior.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/tajikistan-approves-chinese-base/31532078.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-4-5"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** Following a meeting with European officials in Brussels, Iranian foreign minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian announces that negotiations on the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action will resume in November. Negotiations were halted following the United States' withdrawal from the deal.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.wionews.com/world/iran-agrees-to-restart-negotiations-on-2015-nuclear-deal-by-november-end-424625>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-27-5-1"></a>

Context: Climate justice.

**Archived source account.** Men from the Kalaw Lagaw Ya Indigenous Australian community sue the Australian Government in the Federal Court over the impacts of climate change on the Torres Strait Islands.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-10-27/australian-government-sued-for-failing-to-take-climate-action/100569558>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-5-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil, Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian Senate votes to charge President Jair Bolsonaro over his controversial handling of the COVID-19 pandemic. The charges include crimes against humanity, incitement to crime, falsification of documents and the violation of social rights. Brazil's COVID-19 death toll is second only to that of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-59051105>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests continue for a second consecutive day across Ecuador due to an increase in the price of gasoline, as president Guillermo Lasso orders the deployment of security forces to highways in order to maintain order. Lasso also calls on indigenous populations and civil society groups to engage in dialogue.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-president-calls-dialogue-with-indigenous-second-day-protests-2021-10-27/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-27-6-1"></a>

Context: Next Portuguese legislative election.

**Archived source account.** The budget proposed by the Socialist minority government of Prime Minister António Costa is rejected by the Assembly of the Republic for the first time in the country's democratic history, following moves by the Left Bloc and the Communist Party to join the right-wing parties and reject the budget. It is expected that the President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa will dissolve the parliament and call for early elections.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211027-early-polls-likely-as-portugal-mps-reject-budget>).

<a id="event-2021-10-27-6-3"></a>

Context: Poland and the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Justice (ECJ) fines Poland €1 million per day, for breaking the law by maintaining the disciplinary chamber of its Supreme Court. The ECJ says Poland has failed to comply with its order, and finds it might pose a "serious and irreparable harm to the legal order of the European Union". The fine is the highest daily penalty the ECJ has ever imposed on any EU member state.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/eu-fines-poland-1-million-per-day-over-judicial-reforms/a-59635269>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-10-27-7-1"></a>

Context: Homosexuality in association football.

**Archived source account.** Australian professional soccer player Josh Cavallo comes out as gay, becoming the only current openly gay top-flight male soccer player.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/10/27/football/footballer-josh-cavallo-announces-he-is-gay-spt-intl/index.html>).

### 2021-10-28

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Far-right terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** Rémy Daillet, a far-right conspiracy theorist, is charged with leading the planned "Operation Azul", a plot which involved 12 suspects, accused of plotting a series of attacks against COVID-19 vaccination centres, a masonic lodge, journalists, prominent figures and parliament. Former soldiers had been hired to train recruits for the plot.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59075902>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopian forces carry out another airstrike on Mekelle, the capital of the Tigray Region, targeting a compound of the Tigray People's Liberation Front. A Tigrayan spokesman denies that the airstrike hit the compound and instead says that six civilians were killed, including three children.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/airstrike-ethiopias-tigray-capital-kids-121434081.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the October 2021 Sudanese coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue for the fourth day in Sudan after the coup d'état. Another protestor is killed, bringing the total number of protestors killed to 11.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sudanese-army-faces-widening-opposition-takeover-2021-10-28/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The new leader of the Islamic State – West Africa Province has been killed during a military operation this month, two weeks after the death of the group's leader Abu Musab al-Barnawi was announced.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-army-says-islamic-state-west-africas-new-leader-killed-military-2021-10-28/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Facebook, Inc., the parent company of Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, renames itself to Meta Platforms. CEO Mark Zuckerberg says that the rename was done in order to reflect the company's diversification into other areas, such as virtual reality.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-59083601>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-28-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Moscow enters its strictest lockdown since June 2020, closing schools, kindergartens, and all non-essential businesses until November 7 due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases and deaths.

<a id="event-2021-10-28-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the third consecutive day of 1,159 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 235,057. The country also reports a record 40,096 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 8.39 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/russias-virus-cases-spiral-past-40-000-for-1st-time-deaths-hit-new-record/2405532>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary.

**Archived source account.** The Hungarian government announces that it will require face masks to be worn on public transport beginning on November 1 and will also allow companies to impose a vaccine mandate for their employees in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. Additionally, all non-essential medical appointments will be temporarily suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2021/10/28/firms-in-hungary-can-now-require-their-employees-to-get-a-covid-jab>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China, COVID-19 vaccination in mainland China.

**Archived source account.** Beijing mandates booster doses of the COVID-19 vaccine for key workers, including cooks, security guards and cleaning personnel, becoming the first major Chinese city to publicly mandate booster doses.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Uganda.

**Archived source account.** Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni announces that schools will be reopened in January after being closed for almost two years due to the pandemic, while the rest of the economy will be reopened in the same month.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211028-uganda-to-reopen-schools-in-january-after-almost-two-years>).

**Archived source account.** Malaysian gynaecologist John Tang Ing Chinh invents the world's first unisex condom, that can be used by both males and females, which is made from a medical grade material normally used as a dressing for injuries and wounds.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.todayonline.com/world/malaysian-gynaecologist-creates-worlds-first-unisex-condom>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-2-19"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 300 Olive ridley sea turtles have washed up dead on Mexico's Pacific coast, after being tangled in illegal fishing nets in the high seas. The species is listed as vulnerable.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-59077086>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-28-3-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Jersey dispute, France–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** France seizes a British trawler fishing inside its territorial waters without a licence, and fines another vessel amid tensions over post-Brexit fishing rights in the English Channel. The trawler is being held at the Port of Le Havre. The French government also says that, beginning November 2, it will impose extra customs checks on British goods entering France. French Seas Minister Annick Girardin says that "It's not war, but it is a fight".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/france-warns-two-british-fishing-boats-its-waters-wake-brexit-2021-10-28/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-3-2"></a>

Context: 2021 Jersey dispute, France–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** British environment minister George Eustice condemns the French seizure of the vessel, calling it "disappointing and disproportionate, and not what we would expect from a close ally and partner" and warned of an "appropriate and calibrated response".

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Post](<https://financialpost.com/pmn/business-pmn/uk-decries-frances-seizure-of-fishing-boat-as-post-brexit-row-deepens>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-3-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Jersey dispute, France–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** The British government summons the French ambassador to the UK over the actions by French authorities in the English Channel.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/uk-summons-french-ambassador-amid-fishing-dispute/a-59657470>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-3-5"></a>

Context: Australia–France relations.

**Archived source account.** French President Emmanuel Macron tells Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison that Morrison had broken the trust between the two countries and that it was up to Canberra to repair those ties with "tangible actions". France had criticized its allies after Australia opted for nuclear-powered submarines to be built with U.S. and British technology instead of a $A90 billion French diesel-electric submarine program. Macron also urged Australia to stop mining coal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Canberra Times](<https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/7489121/macron-tells-morrison-trust-was-broken/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-3-7"></a>

Context: Moldova–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union accuses Russia of "weaponizing" gas prices in order to "bully" Moldova after negotiations between the two countries failed following the expiration of a Moldovan contract with Gazprom. The Kremlin denied the accusations.

Source citations (as archived): [SwissInfo](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/gas-being--weaponised--against-moldova--eu-says/47065436>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in Cuba.

**Archived source account.** The National Assembly of People's Power passes a law aimed at reforming the country's judicial system and criminal code, consistent with the 2019 constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/cuba-approves-laws-granting-greater-rights-criticism-protesters-arrests-heats-up-2021-10-28/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-28-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** China's Ministry of Housing and Urban–Rural Development and Ministry of Emergency Management announce in a joint statement that cities with a population of more than three million people are not allowed to construct skyscrapers taller than 500 m and need a special exemption in order to construct a building taller than 250 m. The ministries also announce that cities with a population of less than three million people are not allowed to construct skyscrapers taller than 250 m and need a special exemption in order to construct a building taller than 150 m.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-59046480>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-10-28-5-1"></a>

Context: India–Pakistan cricket rivalry.

**Archived source account.** Police in the northern Indian state of Uttar Pradesh arrest three Kashmiri students for allegedly celebrating Pakistan's win over India in Sunday's T20 World Cup cricket game.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-59059494>).

### 2021-10-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1101118136](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%2029&oldid=1101118136>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Uganda bombings.

**Archived source account.** Two children are killed by a bomb explosion at a village in Nakaseke District. The device looked like a jackfruit and was given to the children while they were playing.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/30/fruit-shaped-bomb-kills-two-children-in-uganda-police>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-0-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks.

**Archived source account.** The CODECO and the Alliance for the Liberation of the Congo militia groups attack two villages in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing at least 14 civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://punchng.com/14-dead-in-dr-congo-village-attack/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and several injured when gunmen open fire at a wedding in Nangarhar. The Taliban are accused of being behind the attack, opening fire while music was being played. The Taliban has, however, said that the shooting was an internal dispute and that two of the attackers have been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/30/gunmen-kill-at-least-three-at-afghan-wedding-to-stop-music-being-played>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-0-7"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** Two employees of the Canadian mining company Iamgold are reported missing following an attack on their convoy in Burkina Faso while travelling to Essakane, Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/canadian-mining-firm-iamgold-convoy-attacked-burkina-faso-several-missing-2021-10-29/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-0-9"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Tatmadaw forces bombard the town of Thantlang in Chin State, western Myanmar, with artillery shells, destroying dozens of homes, after clashing with local self-defence forces who captured a soldier.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/29/myanmar-military-shells-restive-town-destroying-dozens-of-homes>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Mexico.

**Archived source account.** The National Institute of Statistics and Geography in Mexico shows that the economy shrank 0.2% in the third-quarter from the three previous months and the GDP also declined during the same period of time, both largely due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on businesses.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexican-economy-shrinks-first-time-since-pandemic-rebound-2021-10-29/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia / COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria.

**Archived source account.** Lockdown restrictions are further eased in Melbourne as 80% of the adult population are now fully vaccinated. Schools, non-essential retail, restaurants and gyms reopen with density limits, masks are no longer mandatory outdoors, and travel between Melbourne and regional Victoria resumes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/oct/29/victorian-covid-restrictions-what-rules-and-regulations-are-changing-on-friday>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania / COVID-19 pandemic in Tonga.

**Archived source account.** Tonga reports its first case of COVID-19 in a person who travelled from Christchurch, New Zealand to Nukuʻalofa and is now in isolation.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/454525/covid-19-tonga-records-first-case>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra.

**Archived source account.** Minister of Culture and Sports Sílvia Riva tests positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Diari d'Andorra](<https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2021/10/29/silvia_riva_dona_positiu_per_covid_189398_1125.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Poland surpasses three million cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-10-29/polands-total-number-of-covid-19-cases-passes-3-million>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 1,163 deaths from COVID-19, bringing the nationwide death toll to 236,220.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/russia-marks-daily-deaths-record-infections-soar-80851892>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine reports a record for the second consecutive day of 26,870 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.88 million.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-ukraine-cases/-ukraine-reports-record-daily-high-of-26870-new-coronavirus-cases-ministry-idUKS8N2MT060>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South America.

**Archived source account.** After seeing a slight increase in the number of cases and deaths, Chile, Uruguay and Argentina intensify their vaccination rollouts. Chile has reported 37,719 total deaths from COVID-19 while Argentina has reported 115,916 total deaths from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [El País Uruguay](<https://www.elpais.com.uy/mundo/senales-aumento-casos-refuerzan-vacunacion-covid.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Kyrgyzstan.

**Archived source account.** The Kyrgyzstan Cabinet of Ministers issues a change of regulations that would require workers in the cultural, leisure, entertainment, and sport sectors to be vaccinated against COVID-19 due to the ongoing pandemic situation in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AKIpress](<https://m.akipress.com/news:664117:Workers_of_culture_and_sport_in_Kyrgyzstan_required_to_get_vaccinated_against_COVID-19/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-2-21"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Food and Drug Administration authorizes the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine for children between the ages of 5 and 11, becoming the first vaccine to be approved for children in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2021/10/29/pfizer-covid-vaccine-fda-authorizes-for-kids-ages-5-to-11.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-29-3-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Belarus–European Union border crisis, Belarus–Poland relations.

**Archived source account.** The Senate of Poland approves a plan to construct an estimated EUR 353 million (US$407 million) wall along the country's border with Belarus, in response to an influx of migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/polish-lawmakers-approve-belarus-border-wall-amid-migrant-influx-01635521408?tesla=y>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-3-3"></a>

Context: Moldova–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Moldova and Russian energy firm Gazprom extend their supply contract, following accusations of Russia raising oil prices against Moldova.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/10/29/moldova-and-russia-extend-gas-contract-after-dispute-a75451>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-3-5"></a>

Context: Lebanon–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia recalls its ambassador to Lebanon and demands for Lebanon to reciprocate the action over "insulting" remarks about the war in Yemen made by Lebanese information minister George Kurdahi.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/middle-east/20211029-saudi-recalls-envoy-to-lebanon-over-yemen-comments>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-29-4-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Afghanistan, Treatment of women by the Taliban.

**Archived source account.** Taliban-appointed chief of the Central Bank Shah Mehrabi says that gay rights will not be respected in Afghanistan because "That's against our Sharia law", but also said that, conversely, women's rights will be different than that of the 1990s.

Source citations (as archived): [Thomson Reuters Foundation](<https://news.trust.org/item/20211029082858-jijlg/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-4-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** U Win Htein, aide to the deposed Burmese leader Aung San Suu Kyi, is sentenced to 20 years in prison for sedition. Htein became the first politician arrested in the aftermath of the February 2021 coup to be convicted.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-suu-kyi-aide-jailed-for-20-years-for-treason-local-reports/a-59663450>).

<a id="event-2021-10-29-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament sues the European Commission for failing to properly enforce the Rule of Law Conditionality Regulation that is linked to the Next Generation EU recovery package, which refuses to fund member states that fail to comply with the European Union's rule of law standards.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2021/10/29/europe/eu-parliament-sues-commission-rule-of-law-intl/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-29-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Bangsamoro Parliament election.

**Archived source account.** President of the Philippines Rodrigo Duterte signs into law a bill postponing the Bangsamoro Parliament election to 2025. The interim government of Bangsamoro led by the Moro Islamic Liberation Front has requested the postponement due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and the inability of the government to draw up an election code for the autonomous region.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/philippines-postpones-self-rule-vote-in-restive-muslim-region>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2021-10-29-6-1"></a>

Context: Solar cycle 25.

**Archived source account.** An X-class solar flare, the second of the current solar cycle, erupts. An associated coronal mass ejection may graze Earth on October 30 or 31, which could cause bright aurorae and interfere with satellite communications.

Source citations (as archived): [Space](<https://www.space.com/sun-unleashes-major-x-class-solar-flare-october-2021>).

### 2021-10-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273224866](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%2030&oldid=1273224866>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / 2021 Aden bombings.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb kills 9 people and injures 12 others near Aden International Airport. The attack coincided with the arrival of Aden's former governor at the airport, who is unhurt.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-59109560>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the October 2021 Sudanese coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed as the military opens fire at an anti-coup protest in Omdurman, bringing the total number of protesters killed since the coup to 14.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/30/sudanese-gear-up-for-nationwide-protests-against-military-coup>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Seven soldiers are killed in two separate attacks on patrols in Mourdiah.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/seven-mali-soldiers-killed-separate-convoy-attacks-army-2021-10-30/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-0-8"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** The Tigray Defense Forces say that they have captured the strategic city of Dessie and are advancing toward neighboring Kombolcha in Amhara. The government denies these claims, but residents confirm that the Ethiopian National Defense Force have completely withdrawn from Dessie.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/30/ethiopias-tigray-rebels-say-captured-strategic-town-of-dessie>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-0-10"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Over 160 buildings, including two churches, in the town of Thantlang, Chin State, have been destroyed by fires resulting from Tatmadaw shelling that occurred the previous day.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://globalnews.ca/news/8337567/160-homes-ablaze-myanmar/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-10-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Argentina.

**Archived source account.** In his speech at the G20 summit in Rome, president Alberto Fernández says that huge debts "condemn generations" and that the "current system prioritizes speculation over the development of the peoples", while also condemning the previous administration of Mauricio Macri for accepting a $46 billion loan from the International Monetary Fund.

Source citations (as archived): [Hola News](<https://holanews.com/argentina-critica-en-el-g20-que-la-deuda-con-el-fmi-condena-a-generaciones/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-30-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record 40,351 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 8.47 million.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/russia-hits-new-record-for-coronavirus-infections-1.5645196>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkey surpasses eight million cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [ANI News](<https://www.aninews.in/news/world/europe/turkey-reports-23096-daily-covid-19-cases-tally-tops-8-mln20211031013904>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, COVID-19 vaccination in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** Vice President Kamala Harris receives a booster dose of the Moderna COVID-19 vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/harris-gets-covid-19-booster-shot-d9be2982-adb8-4c36-a8c0-46026e39f406.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand reports a record 160 new community cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [1 News](<https://www.1news.co.nz/2021/10/30/record-daily-high-160-new-covid-19-community-cases-in-nz/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-2-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines reports a record 423 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours due to reclassification of 373 cases previously listed as recoveries, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 43,044.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/philippines-logs-record-daily-covid-19-deaths-data-reclassified-2279981>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-30-3-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Jersey dispute, France–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Last-ditch talks are held between British and French authorities as local authorities in the ports of Calais and Boulogne warn of a "disaster" if the French government goes ahead with its plan to "clog up" the English Channel and disrupt the trade and sailing of British vessels in French ports. British Prime Minister Boris Johnson said that the UK could consider "formal action" under trade agreements.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2021/oct/30/brexit-fishing-row-uk-and-france-hold-last-ditch-talks-to-avert-chaos-at-ports>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-3-3"></a>

Context: 2021 G20 Rome summit.

**Archived source account.** The 16th G20 summit begins for the first time in person after the beginning of the pandemic with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping appearing via video link.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-59101218>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-3-5"></a>

Context: United States–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo announces the removal of tariffs on steel and aluminum imports from the European Union that were imposed during the presidency of Donald Trump. European Trade Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis announces that the bloc will reciprocate the action on U.S. imports, ending a trade war.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us-eu-expected-announce-deal-ending-steel-aluminum-tariff-dispute-sources-say-2021-10-30/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-30-3-7"></a>

Context: Lebanon–United Arab Emirates relations.

**Archived source account.** The Emirati foreign ministry announces that it will recall its diplomats in Lebanon and ban Emirati citizens from traveling to the country "in solidarity with" Saudi Arabia, which recalled its ambassador to Lebanon over "insulting" remarks about the war in Yemen made by Lebanese information minister George Kurdahi.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/436798.aspx>).

### 2021-10-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1101118515](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20October%2031&oldid=1101118515>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-10-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two missiles are launched against a mosque in Marib Governorate, killing and injuring a total of 29 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/1/houthi-missile-attack-on-mosque-kills-29-says-yemen-minister>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-0-3"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire against security forces in Sourou, Burkina Faso, killing five policemen. Fifteen attackers are killed in a gunfight after the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/armed-group-kills-five-policemen-northern-burkina-faso-2021-10-31/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-10-31-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Salisbury rail crash.

**Archived source account.** Seventeen people are injured in a derailment and crash between two trains near Salisbury, Wiltshire, England.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-59114569>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and 15 others are injured when a Pemex gas pipeline explodes in Puebla, Mexico. The Governor of Puebla, Miguel Barbosa Huerta, blames an illegal tap for the explosion.

Source citations (as archived): [The Canberra Times](<https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/7491689/pemex-pipeline-blast-in-mexico-kills-one/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine firefighters are killed during a training exercise inside a cave in Altinópolis, São Paulo, Brazil, after the roof of the cave collapsed.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/nine-brazil-firefighters-die-after-cave-collapse-during-training-exercise>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-10-31-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar surpasses 500,000 cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Asian News International](<https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/covid-19-cases-surpass-500000-in-myanmar20211031204136>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates issues an emergency use authorization of the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine for children aged 5 to 11.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/uae-approves-pfizer-covid-19-vaccine-ages-5-11-2021-11-01/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports a record for the second consecutive day of 40,993 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 8.51 million.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/russia-hits-high-daily-coronavirus-cases-80885720>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki says that she has tested positive for COVID-19 following a meeting with President Joe Biden. She said in a statement that she is experiencing mild symptoms.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jen-psaki-covid-19-tests-positive/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2021-10-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi visits Pope Francis in the Vatican. It is the first-ever meeting between the two leaders. Modi is in Rome for the G20 Heads of State and Government Summit, October 30-31, before he flies to Glasgow, Scotland, for the 26th United Nations Conference on Climate Change (COP26), October 31 to November 12.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/vatican-city/news/2021-10/pope-francis-india-prime-minister-modi-meeting.html>); [Asia News](<http://asianews.it/news-en/Pope-receives-Narendra-Modi-who-invited-him-to-visit-India-54400.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-10-31-4-1"></a>

Context: October 2021 Tokyo attack.

**Archived source account.** A man attacks passengers on a train in Chōfu, Tokyo, Japan, with acid and a knife, before setting the train on fire, injuring 17 people. A man is arrested at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/knife-arson-acid-attack-tokyo-train-leaves-about-10-injured-media-2021-10-31/>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Mexican National Guard open fire against a vehicle carrying Cuban citizens, killing one person and wounding four more people. The guards said that "the vehicle didn't stopped when ordered to do so".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexicos-national-guard-kills-cuban-migrant-wounds-four-others-caravan-advances-2021-11-02/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-10-31-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Japanese general election.

**Archived source account.** Japanese citizens head to the polls to elect members of the Lower House. The ruling Liberal Democratic Party faces more opposition than in previous elections due to the handling of the COVID-19 pandemic in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/japan-election-ldp-parliament/2021/10/31/9acfc4c8-38aa-11ec-9662-399cfa75efee_story.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-5-3"></a>

Context: October 2021 Sudanese coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Sudanese Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok says that he will not step down despite being under house arrest following the military coup.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/10/31/africa/sudan-prime-minister-hamdok-military-coup-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-10-31-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Macedonian Prime Minister Zoran Zaev announces his resignation following a decisive defeat of his party, the Social Democratic Union, in the local elections.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/europe-elections-local-elections-northmacedonia-skopje-1edf324bbcc88a4239d625e2884fc794>).


## November

### 2021-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1101478279](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20November%201&oldid=1101478279>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-11-01-0-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Lagos high-rise collapse.

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed and several others are trapped when a high-rise building under construction in Ikoyi, Lagos, Nigeria, collapses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-59125228>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-11-01-1-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on tourism, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on The Walt Disney Company / COVID-19 pandemic in Shanghai.

**Archived source account.** Shanghai Disney Resort suspends entry into Shanghai Disneyland and Disneytown and asks 33,863 visitors to take a nucleic acid test upon exiting, and another test after 24 hours, after a visitor from Hangzhou tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/shanghai-disneyland-lockdown-officials-test-30000-visitors-rcna4226>).

<a id="event-2021-11-01-1-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia, COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** The Indonesian Drug and Food Control Agency issues an emergency use authorization for the Sinovac CoronaVac vaccine for children between the ages of 6 and 11 years.

Source citations (as archived): [VOI](<https://voi.id/en/news/99817/bpom-allows-children-6-12-years-old-to-be-injected-with-sinovac-vaccines>).

<a id="event-2021-11-01-1-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia, COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia becomes the first country in the world to approve the protein-based Novavax COVID-19 vaccine, which will be manufactured by the Serum Institute of India.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/01/health/novavax-vaccine-indonesia.html>).

<a id="event-2021-11-01-1-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israel reopens its borders to vaccinated international travellers for the first time since March 2020, where they must have received two doses of any WHO-approved vaccine, a booster dose within the past six months, or only one dose if they have recovered from COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [La Prensa Latina](<https://www.laprensalatina.com/israel-reopens-borders-to-vaccinated-visitors-for-1st-time-since-march-2020/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-01-1-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Japan lifts its 10,000 spectator attendance limit for large-scale events in 27 prefectures and allow events across the country to have 5,000 spectators or 50% venue capacity in order to restore social and economic activities amid decline of COVID-19 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2021/11/d9dc44a41d6a-japan-eases-limits-on-attendance-at-large-events-as-virus-cases-fall.html>).

<a id="event-2021-11-01-1-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea begins to implement a "Living with COVID-19" campaign with easing of movement restrictions and lifting operating hour restrictions for businesses as well as requiring proof of vaccination or a negative COVID-19 test from the previous 48 hours in order to enter high-risk venues. This comes as 75% of the South Korean population has been fully vaccinated.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/south-korea-covid19-ease-curb-vaccine-passport-2282771>).

<a id="event-2021-11-01-1-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand, Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Thailand reopens its international borders for the first time in 18 months to fully vaccinated travellers from 60 countries, where they are allowed to enter the country without quarantining, despite only 42% of the country's population being fully vaccinated.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-59115395>).

<a id="event-2021-11-01-1-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.
