#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-11-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Islamic State–Taliban conflict / 2021 Kabul hospital attack.

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes at the entrance of the Daoud Khan Military Hospital in Kabul, followed by gunfire and a second explosion. At least 25 people are killed and more than 50 others are wounded. Four of the attackers are killed and a fifth is arrested by the Taliban.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/nov/02/deadly-explosions-hit-military-hospital-in-kabul-afghanistan>).

<a id="event-2021-11-02-0-6"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb / 2021 Niger attacks.

**Archived source account.** At least 69 people are killed as Islamic State in the Greater Sahara gunmen attack a delegation led by the mayor of Banibangou, in Niger. The mayor is among those killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/4/dozens-dead-in-west-niger-village-attack-officials>).

<a id="event-2021-11-02-0-8"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopia declares a six-month state of emergency as the Tigray Defense Forces (TDF) and Oromo Liberation Army gain control over areas outside of Tigray and the TDF announces its intention to advance to the Ethiopian capital, Addis Ababa. Authorities in Addis Ababa, in a separate announcement earlier in the day, tell citizens to register arms and prepare to defend their neighbourhoods.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/addis-ababa-government-urges-residents-register-arms-media-2021-11-02/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** The United States bans embassy personnel from traveling outside of Addis Ababa and strongly suggests that U.S. citizens seriously reconsider travel to Ethiopia and that those who are currently in Ethiopia consider making preparations to leave the country.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. Embassy in Ethiopia](<https://et.usembassy.gov/security-alert-update-on-security-situation-in-ethiopia/>).

**Archived source account.** Human rights organizations urge Singapore to cancel the execution of a 33-year-old Malaysian mentally impaired man who was convicted after being caught in 2010 with 42.72 grams of heroin. However, the court postponed the execution again after the man was diagnosed with COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/chile-impeachment-vote-heads-senate-after-lower-house-approval-2021-11-09/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-09-4-4"></a>

<a id="event-2021-11-13-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ethiopian Human Rights Commission publishes a report accusing the Tigray People's Liberation Front of killing more than 150 civilians in the Amhara Region between July and August. The report states that they were killed for either supporting the federal government or sheltering soldiers.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Austria.

This new policy was implemented after a proposed policy that would require unvaccinated people to provide a mandatory rapid COVID-19 test in order to enter supermarkets was deemed too difficult to implement.

Source citations (as archived): [Ekathimerini](<https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1171698/restrictions-in-number-of-supermarket-customers-return/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-13-1-11"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Papua New Guinea.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand sends doctors to Papua New Guinea, after Papua New Guinea formally requested international help to combat the worsening COVID-19 situation in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/455621/nz-sends-medical-team-to-png-as-covid-19-overwhelms-its-health-system>).

<a id="event-2021-11-13-1-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. surpasses 47 million cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [WFTV](<https://www.wftv.com/news/trending/coronavirus-total-us-covid-19-cases-top-47-million/MQBLP2PIIZCSTI2GW5HWD4GZN4/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-13-1-15"></a>

Context: 2021 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** At COP26, diplomats from countries around the world reach a major agreement aimed at intensifying global efforts to fight climate change by calling on governments to return next year with stronger plans to curb planet-warming emissions and urging wealthy nations to "at least double" their funding in order to protect poorer nations from the hazards of a warming planet. Some activists are critical of the agreement, as it leaves unresolved the question of how much and how quickly each nation should cut its carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gas emissions over the next decade, and it still leaves many developing countries short of the funds that they would need in order to cope with increasing weather disasters. However, the agreement makes reference to fossil fuels and their role in the climate crisis for the first time in the conference's history.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/11/13/world/cop26-agreement-final-climate-intl/index.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/13/climate/cop26-glasgow-climate-agreement.html>).

<a id="event-2021-11-19-0-1"></a>

Context: November 2021 Pacific Northwest floods.

**Archived source account.** The provincial government of British Columbia, Canada, declares a state of emergency in response to ongoing risks from floods and mudslides. Effective immediately until December 1, citizens in affected regions, including the Lower Mainland and Vancouver Island, are limited to 30 litres of diesel and gasoline purchased at fuel stations. Vehicles used for essential services, such as emergency response, commercial transport, and public transit, are exempt from this order and granted unlimited access to cardlock gas stations ordinarily used by the commercial trucking industry. Price gouging at retail gas stations and the resale of fuel is prohibited. Restrictions on non-essential travel along damaged highways are also set in place.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/8387091/bc-flooding-mudslides-update-november-19-latest/>).

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20211124-wisconsin-parade-ramming-claims-sixth-victim-as-eight-year-old-dies>).

<a id="event-2021-11-23-5-4"></a>

Context: Colombian peace process.

**Archived source account.** United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres arrives in Colombia to commemorate the fifth year of the signing of the peace deal between the government of Colombia and the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia.

Source citations (as archived): [MercoPress](<https://en.mercopress.com/2021/11/23/un-secretary-general-arrives-in-colombia-for-5th-anniversary-of-peace-deal-with-farc>).

<a id="event-2021-11-23-5-5"></a>

Context: Colombian peace process.

**Archived source account.** The Biden administration announces the delisting of the former FARC rebel group from the United States Department of State list of Foreign Terrorist Organizations where it had been listed since 1997.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-set-remove-colombia-rebel-group-farc-terrorism-list-sources-2021-11-23/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-23-5-7"></a>

Context: Sines v. Kessler.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. federal jury finds the organizers of 2017's Unite the Right rally, which includes white supremacists Richard B. Spencer, Jason Kessler, and Christopher Cantwell, liable for the violence that occurred and are ordered to pay US$26 million to nine individuals that suffered "physical and emotional damages". However, the jury was deadlocked on whether to convict on two federal conspiracy charges.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/charlottesville-rally-unite-the-right-leaders-ordered-to-pay-26-million/a-59913676>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/11/23/us/charlottesville-unite-the-right-trial-deliberations-tuesday/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-11-24-4-2"></a>

Context: 2015–present Polish constitutional crisis / 2015 Polish Constitutional Court crisis.

**Archived source account.** In response to the ruling of the European Court of Human Rights in Xero Flor w Polsce sp. z o.o. v. Poland, which found that the business was denied the right to fair trial because a judge of the Tribunal was appointed illegally, the Constitutional Tribunal declares that it is not a court within the meaning of Article 6 of the European Convention on Human Rights and rules that the ECHR did not have the right to control the validity of appointments of the Tribunal's judges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-tribunal-rules-european-rights-court-cannot-question-its-judges-2021-11-24/>).

**Archived source account.** The three men who killed Ahmaud Arbery in Brunswick, Georgia, United States, in February 2020 are found guilty of murder and aggravated assault.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-us-canada-59379518>).

Context: 2021 Solomon Islands unrest.

**Archived source account.** Protesters take to the streets in Honiara, Solomon Islands, calling for the resignation of incumbent prime minister Manasseh Sogavare. A building within the Parliament complex is set on fire as protesters engage in looting and arson while law enforcement personnel fire tear gas into crowds.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/456476/buildings-burned-in-looting-after-solomon-islands-protest>); [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/456444/protesters-take-to-the-streets-in-solomon-islands>).

The two people are identified as a woman who helped Navalny represent his organization and a lawyer who said that he was under pressure.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/two-navalny-allies-flee-russia-he-challenges-extremist-tag-2021-11-24/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-24-4-8"></a>

<a id="event-2021-11-24-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 German federal election.

**Archived source account.** The Social Democratic Party of Germany, the Free Democratic Party of Germany, and Alliance 90/The Greens agree to a "traffic light coalition" to form the next government with Olaf Scholz of the SPD as the next Chancellor, succeeding Angela Merkel. The government will be formally elected by the Bundestag in early December.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/future-german-government-to-present-coalition-deal-this-afternoon/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-24-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sweden's Riksdag votes for Social Democrat leader Magdalena Andersson to become the first female prime minister of Sweden. However, Andersson resigned several hours later, after the Green Party quit the coalition. The Greens quit the coalition after the opposition budget was approved by the Riksdag.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Sweden](<https://sverigesradio.se/artikel/andersson-clears-vote-to-become-swedens-first-female-prime-minister>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/rates-bonds/swedish-pm-resigns-first-day-after-coalition-collapses-2021-11-24/>).

### 2021-11-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1081383586](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20November%2025&oldid=1081383586>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-11-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / November 2021 Mogadishu bombing.

**Archived source account.** A car bombing targeting a UN convoy explodes outside a school in Mogadishu, killing eight people and injuring 17 others. Jihadist group al-Shabaab claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/25/large-explosion-rocks-somali-capital-mogadishu>).

<a id="event-2021-11-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Piracy in the Gulf of Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Royal Danish Navy frigate HDMS Esbern Snare opens fire and kills four pirates in the Gulf of Guinea after being fired upon. Four other pirates are detained and taken aboard by Frogman Corps. The incident took place 25 to 30 nautical miles south of the territorial boundary of Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/danish-frigate-kills-four-suspected-pirates-gulf-guinea-2021-11-25/>).

<a id="event-2021-11-25-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 35 people are killed during an eight-day fight over a dispute about camel looting between herders in Jebel Moon, Darfur, Sudan. Sixteen villages and thousands of homes are also set on fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/25/dozens-killed-in-clashes-in-sudans-restive-darfur>).

Context: Listvyazhnaya mine disaster.

**Archived source account.** A fire inside a coal mine in Kemerovo Oblast, Russia, traps 285 miners underground. Forty-six miners are killed and 49 others are being treated for smoke inhalation in hospital. Five rescuers later die while searching for trapped miners, bringing the total death toll to 51.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/russia-over-50-miners-die-in-siberian-incident/a-59926879?maca=en-rss-en-top-1022-rdf>); [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/siberia-coal-mine-fire-1.6261971>).

Lukashenko gives a speech to migrants, telling them that they are free to either return home or head west, saying, "If you want to go westwards, we won't detain you, choke you, beat you. It's up to you. Go through. Go."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/twenty-charged-with-plotting-kill-madagascar-president-trial-begins-2021-12-06/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2021-12-06-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Solomon Islands unrest.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Manasseh Sogavare survives a no-confidence vote in the National Parliament after his management of the riots.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/solomon-islands-prime-minister-faces-no-confidence-vote-after-riots-2021-12-06/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-06-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Karl Nehammer is sworn in as the new Chancellor of Austria after the resignation of Alexander Schallenberg on December 2.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/nehammer-sworn-austrias-chancellor-months-81581062>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-12-06-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Winter Olympics.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces a formal diplomatic boycott of the upcoming Winter Olympic Games in Beijing, China. The White House says that no official delegation will be sent to the Games due to concerns regarding China's human rights record.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-59556613>).

### 2021-12-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1098157052](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20December%207&oldid=1098157052>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-12-07-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israel's role in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Air Force warplanes bomb the Port of Latakia, Syria's main seaport. At least five explosions are reported, with a Syrian military official stating that several missiles struck the container area of the port. It is the first Israeli attack on the facility through which Iran and Hezbollah import weapons into Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/syria-says-israeli-warplanes-attacked-latakia-port/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-aggression-targets-syrias-latakia-port-area-state-tv-2021-12-07/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamic State insurgency in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Four civilians are killed and four more are injured in an ISIL motorcycle bombing near a hospital in Basra, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Arab](<https://english.alaraby.co.uk/news/motorcycle-bomb-kills-four-basra-iraq-official/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-07-0-7"></a>

Context: Nigerian bandit conflict / Sokoto bus massacre.

**Archived source account.** Bandits ambush and set fire to a passenger bus in Sokoto State, Nigeria, killing 30 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-torch-bus-kill-30-passengers-nigerias-sokoto-state-2021-12-07/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2021-12-07-1-1"></a>

Context: Evergrande liquidity crisis.

**Archived source account.** Chinese property developer Evergrande Group misses a deadline for the payment of debt for the first time at the end of a 30-day grace period, pushing the property developer closer to formal default.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/developer-china-evergrandes-shares-set-rise-66-restructuring-looms-2021-12-07/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-07-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates says that weekends in the country will occur from Friday afternoon to Sunday, effective January 1.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2021/12/07/uae-to-shift-weekend-to-saturday-and-sunday-from-next-year.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-12-07-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the eruption of the Semeru volcano in East Java, Indonesia, increases to 34.

**Archived source account.** At least 38 people are killed and 69 more are injured during a fire at an overcrowded prison in Gitega, Burundi.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-59560444>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-12-07-3-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Northern Ireland reports its first cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in two people from the same household in the greater Belfast area and a third unrelated person.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Norway.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/norway-again-hardens-covid-19-curbs-to-try-to-halt-spread-of-virus-1.4749392>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, COVID-19 vaccination in Spain.

**Archived source account.** The Spanish Public Health Commission approves the usage of the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine for children between the ages of 5 and 11 years. Vaccination rollout for this age group will begin on December 15.

Source citations (as archived): [El Pais](<https://english.elpais.com/society/2021-12-07/spain-approves-covid-19-vaccines-for-children-with-drive-set-to-begin-on-december-15.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20211207-eu-health-agencies-endorse-mixing-and-matching-covid-19-vaccines>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois.

<a id="event-2021-12-07-3-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Missouri.

Source citations (as archived): [KTVI](<https://fox2now.com/news/missouri/70-of-missouri-adults-have-received-first-covid-vaccine-dose/>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Martinique.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico / COVID-19 vaccination in Mexico.

<a id="event-2021-12-07-3-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** A trial of a plant-based COVID-19 vaccine conducted by GSK and Medicago shows an overall 71% efficacy against disease caused by the predominant SARS-CoV-2 variants of concern observed during most of 2021, and 75% efficacy specifically against disease caused by Delta. The study excludes the Omicron variant, which was not in circulation at the time of the clinical trials.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/584679-plant-based-coronavirus-vaccine-shows-positive-efficacy-and>); [GSK](<https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/medicago-and-gsk-announce-positive-phase-3-efficacy-and-safety-results/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-07-4-2"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in the Americas / LGBT rights in Canada.

**Archived source account.** A bill to criminalize the widely discredited practice of conversion therapy passes the Senate in Canada without opposition, one week after it passed the House of Commons without opposition; the bill now awaits royal assent to become law.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics/senate-passes-bill-to-ban-conversion-therapy-1.5697507>).

<a id="event-2021-12-07-4-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/7/kenya-police-officer-deadly-shooting-spree-after-killing-wife>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden rules out deploying American troops unilaterally to Ukraine in order to deter a potential Russian invasion, saying that the option "was not on the table".

<a id="event-2021-12-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The bones of over 100 Indigenous Australian Kaurna people are repatriated from the South Australian Museum and buried in a ceremony in Adelaide.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/dec/08/this-is-what-we-need-indigenous-remains-finally-laid-to-rest-in-historic-adelaide-ceremony>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-12-08-2-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Indian Air Force Mil Mi-17 crash.

**Archived source account.** Chief of Defence Staff Bipin Rawat and 12 other people are killed when their Indian Air Force Mi-17V-5 crashes near Coonoor, Tamil Nadu, while flying from Sulur Air Force Station to Wellington. Another person was injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-59576082>).

<a id="event-2021-12-08-2-3"></a>

Context: 2021 Semeru eruption.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-12-08-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China, COVID-19 drug development.

**Archived source account.** China's National Medical Products Administration approves the use of the neutralizing antibody cocktail developed by BRII Biosciences to treat COVID-19 in adults and teenagers.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Post](<https://financialpost.com/pmn/business-pmn/china-approves-brii-biosciences-covid-19-treatment>).

<a id="event-2021-12-08-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India, COVID-19 vaccination in India.

**Archived source account.** India's Serum Institute announces that it will halve the production of its COVID-19 vaccine because it has no new orders for the vaccine.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-59574878>).

<a id="event-2021-12-08-3-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Kuwait.

**Archived source account.** Kuwait reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a fully vaccinated European citizen who travelled from an African country.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/kuwait-records-first-case-of-omicron-variant/2442301#>).

<a id="event-2021-12-08-3-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea reports a record 7,175 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 489,484.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/12/08/asia-pacific/south-korea-covid-surge/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-08-3-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Boris Johnson announces new "Plan B" restrictions that include working from home for those who can beginning on December 13, and an extension of mandatory face mask wearing to more indoor venues beginning on December 10. The restrictions also include usage of the mandatory NHS COVID pass in order to enter nightclubs and other venues with large crowds, as well as daily tests for people who had contact with a person who tested positive for the Omicron variant.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-boris-johnson-announces-plan-b-restrictions-to-combat-spread-of-omicron-variant-12490130>).

<a id="event-2021-12-08-3-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark.

**Archived source account.** The Danish government announces that schoolchildren will be sent home early from December 15 and nightlife establishments will close on December 10 due to persistently high number of COVID-19 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/denmark-extends-holiday-break-for-schools-over-surging-infections>).

<a id="event-2021-12-08-3-17"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Romania.

**Archived source account.** Romania lifts its nighttime curfew and mandatory outdoor face mask policy, allows shops and restaurants to close at 10 p.m. and allows entry to non-essential venues for those with a negative COVID-19 test as the number of cases declines.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/romanian-government-ease-some-covid-19-restrictions-2021-12-07/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-08-3-19"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa, COVID-19 vaccination in South Africa.

**Archived source account.** The South African Health Products Regulatory Authority approves the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine booster dose for people over the age of 18 that can be administered six months after their second dose, as well as immunocompromised people aged above 12 years that can be administered 28 days after their second dose.

Source citations (as archived): [BusinessTech](<https://businesstech.co.za/news/lifestyle/545320/south-africa-approves-pfizer-booster-shot-for-people-over-18-heres-when-you-should-take-it/amp/>).

Context: 1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal.

**Archived source account.** The Court of Appeal of Malaysia upholds the conviction against former Prime Minister Najib Razak of all seven counts of abuse of power, money laundering and criminal breach of trust for his involvement in the 1MDB scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-court-appeal-upholds-1mdb-najib-src-international-guilty-conviction-2363971>).

**Archived source account.** The Bundestag elects Olaf Scholz as the new Chancellor of Germany, replacing Angela Merkel after 16 years in office.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59575773>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2021-12-08-6-1"></a>

Context: Concerns and controversies at the 2022 Winter Olympics.

**Archived source account.** Australia, Canada and the United Kingdom join a U.S.-led diplomatic boycott of the upcoming Winter Olympic Games in Beijing citing China's human rights abuses in the Xinjiang region and Beijing's ongoing freeze on ministerial contact with Canberra.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://sg.news.yahoo.com/australia-not-send-officials-beijing-230158492.html>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/news/2021/12/08/canada-diplomatic-boycott-olympics-523942>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2021/12/08/world/europe/uk-china-olympics-diplomatic-boycott.html>).

### 2021-12-09

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-12-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Turkish–Kurdish conflict.

**Archived source account.** PKK fighters kill three Turkish soldiers in northern Iraq, before Turkish fighter jets reportedly kill six PKK fighters during airstrikes.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2021-12-09-1-2"></a>

Context: Mexico–United States border crisis / Chiapas truck crash.

**Archived source account.** A tractor-trailer transporting more than 180 illegal migrants, mostly Guatemalans and Hondurans, crashes in Chiapas, Mexico, killing 55 people and injuring 105 others.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2021/12/09/tractor-trailer-full-migrants-crashes-southern-mexico-killing-least-49/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-12-09-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong, COVID-19 apps.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong mandates usage of its COVID-19 tracing app for all adults under the age of 65. The app logs a person's presence at 18 types of premises, including bars and restaurants, and enables tracing of infections if an outbreak is reported.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/hong-kong-mandate-covid19-tracing-app-bars-restaurants-2369096>).

<a id="event-2021-12-09-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan.

**Archived source account.** Jordan reports its first two cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a citizen who had travelled from South Africa and another who had no travel history.

Source citations (as archived): [Petra News Agency](<https://petra.gov.jo/Include/InnerPage.jsp?ID=39538&amp;lang=en&amp;name=en_news>).

<a id="event-2021-12-09-2-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore reports its first locally transmitted case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a 24-year-old airport employee with no recent travel history.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/singapore-reports-first-locally-transmitted-omicron-case-2021-12-10/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-09-2-10"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Cuba.

**Archived source account.** Cuba reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a person who travelled from Mozambique.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/cuba-detects-first-omicron-case>).

<a id="event-2021-12-09-2-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention recommends that people as young as 16 years receive a booster dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. This comes after the FDA authorized the usage of the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine as a booster dose for people in that age group.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/fda-pfizer-covid-vaccine-booster-shots-age-16/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-09-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Austria.

**Archived source account.** The government announces plans to make COVID-19 vaccination compulsory for the general population, setting a minimum age of 14 years and requiring unvaccinated persons to pay fines of up to 3,600 euros every three months. The rules will be in effect from February 1 until January 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/austria-announce-details-planned-covid-19-vaccine-mandate-2021-12-09/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-09-2-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization recommends that people who are immunocompromised or received an inactivated COVID-19 vaccine should get their COVID-19 booster dose due to reducement of vaccine effectiveness against virus variants.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/international/585117-who-recommends-booster-for-people-with-health-problems-and-inactive>).

<a id="event-2021-12-09-2-18"></a>

Context: HIV vaccine development.

**Archived source account.** An mRNA vaccine candidate against the human immunodeficiency virus, developed by the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, Moderna and other institutes, shows a 79% efficacy rate and no major side effects in animal trials on rhesus macaques, according to a peer-reviewed paper published in Nature Medicine.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211209-experimental-mrna-vaccine-for-hiv-shows-promise-in-animals>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-12-09-3-1"></a>

Context: Smoking in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** The government announces that it will begin increasing the legal age by one year for purchasing tobacco every year beginning in 2025, effectively preventing future generations from legally purchasing tobacco products. The plan also involves decreasing the nicotine content of tobacco, limiting licenses for the sale of tobacco, and increasing funding for anti-addiction services. Electronic cigarettes, which are more popular among younger generations in New Zealand, will not be subject to the ban.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/dec/09/new-zealand-to-ban-smoking-for-next-generation-in-bid-to-outlaw-habit-by-2025>).

<a id="event-2021-12-09-3-3"></a>

Context: Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020, Human rights in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the Philippines partially upholds provisions of the contentious Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020 while declaring unconstitutional the designation of terrorists on the request of foreign jurisdictions as well as the qualifier on harmful dissent.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/supreme-court-voids-killer-caveat-anti-terror-law-harmful-dissent/>).

Context: Yemeni Civil War / Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

Boura was involved in the killings of six French aid workers and their two Nigerien guides in a mass shooting in August 2020 in Kouré, Niger.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/21/france-says-killed-suspect-in-2020-murder-of-aid-workers-in-niger>).

**Archived source account.** The Standing Committee on Vaccination recommends the shortening of the interval between the second dose and booster dose of the COVID-19 vaccine to three months and urges all citizens over the age of 18 to receive a booster dose of an mRNA-based vaccine after receiving their first two doses in order to reduce the spread of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Germany.

**Archived source account.** German Chancellor Olaf Scholz and 16 state premiers agree to tighten the restrictions beginning on December 28, including limiting the number of people in private gatherings to 10 and banning spectators at large-scale musical, sporting and cultural events due to concerns related to the spread of the Omicron variant.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal.

There will also be capacity restrictions at shops and people will require a negative COVID-19 test in order to enter events.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden.

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / European Union response to the COVID-19 pandemic, Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic.

The new rules will be mandatory for all 27 EU member states beginning on February 1.

Source citations (as archived): [RFI](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/europe/20211221-eu-sets-a-mandatory-9-month-validity-of-vaccinations-for-covid-19-travel-pass>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel.

The hospital later states that the death was actually because of the Delta variant.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/israel-reportedly-records-first-known-omicron-death/>); [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/hospital-reverses-course-says-covid-linked-death-was-delta-not-omicron/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-23-3-2"></a>

Context: Japan–United States relations, Taiwan–United States relations.

The operation would consist of deploying U.S. Marines on the Ryukyu Islands near Taiwan, while the Japan Self-Defense Forces would provide logistical support such as ammunition and fuel supplies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/japan-us-draw-up-joint-operation-plan-any-taiwan-emergency-kyodo-2021-12-23/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2021-12-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 14-Year-Old Valentina Orellana-Peralta killed in LAPD response.

**Archived source account.** While responding to multiple reports of a violent assault suspect at a Los Angeles clothing store, LAPD officers fired upon one male subject. Valentina Orellana-Peralta was sheltering with her mother and other patrons and was killed by an errant shot. Valentina and the suspect both succumbed to their injuries in the store. Several patrons were injured by the suspect prior to officers' arrival.

Source citations (as archived): [Source](<https://www.cnn.com/2021/12/28/us/lapd-teen-killed-valentina-orellana-peralta-family/index.html>).

<a id="event-2021-12-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Killing of Daunte Wright.

**Archived source account.** Former Minneapolis police officer Kim Potter is found guilty on both counts in the killing of Daunte Wright. She is scheduled to be sentenced on February 18, 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/kim-potter-guilty-manslaughter-death-of-daunte-wright-43e70645189bf61be64fc00534adf388>).

<a id="event-2021-12-23-4-6"></a>

Context: Political impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Lithuania.

**Archived source account.** The Seimas votes 89–17 with 19 abstentions to approve a law that would require MPs to have a health pass, which shows proof of vaccination, a negative test result from the previous 72 hours, or that a person has recovered from COVID-19, in order to attend hearings beginning in January.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/lithuania-to-require-covid-health-pass-from-mps-01640284207?tesla=y>).

<a id="event-2021-12-23-4-8"></a>

Context: Workfare.

**Archived source account.** The Australian Government pays a A$2,000,000 settlement to the Shire of Ngaanyatjarraku to end a class action lawsuit in the Federal Court over the controversial Community Development Program, which saw unemployed Ngaanyatjarra and other Indigenous Australian people in remote communities working up to 25 hours a week otherwise unpaid in order to receive the JobSeeker payment, which is generally considered to be less than the cost of living and which is provided to other Australians in exchange for completing a fortnightly quota of job applications. The Ngaanyatjarra accused the program of being racist and a form of modern slavery.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/dec/23/federal-government-to-pay-out-2m-to-settle-class-action-over-racist-work-for-the-dole-program>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-12-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Syrian state media reports that Israel has bombed the Port of Latakia. If this is confirmed by the IDF, it would be the second airstrike on the facility this month. Secondary explosions are believed to be from Iranian munitions stored at the facility.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-airstrikes-said-to-hit-key-syrian-port-of-latakia-causing-massive-damage/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Massive damage at the port is reported from the air raid with most of the port on fire, although there are no immediate reports of casualties from the attack. Videos on social media show multiple large explosions and anti-aircraft fire over the city. A hospital, shops, and some residential buildings were also badly damaged.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/28/israeli-air-raid-targets-syrian-port-of-latakia-state-media>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-12-28-2-4"></a>

<a id="event-2021-12-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in London.

**Archived source account.** A 16-year-old boy is stabbed to death in Hillingdon, west London, making him the 30th teenage homicide in the British capital in 2021. It is now the deadliest year on record for killings of teenagers, surpassing a previous peak of 29 homicides in 2008.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-59836010>).

### 2021-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1080898191](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2021%20December%2031&oldid=1080898191>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2021-12-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Four soldiers and two militants are killed during gunfights between the Pakistan Army and the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan in Mir Ali, North Waziristan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/31/four-soldiers-killed-in-raid-on-pakistan-taliban-hideout>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six soldiers from Niger and Nigeria are killed and 16 others are wounded during a fight with ISWAP militants in the Lake Chad region of Borno State, Nigeria. Twenty-two militants are also killed and 17 more are captured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/six-nigerian-niger-troops-killed-by-islamic-state-security-forces-say-2021-12-30/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines / COVID-19 pandemic in Metro Manila.

**Archived source account.** Metro Manila moves into Alert Level 3 from January 3 to 15 amid an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases and the detection of local cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1534501/ncr-under-alert-level-3-from-jan-3-to-jan-15-palace>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines reports its first three locally transmitted cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Philippines](<https://cnnphilippines.com/news/2021/12/31/Philippines-first-local-cases-of-Omicron.html>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-7"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong reports its first potential community cluster of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant, which are also the first locally transmitted cases reported by the city since June.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-12-31/potential-omicron-cluster-clouds-hong-kong-s-virus-free-streak>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Israel, COVID-19 vaccination in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israel extends fourth doses of the COVID-19 vaccine to elderly people in care facilities and begins administering fourth doses for vulnerable people, citing the high-risk of infection.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/israel-extends-4th-covid-vaccine-elderly-care-facilities-2021-12-31/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-13"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in Florida.

**Archived source account.** Florida reports 75,900 cases of COVID-19, a new single-day record.

Source citations (as archived): [WFTV](<https://www.wftv.com/news/local/florida-breaks-single-day-covid-19-record-with-75900-cases/AYK7G3KVVRHMBLL6WUCJWKTMYY/?outputType=amp>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-15"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state).

**Archived source account.** New York reports a new record of 85,476 cases, with 22% of all tests being positive.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/01/01/world/omicron-covid-vaccine-tests>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada / COVID-19 pandemic in New Brunswick.

**Archived source account.** New Brunswick premier Blaine Higgs tests positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/new-brunswick/nb-covid-19-roundup-dec-31-1.6301325>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-21"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** Paris begins to implement mandatory outdoor mask wearing for people over the age of 11 years. This comes as France reports a substantial increase in new cases of the Omicron variant nationwide.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20211230-paris-mandates-wearing-masks-even-outdoors-starting-friday>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-22"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France reports a record 232,200 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is also the highest daily total recorded in any European nation since the beginning of the pandemic.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1996106/world>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-24"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus.

**Archived source account.** Cyprus reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 5,048 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 166,827.

Source citations (as archived): [In-Cyprus](<https://in-cyprus.philenews.com/two-deaths-from-covid-and-another-new-record-number-of-new-cases-on-friday/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-26"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece.

**Archived source account.** Greece reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 40,560 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,170,293.

Source citations (as archived): [Greek Reporter](<https://greekreporter.com/2021/12/31/new-covid-19-record-set-as-40560-cases-announced-in-greece/>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-28"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italy reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 144,243 new cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [ANSA](<https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2021/12/31/covid-new-record-of-over-144000-new-cases_6216883c-990e-4064-a6c2-ff8ef9f4a526.html>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-30"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom, COVID-19 drug development.

**Archived source account.** The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency approves the use of Pfizer's anti-viral oral drug Paxlovid for high-risk patients.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/paxlovid-covid-pill-pfizer-uk-b1984885.html>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-32"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand moves COVID-19 traffic light settings for Auckland from red to orange, allowing bars, restaurants and cafes that enforce the vaccine pass requirement to remove crowd size limits and requirements to sit down, despite fears of community transmission of the Omicron variant.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/dec/31/new-zealand-eases-covid-crowd-rules-in-time-for-new-years-eve-despite-omicron-scare>).

<a id="event-2021-12-31-1-34"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Niger.

**Archived source account.** Niger reports its first case of the Omicron variant in the capital Niamey.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/niger-sees-1st-case-of-omicron-coronavirus-variant-/2462403>).
